src: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse matshwenyego a yona tebang le dikhuduego tsa fa gautshwane tse di bakileng go ngala tiro le go kgoreletsa tlhagiso kwa Moepong wa Lonmin kwa Marikana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukukhathazeka kwayo yimigushuzo yabasebenzi baseLonmin kumgodi oseMarikana kutshanje, ekhokelele ekubeni bazibeke phantsi izixhobo zokusebenza nto leyo iphazamise imveliso.

src: Go begwa fa mooko wa kgotlhang e le ntlha ya kemedi e kgolo go gaisa e e akaretsang Mokgatlho wa Bosetšhaba wa Badiramoepong (NUM) le Mokgatlho wa Meepo le Boagi (AMCU).Kabinete e ikuela kwa boeteledipeleng jwa mekgatlho ka bobedi (NUM le AMCU) go rarabolola dikgotlhang tsa bona ka kagiso le go baya dikgatlhegelo tsa naga le badiri godimo ga tsotlhe.
tgt: Kukho ingxelo yokuba oku kungaboni ngasonye kumalunga nemiba yokumelwa kwiiManyano ezibizwa ngokuthi yiNational Union of Mineworkers (NUM) kunye ne-Association for Mining and Construction Union (AMCU).IKhabhinethi ibongoza iinkokeli zezi manyano (i-NUM kunye ne-AMCU) ukuba zikusombulule ukungaboni ngasonye ngoxolo zicingele ilizwe nabasebenzi ngaphezu kwayo yonke into.

src: Badiri ba tshwanetse go lemoga gore mogwanto yo o sa sireletsegang o ka nna le ditlamorago tse di bosula mo badiring le mo isagong ya meepo le ditiro tsa bone.
tgt: Abasebenzi kufuneka baqonde ukuba ugwayimbo olungekho mthethweni lunganeziphumo ezimandundu kungekho kubo kuphela, kodwa kuchaphazele nekamva lomgodi kunye nemisebenzi yabo.

src: Gape Kabinete e ikuela kwa botsamaising jwa Lonmin go dira tsotlhe tse di kgonegang go netefatsa gore mathata a rarabololwa ka bonako jo bo ka kgonegang kwa ntle ga ditshenyegelo tse dingwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekwabongoza abalawuli baseLonmin ukuba benze konke abanakho ukuqinisekisa ukuba iingxaki zisonjululwa kamsinyane kangangoko nangaphandle komonakalo.

src: Go mo dikgatlhegong tsa naga le mekgatlho ka bobedi mmogo le botsamaisi jwa Lonmin go supa boeteledipele jo bo tlhokegang le tsamaiso ya dikamano tsa badiri.
tgt: Kubalulekile kakhulu kwilizwe lethu ukuba zombini ezi manyano kunye nabalawuli baseLonmin babonise ubunkokeli obufunekayo nobufanelekileyo kunye nolawulo lobudlelwane kwezoshishino.

src: Kabinete e tshegetsa ka botlalo diphitlhelelo tsa pulamadibogo tsa patlisiso ya go tsuruma go go sa letlelelwang ga sefofane sa banamedi kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Sesole jwa Waterkloof.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izixhasa ngokupheleleyo iziphumo eziyintshayelelo ezivela kuphando lokuchopha ngokungekho mthethweni nangokungagunyaziswanga kwenqwelontaka yokuthwala abantu abangewona malungu ombutho womkhosi kwisikhululo soMkhosi woKhuselo iWaterkloof Air Force Base.

src: Kabinete e gateletse gore pabalesego le go ikemela ga Aforika Borwa go botlhokwa thata.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi igxininisa ukuba ukhuseleko nokuzimela koMzantsi Afrika kubaluleke kakhulu.

src: Go tshwanetse ga samaganwa le kgatako ya melao le melawana e e malebana le matseno le ditlamelo tsa botlhokwa tsa setšhaba ka tsepamo, kwa ntle ga letshogo gongwe go direla yo mongwe molemo.
tgt: Ukophulwa kwemithetho nemiqathango elawula amazibuko okungena kweli kunye neendawo zobuchule besizwe ezibalulekileyo kufuneka kujongwane nako ngqongqo nangaphandle kokoyika nokwenzelelelwa.

src: Ba go fitlhelwang ba tlola gongwe ba nyatsa melawana ba tshwanetse go lebagana le bogale jotlhe jwa molao.
tgt: Abo bafunyaniswe njengabophule imithetho nemiqathango baza kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Kabinete e amogela tiro ya Mafapha a Puso e e begilweng ke Ditona tse di farologaneng ka nako ya Ditekanyetsokabo tsa mafapha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawamkela umsebenzi wamaSebe kaRhulumente njengoko iingxelo zawo zithiwe thaca ngaBaphathiswa abohlukileyo ngexesha leeVoti zoHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore go begwa ga Ditekanyetsokabo go thusa go maatlafatsa baagi ka tshedimosetso le go rwesa puso maikarabelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba usasazo olwenziwayo lwezi Voti lunceda ekuxhobiseni abemi ngolwazi kunye nokunyanzela urhulumente athathe uxanduva anike neempendulo.

src: Kabinete e amogela dipuisano tse di lebisitseng kwa go sekegiweng ga dikgato tsa ngongorego magareng ga Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le Mokgatlho wa Temokerasi wa Barutabana wa Aforika BorwaKabinete e ikuela mo batsayakarolong botlhe mo lephateng la thuto go rarabolola dikgotlhang tsa bone gore thuto ya bana e se ke ya amega.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo phakathi kweSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko kunye nemanyano yootitshala i-South African Democratic Teacherr’s Union ezikhokelele ekuxhonyweni koqhankqalazo.

src: Kabinete e itemogetse Tshekatsheko ya Kotara ya Palo ya Badiri e e bontshang koketsego ya seelo sa botlhokatiro go tloga go diphesente di le 24,9 go ya go diphesente di le 25,2.Puso e akofisa dikgato di tshwana le letsholo le le eteletsweng pele ke mmuso la mafaratlhatlha, go oketsa ditiro ka ditsereganyo tsa Lephata la Setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abachaphazelekayo kwicandelo lezemfundo ukuba basombulule ukungaboni ngasonye ukuze imfundo yabantwana bethu ingabi sengozini.

src: Puso mmogo le lephata la badiri le kgwebo, ba tlhomile Tumelano ya Loago ya Go Thapiwa ga Bašwa ka Moranang 2013.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele uPhando lwekota lwaBasebenzi (i-QLFS) olubonisa ukwanda kwentswela-ngqesho ukusuka kwiipesenti ezingama-24,9 ukuya kwezingama-25,2.URhulumente ukhawulezisa amanyathelo afana nephulo leziseko eziluncedo nezophuhliso elikhokelwa ngurhulumente ukwandisa imisebenzi ngokungenelela kwamaCandelo kaRhulumente.

src: E tlhalosa maikano a maphata a a farologaneng tebang le go tsayakarolo mo go lwantsheng botlhokatiro jwa bašwa ka dipeelo tse di tsepameng le nako e e beilweng go lebeletswe tiragatso, tlhokomelo mmogo le tshekatsheko e e tlhakanetsweng ya ditsereganyo tse di supilweng.
tgt: URhulumente esebenzisana nezabasebenzi kunye noshishino basungule iSivumelwano sokuQeshwa koLutsha kuTshazimpunzi wama-2013.

src: Kabinete e na le bonnete jwa gore dikgato tse di setseng di tsentswe tirisong di tla thusa naga go tlhama ditiro tse dintšhwa le go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo tse di totilweng tsa ditiro tse dintšhwa di le dimilione di le tlhano ka 2020.
tgt: Oku kusekwabonisa ukuzinikela ngokuhlangeneyo ekushukuxeni umba wentswela-ngqesho.

src: Kabinete e amogela go saeniwa ga leano la tiragatso go tsenya tirisong Memorantamo wa Ditumelano o o ka ga Tshomarelo le Tshireletso ya Ditshedi tse di Farologaneng magareng ga Aforika Borwa le Vietnam.
tgt: Kucacisa ukuzinikela kwecandelo ngalinye ekwenzeni igalelo ekulweni nokungaphangeli kolutsha ngokujolisa kokubonakalayo kunye nexesha eliza kuthathwa ukuze kuphunyezwe ngempumelelo, ukongamela kunye nokuhlola kokungenelela okuchongiweyo.

src: Leano la Tiragatso le tla dira go fitlha ka 2017 mme le tla thusa maiteko a go lwantsha bosenyi jo bo amang diphologolo tsa naga, bogolo segolo bogodu jwa go tumola dinaka tsa ditshukudu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isaqinisekile ukuba amanyathelo asele ethathiwe aza kuncedisa ilizwe lidale imisebenzi emitsha kunye nokufikelela kokujoliswe kuko okuyimisebenzi ezizigidi ezintlanu ungekafiki owama-2020.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa gore Puso e itlamile go samagana le leroborobo la bogodu jwa go tumola dinaka tsa ditshukudu mme e boa e itlama gore ba ba molato ba tla sekisiwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yamkele ukutyikitywa kwesicwangciso sokusebenza ukuphumeza iMemorandam yokuQondwa nokuLondolozwa kweNdalo eyoHlukahlukileyo phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye neVietnam.

src: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae go lekeletsa Thulaganyo ya karata ya Boitshupo, e e gokaganyang boitshupo jwa rona jwa bosetšhaba mme e tokafatse tshireletsego ya bosetšhaba.
tgt: IsiCwangciso sokuPhumeza siza kuqhuba kude kube ngonyaka wama-2017 kwaye siza kuncedisa kwiinzame zokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho oluquka izilwanyana zasendle, ingakumbi ukubulawa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni.

src: Go na le kgonagalo ya gore phitlhelelo eno ya botlhokwa e ka akofisa ditirelo tsa puso, fa e tla bo e fokotsa bosenyi le bobodu jo bo amanang le makwaloitshupo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi iyaphinda igxininisa ukuba uRhulumente uzinikele ekushukuxeni ukubulawa kwemikhombe kwaye ungqina ukuba abo bophulimthetho baza kutshutshiswa.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go tshegetsa tsamaiso eno gore ka 2020 rotlhe re bo re amogetse Karata ya Boitshupo jaaka karolo ya boitshupo jwa bosetšhaba.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yamkele isibhengezo esenziwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya lokuqalisa iphulo lokusebenzisa inkqubo yesazisi esilicwecwe, nto leyo isimanya njengesizwe esinye kunye nokhuseleko lwesizwe.

src: Kabinete e nyatsa tlhaselo e e bakileng dintsho tsa kgosi ya morafe le modiri wa kagiso wa Itopia mo mokolokong wa Ditšhabakopano kwa Abyei, Sudan.
tgt: Eli linyathelo elingundoqo nelinamandla okukhawulezisa iinkonzo zikarhulumente, lo gama linciphisa ulwaphulomthetho norhwaphilizo olubandakanya izasizi.

src: Tiragalo eno e e swabisang e tshosetsa go tsepama ga Abyei gammogo le tswelelopele e e sa tswang go fitlhelelwa ke Sudan le Sudan o o kwa Borwa.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase le nkqubo ukuze ngonyaka wama-2020 sonke sibe sesilifumene icwecwe lesazisi njengendlela yokuzazisa kwesizwe.

src: Kabinete e nyatsa tlhaselo ya Seria e e dirilweng ke masole a tshireletso a Iseraele.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ilugxeka kakhulu uhlaselo lwezithuthi ezikhaphayo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo e-Abyei, eSudan, olube neziphumo zokusweleka kwenkokeli yemveli kunye nomgcinixolo wase-Ethiopia.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go Ditšhabakopano go netefatsa gore maphata a kwa ntle a tlotla go ikemela ga Seria le go letla maSeria go dira mmogo go rarabolola dikgotlhang tsa ona.
tgt: Esi sehlo silusizi sibeka emngciphekweni uzinzo lwase-Abyei kwakunye nenkqubela ezuzwe kutshanje yiSudan noMzantsi Sudan.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhomiwa ga Moatefokate Lawrence Mushwana jaaka Modulasetilo o montšhwa wa Komiti ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Kgokaganyo (ICC) ya Ditheo tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Tsweletso le Tshireletso ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ichasa uhlaselo lwaseSyria ngamajoni omkhosi wokhuselo akwaSirayeli.

src: Ke la ntlha Aforika e etelela pele kantoro ya Modulasetilo wa ICMaemo a Modulasetilo wa ICC a netefatsa tebo e e oketsegileng mo rekotong ya ditshwanelo tsa botho ya naga gammogo le kobamelo ya yona ya maitlamo a boditšhabatšhaba a ditshwanelo tsa botho.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kwiZizwe eziManyeneyo ukuba zicenge imikhosi yangaphandle ukuba ihloniphe ukuzimela kweSyria kunye nokuvumela abemi baseSyria basebenze bebonke ukusombulula ukungaboni ngasonye kwabo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse segopotso sa bo 50 sa Mokgatlho wa Tshwaragano ya Aforika (OAU) se se tla ketikiwang ka Letsatsi la Aforika, la bo 25 Motsheganong 2013.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yamkele ukumiselwa nokubekwa kuka-Advocate Lawrence Mushwana njengomtsha uSihlalo weKomiti yaMazwe ngaMazwe (ICC) yamaZiko eSizwe okuXhasa nokuKhusela amaLungelo Oluntu.

src: Kabinete e sedifaditse gore kemonokeng ya OAU ya go se akaretse puso ya tlhaolele mo ditokololong tsa yona e maatlafaditse kgaratlho ya rona ya kgololesego le phitlhelelo ya temokerasi.
tgt: Isikhundla sikaSihlalo wale komiti siqinisekisa ukwandiswa kwengqalelo kwimbali yamalungelo oluntu eli lizwe kunye nokuthotyelwa kwembophelelo zamalungelo oluntu ngamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla golagana le kontinete go keteka Segopotso sa bo 50 sa Tshwaragano ya Aforika.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yamkele isikhumbuzo sama-50 eminyaka yoMbutho weManyano yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-OAU) esiza kubhiyozelwa ngoSuku lwe-Afrika umhla wama-25 kuCanzibe wama-2013.IKhabhinethi iqaqambise ukuba ubunye be-OAU nokumkhetha urhulumente wengcinezelo ukuba ungabi lilungu lawo kwawuphakamisa umzabalazo wenkululeko kunye nokufumaneka kwentando yesininzi.

src: Ditiragalo di akaretsa dipontsho tsa kgwedi yotlhe tsa botsweretshipono mo kgaolong ya SADC go tloga ka la bo 24 Motsheganong go fitlha ka la bo 28 Seetebosigo 2013.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuzimanya nelizwekazi ekubhiyozeleni isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-50 yeMbumba yase-Afrika.

src: Setheo sa tsa Aforika sa Aforika Borwa se tla kokoanya barutegi le ba ditšhaba jaaka karolo ya segopotso ka la bo 19-21 Motsheganong 2013.
tgt: Imibhiyozo iquka umbukiso wobugcisa bale mihla oza kuthatha inyanga yonke kwingingqi yaMazantsi e-Afrika ukususela ngomhla wama-24 kuCanzibe ukuya kowama-28 kweyeSilimela wama-2013.

src: Godimo ga moo, go tla nna le dipontsho kwa Musiamong wa Ditsong (Motsemogolo wa Tshwane) go keteka Letsatsi la Aforika ka la bo 21 Motsheganong 2013 ka moono wa "Dingwaga tse 50 morago ga go tlhamiwa ga OAU - Aforika e tshwanetse go tshwaragana kgotsa e nyelele."
tgt: IZiko le-Afrika eliseMzantsi Afrika liza kuhlanganisa uluntu oluzingcungela kwezemfundo kunye nezizwe zase-Afrika njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yesikhumbuzo ngomhla we-19-21 kuCanzibe wama-2013.

src: Seno se tla latelwa ke konsarata ya mmino ya Letsatsi la Aforika kwa Union Buildings ka la bo 25 Motsheganong 2013.
tgt: Ngaphaya koko, kuza kubakho umbukiso kwiziko lamagugu iDitsong (kwisiXeko saseTshwane) ukukhumbula uSuku lwe-Afrika ngomhla wama-21 kuCanzibe wama-2013 phantsi komxholo osihloko sithi “Iminyaka engama-50 emva kokusekwa koMbutho weManyano yaMazwe ase-Afrika – i-Afrika mayimanyane okanye iTshabalale” Oku kuza kulandelwa yikonsathi yomculo woSuku lwe-Afrika kwiZakhiwo zoMdibaniso ngomhla wama-25 kuCanzibe wama-2013.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsibogelo ya ka bonako ya Moporesitente Jacob Zuma mo taletsong ya moagi gore a etele batho ba kwa Eldorado Park le ba kwa Kliptown e e gaufi, ka Labobedi, la bo 14 Motsheganong 2013.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yamkele ukusabela ngokukhawuleza kukaMongameli uJacob Zuma kwisimemo selungu loluntu sokundwendwela abahlali base-Eldorado Park kunye nabaseKliptown ngoLwesibini, umhla we-14 kuCanzibe.

src: Kopo ya baagi e ne e le malebana le go buisanela go gola ga kgwebo e e seng mo molaong ya diritibatsi le bothata jwa tiriso ya tsone e e botlhaswa mo tikologong eo.
tgt: Isicelo sabahlali yayisesokuxoxa ngokwanda kokuthutyeleziswa kweziyobisi okungekho mthethweni kunye nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi kulo mmandla.

src: Puso, mmogo le baagi, ba itlamile go akofisa lenaneo la tsereganyo go emisa leroborobo le le bolayang bašwa.
tgt: URhulumente, kunye nolu luntu, luzinikele ekukhawuleziseni inkqubo yongenelelo ukuphelisa olu lwaphulo-mthetho lutshabalalisa abantu abatsha.

src: Kabinete e amogetse ketelo ya tatediso ya Motlatsamoporesitente Motlanthe, a patilwe ke baeteledipele ba magato a le mararo a puso, go ya kwa De Doorns kwa Kapa Bophirima ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 11 Motsheganong 2013.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi yamkele utyelelo olulandelayo olwenziwe nguSekela Mongameli uMotlanthe, ekhatshwa ziinkokeli zamanqanaba amathathu karhulumente besiya eDe Doorns eNtshona Koloni ngoMgqibelo umhla we-11 kuCanzibe wama-2013.

src: Ketelo le dipuisano le baamegi ba ba akaretsang badiri ba dipolase e latela ketelo ya ntlha ya Motlatsamoporesitente ka la bo 12 Tlhakole 2013.
tgt: Utyelelo nengxoxo kunye nabachaphazelekayo kuquka abasebenzi basezifama sisiphumo sotyelelo lokuqala lukaSekela Mongameli ngomhla we-12 kweyoMdumba wama-2012.

src: Go lemogilwe tswelelopele e e tsepameng ya go tokafatsa ditirelo mo tikolong eo go tswa mo mafapheng a le mmalwa.
tgt: Kuqatshelwe inkqubela eluqilima evela kwiqela lamaSebe kaRhulumente ekuphuculeni ukuziswa kweenkonzo kulo mmandla.

src: Maitlamo a a bontshitsweng ke maphata otlhe ke motheo wa dipuisano tse di tswelelang go lebeletswe gore go nne le lephata la leruri la temothuo.
tgt: Oku kuzinikela kubonakaliswe ngawo onke amaqela kwakha isiseko esiluqilima sothethathethwano olusingise kwicandelo lezolimo elizinzileyo.

src: Dipuisano le ditshweetso tsa botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka dithulaganyo tsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana (CPW) magareng ga 27 Motsheganong le 2 Seetebosigo 2013 ka moono wa "Re dira mmogo go sireletsa bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yenzelwe amagqabantshintshi ngamalungiselelo eVeki yoKhuseleko lwaBantwana (i-CPW) phakathi komhla wama-27 kuCanzibe kunye nowe-2 kweyeSilimela wama-2013, phantsi komxholo osihloko sithi “Sisebenza sisonke ukukhusela abantwana.”Iingxoxo ngabantwana nolutsha ziyaqhuba kuwo onke amaphondo njengentshayelelo esingise ekusungulweni kweVeki yoKhuseleko lwaBantwana kunye neNkomfa Njengenxalenye yokuhlumisa ukuqondwa, iVeki yoKhuseleko lwaBantwana iza kusungulwa kunye neNkomfa yeeNkedama, aBantwana noLutsha olusesiChengeni (OVCY) ngomhla wama-27 kuCanzibe kwiZiko leeNkomfa zaMazwe ngaMazwe Inkosi Albert Luthuli KwaZulu-Natal.

src: "Go tsweletswe ka dipuisano tsa bana le bašwa mo diporofenseng tsotlhe go baakanyetsa go tlhomiwa ga CPW le Khonferense.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe negalelo ekukhuseleni abantwana bethu kunye nokudala iindawo ezisingqongileyo ukuba zibe zezinokhuselo nezikhuselekileyo.

src: Jaaka karolo ya go oketsa temogo, CPW e tla tlhomiwa mmogo le Khonferense ya Dikhutsana, Bana le Bašwa ba ba mo Matshosetsing (OVYC), ka la bo 27 Motsheganong kwa Tikwatikweng ya Bosetšhaba ya Dikopano ya Inkosi Albert Luthuli kwa KwaZulu Natal.
tgt: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bangayibonakalisa inkxaso yabo ngokuqhoboshela umtya weribhoni oluhlaza njengophawu lobomi, ukukhula, ithemba, inkathalo kunye nenkxaso yeenkokeli zexesha elizayo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go tshayakarolo mo tshireletsong ya bana ba rona le go tlhama tikologo e e babalesegileng e bile e sireletsegile.
tgt: Ingqalelo yeVeki yoKhuseleko lwaBantwana neNkomfa yeeNkedama, aBantwana noLutsha olusesiChengeni isekuthatheni kwabantwana inxaxheba kuluntu lwethu kunye nasekuhlaleni ukuze abantwana bakwazi ukumanyelwa kwimiba ebachaphazelayo.

src: Kabinete e rebotse Letlhomeso la Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya Boruatlhapi (NAPF).
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo weNkcubeko yaseManzini yeSizwe (i-NAPF).

src: Pholisi eno e tlamela ka letlhomeso le le kopaneng la go tlhamiwa le go tlhabololwa ga intaseteri e e tsayang karolo mo go tlhamiweng ga ditiro tsa leruri mmogo le dipeeletso tse di oketsegileng.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngenkqubo-sikhokelo yomanyano yokusekwa nophuhliso loshishino olunegalelo ekudalweni kwemisebenzi ezinzileyo kunye nokwanda kotyalomali.

src: NAPF e tlhamilwe go lebeletswe lephata la boruatlhapi le le itemogetseng koketsego ya go batlega ga dikuno tsa ditlhapi.
tgt: I-NAPF yasekwa kujongwe kwimvelaphi yecandelo lenkcubeko yasemanzini kwihlabathi ethe yaphantsi koxinzelelo lokufunwa kweemveliso ezilotyiweyo.

src: Mo Aforika Borwa, boruatlhapi jwa mo lewatleng le mo metsing a a foreše bo tlamela ka tšhono e e siameng ya go atolosa tlhagiso ya ditlhapi go kgotsofatsa tlhokego ya selegae, go tsayakarolo mo tlhagisong e e sa tlhaeleng ya dijo, go tlhama ditiro, go tlhabolola ikonomi mmogo le go tlhabolola metseselegae, gammogo le ditšhono tsa thomelontle.
tgt: EMzantsi Afrika, inkcubeko yamanzi aselwandle nahambayo izisa ithuba elihle kakhulu lwemveliso yeentlanzi ezohlukileyo ukwanelisa iimfuno zasekuhlaleni, ukuze zibe negalelo ekubeni kubekho ukutya, ukudala imisebenzi, uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nolwasemaphandleni kunye namathuba okuthumela le mveliso kwamanye amazwe.

src: Kabinete e rebotse gore Aforika Borwa, e eteletswe pele ke Lefapha la Temothuo, Jalo ya Dikgwa le Bodirelatlhapi, e amogele Khonferense ya Boraro ya Lefatshe ya Temothuo, Tlhagiso e e sa Tlhaeleng ya Dijo le Phetogo ya Tlelaemete mo kotareng ya bone ya 2013.Tlhagiso e e sa tlhaeleng ya dijo e sa ntse e le ntlha e e tshwenyang go gaisa mme Khonferense e tla nna le ditlamorago tse di siameng tebang le ka moo re tlhagisang, re tsamaisang le go dirisa dijo ka gona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ithuba loMzantsi Afrika lokusindleka iNkomfa yeHlabathi yesiThathu kwezoLimo, ukubaKho koKutya kunye noGuquguquko lweMozulu kwikota yesine kunyaka wama-2013, ikhokelwa liSebe lezoLimo, amaHlathi nezokuLoba.

src: Fa e sa le ka COP17/MP7, Aforika Borwa e ntse e le nngwe ya dinaga tse di eteletseng pele mo go tsweletseng temothuo e e botlhale e e tsibogelang dikgwetlho tsa go nna teng ga dijo mmogo le phetogo ya tlelaemete.
tgt: Ukubakho kokutya kusengumngeni okhathazayo kwaye le Nkomfa iza kuba nefuthe eliphilileyo kwindlela yokuvelisa, ulawulo kunye nokusetyenziswa kokutya.

src: Maikaelelo a Khonferense ya Lefatshe ke go tlhama mekgwa ya kgolo e e ka dirisegang go ya go ile mo loagong le mo tikologong.
tgt: Okoko kwange--COP17/CMP7, uMzantsi Afrika lelinye lamazwe akhokeleyo ekuxhaseni ezolimo kusetyenziswa imozulu ngobukrelekrele, nelithi lisabele kwimingeni yobukho bokutya kunye noguquguquko lwemozulu.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tlhomamiso ya Aforika Borwa ya Mametlelelo ya Tlhokomelo ya Ditshedi le Tlhokomelo ya Dijalo (SPS) mo Mametlelelong ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya Dinaga tsa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) le gore e isiwe kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: INkomfa yeHlabathi ijolise ekuphuhliseni iintlobo zokuhluma ezizinzileyo xa kujongwe ekuhlaleni nakokusingqongileyo.

src: Molao wa Kgwebisano ya SADC e Aforika Borwa e dumelaneng nayo e tsweletsa tirisanommogo ya kgaolo le kgolagano magareng ga dinaga tse e leng ditokololo malebana le kgwebisano ya dithoto le ditirelo mo kgaolong, go akarediwa dikumo tsa temothuo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele isiqinisekiso soMzantsi Afrika seSihlomelo soCoceko kunye noCoceko oluhlanganisiweyo kwiCandelo loPhuhliso lwaMazwe ase-Afrika eseMazantsi (i-SADC) kwezoRhwebo ukuba sifakwe ePalamente.

src: Mametlelelo ya SADC SPC ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya SADC e tlamela ka letlhomeso le le kgontshang tirisanommogo ya SPGape e tsweletsa kgokaganyo ya dikgato tsa SPS tse di ikaegileng ka seemo le kaedi ya boditšhabatšhaba go gokaganya kgwebisano e e babalesegileng le e e sa gobeleleng ya dikuno tsa temothuo mo kgaolong.
tgt: ISivumelwano soMnqophiso se-SADC apho uMzantsi Afrika uvume khona sinceda ekuxhaseni intsebenziswano kunye nokuhlangana kwezizwe ezingamalungu ukuze zirhwebelane ngempahla neenkonzo kwingingqi, kuquka iimveliso zezolimo.

src: Kabinete e sedimoseditswe ka tswelelopele e e amanang le go amogela Dikopano tsa Aforika Borwa ka ga Sekema sa Ditifikeiti tsa Tiragatso sa Kimberley (KPCS), go simolola ka la bo 4 go fitlha ka la bo 7 Seetebosigo le Kopano ya KPCS kwa Gauteng go tloga ka la bo 26 go fitlha ka la bo 29 Ngwanaitseele 2013.
tgt: Isihlomelo se-SADC SPS kwiSivumelwano soMnqophiso se-SADC kwezoRhwebo sibonelela ngenkqubo-sikhokelo esebenzayo yentsebenziswano.

src: Go amogelwa ga dikopano tsa KPCS go tla tsayakarolo mo tsweletsong ya intaseteri ya ditaemane le bojanala.
tgt: Sisekwaxhasa amanyathelo emvisiswano yeSPS asekwe kwimigangatho yamazwe ngamazwe kunye nesikhokelo ukuze kuququzelelwe urhwebo lweemveliso zezolimo olukhuselekileyo nolunobulungisa kwingingqi.

src: Maemo a Aforika Borwa jaaka modulasetilo wa KPCS a lemoga seabe se segolo se Aforika Borwa e nang naso mo lephateng la boditšhabatšhaba la ditaemane.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi ifumene uhlaziyo ngenkqubela yeentlanganiso ezimalunga nokusindleka koMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo yokuQinisekiswa eKimberley yowama-2013 (KPCS) eziquka intlanganiso yeseshoni eKimberley ukususela ngomhla we-4 ukuya kowe-7 kweyeSilimela kunye neNtlanganiso eseGauteng ukususela kumhla wama-26 ukuya kowama-29 kweyeNkanga wama-2013.

src: Jaaka modulasetilo, Aforika Borwa o ikaelela go maatlafatsa dikamano tsa kgwebo tsa boditšhabatšhaba ka maikaelelo a go golaganya le go oketsa seabe sa Aforika mo KPC le go tsayakarolo mo tikologong e e babalesegileng ya lefatshe.
tgt: Ukusindlekwa kweentlanganiso zeKPCS kuza kuba negalelo ekuxhaseni ushishino lwedayimani kunye nokhenketho.

src: Kabinete e rebotse go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Pusetso ya Ditshwanelo tsa Lefatshe wa 2013, le Memorantamo o o ka ga Maitlhomo a Molaotlhomo, gore baagi ba tshwaele.
tgt: Isikhundla soMzantsi Afrika njengoSihlalo weKPCS sinakana indima engundoqo edlalwa nguMzantsi Afrika kwicandelo ledayimani lamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Seno se diragatsa kitsiso ya Moporesitente ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya 2013 malebana le dipaakanyo tse di tshitshintsweng mo go Molao wa Pusetso ya Lefatshe.
tgt: Njengosihlalo, uMzantsi Afrika unenjongo zokomeleza ubudlelwane borhwebo kumazwe ngamazwe, kujongwe ekuhlanganiseni nasekwandiseni umzila we-Afrika kwiKPCS kunye nokwenza igalelo kukhuseleko lokusingqongileyo ehlabathini.

src: Seno se amana le go atolosiwa ga letlha la go tsenya dkopo tsa pusetso ya lefatshe, go kgontsha ba ba sa kgonang go tsenya dkopoi ka letlha la go tswala la bo 31 Sedimonthole 1998 gongwe ba ba neng ba sa akarediwa mo tsamaisong, go dira jalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukupapashwa koMthetho Sihlomelo wokuBuyiselwa kwamaLungelo oMhlaba kubaniniwo wama-2013, kunye neMemorandam yeeNjongo zoMthetho osaYilwayo ukuze uluntu luphefumle.

src: Go bulwa gape ga go tsenngwa ga dkopo go kaelwa ke ponelopele ya Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mmogo le Lenaneo le le Akaretsang la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le maano a mangwe a kgolo a a ikaeletseng go tsweletsa poelano ya bosetšhaba le tomagano ya loago.
tgt: Oku kunika ifuthe kwisibhengezo esenziwa kwiNtetho kaMongameli engoBume beSizwe yowama-2013 sesindululo sokuhlomela uMthetho wokuBuyiselwa kwamaLungelo oMhlaba kubaniniwo.

src: Kabinete e rebotse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Tlhaeletsano ya Eleketeroniki kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Oku kunxulumene nokwandiswa kwexesha lokufaka amabango okubuyiselwa komhlaba ukwenzela ukuba abo bangazange bawafake amabango abo ngomhla wokuvala umhla wama-31 kweyoMnga we-1998 okanye abo bavalelwa ngaphandle kule nkqubo bafake amabango abo.

src: Paakanyo e tlhodilwe ke kgololesego ya lephata la tlhaeletsano ya eleketeroniki mmogo le kgolo e e bonako ya thekenoloji e e dirang gore go nna teng ga ditlamelo dingwe tsa Molao ono go se ke ga nna mosola.
tgt: Ukuvulwa kokufakwa kwamabango kukhokelwa ngumbono wesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwakunye neNkqubo eBanzi yoPhuhliso lwaMaphandle kunye nobunye ubuchule bokukhula ekulindeleke ukuba buxhase uxolelwaniso lwesizwe kunye nobunye kwezentlalo.

src: Paakanyo e ikaelela go samagana le tekanyetso ya tsweletso ya kgaisano, phitlhelelo ya mafaratlhatlha a tlhaeletsano ya eleketeroniki, ditshenyegelo tsa eleketeroniki mmogo le go tokafatsa nako ya tsamaiso ya patloditirelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukufakwa koMthetho Sihlomelo woNxibelelwano ngeKhompyutha ePalamente.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Paakanyo o lepalepanya Molao le molao wa maatlafatso e e atolositsweng ya ikonomi ya bantsho o tokafatsa dintlha tsa dilaesense o tokafatsa ditlamelo tsa dikgaisano o tlosa dikgoreletsi tsa taolo mme o na le tlamelo ya merero e e amanang le tseno.
tgt: Esi Sihlomelo sibangelwe yinkululeko kwicandelo lonxibelelwano ngeekhompyutha kunye nokuhambela phambili kobuchwepheshe ngokukhawuleza okuthe kwabangela ubukho bezinye izibonelelo zoMthetho zingasebenzi.

src: Kabinete e rebotse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Bothati jo bo Ikemetseng jwa Tlhaeletsano jwa Aforika Borwa (ICASA) kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Esi Sihlomelo sinqwenela ukujongana nokhuphiswano oluxhasa imida, ukufikelela kwiziseko eziluncedo nophuhliso lonxibelelwano ngeekhompyutha, iindleko zonxibelelwano kwakunye nokuphuculwa kwexesha elithathwayo kwinkqubo yothethathethwano.

src: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng o tsibogela dingwe tsa dintlha tse di mo NDP.
tgt: Esi Sihlomelo silungelelanisa uMthetho kunye noMthetho olawula uqoqosho ngokubanzi lwamashishini abantsundu, uhluza imiba yokunikezelwa kwempephamvume, uphucula ukubonelelwa kokhuphiswano, ususa ukungahambeli ndawo okubangelwa yimiqathango kwaye ubonelela ngemiba enxulumene noko.

src: Dipaakanyo tsa Molao wa Bothati jo bo Ikemetseng jwa Tlhaeletsano wa bo 13 wa 2002 (Molao wa ICASA) di tshegeditswe ke tlhokego ya ditokafatso tsa setheo go maatlafatsa Bothati jo bo Ikemetseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukufakwa koMthetho Sihlomelo weGunyabantu loNxibelelwano oluziMeleyo laseMzantsi Afrika (ICASA) ePalamente.

src: Seno e tla nna ka go sedifadiwa ga dintlha tsa maatla a jona go lepalepanya Molao thata le ditlhokego tsa Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Ditšhelete tsa Setšhaba le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa bona.
tgt: Lo Mthetho Sihlomelo usabela kweminye imiba equlethwe kwi-NDEzi zihlomelo zoMthetho we-ICASA zixhasa iingxoxo zemfuneko yokuphuculwa kwamaziko ukomeleza iGunyabantu eliziMeleyo.

src: Seo se dirwa go totilwe go tokafatsa maikarabelo le go direla dilo mo pepeneneng e leng se se tla tsayang karolo mo taolong e e lolameng mo teng ga ICASA.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenziwa ngokubonelela ngengcaciso kwimiba ephathelele kwigunya lalo ukulungelelanisa uMthetho ukhawulelane neemfuneko zoMthetho woLawulo LweziMali zikaRhulumente (PFMA) kunye nokuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle kwawo.

src: Puso e tshwanetse go nna le seabe se se golwane go netefatsa gore lephata la tlhaeletsano ya eleketoroniki le laolwa ka tsela e e tshegetsang maitlhomo a bosetšhaba ka kakaretso.
tgt: Oku kungenjongo yokuphucula ukusabela nokuphendula kunye nokusebenza elubala okuya kuba negalelo kwindlela yolawulo olusemgangathweni kwi-ICASA.

src: Seno ga se a tshwanela go tsewa e le tshitshinyo ya go lekanyetsa go ikemela ga ICASA.
tgt: Urhulumente unqwenela ukudlala indima enkulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lonxibelelwano ngekhompyutha lilawulwa ngendlela exhasa iinjongo zesizwe ngokubanzi.

src: Go ka se gatelelwe botlhokwa jwa bolaodi jo bo ikemetseng le jo bo sa tseyeng letlhakore jwa lephata la tlhaeletsano.
tgt: Oku makungafundwa ngendlela ecebisa ukuba kukho nawuphi na umda kwindlela i-ICASA isebenza ngayo.

src: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go nna kelotlhoko kgatlhanong le kgonagalo ya go tsoga gape ga bosenyi jwa tirisodikgoka jo bo totileng baditšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema uluntu ukuba lulwe nokuvumbuluka kolwaphulo-mthetho olunobundlobongela olujoliswe kubemi bamazwe angaphandle abakweli.

src: Kabinete e tila go ka re tirisodikgoka eno ke ya letlhoo la baditšhaba gonne bosupi jwa ga jaana bo supa gore ditiragalo tseno di susumediwa ke bosenyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulumkele ukuthiya obu bundlobongela njengobundlbongela boloyiko olungenasizathu sivakalayo lokudibana nabantu bamazwe angaphandle kuba ubungqina bokuqala bubonisa ukuba ezi zenzo zisenokuba ziqhutywa lulwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Kabinete e akgotse maphata a tiragatso ya molao ka ntlha ya dikgato tse di bonako le tse di maikaelelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma ii-arhente ezinyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa komthetho ngokuthi zisebenze kwakamsinyane nangokugqibeleleyo.

src: Kabinete e romela matshidiso kwa malapeng le kwa ditsaleng tsa makawana a a latlhegetsweng ke matshelo ka ntlha ya ditiro tse di seng maleba tsa go rupisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa uvelwano kwiintsapho nakubahlobo bamakhwenkwe asweleke ngenxa yokwaluswa ngendlela engafanelekanga.

src: Kabinete e amogela boikuelo jwa Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jwa gore go diragadiwe bosiamisi ka bonako mme e ikuela mo magosing le ditokololo tsa baagi go ema kgatlhanong le tshotlakako le botlhaswa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ingqina ikhwelo elihlatywe nguMongameli uJacob Zuma lobulungisa obukhawulezileyo kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo kwiinkokeli zemveli kunye namalungu oluntu ukuba balwe nokuxhatshazwa okanye ukungahoywa.

src: Puso e tshegetsa ditso tsa baagi ba rona ba ba farologaneng ka botlalo mme e gatelela gore di tshwanetse go lepalepana le ditshwanelo tsa molaotheo.
tgt: Urhulumente uwaxhasa ngokupheleleyo amasiko nenkcubeko yoluntu lwethu olohlukileyo kwaye uqaqambisa ukuba oko kulungelelaniswe namalungelo aqulethwe kuMgaqo-siseko.

src: Kabinete e amogetse seabe sa Aforika Borwa mo Samiting ya Tshwaragano ya Aforika (AU) fa gautshwane, moo Aforika Borwa e beetseng kwa pele dintlha di le mmalwa mo lenaneong la Samiti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele ukuthatha inxaxheba koMzantsi Afrika kwiNtlanganiso yaBaphathi baMazwe yeManyano ye-Afrika, apho uMzantsi Afrika ubeke phambili ukubaluleka kwemiba eliqela kwi-ajenda yale Ntlanganiso yaBaphathi baMazwe Oku kuquka isiCwangciso soBuchule seKomishoni yeManyano ye-Afrika seminyaka yama-2014 – 2017 kunye noHlahlo-lwabiwo-mali lweManyano ye-Afrika lonyaka wama-2014 imeko yoxolo nokhuselo lwe-Afrika eminye imithombo yenkxaso-mali yeManyano ye-Afrika i-Ajenda yoPhuhliso olusemva konyaka wama-2015 intlanganiso yaBaphathi baMazwe e-NEPAD kunye neKomiti yokuziQhelanisa kaRhulumente, kunye neNtlanganiso yeQela laBaphathi baMazwe neNdlela i-Afrika eHlaziya ubuHlobo kuwo.

src: Tsona di akareditse Leano la Togamaano la Khomišene ya AU mo pakeng ya 2014-2017 le Tekanyetsokabo ya AU ya 2015 seemo sa kagiso le pabalesego mo Aforika metswedi e mengwe ya tlamelo ka matlole ya AU Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la morago ga 2015 kopano ya Ditlhogo tsa Mebuso tsa Bodirisanimmogo jo Bontšhwa jwa Tlhabololo ya Aforika le Komiti ya Kitsiso ya Puso, mmogo le Samiti ya Foramo ya Thulaganyo ya Tshekatsheko ya Balekane ba Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income ubunkokheli boLuntu oluPhuhlayo lwaseMazantsi e-Afrika (SADC) ngokuququzelela inkqubo ekhokelele ukubeni i-Zimbabwe yamkele uMgaqo-siseko omtsha.

src: Kabinete e akgotse boeteledipele jwa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Aforika ka go gokaganya thulaganyo e e lebisitseng kwa goreng Zimbabwe e amogele Molaotheo o montšhwa.
tgt: UMgaqo-siseko wase-Zimbabwe uphawula indima ebalulekileyo ekuphumezeni ngempumelelo iSivumelwano soXolo seHlabathi.

src: Molaotheo wa Zimbabwe ke sesupo sa tswelelopele mo tiragatsong e e atlegang ya Tumelano ya Kagiso ya Lefatshe.
tgt: Kwilanga kanye elandulela iNyanga yoLutsha iKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo oluntu ukuba axhome umgangatho weenkqubo zokulwa nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi.

src: Pele fela ga Kgwedi ya Bašwa, Kabinete e ikuela mo dikarolong tsotlhe tsa baagi go godisa manaane a a lwantshang tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi.
tgt: Umxholo weNyanga yoLutsha uthi: “Sisebenza Sisonke ukuPhuhlisa uLutsha noMzantsi Afrika oKhululekileyo kwiZiyobisi.”Ukusebenza ngokugqibeleleyo kukarhulumente ukushukuxa ukusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi e-Eldorado Park, eGauteng, kusondeza abantu bale ngingqi kufutshane nokuzalisekisa uluntu olukhululekileyo kwiziyobisi.

src: Moono wa Kgwedi ya Bašwa ke: "Re Dira Mmogo go Tlhabolola Bašwa le go bona Aforika Borwa yo o se nang Diritibatsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela kwaye yamkela inkqubela eyenziwe ngamapolisa, iinkokeli zoluntu namanye amaziko e-Eldorado Park ngokukhokelwa nguRhulumente wePhondo laseGauteng.

src: "Kgato ya puso ya go samagana le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi kwa Eldorado Park kwa Gauteng, e atametsa batho ba lefelo le gaufi le go fitlhelela go nna lefelo le le se nang diritibatsi.
tgt: Bebonke benze inkqubela ebonakalayo ekulweni nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi.

src: Kabinete e lemoga le go amogela tswelelopele e e dirwang ke mapodisi, baeteledipele ba baagi le ditheo tse dingwe kwa Eldorado Park ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Puso ya Porofense ya Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuqonda ukuba imeko yase-Eldorado Park ibonisa imiba uluntu oluninzi olujongene nayo kwilizwe lethu jikelele kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu kwilizwe lonke ukuba lukhokele kwimfazwe yokulwa neziyobisi kwiindawo abahlala kuzo ukuze uMzantsi Afrika “ukhululeke kwiziyobisi”.NgeNyanga yoLutsha, masizinikele ekulweni imfazwe nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi kunye nokusela utywala ngokugqithisileyo kuyo yonke imimandla yelizwe lethu.

src: Mmogo ba nnile le tswelelopele e e bonalang mo ntweng kgatlhanong le bosula jwa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi uyakwamkela ukwanda kokuqalisa kokufundiswa kweelwimi zeMveli kwiBanga R kunye neBanga loku-1 apho ezi lwimi zingekafundiswa khona.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore seemo sa kwa Eldorado Park ke sesupo sa mathata a a lebaneng bontsi jwa baagi mo nageng ka bophara mme e ikuela mo baaging go ralalala naga go etelela pele ntwa ya go fedisa diritibatsi mo Aforika Borwa mo mafelong a WEBTOKEN Kgweding ya Bašwa, tlaya re itlameng gape go lwa ntwa kgatlhanong le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi le botagwa mo dikarolong tsotlhe tsa naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isekwancoma isibhengezo esenziwe yiDyunivesithi yaKwaZulu-Natal sokwenza ukuba abafundi banyanzeleke bafunde isiZulu kwinqanaba labangekathweswa zidanga, abangasaziyo isiZulu, babhalise kwizifundo zokuphuhlisa izakhono zokuncokola ngesiZulu.

src: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso e e tla okediwang ya puo ya seAforika kwa Mophatong wa R le Mophato wa 1 koo dipuo tseno di neng di sa rutiwe teng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bafunde ulwimi lwase-Afrika njengoko ixhasa ukuthethwa kweelwimi ezininzi njengento ekhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwesizwe.

src: Gape Kabinete e akgola kitsiso ya Yunibesithi ya KwaZulu-Natal ya go dira gore baithuti ba ngwaga wa ntlha, ba ba sa itseng puo ya SeZulu ba patelesege go ikwadisetsa serutwa seno gore ba oketse bokgoni jwa go tlotla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukususela ngomhla woku-1 ukuya kowe-3 kweyeSilimela uMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kutyelela ngokusemthethweni nangokwaseburhulumenteni eJapan ukuya kuzimasa iNkomfa yaseTokyo yesiHlanu yaMazwe ngaMazwe engoPhuhliso lwe-Afrika (TICAD V).

src: Kabinete e nopotse gore go tloga ka la bo 1 go fitlha ka la bo 3 Seetebosigo 2013, Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla tsaya leeto la semmuso go ya Japane koo a tla tsenelang Khonferense ya Botlhano ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Tokyo e e ka ga Tlhabololo ya Aforika (TICAD V).
tgt: Umxholo wale nkomfa ye-TICAD V eza kubanjelwa eYokohama eJapan, uthi: “Sibambene ngeZandla ne-Afrika enaMandla ngaPhezulu.” IKhabhinethi ilusizi kukushiywa ngumakhwekhwetha wentatheli uVuyo Mbuli kwaye ivakalisa uvelwano kusapho lwakwaMbuli, abahlobo nogxa bakhe abakushishino lwamajelo eendaba.

src: Moono wa TICAD V kwa Yokohama, Japan, ke: “Re tshwaragane ka diatla le Aforika e e Mafolofolo go Gaisa.”.
tgt: UMnu Mbuli ube negalelo elikhulu ekuvuleni iingxoxo zesizwe kwimiba engundoqo kwaye uthando lwakhe lomsebenzi wakhe luhlabe umxhelo kubemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe botlhoko ke loso la mankge wa mmegadikgang Vuyo Mbuli mme e romela matshidiso kwa lelapeng la ga Mbuli, kwa ditsaleng le kwa badiringmmogo ka ene mo lephateng la bobegakgang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa olunzulu uvelwano kubemi base-Bangladesh nakwiintsapho nabahlobo babasebenzi bomzi-mveliso wempahla abangaphezulu kwe-1 000 abasweleke ngokudilikelwa sisakhiwo.

src: Rre Mbuli o tsere karolo go bonala mo go rulaganyeng dikganetsano tsa bosetšhaba mo mererong ya botlhokwa mme lerato la gagwe mo tirong ya gagwe le amile dipelo tsa maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Sibandakanya abemi base-Bangladesh kwiingcinga nemithandazo yethu.

src: Kabinete e romela matshidiso kwa baaging ba kwa Bangladesh le ba malapa le ditsala tsa badiri ba le 1 000 ba feme ya diaparo ba ba tlhokafetseng fa kago e ne e gosomana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilusizi kakhulu ngokusweleka kunye nokwenzakala kwabantu okusisiphumo sezikhukhula emazantsi e-China.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe botlhoko thata ke tatlhegelo ya matshelo le dikgobalo ka ntlha ya merwalela e e boitshegang kwa borweng jwa China.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa intlungu nosizi ngokusweleka kwabafundi abahlanu abaphuma kwilali yaseLwandile eNgqeleni, eMpuma Koloni, abasweleke kwingozi yebhasi.

src: Gape Kabinete e tlhagisitse kutlobotlhoko ka ntlha ya dintsho tsa barutwana ba le batlhano go tswa kwa motseng wa Lwandile kwa Ngqeleni, kwa Eastern Cape, ba ba tlhokafetseng mo kotsing ya bese.
tgt: Abafundi abangama-30 bonzakele kule ntlekele yengozi.

src: Puso e romela matshidiso kwa malapeng, kwa ditsaleng le kwa barutwana ka bona le barutabana ba batswasetlhabelo.
tgt: URhulumente udlulisa uvelwano kwiintsapho, abahlobo, abafundi kunye nootitshala bala maxhoba.

src: Go utlwisa botlhoko fa Aforika Borwa e latlhegelwa ke baeteledipele ba isago.
tgt: “Ngumzuzu olusizi kakhulu xa uMzantsi Afrika ulahlekelwa ziinkokheli zangomso.”2.

src: Dipuisano le ditshweetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Iingxoxo kunye nezigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lokwalotshwaelo lwa Puso tebang le Sepodisi le phasaladiwe mo Lekwalodikgang la go Tlhomamisa Melao ya Puso gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iPhepha loGayo-zimvo ngobuPolisa lipapashwe kwincwadana karhulumente esihloko sithi Government Gazette ukuze uluntu luphawule ngokwenza amanqaku.

src: Fa e sa le go tlhamiwa Tirelo ya Sepodisi ya Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka 1994, go nnile le diphetogo di le dintsi mo tikologong ya ka fa gare le kwa ntle, tse di amileng ka moo Tirelo e tlhaloganyang le go tsibogela merero ya bosenyi le pabalesego ka gona.
tgt: Okoko kwathi kwasekwa iiNkonzo zamaPolisa zaseMzantsi Afrika (SAPS) ngowe-1994, kubekho iinguqu ezininzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwezi nkonzo ezithe zanefuthe ekuqondeni kunye nasekusabeleni kweeNkonzo zamaPolisa kwimiba yolwaphulo-mthetho kunye nokhuselo.

src: Morago ga 1994, puso e ne e lebanwe ke go samagana le maitlhomo a le mabedi a go tlhama mmuso o o tlhabologang mme gape e ntse e fetola sepodisi go nna setheo sa taolo.
tgt: Emva konyaka we-1994, urhulumente wajongana nokushukuxa iinjongo ezimbini zokudala umbuso ophuhlayo lo gama esekwaguqula ubupolisa bube liziko lolawulo.

src: Lokwalotshwaelo lwa Puso leno le tsibogela dikgwetlho tse di supilweng go latela tshekatsheko ya bomaleba jwa Togamaano ya Thibelo ya Bosenyi ya Bosetšhaba ya 1996 le Lokwalotemoso lwa puso lwa 1998 le le ka ga Pabalesego le Tshireletsego.
tgt: Eli Phepha loGayo-zimvo lisabela kwimingeni echongwe emva kokuhlolwa kokufaneleka koBuchule bokuThintela uLwaphulo-mthetho ngowe-1996 (NCPS) kunye nePhepha leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo woKhuselo noKhuseleko we-1998.

src: Mo teng ga dipholisi tseno go ne go na le ntlha ya go samagana le pabalesego le tshireletsego ka tsela e e akaretsang tlhabololo le go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a a kopaneng a a kgabaganyang maphata.
tgt: Kwendelisiswe kule migaqo-nkqubo ingcamango yokushukuxa ukhuselo kunye nokhuseleko ngendlela egqibeleleyo ngophuhliso kunye nokuphumeza iinkqubo ehlangeneyo yamacandelo ohlukileyo.

src: Ka bobedi, di ne di batla go tlhoma letlhomeso le le akaretsang la go samagana le merero ya pabalesego le tshireletsego ka bophara go fitlha ka 2004.Lokwalotshwaelo lwa Puso le bua ka "Go Tota Bosenyi mo go Aforika Borwa wa Temokerasi, Sepodisi mo Aforika Borwa, Go Tiisa Boporofešenale jwa Sepodisi gammogo le Dithulaganyo tsa Setheo."
tgt: Le migaqo-nkqubo ijonge ukumisela inkqubo-sikhokelo ngokubanzi yokujongana nemiba yokhuselo nokhuseleko ngokubanzi kude kube ngunyaka wama-2004.IPhepha loGayo-zimvo lijongene “nokuJongana ubuso ngobuso nolwaphulo-mthetho kuMzantsi Afrika weNtando yesininzi, uBupolisa eMzantsi Afrika, iNtsingiselo eyiNtloko yobuNgcali bamaPolisa kunye namaLungiselelo amaZiko”.

src: Maikaelelo a seno ke go baya SAPS mo maemong a go kgona go tsibogela bosenyi jo bo nnang bo fetoga mme e ntse gape e fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa Mmuso o o tlhabologang.
tgt: Oku kujolise ekubekeni iiNkonzo zamaPolisa zaseMzantsi Afrika ekugqibeleni kwisikhundla sokusabela kulwaphulo-mthetho olukhulayo noluguquguqukayo kwangaxeshanye nokuphumeza iimfuno zoMbuso osaphuhlayo.

src: Kabinete e amogetsa Leano la Bosetšhaba la Dikgato Tebang le Bana la 2012-2017 jaaka leano le le akaretsang le e tla nnang kaedi le mosupatsela wa mafapha a puso, baagi le balekane ba bangwe mo lephateng la bana go lebisa kwa go fitlheleleng ditshwanelo tsa bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume isiCwangciso seSizwe sokuSebenza saBantwana sama-2012-2017 njengesicwangciso ngokubanzi sokukhokela kunye nokukhomba indlela kumasebe karhulumente, kuluntu kunye namanye amaqabane kwicandelo labantwana esisingise ekuphumezeni amalungelo abantwana.

src: Leano le akaretsa Molaotheo, ditumelano tsa boditšhabatšhaba le tsa kgaolo, molao o o tlhagelelang wa bana mo Aforika Borwa, Diphitlhelelo tsa Tlhabololo tsa Ngwagakete gammogo le Ponelopele ya Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) ya 2030.Leano le na le meono e megolo e le metlhano: go tshela ga bana (sekao.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso samkela uMgaqo-siseko, izivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe nezengingqi, imithetho emitsha nevelayo yabantwana eMzantsi Afrika, iiNjongo zoPhuhliso zeNkulungwane kunye nesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe soMbono wonyaka wama-2030.Esi sicwangciso sinemixholo emihlanu: ukusinda kwabantwana (umzekelo, ukuncitshiswa kokusweleka kwabantwana) ukukhula kwabantwana (umzekelo, iinkonzo zophuhliso lwabantwana kwangethuba) ukhuseleko lwabantwana (umzekelo, ukukhuselwa kubundlobongela kunye nokuxhatshazwa ngokwesondo) umgangatho wokuphila kwabantwana (umzekelo, iimeko abahlala phantsi kwazo abantwana) kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabantwana (umzekelo, abantwana babe noxanduva lo gama besonwabela amalungelo abo).Esi siCwangciso seSizwe sokuSebenza saBantwana sowama-2012-2017 siza kucaciswa ngokubanzi kwintlanganiso yamabal’engwe nemfutshane yamajelo eendaba.

src: bana ba nna le maikarabelo fa ba itumelela ditshwanelo tsa bona).Leano leno la Bosetšhaba la Dikgato la Bana la 2012-2017, le tla tlhalosiwa ka botlalo kwa kopanong e e farologaneng ya bobegakgang.
tgt: Iphepha lilungelelaniswe noMgaqo-nkqubo oMtsha wokuHluma koQoqosho, isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe, iPhepha leNgcaciso yoMgaqo-nkqubo wezoBugcisa, iNkcubeko kunye namaGugu kunye nesiCwangciso soBuchule soQoqosho olubugolide lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Tumelano ya Tsosoloso ya Setso sa Aforika e isiwe kwa Palamenteng gore e amogele tlhomamiso go ya ka Karolo ya 231 (92) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: UMphathiswa woBugcisa neNkcubeko uza kusindleka intlanganiso yamabal’engwe nemfutshane yamajelo eendaba ngokuphathelele kulo mba.

src: Tlhomamiso ya Tumelano ke puso ke go tsibogela Kgoeletso ya tsosoloso ya Setso le Ditumelo tse di Aroganwang ya Kopano ya Tlwaelo ya bo 16 ya Ditlhogo tsa Dinaga le Mebuso ya AU e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Equatorial Guinea ka Ferikgong 2011, le go tlhomiwa ga Letsholo la AU la Tumelano ya Tsosoloso ya Setso sa Aforika le le neng le tshwerwe go ya kwa bokhutlong jwa 2011 mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukusindlekwa kweNtlanganiso yokuqala yaBaphathi bamazwe engeNzululwazi, ubuChwepheshe kunye nokuNgenisa nokwenziwa kwezinto ezintsha ukususela ngomhla wama-20 ukuya kuma-21 KweyeKhala kowama-2013.Ingxoxo ezicwangcisiweyo ngexesha leNtlanganiso yaBaphathi bamazwe zibonelela ngeqonga lokuphonononga iindlela zokuqaqambisa intsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente noshishino lwabucala.

src: Tlhomamiso ya Tumelano e tokafatsa tshireletso ya ditumelo tsa setso tsa seAforika le ngwaoboswa ya setso mme e tsweletsa mowa wa BoAforika.
tgt: INtlanganiso iza kwenza abathathi-nxaxheba baphonononge iindlela inzululwazi, ubuchwepheshe kunye nokungenisa nokwenziwa kwezinto ezintsha ezingadlala indima kuhambo oluya kuqoqosho olusekwe kulwazi kunye nokuzalisekisa uMbono wonyaka wama-20.

src: Tumelano e tsweletsa kopano ya setso, botsweretshi, ditumelo tsa setso, puo, ngwaoboswa mmogo le diintaseteri tsa setso le boitlhamedi jaaka mooko wa tlhabololo ya leruri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele izihlomelo zoMthetho osaYilwayo woLawulo lwaBasebenzi bakaRhulumente oluYilwayo eziza kupapashwa ukuze uluntu luphawule ngokwenza amanqaku.

src: Seno se ka nna le bokgoni jwa go tsayakarolo mo kgolong ya ikonomi le mo go nneng seoposengwe.
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo ufuna ukudala inkqubo-sikhokelo esemthethweni nefanayo yabasebenzi kunye nemiba ethile karhulumente nemibutho yesizwe, eyamaphondo kunye nolawulo loomasipala.

src: Tumelano e lepalepane le Tsela e Ntšhwa ya Kgolo, NDP, Lokwalotemoso lwa Puso lwa Botsweretshi, Setso le Ngwaoboswa mmogo le Togamaano ya Mzansi ya Ikonomi ya Gauta.
tgt: Oku kujoliswe ekuqaqambiseni ukuziswa kweenkonzo ngenkqubo efanayo yolawulo lwabasebenzi bakarhulumente, ukusetyenziswa kwabasebenzi okuphucukileyo kunye nokudala umnyango omnye wokuziswa kweenkonzo zikarhulumente kubemi beli.

src: Tona ya Botsweretshi le Setso e tla nna le kopano ya bobegakgang malebana le seno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele uMthetho osaYilwayo weKomishoni yaBasebenzi bakaRhulumente ukuze uluntu luphefumle ngokwenza amanqaku kunye nokwazisa lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ePalamente.

src: Kabinete e nopotse go amogelwa ga Samitii ya ntlha ya Saense, Thekenoloji le Boitlhamedi go tloga ka la bo 20 go ya go la bo 21 Phukwi 2013.Dipuisano tse di rulagantsweng ka nako ya Samiti di tlamela ka motheo wa go lebelela ditsela tsa go tokafatsa kgolagano magareng ga puso le lephata la poraefete.
tgt: Injongo yalo Mthetho osaYilwayo kukulungelelanisa uMthetho weKomishoni yaBasebenzi bakaRhulumente we-1997 kunye noMgaqo-siseko ukunika umkhombandlela malunga nemithetho-sisekelo elawulo ulawulo lwabasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Samiti e tla kgontsha batsayakarolo go lebelela ditsela tse saense, thekenoloji le boitlhamedi di ka nnang le seabe sa botlhokwa ka tsona mo leetong la rona la go nna naga e e tletseng kitso le go re re fitlhelele Ponelopele ya Melaotlhomo.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nendima eyomeleziweyo nengumbono wesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwiKomishoni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dipaakanyo tse di tshitshintsweng mo Molaotlhomong wa Botsamaisi jwa Tsamaiso ya Setšhaba (PAM) o jaanong o tla phasaladiwang gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele uMthetho osaYilwayo weeNkonzo zeMozulu zaseMzantsi Afrika wama-2013 ukuba upapashwe ukuze uluntu luphefumle ngokwenza amanqaku.

src: Molaotlhomo o ikaelela go tlhama letlhomeso le le tshwanang la molao la tsamaiso ya badiri le merero mengwe ya ditheo le taolo mo ditsamaisong tsa bosetšhaba, porofense le makgotlatoropo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ufuna ukuhlomela uMthetho weeNkonzo zeMozulu zaseMzantsi Afrika, wama-2001 (uMthetho Nombolo 8 wama-2001) obonelela ngokusekwa, iinjongo, amagunya kunye nemisebenzi yeeNkonzo zeMozulu zaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Maikaelelo a seno ke go tokafatsa tlamelo ya ditirelo ka thulaganyo e e tshwanang ya tsamaiso ya setšhaba, tiriso e e tokafaetseng ya badiri mmogo le go tlhamela baagi mafelo a le mangwe fela a ditirelo tsotlhe tsa puso.
tgt: Okubalulekileyo kukuba ezi zihlomelo ziza kubonelela iiNkonzo zeMozulu zaseMzantsi Afrika ngegunya elisemthethweni lokuphumeza umsebenzi wolawulo lolwazi ngomgangatho womoya osingqongileyo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Khomišene ya Tirelo ya Setšhaba gore baagi ba tshwaele mmogo le go itsisewe ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Oku kunegalelo ekukhuseleni kunye nasekuqaqambiseni okusingqongileyo nemithombo eluncedo yendalo.

src: Maitlhomo a Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng ke go lepalepanya Molao wa Khomišene ya Tirelo ya Setšhaba wa 1997 le Molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele uMthetho siHlomelo osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweMithombo yeziMbiwa nePetroliyam, wama-2012 ukuba ufakwe ePalamente.

src: Seno se ikamanya le seabe se se maatlafaditsweng se se solofetsweng mo Khomišeneng ke NDKabinete e amogetse gore Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Tirelo ya Maemo A Bosa ya Aforika Borwa wa 2013 o phasaladiwe gore setšhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: Lo Mthetho siHlomelo osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweMithombo yeziMbiwa nePetroliyam, wama-2012 (uMthetho osaYilwayo) ufuna ukuhlomela uMthetho siHlomelo osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweMithombo yeziMbiwa nePetroliyam, wama-2012 (uMthetho Nombolo 28 wama-2002) njengokuba uhlonyelwa nguMthetho siHlomelo osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweMithombo yeziMbiwa nePetroliyam, wama-2008 (uMthetho Nombolo 49 wama-2008).Eyona njongo ingundoqo yalo Mthetho siHlomelo osaYilwayo, phakathi kwezinye, kukuqaqambisa ukubonelelwa kokunyityilikiswa kwezimbiwa ngeenjongo zokwenza ubucwebecwebe ukuze kuxhaswe ushishino kunye negalelo leenjongo zesizwe zokudala imisebenzi kunye nokuhluma koqoqosho njengoko oko kungumbono wesiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe.

src: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng o ikaelela go baakanya Molao wa Tirelo ya Maemo a Bosa ya Aforika Borwa wa 2001, (Molao wa bo 08 wa 2001) o o nang le ditlamelo tsa go tlhamiwa, maikaelelo, maatla le ditiro tsa Tirelo ya Maemo a Bosa ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Intlanganiso yamabal’engwe nemfutshane yamajelo eendaba iza kubanjwa ngeenjongo zokucacisa malunga nolu phuhliso.

src: Maitlhomomagolo ke dipaakanyo tse di tla tlamelang Tirelo ya Maemo a Bosa ya Aforika Borwa ka thomo ya semolao go diragatsa tiro ya tsamaiso ya tshedimosetso ya boleng jwa mowa, mmogo le go dira jaaka motlhokomedi wa Thulaganyo ya Tshedimosetso ya Boleng jwa Mowa ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Mnu Sithembiso Freeman Nomvalo njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yeSigqeba le-Arhente yoBuchwepheshe boLwazi loMbuso kunye nelungu lesigqeba kwiBhodi yaBalawuli ixesha elingangonyaka.

src: Seno se tshwaela mo go sireletseng le mo go tokafatseng dithoto tsa rona tsa tikologo le ditlamelo tsa tlholego.
tgt: Mnu Trevor Gordon njengoSekela Mlawuli Jikelele: woLawulo lweMichiza kunye neNkunkuma kwiSebe lezeNdalo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Tlhabololo ya Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale le Peteroliamo wa 2012 o tlhagisiwe kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Nks Yoliswa Makhasi njengoSekela Mlawuli Jikelele: uLawulo lwezoShishino kwiSebe lezamaShishini kaRhulumente.

src: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Tlhabololo ya Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale le Peteroliamo wa 2012 (Molaotlhomo) o ikaelela go baakanya Molao wa Tlhabololo ya Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale le Peteroliamo wa 2002 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 2002) jaaka o baakantswe ke Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Tlhabololo ya Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale le Peteroliamo wa 2008 (Molao wa bo 49 wa 2008).Maikaelelo a ntlha a Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng, gareng ga tse dingwe, ke go tokafatsa tlamelo ya go fetolwa ga diminerale gore go tswelediwe madirelo le go tshwaela mo maitlhomomg a setšhaba a go tlhamiwa ga ditiro le kgolo ya ikonomi jaaka a lebeletswe mo NDGo tla nna le kopano e e farologaneng ya bobegakgang malebana le seno.
tgt: Nks Rose Mbono njengoSekala Mlawuli Jikelele: iFuthe lezoQoqosho noLungelelaniso loMgaqo-nkqubo kwiSebe lezamaShishini kaRhulumente.

src: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba ebalulekileyo kwiimeko ezigqubayo nezingundabamlonyeni.

src: Kabinete e eleletsa Moporesitente wa maloba Nelson Mandela go sidilega ka bonako mme e netefaletsa setšhaba gore o amogela tlhokomelo e e gaisang ya kalafi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela ukuba akhawuleze aphile kwaye iqinisekisa isizwe ukuba ufumana eyona nkathalo nonyango ezikumgangatho ophezulu.

src: Kabinete e lebogela gore o tsibogela kalafi sentle mme e boeletsa boikuelo jwa gore bobegakgang le setšhaba ba tlotle sebaka sa Moporesitente wa maloba le balelapa la gagwe mo pakeng eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyiswa kukuba amayeza ayasebenza kwaye ukusabela kakuhle ukunyangwa kwaye iyasiphindaphinda isicelo sayo esibhekiswa kumajelo eendaba kunye noluntu ukuba bahloniphe ubomi obubobakhe lowo wayesakuba nguMongameli kunye nosapho lwakhe ngeli xesha.

src: Kabinete e akgola tiro ya Setlhopha sa Tiro se se Kgatlhanong le Bobodu sa Lephata la Bosiamisi, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Tshireletsego (ACTT) se se tlhamilweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka 2010.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma umsebenzi weQela lezoBulungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho noKhuseleko eliliQela elinoMsebenzi wokulwa noRhwaphilizo elasekwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngowama-2010.Okokuqala kwimbali yethu yentando yesininzi, abophuli-mthetho abakusebenzisa kakubi ukuthenjwa luluntu nabasebenzisa gwenxa imithombo yoluntu baye baziswa kwaza kwafuneka bathathe uxanduva ngezenzo zabo esidlangalaleni.

src: La ntlha mo hisetoring ya temokerasi ya rona, basenyi ba ba dirisitseng botlhaswa ditlamelo tsa setšhaba le boikanyego, ba senotswe mme ba rwesiwa maikarabelo a ditiro tsa bona mo phatlhalatseng.
tgt: Ukungalunyamezeli konke-konke koMzantsi Afrika urhwaphilizo kusisondeza kumbono wonyaka wama-2030 apho uluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika luza kuphawulwa ngemigangatho ephezulu yemikhwa esesikweni kunye nobulungisa.

src: Go se batle go itshokela bobodu ga Aforika Borwa go re atametsa gaufi le ponelopele ya rona ya 2030, moo setšhaba sa Aforika Borwa se tla bong se rena maitsholo a maemo a a kwa godimo le boikanyego.
tgt: Esi simo sihlaselayo sijolise ekunqandeni abantu kumacandelo karhulumente kunye nawabucala abathi bazibandakanye kwizenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho kwaye siqhutywa kukuzinikela ekuqinisekiseni ukuba bonke abemi bakhuselekile kwaye nabo baziva bekhuselekile.

src: Seemo seno sa tšhakgalo se ikaelela go thibela batho ba ba mo maphateng a poraefete le a setšhaba go dira ditiro tsa bobodu le bosenyi mme se tsamaisiwa ke maitlamo a rona a go netefatsa gore baagi botlhe ba gololesegile mme ba ikutlwa ba babalesegile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izigxeka kakhulu izenzo zakutshanje zocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga kwezinye iindawo zelizwe.

src: Kabinete e kgala ka mafoko a a bogale ditiragalo tsa sešweng tsa bosemorafe mo dikarolong dingwe tsa naga ya rona.
tgt: Ucalucalulo alunayo indawo kwilizwe lethu nentando yesininzi yethu, ingakumbi ezikolweni, apho iinqobo zoMgaqo-siseko kufuneka zixhaswe kwaye zikhuselwe khona.

src: Bosemorafe ga bo na sebaka mo nageng le mo temokerasing ya rona, bogolo segolo kwa dikolong tsa rona koo go tshwanetseng ga tswelediwa le go sireletsa dintlhatheo tsa Molaotheo wa rona gone.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko ngezenzo zalo ezikhawulezileyo zokujongana nocalucalulo ezikolweni kunye nokukhuthaza bonke abazali, abafundi nootitshala ukuba baluchaze ucalucalulo kunye nokuxhatshazwa ezikolweni.

src: Kabinete e akgola Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo ka tsibogo ya lona e e bonako malebana le go samagana le bosemorafe kwa dikolong mme e rotloetsa batsadi, barutwana, le barutabana go bega bosemorafe le tshotlakako kwa dikolong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenze kunye norhulumente ukujongana nocalucalulo apho luthi lwenzeke khona kuluntu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go dira mmogo le puso go lwantsha bosemorafe nako nngwe le nngwe fa bo tlhagelela mo setšhabeng sa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli waseMerika eMzantsi Afrika, uBarack Obama, oluyinxalenye yotyelelo lwakhe kumazwe amathathu ayi-Senegal, Tanzania kunye noMzantsi Afrika phakathi komhla wama-26 kweyeSilimela kunye nomhla wesi-3 kweyeKhala wama-2013.

src: Kabinete e amogela ketelo ya mo Rephaboliking ya Aforika Borwa ke Moporesitente wa Amerika, Barack Obama, jaaka karolo ya ketelo ya dinaga di le tharo tsa Senegal, Tanzania le Aforika Borwa magareng ga la bo 26 Seetebosigo le la bo 3 Phukwi 2013.
tgt: Iingxoxo zethu zobuchule kwezopolitiko neMerika ziyaqhuba ukuba nefuthe elakhayo kubudlelwane bethu bala mazwe mabini.

src: Dipuisano tsa rona tsa togamaano tsa sepolotiki le Amerika di tswelela go nna le ditlamorago tse di namatshang mo botsalanong jwa rona jwa sebedi.
tgt: IMerika isengumehlulelane obalulekileyo kwezorhwebo, utyalomali, ukhenketho kunye nobuchwepheshe.

src: Kabinete e akgotse kopano ya botlhokwa e e ka ga Sekema sa Makwalonetefaletso a go Rafša sa Kimberley (KPCS), e e neng e tshwerwe magareng ga la bo 4 le la bo 7 Seetebosigo 2013 kwa Kimberley.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma intlanganiso eyimbali yeNkqubo yeZiqinisekiso yaseKimberley (KPCS) ebanjwe phakathi komhla we-4 kunye nowe-7 kweyeSilimela wama-2013 eKimberley.

src: Gareng ga tse dingwe, Samiti e buisanetse ditsela tsa go maatlafatsa bokgoni jwa sekema sa makwalonetefaletso a taemane e e sa rafšwang.
tgt: Le ntlanganiso yaBaphathi bamazwe ixoxe phakathi kwezinye izinto ngeendlela zokomeleza ukusebenza kakuhle kwenkqubo yeziqinisekiso zedayimani engekacokiswa.

src: Seno ke go netefatsa gore kgwebo ya ditaemane ga e tlamele matlole a tirisodikgoka ya mekgatlho ya marabele le ditsala tsa bona tse di ikaeletseng go nyatsa dipuso tse di mo molaong.
tgt: Oku kuqinisekisa ukuba urhwebo lwedayimani alubuxhasi ubundlobongela bemibutho yabavukeli-mbuso kunye nabaxhasi babo abafuna ukujongela phantsi oorhulumente abasemthethweni.

src: Dikatlenigiso tsa kopano eno di tla lebelelwa kwa kopanong ya KPCS e e tla tshwarwang moragonyana monongwaga.
tgt: Iingcebiso ezivela kule ntlanganiso ziza kubaluleka kwintlanganiso yeKPCS eza kubanjwa apha ekuhambeni konyaka.

src: Kabinete e nopotse gore segopotso sa Letsatsi la Bašwa se e leng gore mo ngwageng wa 2013 e tla bo e le segopotso sa bo 37 sa Dikhuduego tsa kwa Soweto tsa Seetebosigo a le 16, se tla bo se ketekwa ka moono wa "Re dira mmogo go tlhabolola bašwa le go fitlhelela Aforika Borwa yo o senang diritibatsi."
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba isikhumbuzo soSuku loLutsha kunyaka wama-2013 nesiphawula unyaka wama-37 woQhankqalazo eSoweto siza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi “Sisebenza sisonke ukuphuhlisa ulutsha kunye noMzantsi Afrika okhululekileyo kwiziyobisi.” IKhabhinethi ibulela abafundi bonyaka we-1976 abazenza idini ekuguquleni imbali yeli lizwe yaze yabeka uMzantsi Afrika kumzila oya kwintando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete e lemogile go intsha setlhabelo ga barutwana ba 1976 ka go fetola hisetori ya naga le go tlhoma Aforika Borwa mo tseleng ya temokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphindaphinda ukuthi, lo gama ulutsha lonyaka we-1976 lwalusilwela inkululeko kunye nokudalwa kombuso wentando yesininzi, ubutshantliziyo bolutsha lwanamhlanje bujoliswe ekoyiseni ngempumelelo imingeni yokulwa nentlupheko, intswela-ngqesho, iNtsholongwane kaGawulayo noGawulayo, uphuhliso lomntu ngamnye kunye nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse gore, fa bašwa ba 1976 ba ne ba lwela kgololesego le go tlhamiwa ga mmuso wa temokerasi, kgaratlho ya bašwa gompieno e lebisitse kwa go atlegeng go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa go lwantsha lehuma, botlhokatiro, HIV le AIDS, go itlhabolola, le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nemibutho ukuba basebenze kunye ukuphucula ubomi babantu abatsha kunye nokususa abashishina ngeziyobisi phakathi koluntu lwethu.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe le ditheo go dira mmogo go tokafatsa matshelo a bašwa le go lwela go tlosa ba ba gwebang ka diritibatsi mo ditšhabeng tsa rona.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo soSuku loLutsha siza kubhiyozelwa ngeCawa, umhla we-16 kweyeSilimela wama-2013 eNewcastle, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: Segopotso sa bosetšhaba sa Letsatsi la Bašwa se tla ketekwa ka Sontaga, Seetebosigo 16, 2013 kwa Newcastle, KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neNkongolo yabaFundi baseMzantsi Afrika (Cosas) ngokugqiba iminyaka engama-34, kwaye iingcambu zayo zikumzabalazo waseSoweto wonyaka we-1976 wemfundo ekhululekileyo, esemgangathweni kunye nefanelekileyo.

src: Kabinete e akgola Khonkerese ya Baithuti ba Aforika Borwa (Cosas) ka segopotso sa bona sa bo 34, se modi wa sona e leng kgaratlho ya Soweto ya 1976 ya thuto e e sa duelelweng, ya boleng le e e maleba.
tgt: Ilizwe lizibandakanya ne-Cosas ekubhiyozeleni impumelelo yayo kunye nokubeka phambili imfundo esemgangathweni yakhe wonke ubani.

src: Naga e ikgolaganya le Cosas fa e keteka diphitlhelelo tsa yona tse di namatshang tsa go fitlhelela thuto ya boleng go botlhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi incoma iinkokeli ze-Cosas ngelinge lazo lokuhlanganisa ulutsha khon’ ukuze lulwe nokusetyenziswa gwenxa kweziyobisi.

src: Gape Kabinete e akgola boeteledipele jwa Cosas ka ntlha ya go tsaya kgato ya go rotloetsa bašwa go ema kgatlhanong le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya diritibatsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igxeka izenzo zoluntu zokulahlwa kwelindle eNtshona Koloni ngabaqhankqalazi abaqhankqalazela izindlu zangasese ezingamabhakethi aphathwayo.

src: Kabinete e kgala dikgato tsa go tshololela mantle a batho kwa Kapa Bophirima ke badiraditshupetso ba ba leng kgatlhanong le matlwanaboithusetso a a sutisiwang.
tgt: Lo gama urhulumente elihlonipha ilungelo lokuqhankqalaza kwabemi, olu hlobo loqhankqalazo alunasidima kwaye lubeka emngciphekweni omandundu iimpilo yoluntu kunye naleyo yabaqhankqalazi ngokwabo.

src: Le fa Puso e tlotla ditshwanelo tsa baagi go dira ditshupetso, mofuta ono wa go dira ditshupetso ga o na seriti mme o baya baagi le bona bangongoregi, mo matshosetsing a a masisi a boitekanelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema abemi ukuba bazizise ngaphambili izikhalazo zabo ngendlela eyakhayo kwaye baphathe amaziko oluntu ngeyona ntlonipho nokuba zithini na izikhalazo zabo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe go tlhagisa dingongorego tsa bona ka tsela e e agang le go tlotla ditheo tsa setšhaba go sa kgathalesege dingongorego tsa bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema abasemagunyeni ukuba bakhawulezise ukuwushukuxa lo mba ngendlela ehambelana noMgaqo-siseko.9 URhulumente, ngokukhokelwa nguSekela-Mongameli uKgalema Motlanthe, uhlangene neenkokeli zeenkolo ezimele iBhunga leeCawa zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye neNkomfa yooBhishophu bebandla lamaKatolike yaseMzantsi Afrika ukuze baxoxe ngenkxalabo yabo yokuba iProjekthi yokuPhucula ooHola beeNdlela baseGauteng iza kuba nefuthe njani kwabahluphekayo kunye nokungazikhathaleli kukarhulumente iimfuno zabahluphekayo.

src: Puso, ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Motlatsamoporesitente Kgalema Motlanthe, e kopane le baeteledipele ba sedumedi ba ba emetseng Lekgotla la Dikereke la Aforika Borwa mmogo le Khonferense ya Babišopo ba Katoliki ba Aforika Borwa go buisana nabo malebana le matshwenyego a bona a gore Porojeke ya Tokafatso ya Ditselafefo tsa Gauteng e tla ama bahumanegi le gore puso e ikgatholositse ditlhokego tsa bahumanegi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda ukuthi urhulumente uzikhulule izithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezibhalisiweyo (ezisetyenziswa ikakhulu ngabahluphekileyo) kwirhafu yoohola bendlela abaseGauteng.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa gape gore puso e golotse dipalangwa tse di kwadisitsweng tsa botlhe (tse di dirisiwang bogolo ke bahumanegi) mo dituelong tsa ditselakgethiso mo ditselakgethisong tsa Gauteng.
tgt: Kwakhona, ukushukuxa iinkxalabo zabanye abakhweli beemoto, urhulumente ucuthe irhafu waza waqalisa ngezixa-mali ezinomda zazo zonke iindidi zezithuthi.

src: Gape, go samagana le matshwenyego a boradijanaga ba bangwe, puso e fokoditse dituelo mme ya itsise selekano se sentšhwa sa dikarolo tsotlhe tsa dijanaga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abakhweli zimoto baseGauteng ukuba babhalisele ukufumana ibheji zekhompyutha kwaye bayibone leprojekthi njengenxalenye yephulo lokwakha iziseko zophuhliso neziluncedo zoluntu.10 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana namaQela eBhola eKhatywayo iBafana Bafana neBanyana Banyana kunye neQela leQakamba iiProteas ngempumelelo yawo yakutshanje kwibhola ekhatywayo neqakamba.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa boradijanaga ba Gauteng go ikwadisetsa di-e-tag le go tsaya porojeke eno jaaka karolo ya letsholo la naga la go aga mafaratlhatlha a bosetšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana namaqela esizwe ngempumelelo ayilwele nzima kwimpelaveki esiphuma kuyo kwaye ikhuthaza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba baxhase amaqela ethu esizwe.11 IKhabhinethi yamkele ukusungulwa kwesikhululo sosasazo iPower FM, esisikhululo esitsha sosasazo, njengomdlali omtsha kolu shishino.

src: Kabinete e akgola Ditlhopha tsa Kgwele ya Dinao tsa Bafana Bafana le Banyana Banyana gammogo le Setlhopha sa Khirikete sa Proteas ka diphenyo tsa tsona tsa fa gautshwane mo kgweleng ya dinao le khirikete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba esi sikhululo siza kujongana nopolitiko, imiba yezentlalo kunye nezemidlalo ubukhulu becala kwaye sizibandakanya kuluhlu lwamaqonga kanomathotholo anokusetyenziswa ukwazisa abemi baseMzantsi Afrika.12 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMlawuli Jikelele weSebe lezeMpilo, uGqr Malebona Precious Matsoso, ngokuqeshwa kwakhe njengelungu nelikwangomnye wooSekela Sihlalo beBhodi yesiGqeba yeNgqungquthela yezeMpilo yeHlabathi isithuba seminyaka emithathu.

src: Kabinete e akgola ditlhopha tsa bosetšhaba ka diphenyo tsa tsona tse di neng di se bonolo mo bekeng e e fetileng mme e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe go tshegetsa ditlhopha tsa rona tsa bosetšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba iZiko lobuNtlola lezeziMali laseMzantsi Afrika liza kusindleka iiNtlanganiso Jikelele zamaQela aSebenzayo zoNyaka wama-2013 zamacandelo ezobuntlola kwezezimali eQela le-Egmont.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhomiwa ga Power FM, seteišene se sentšhwa sa radio ya dipuisano, jaaka motshameki yo montšhwa mo indasetering.
tgt: IQela le-Egmont ngumbutho wamacandelo ezobuntlola kwezezimali aphuma kumazwe ali-131.

src: Kabinete e lemogile gore seteišene se tla samagana thata le dipolotiki, merero ya loago le metshameko mme se tsena mo lenaaneng la didiriswa tsa radio tse di ka dirisediwang go sedimosetsa maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Ahlangana rhoqo ukuseka ubudlelwane bokuchonga ingeniso efunyenwe ngolwaphulo-mthetho, ukulwa nokusasazwa kwemali ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nokuxhasa ubunqolobi ngezimali ngenjongo yokukhusela ubulungisa kwiinkqubo zezimali.

src: Kabinete e akgola Mokaedikakaretso wa Lefapha la Boitekanelo, Ngaka Malebona Precious Matsoso, ka go thapiwa ga gagwe jaaka tokololo le mongwe wa Bathusabadulasetilo ba Botokhuduthamaga ya Kokoano ya Boitekanelo ya Lefatshe sebaka sa dingwaga di le Dipuisano le ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukonyulwa koMzantsi Afrika ukuba usebenze kwiBhunga lezoQoqosho nezeNtlalo leZizwe eziManyeneyo (ECOSOC) ixesha elisusela kunyaka wama-2013 ukuya kowama-2015.

src: Kabinete e lemogile gore Tikwatikwe ya Matlhale a Ditšhelete ya Aforika Borwa e tla amogela Dikopano tsa 2013 tsa Togomaano ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga le tsa Setlhophatiro Kakaretso tsa Setlhopha sa Egmont sa diyuniti tsa matlhale a ditšhelete.
tgt: Oku kuzisa ithuba lokubeka ubuchule bobunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kwimiba yophuhliso kunye nokugxininisa indima yelizwe njengomthathi-nxaxheba ongaguqukiyo nosebenza kakuhle xa uzibandakanya namanye amazwe amaninzi.

src: Se kopana gangwe le gape go kgontsha tirisanommogo ya boditšhabatšhaba go supa dipoelo tsa bosenyi, go lwantsha go gweba go go seng mo molaong ka madi mmogo le go tlamela borukhutlhi ka matlole ka maitlhomo a go femela boikanyego jwa thulaganyo ya ditšhelete.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuqinisekisa ukuba i-ECOSOC yomelezwa nangakumbi kwaye iguqulwa ukuze ikwazi ukumelana neenguqu zehlabathi kunye neemfuno zamazwe asaphuhlayo.

src: Kabinete e lemogile go tlhophiwa ga Aforika Borwa go dira mo Lekgotleng la Ikonomi le Loago la Ditšhabakopano (ECOSOC) mo pakeng ya 2013 - 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ingxelo yobulungu obungesosigxina boMzantsi Afrika kwiBhunga loKhuselo leZizwe eziManyeneyo (UNSC) ukususela kumhla woku-1 kweyoMqungu wama-2011 ukuya kumhla wama-31 kweyoMnga wama-2012.Le ngxelo ichaza impembelelo yoMzantsi Afrika kwinkqubo yolawulo lwehlabathi yokugcina uxolo kunye nokhuseleko lwamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Seno se naya tšhono ya go baya ketapele ya Aforika Borwa ka tsela ya togamaano mo mererong ya tlhabololo le go maatlafatsa seabe sa naga jaaka motsayakarolo yo o tsepameng le yo o mosola mo mererong ya bontsi.
tgt: Ngokuhambelana neenqobo zayo kunye nomdla wesizwe, uMzantsi Afrika kwi-UNSC ubeke phambili ukusonjululwa kwempixwano kunye noxolo nozinzo kwilizwekazi lase-Afrika.

src: Gape Aforika Borwa e tla netefatsa gore ECOSOC e maatlafadiwa gape le go fetolwa go fitlhelela botoka dikgwetlho tse di golang tsa lefatshe le ditlhokego tsa dinaga tse di tlhabologang.
tgt: Ubulungu kwi-UNSC busekwabonelela uMzantsi Afrika ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane namaqabane amazwe angundoqo kuphuhliso iBrazil, India, Nigeria neChina - abelana ngobulungu noMzantsi Afrika kwiBhunga.

src: Kabinete e lemogile pegelo e e ka ga botokololo jo E seng jwa Leruri jwa Aforika Borwa kwa Lekgotleng la Tshireletso la Ditšhabakopano (UNSC) go tloga ka la bo 1 Ferikgong go fitlha ka la bo 31 Sedimonthole 2012.Pegelo e tlhalosa tshusumetso ya Aforika Borwa mo thulaganyong ya tsamaiso ya lefatshe mo go tsholeng kagiso le tshireletso ya boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: IMithetho esaYilwayo IKhabhinethi ivumele ukuba uMthetho Sihlomelo woLawulo lweNtlekele upapashwe ukuze uluntu luphefumle.

src: Go lepalepana le dintlhatheo le dikgatlhego tsa yona tsa bosetšhaba, Aforika Borwa le UNSC di beile tharabololo ya dikgotlhang le kagiso le tsepamo mo Kontinenteng ya Aforika jaaka ditlapele.
tgt: Esi Sihlomelo siza kuqinisekisa kwakhona umsebenzi woomasipala besithili malunga noxanduva lokuseka umthamo wophuhliso kunye nentsebenziswano ngesicwangciso solawulo lwentlekele.

src: Botokololo jwa UNSC gape bo tlametse Aforika Borwa ka tšhono ya go maatlafatsa botsalano le balekane ba botlhokwa ba dinaga tse di tlhabologang - Brazil, India, Nigeria le China - ba ba neng ba arogana botokololo jwa Lekgotla le Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukuphunyezwa komsebenzi wolawulo lwentlekele kummandla lowo kamasipala.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Tsamaiso ya Matlhotlhapelo o phasaladiwe gore setšhaba se tshwaele.
tgt: UMthetho woLawulo lweNtlekele wama-2002 ujolise kwiinjongo ezine: Useka isikhokelo solawulo lwentlekele seziko ngokubanzi.

src: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di itemogelwang go ralala magato a puso morago ga go simolola ga Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Matlhotlhapelo wa 2002.
tgt: Umisela umgaqo-nkqubo oneenkcukacha zophuhliso kunye nesikhokelo sesicwangciso sobuchule solawulo lwentlekele.

src: Paakanyo e tla tlhomamisa gape tiro ya makgotlatoropo a kgaolo malebana le maikarabelo a go tlhama bokgoni jwa go tlhama le go gokaganya leano la tsamaiso ya matlhotlhapelo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo usekwabonelela ngokuhlelwa ngokohlobo nokubhengezwa kwentlekele kwaye ujongene nokuxhasa ngezimali okwethutyana ukubuyiselwa kunye nokuvuselelwa kwesimo emva kwentlekele.

src: Seno se akaretsa go tsenngwa tirisong ga tiro ya tsamaiso ya matlhotlhapelo mo karolong ya lekgotlatoropo.
tgt: Ubonelela ngamavolontiya olawulo lwentlekele kunye nemiba embalwa encedisayo nenxulumene noko.

src: Molao wa Tsamaiso ya Matlhotlhapelo wa 2002 o na le tebo ya maphata a le mane: O tlhama letlhomeso le le bonalang la setheo sa tsamaiso ya matlhotlhapelo o akaretsa tlhabololo ya pholisi ka botlalo gammogo le letlhomeso la togamaano ya tsamaiso ya matlhotlhapelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukufakwa koMthetho Sihlomelo weRhafu yeZakhiwo kuRhulumente kaMasipala waseKhaya ePalamente.

src: Gape molaotlhomo o na le tlamelo ya karoganyo le kgoeletso ya matlhotlhapelo mme o samagana nakwana le matlole a pusetso le tsosoloso ya morago ga matlhotlhapelo.
tgt: Izihlomelo zifuna ukususa ukungacaci okanye iintsingiselo-mbini kunye nokubonelela ngokuqiniseka ngokwasemthethweni okungaphezulu.

src: O na le tlamelo ya baithaopi ba tsamaiso ya matlhotlhapelo gammogo le merero e mengwe ya tlaleletso.
tgt: Isihlomelo siza kuvumela ukusekwa kwendidi zerhafu yezakhiwo ezohlukileyo elubala, oko kuza komeleza ukuqonda kwabanini bezakhiwo ngokumiselwa kwerhafu.

src: Kabinete e rebotse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Pusoselegae wa Kgethiso ya matlo a Makgotlatoropo kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Isihlomelo siza kubekela ecaleni iziseko zophuhliso eziluncedo zeenkonzo zoluntu ezifana neendlela, imizila kaloliwe, izikhululo zenqwelomoya neendlela ezisetyenziselwa ukuchopha nokuntinga kwazo, amadama kunye neendonga ezakhiwe elwandle ukukhusela amazibuko kumaza ekubeni zirhafelwe.

src: Paakanyo e ikaelela go tlosa ketsaetsego le go tlamela ka tlhaloso e kgolwane ya semolao.
tgt: Kuza kuba negalelo kwindima yophuhliso lwamashishini karhulumente ngokucutha iindleko zawo ezisisigxina.

src: Paakanyo e tla dira gore go bewa ga lekgetho la dikarolo tse di farologaneng tsa matlo go direlwe mo pepeneneng, mme ka go rialo go tokafatsa gore beng ba matlo ba tlhaloganye lekgetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumele iqela leMithetho yoRhwebo ngeeNqanawe efanayo ukuba ithiwe thaca ePalamente.

src: Paakanyo e ka se ke ya akaretsa mafaratlhatlha mangwe a tirelosetšhaba a tshwana le ditsela, diporo, mafelo a difofane di tsoramang mo go one le ao di tlhatlhogang mo go one, matamo le magora a maemelakepe mo kgethisong.
tgt: Le Mithetho esaYilwayo yinxalenye yamanyathelo ayilwa ukuze anike uMzantsi Afrika uxanduva phantsi kweMithetho yokuziPhatha yaseLwandle yaMazwe ngaMazwe we-1992.1 Injongo yoMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (iNgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu) kukumisela iMithetho yokuziPhatha yoMbutho waseLwandle waMazwe ngaMazwe, we-1992 kunye nokuphumeza sibe ngumthetho isihlomelo seNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe seTyala kuLuntu loMonakalo ngenxa yoNgcoliseko yi-oli, we-1969.

src: Tseno di laolwa ke setšhaba mme di ka seke tsa lomeletsa lephata la poraefete.
tgt: INgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu iseka kwaye ilawula ityala lomnini nqanawe obhalisiweyo.2 Injongo yoMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (INgxowamali yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-oli yaMazwe ngaMazwe) kukuphumeza iMithetho yokuziPhatha yowe-1992 kwiNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe yokuSekwa kweNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo ngoMonakalo woNgcoliseko yi-Oli, we-1971 (iNgqungquthela yeNgxowamali).INgqungquthela yeNgxowamali iseka iNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe, ebizwa ngokuthi yiNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-Oli (IOPC).

src: Seno se tla tokafatsa motsamao wa ikonomi go ralala melelwane ya makgotlatoropo.
tgt: Injongo yeNgxowamali kukuhlawula imbuyekezo kumaxhoba omonakalo wongcoliseko (ngokwentsingiselo yeNgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu) apho bangakwazanga ukufumana imbuyekezo, okanye imbuyekezo epheleleyo, phantsi kwezibonelelo zeNgqungquthela yeTyala kuLuntu, INgxowamali ye-IOPC ifumana inkxaso yayo kubanini bemithwalo.

src: Melaotlhomo eno ke karolo ya setlhopha sa dikgato tse di rulaganyeditsweng go diragatsa maikarabelo a Aforika Borwa ka fa tlase ga Thulaganyo ya Mekgatlho ya Mawatle ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya 1992.1 Maitlhomo a Molaotlhomo wa Tsamaiso ka Dikepe Dilwana tse di Rekisiwang (Tumelano ya Maikarabelo a Setšhaba) ke go: tlhomamisa Thulaganyo ya Mekgatlho ya Mawatle ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya 1992 le go fetisa Tumelano ya 1969 e e baakantsweng ya Boditšhabatšhaba e e ka ga Maikarabelo a Setšhaba malebana le Tshenyo ya Kgotlhelego ya Oli, go nna molao.
tgt: IMithetho esaYilwayo yeTyala kuLuntu kunye neNgqungquthela yeNgxowamali ijongene nemibuzo yamatyala kunye nembuyekezo yokulahlekelwa okanye ukonakaliswa okwenziwe kukungcola okusisiphumo sokuvuza kwe-oli okungaguqukiyo kwimikhumbi ethwele i-oli.3 UMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (INgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-oli) woMrhumo kunye noMthetho osaYilwayo woRhwebo ngeeNqanawe (INgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-oli) woLawulo ubonelela ngokuphunyezwa kweMithetho yokuziPhatha koMbutho waseLwandle waMazwe ngaMazwe we-1992 ukuze kuhlonyelwe kwiNgqungquthela yaMazwe ngaMazwe yokuSekwa kweNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yoMonakala luNgcoliseko yi-Oli, nguMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tumelano ya Maikarabelo a Setšhaba e tlhama le go laola maikarabelo a mong yo o kwadisitsweng wa sekepe.2 Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo wa Tsamaiso ka Dikepe Dilwana tse di Rekisiwang (Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba la Tuelo ya go Kgotlhelwa ke Oli) ke go: tsenya tirisong Thulaganyo ya 1992 mo Sebokeng sa Boditšhabatšhaba ka ga Go Tlhamiwa ga Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba la Tuelo ya Ditshenyegelo tsa go Kgotlhelwa ke Oli la 1971 (Seboka sa Letlole).Seboka sa Letlole se tlhama Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba, le le bidiwang Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba la Tuelo ya Tshenyegelo ka go Kgotlhelwa ke Oli (IOPC).
tgt: UMthetho osaYilwayo woLawulo uza kubonelela ngegunya lezomthetho elifunekayo ukuze iiNkonzo zeNgeniso zaseMzantsi Afrika (SARS) zilawule ukuqokelelwa kwerhafu zemirhumo kwiNgxowamali yaMazwe ngaMazwe yeMbuyekezo yoNgcoliseko yi-Oli.
