tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ukhokelisa phambili ubomi babantu ngokuthi uzame kangangoko ukuba ubekele bucala imali yokuxhasa amaphulo eenkonzo ezikumgangatho ophezulu, kubonelelwe ngeenkonzo amakhaya angafumani zinkonzo zaneleyo, ngelithuba uzama ngaxeshanye ukulungisa nokuhlaziya iziseko ezingundoqo zogutyulo ezikhoyo.5 IKhabhineti ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente kweNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yesiHlanu yamaXesha aThile (yowama-2009-2014) malunga nokuFezekiswa kwesiVumelwano sokuLwa zonke iiNtlobo zoCalu-calulo oluJoliswe kwabaseTyhini.

src: Pegelo e tlamela ka lemorago la mesola ya melao e e farologaneng, dipholisis le manaane ao a tsentsweng tirisong mmogo le go neela dintlhakgolo tsa dikatlego tsa naga fa go tla mo matlafatsong ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.
tgt: Le ngxelo inika isishwankathelo sokuba ingaba uthotho lwemithetho, imigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo ezisetyenziswayo iyasebenza na iphinde futhi inyathele kwizinto ezenziwe ngempumelelo lilizwe malunga nokuxhotyiswa kwabasetyhini kunye nolingwano ngokwesini.

src: Pegelo gape e tlhagisa gore go na le dikgwetlho tse di tsweletseng le dikgoreletso go ka fedisa tlhokotekatekano le tlhaolele mo nageng.
tgt: Le ngxelo iyakwamnkela nokuba kukho imingeni nemiqobo engapheliyo esokolisa kwidabi lokulwa ukungalingani nocalu-calulo kweli lizwe.6 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweDrafti yesiCwangciso seSizwe sokuSebenza sokuLwa ubuHlanga, uCalu-calulo ngokobuHlanga, ukuBukulwa kwaBantu bangaPhandle kunye nokuNye ukungaNyamezelani okuFana Noku, ukuze uluntu luhlomle ngawo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Leanotirotlhomo la Bosetšhaba la Twantsho ya Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele, Tlhaolele go ya ka Lotso, Tlhaolele go ya ka Semorafe mmogo le Ditiragalo tse Dingwe tsa Tlhoko Itshokelano, gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso licebo lesizwe elihlangeneyo neliqiqisisiweyo esinjongo zaso ikukulwa ubuhlanga nokwakha uMzantsi Afrika ongacaluli ngabuhlanga nangobuni.

src: Leano leno ke togamaano ya bosetšhaba e e rulagantsweng e bile e kopanetswe ka maitlhomo a go lwantshana le tlhaolele go ya ka lotso mme go agiwa Aforika Borwa wa boammaruri wa temokerasi yo a senang tlhaolele go ya ka lotso le go ya ka bong.
tgt: Sikwanika isikhokelo samanyathelo angazi kuphela sithubeni nahamba kunye aza kuthathwa sisizwe sisonke ukulwa ubuhlanga nocalulo-calulo ngokobuhlanga.

src: Le neelana ka letlhomeso la dikgato tse di rulaganeng tsa leruri tse di ka tsewang ke naga ka bojotlhe go ka samagana le lefa la ditiro tsa tlhaolele le la tlhaolele go ya ka lotso.
tgt: Oku kuza kunceda uMzantsi Afrika ukuba uzalisekise izivumelwano zawo zehlabathi, zeli lizwekazi kunye nezesiwe, ingakumbi isiVumelwano saseDurban kunye nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza esamnkelwa yi-UN kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yokulwa ubuHlanga ngowama-20.7 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngomgama osele uhanjiwe ngenkqubo yokufudukela kwidijithali.

src: Seno se thusa Aforika Borwa go ka fitlhelela maikano a yone a boditšhabatšhaba, a kgaolo le a bosetšhaba, bogolosegolo Kgoeletso ya Durban le Leanotiro tse di amogetsweng ke Dinagakopano (UN) kwa Khonferenseng ya Lefatshe e e kgatlhanong le Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele ka 2001.
tgt: Ikuvumile ukuqaliswa kwexesha apho zombini indlela zosasazo le idijithali nale i-anologi ziza kusetyenziswa ngaxeshanye kusasazo olidijithali eMzantsi Afrika ngomhla woku-1 kweyoMdumba ngowama-2016.Ukufuduka kusukwa kuhlobo lokusasazo olu-analogi kuyiwe koludijithali kuza kuvulela amaza osasazo amaninzi afuneka kakhulu ukuze kukwazi ukuba kufumaneke usasazo ngeeselula olukhawuleza kakhulu.

src: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka kgatelopele e e dirilweng mo lenaaneng la phetolelokgaso go ya go ya dijithale.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba uqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika lukwazi nangakumbi ukumelana nokhuphiswano ngokuhlaziya icandelo lezosasazo loMzantsi Afrika, ukomeleza icandelo lokuveliswa kobuxhakaxhaka be-elektronikhi, kudale imisebenzi kuze kukhuthaze nokuba kudidiyelwe kuveliswe neenkqubo zosasazo ezahluka-hlukeneyo zalapha ekhaya.8 IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zeNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yowama-2014 yezaLathisi zobuNzululwazi, ubuChwepheshe kunye noYilo kunye nezinto ezingundaba-mlonyeni kwindlela eqhuba ngayo iNkqubo yeSizwe yokuYila (i-NSI), ebhalwa rhoqo ngonyaka liBhunga leSizwe lokuCebisa ngoYilo.

src: E amogetse gape le tshimololo ya paka ya kgasopedi mabapi le kgaso ya dijithale mo Aforika Borwa go ka simolola ka la bo 1 Tlhakole 2016.Phetogelo e no ya go tswa mo ditirelong tsa kgaso ya analoko go ya go ya dijithale e tlhagisa makhubu a a tlhokegang thata a kgaso a a nang le matshwanedi a go abelana ka ditirelo tse di latelelang tsa porotebente.
tgt: Le ngxelo isebenzisa izalathisi ezingundoqo ukuvavanya inkqubo kunye negalelo le-NSI kwimiba engundoqo ephambili yesizwe ecaciswe kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) kunye namanye amaxwebhu ezicwangciso-nkqubo anegalelo kuphuhliso lwezentlalo nezoqoqsho.9 IKhabhinethi iluvumile uhlenga-hlengiso lwezithili zikamantyi eLimpopo naseMpumalanga, kunye nokubekwa ngokusesikweni kweNkundla kaMantyi yaseLephalale njengokuba yiyo eza kusebenza okwethutyana njengeNkundla ePhakamileyo yaseLimpopo kude kwakhiwe iNkundla ePhakamileyo endaweni yayo kulo mmandla.

src: Seno se tla oketsa kgaisano ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa ka go tsosolosa intaseteri ya kgaso, go natlafatsa intaseteri ya botlhagisi jwa ditlhagisiwa tsa ileketeroniki, go tlhola ditiro, mmogo le go tlhagisa mananeo a kgaso a a farologaneng a mantsi a fa gae.
tgt: Ukuhlenga-hlengiswa kwezithili zikamantyi kunye nemimandla ezinkundla zamaCandelo eNkundla ePhakamileyo kuyinxalenye yeenguqu ezenziwayo kumgaqo-nkqubo ezineenjongo zokulungisa umonakalo wangaphambili wokwabiwa kwemihlaba.

src: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka ga diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Boitshimololedi le tsa Saense le Thekenoloji mo Aforika Borwa ya 2014 mmogo le setlwaedi sa tiragatso ya Thulaganyo ya Boitshimololedi ya Naga (NSI), tse di tlhagisiwang ngwaga le ngwaga ke Lekgotla la Dikeletso ka Boitshimololedi la Bosetšhaba.
tgt: Kukwayinxalenye yamalinge okuzisa iinguqu ezibalulekileyo ukwenzela ukuba wonke ubani akwazi ukuzixhamla iinkonzo zobulungisa, nto leyo ihambelana nezithembiso zoMgaqo-siseko woMzantsi Afrika wowe-1996.

src: Pegelo e dirisa ditshupetso tse di diphatsa go ka sekaseka tiragatso le seabe sa NSI mo ditlapeleng tse di botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mmogo le ditokomane tse dingwe tsa dipholisi tse di nang le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya loago.
tgt: 2.10 IKhabhinethi iyivumile ingxelo emalunga nomgama osele uhanjiwe ngomba wokuphunyezwa kwemiyalelo yeKhabhinethi eLimpopo ngokweCandelo 100 (1)

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata tebang le Limpopo le Mpumalanga, mmogo le go tlhomiwa ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Magiseterata ya Lephalale jaaka kantoro ya tikologo ya Karolo ya Limpopo, go nna monamaotshwere go fitlhelela kantoro ya tikologo ya karolo ya leruri e agiwa mo lefelong leo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukurhoxiswa, phantsi kwemiqathango, kweCandelo 100 (1)

src: Go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata mmogo le mafelo a taolo a Dikarolo tsa Kgotlatshekelo e Kgolo ka karolo ya ntšhwafatso ya pholisi maitlhomo a yone ke go baakanya lefa la thulaganyo ya bodulo e e sa siamang ya mo malobeng.
tgt: okuza kwenziwa ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 kula masebe alandelayo ephondo laseLimpopo: elezeMpilo elezoThutho elezemiSebenzi kaRhulumente elezeeNdlela neziSeko ezinguNdoqo kunye nonoNdyebo wePhondo.

src: Ke karolo gape ya phetolothefosano e e namileng go ka thusa go ka fitlhelela bosiamisi, e leng seo se lepalepisitsweng le Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa ya 1996.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwakuvumile nokurhoxiswa, phantsi kwemiqathango, kweCandelo 100 (1)

src: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ka ga kgatelopele mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga ditaelo tsa Kabinete kwa Limpopo go ya ka Karolo ya bo 100 (1)
tgt: kwiSebe lezeMfundo into leyo iza kuvulela indlela uNondyebo wePhondo, encediswa ngurhulumente kazwelonke, ukuba aqalise ngokwenyani ukusebenzisa iCandelo 18 loMthetho wokuLawulwa kweMali kaRhulumente, wowama-1999 (uMthetho uNombolo 1 wowama-1999) kwiSebe lezeMfundo lephondo laseLimpopo.

src: go fitlha ka Mopitlwe 2016 mo mafapheng a a latelang a porofense ya Limpopo: Lefapha la Boitekanelo Lefapha la Dipalangwa Lefapha la Ditirelo tsa Puso Lefapha la Ditsela le Mafaratlhatlha go akaretsa le Lefapha la Matlole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile le miqathango ilandelayo iya kwiNkulumbuso kunye noMphathiswa wePhondo (i-MEC) wezeMali kunye nowezeMfundo:a) Ukuxhobisa ngezakhono amasebe ephondo ngokuthi kuqeshwe abantu abanezakhono ezifanelekileyob) Ukuqukunjelwa komba wokuqeshwa kwabantu abaza kungena kwizikhundla zabalawuli abaphezuluc) Ukusonjululwa kwengxaki yorhwaphilizo kunye nezikhulu eziphezulu ezingawenzi kakuhle umsebenzi wazo.

src: Kabinete gape e amogetse go gogelwa morago ga nakwana ga Karolo ya bo 100 (1)
tgt: 2.11 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usingathe iNkomfa yeeNgxoxo ezingokuLwa iziYobisi ekwizinga eliphezulu ukusuka ngomhla we-11 ukuya kowe-12 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, eza kube iququzelelwa yiMbumba ye-Afrika (i-AU).Le Nkomfa iza kusetyenziswa njengeseshoni elandela iiNgxoxo zeRussia ne-Afrika ezingokuLwa iziYobisi, enjongo zayo ikukunika ingxelo enye malunga nokulwa ingxaki yeziyobisi kwihlabathi.

src: mo Thuto go ka ala tsela gore Lefapha la Matlole la Porofense le tsenya ka matlhagatlhaga Karolo ya bo 18 ya Molao wa Botsamaisi jwa Madi a Puso (PFMA), 1999 (Molao wa bo 1 wa 1999) kwa Lefapheng la Thuto la Limpopo, ka tshegetso go tswa kwa pusong ya bosetšhaba.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kuthiwa thaca kwiSeshoni eKhethekileyo ye-UNGA ngekaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.Umba wedabi lokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uhambelana ne-NDP kwaye ezi Ngxoxo ziza kunika ithuba lokuqinisa nangakumbi isiCwangciso esiBanzi seSizwe seziYobisi (sowama-2013-2017).

src: Kabinete e amogetse ditaelo tse di latelang tebang le Tonakgolo le Bakhuduthamaga (di-MEC) tsa Matlole le tsa Thuto:a) Go tlamela ka badiredi mafapha a porofense ka go thapa badiredi ba ba gaisangb) Go konosetsa go thapa botsamaisi jo bogolo lec) Go samagana ka tshwanelo le go retelelwa le bogwenegwene jwa boeteledipele.
tgt: 2.12 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuba iSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe kunye neNkqubo ye-UN yokuHlaliswa koLuntu iNkomfa yokuKhokela uTshintsho esiXekweni: Ukusuka kumaTyotyombe ukuya kwiNdawo zokuHlaliswa koLuntu ezingenaMkhethe, eziKhuselekileyo, ezoMoleleyo kunye neziZinzileyo, ngeyoKwindla ngowama-2016.Le nkomfa ixhasa amaphulo ehlabathi ophuhliso kunye nawalapha ekhaya ngokubethelela iNjongo ye-11 yeeNjongo zoPhuhliso eziZinzileyo ethi: ‘Yenza izixeko kunye neendawo zokuhlalisa uluntu zingabi namkhehe, zikhuseleke, zomelele kwaye zizinze.’Le nkomfa iyinxalenye yeengxoxo ezingokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso ye-UN yasemva konyaka wama-2015 kunye “ne-Ajenda eNtsha ngeeDolophu” eza kwamnkelwa yi-UN ngowama-20.13 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba iBhunga loPhando lezoLimo lisingathe iNkomfa yesiThathu engoPhando ngezoLimo kuPhuhliso ngekaTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Dipuisano tse di leng Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi go simolola ka la bo 11 go fitlha ka la bo 12 Mopitlwe 2016, e leng seo se tla nnang ka fa tlase ga taolo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU).Seno se diragadiwa jaaka kopano ya go lekola ya Dipuisano tse di Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi magareng ga Aforika le Russia, e leng seo se ikaeletseng go tlhagisa maemo a a kopanetsweng tebang le go samagana le mathata a lefatsha a a ka ga diritibatsi.
tgt: Le nkomfa iza kukhetha: imiba ephambili yophando noyilo lwezinto ezintsha kwihlabathi kwaye nezinto ezifunekayo kwiinkqubo zesizwe zokuyila izinto ezintsha ukuze kufezekiswe injongo zexa elizayo, ingakumbi kumafama alimela nje ukuzondla wona neentsapho zawo kunye nemimandla engathathi ntweni.

src: Seno se tla tlhagisiwa kwa Kopanong e e Itlhophileng ya UNGA ka Moranang 2016.Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tseo di seng mo molaong e tsamaisana le NDP e bile Dipuisano eno e tla tlhagisa serala sa go ka tsweletsa go gagamatsa Leano la Botlhokwa la Diritibatsi la Bosetšhaba (2013-2017).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho osaYilwayo wezokuCwangciswa kweMimandla eseLwandle wama-2015 ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Bonno jwa Batho le tshware mmogo Khonferense le Lenaane la Bonno jwa Batho la “Ketelelopele ya Diphetogo mo Motseteropong: go tswa kwa megoafatsheng go lebisa kwa Bonnong jwa Batho jo bo akaretsang botlhe, jo bo babalesegileng, jo bo sa Tseweng ke Ditsuatsue le jwa Leruri” ka Mopitlwe 2016.Khonferense e tshegetsa maphata ka bobedi e leng lephata la tlhabololo la boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le lephata la tlhabololo la fa gae ka go gagamatsa tshegetso Peelong ya bo 11 ya Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Leruri: Go dira gore diteropokgolo le bonno jwa batho di fitlhelesege, di babalesege, di se tsewe ke ditsuatsue mme e nne tsa leruri.
tgt: Lo Mthetho usaYilwayo ulikhubalo elisemthethweni elicacisa iindlela zokuvula amathuba kuqoqosho lwaselwandle ngokukhuthaza ucwangciso lwemimandla yaselwandle ekubanjiswanayo ngalo.

src: Khonferense ke karolo ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go tsenngwatirisong ga Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la Dinagakopano (UN) la morago ga 2015 mmogo le “Lenaneo le Lentšhwa la Teropo” leo le tla amogelwang ke Dinagakopano (UN) ka 2016.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uza kuncedisa kumaziko e-Operation Phakisa la akhoyo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo le tshware Khonferense ya Boraro e e ka ga Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo tebang le Tlhabololo ka Moranang 2016.
tgt: Ufuna ukukhuthaza intsebenziswano kunye neendlela yokulawula ulwandle ebonakalisa inkathalo.

src: Khonferense e tla nopola: dipatlisiso tsa boditšhabatšhaba le ditlapele tsa boitshimololedi mmogo le ditlhokego mo thulaganyong ya boitshimololedi mo nageng gore go kgonagale go ka fitlhelela dipeelo tse di tlang tsa tlhabololo, bogolosegolo mo malapeng a balemirui mmogo le baagi ba ba humanegileng.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku loXolelwaniso ngomhla we-16 kweyoMnga eza kubanjelwa eBhayi, kwiphondo laseMpuma Koloni phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuvala umsantsa: Ukwakha isizwe soMzantsi Afrika esibambeneyo kulungiselelwa isizwe esikhulayo”.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Molaotlhomo wa Tiromaano ya Sekgoba sa kwa Mawatleng wa 2015 gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: UMphathiswa weziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi, uGq Siyabonga Cwele, uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika kwi-UNGA ngeNgqungquthela yeHlabathi yezobuChwepheshe ngoLwazi (i-WSIS) ukusuka ngomhla we-15 ukuya kowe-16 kweyoMnga ngowama-2015, apho kuza kunikwa ingxelo eluluvo loMzantsi Afrika, luncedisa kwi-WSIS+10 eyingxelo engeyonxalenye yeengxoxo ze-WSIUluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo.

src: Molaotlhomo yoo o abelana ka letlhomeso la semola go ka bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi ya kwa mawatleng ka go rotloetsa tiromaano ya sekgoba sa dikoporasi.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usingathe ngempumelelo iNgqungquthela yesiXhenxe yeziXeko zase-Afrika yezixeko noomasipala base-Afrika eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wama-29 kweyeNkanga ukuya ngomhla wesi-3 kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele mokete wa naga wa Letsatsi la Poelano ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapa Botlhaba ka fa tlase ga moono: "Go fokotsa dikgaogano: Go aga Legae la Setšhaba sa Aforika Borwa se se lebisang kwa pusong e tlhabololang setšhaba.
tgt: Le ngqungquthelo ibigxininisa kumba wokomeleza oorhulumente basekhaya kwilizwekazi le-Afrika, ingakumbi umba wokuphathwa kwemali kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho imithombo ezinzileyo yokwenza ingeniso, kulungiselelwa ukufezekiswa iiNjongo zowama-2063 – i-Afrika esiyifunayo.

src: Tona ya Lefapha la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso, Ngaka Siyabonga Cwele, o tla etelelapele baemedi ba Aforika Borwa kwa UNGA kwa Samiting ya Lefatshe ya Setlhopha sa Tshedimosetso go tloga ka la bo 15 go fitlha ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole 2015, mo maemo a naga ya Aforika Borwa, a tla nnang le seabe mo go WSIS+10 mo go ka se tlhagisiweng Pampiri-Epe.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ixhasa iinjongo ze-NDP apho izixeko kunye norhulumente wasekhaya zidlala indima ebalulekileyo kulo lonke uphuhliso.

src: Ka fa tlase ga moono: “Go baakanya bokamoso jwa Aforika le batho: seabe sa bothati jwa selegae jwa Aforika mo lenaaneng la 2063 la Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika” samiti, eo e ngoketseng dimeyara di le 15 000 le dikhanselara di le 500 000, ke enngwe ya matsholo a a matla a go aga tshwaraganelo ya Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ayikalilahli ithemba lokuba iingxoxo eziqhubayo kwiseshoni yama-21 yeNkomfa yamaZwe athatha iNxaxheba (i-COP21) engeSivumelwano se-UN ngokuTshintsha kweMozulu (i-UNFCCC), ziza kufikelela kwisivumelwano esingazikudala makhwiniba nesiza kubophelela onke amazwe.

src: Samiti e ne e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo go matlafatseng dipusoselegae go ralala le kontinente ya Aforika, bogolosegolo botsamaisi jwa matlole le go tlhola motheo wa lotseno lo lo babalesegileng, gore go fitlhelelwa Lenaneo la 2063 la – Aforika yo re mo batlang.
tgt: Ingxaki yokutshintsha kwemozulu yingxaki yehlabathi lonke efuna izisombululo ezinokuphakanyiswa lihlabathi liphela, zithathwe ngamazwe ehlabathi ahlukeneyo amaninzi, ekhokelwa yi-UNFCC ehlonitshwa ivunywe lihlabathi ngobubanzi, futhi onke amazwe athatha inxaxheba efaka isandla.

src: Samiti eno e tshegetsa dipeelo tsa NDP mo diteropokgolo le dipusoselegae di tshamekang karolo e e botlhokwa mo tlhabololong ka botlalo.
tgt: EMzantsi Afrika, singatsho ngokungathandabuziyo, ukuba sinemigaqo-nkqubo ebonakalisa inkqubela, eqiqisiweyo kunye nehlakaniphileyo, kwaye nezicwangciso zokukwazi ukumelana neemeko zezulu ezitshintsha imihla nezolo.

src: Kabinete e tswelela go itshepa gore fa dipuisano di tswelela kwa Khoferenseng ya Makoko ya bo 21 (COP21) tebang le Letlhomeso la Tumelano ya Dinagakopano tebang le Phetogo ya Maemo a Loapi (UNFCCC), tumelano e e sa tseeng letlhakore e e tshwaraganyang maphata otlhe e tla amogelwa.
tgt: Le migaqo-nkqubo ingummiselo ongagungqiyo wophuhliso oluzinzileyo, oyintsika ephambili yoMbono wama-2030 okwi-NDP.3 Njengokuba le iyintlanganiso yeKhabhinethi yokugqibela yowama-2015, iKhabhinethi inqwenelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika okuhle kodwa kwiholide zokuphela konyaka.

src: Phetogo ya maemo a loapi ke bothata jwa lefatshe lotlhe mme go tlhokega tharabololo ya lefatshe lotlhe, e leng seo se ka baakanngwang ka tshwanelo ke dipuso di le mmalwa, ka fa tlase ga tetlelelo ya UNFCCC le makoko otlhe a tsaya WEBTOKEN Aforika Borwa re ka bua ka boikgantsho gore re tsentsetirisong dipholisi tse di mafolofolo e bile e le tsa boitshimololedi tse di gatelang pele, mmogo le maano a a samaganang le maemo a loapi a a fetogetseng ruri.
tgt: Ngomoya weli xesha loyolo kunye nathi njengabantu abakhonza Ubuntu, iKhabhinethi imelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bancede abantu kunye neentsapho ezingathathi ntweni kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Dipholisi tseno di laolwa ke metheo e e reretsweng ruri ya tlhabololo ya leruri, e leng karolo e e botlhokwa thata ya Ponelopele ya 2030 jaaka go tlhagelela mo NDJaaka e le kopano ya bofelofelo ya Kabinete monongwaga wa 2015, kabinete e eletsa maAforika Borwa otlhe matlhatsi le matlhogonolo mo pakeng e e tlang ya khunologo.
tgt: Sisizwe esikhathalelanayo, esihloniphanayo kwaye nesibancedayo aba basweleyo.

src: Ka mowa wa setlha seno le ka go tsweletsa mowa wa Botho, Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go ka thusa batho le malapa a a tlhokang mo ditšhabeng tsa bobone.
tgt: Lo Nyaka Mtsha uzayo usinika ithuba sonke sokuba sizibophelele kwakhona ekusebenzeleni ikamva eliqaqambileyo lethu sonke.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a yone le kutlwelobotlhoko kwa go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, yo a ragileng kgamelo ka Labobedi, 8 Sedimonthole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa intlungu kunye namazwi ayo ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zikaMohamed Ismail (obeteketiswa ngelika-“Issy”) Dinat, olandulele eliphakade ngoLwesibini umhla wesi-8 kweyoMnga.

src: Go se inaganele a le esi ga gagwe mmogo le mo go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo kgaratlhong go nnile le seabe mo go iponeleng kgololesego ya rona.
tgt: Ukuzinikela kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwakhe kuMzabalazo weNkululeko kwabanegalelo kwinkululeko yethu.

src: Fa re digela, Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa ao a obametseng tsa lekgetho ka go tsenya dipusetso tsa bone tsa lekgetho e leng seo se dirileng gore go nne le palogotlhe ya dipusetso tsa lekgetho di le 5.94 milione tse di amogetsweng tsa baobamelalekgetho.
tgt: Ngelokuqumbela, iKhabhinethi yenza umbulelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abathobele umthetho bangenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu, into ebonakalisa ukuba zingxelo zerhafu ezizigidi eziyi-5.94 ezingenisiweyo ngabahlawuli berhafu abenimivuzo kuphela.

src: Seno se kwa godimo ka 11.52% go gaisa ka 2014, e bile kobamelo ya baduelalekgetho ya go tsenya dikopo ka nako e fetile 90% mo dingwageng di le tharo tse di latelanang.
tgt: Eli nani linyuke nge-11.52% kwelama-2014, kwaye abo bafake iingxelo zerhafu kwangexesha bangaphezulu kwama-90% iminyaka emithathu ilandelelana.

src: Kobamelo e e jaaka eno ya maemo a a kwa godimo e thusa puso go abelana ka ditirelo tse di tokafatsang boleng jwa matshelo a baagi WEBTOKEN pakeng eno ya khunulogo, puso e tsenyatirisong matsholo a a farologaneng a a tlhokang gore maAforika Borwa otlhe mmogo le baeng ba yone go tshameka karolo ya bone mo go netefatseng gore ba keteka paka ya khunulogo mo tikologong e e babalesegileng e bile e sireletsegile.
tgt: Eli nani liphezulu labo bafake iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngexesha kunceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukuhambisa iinkonzo futhi aphucule umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe go dirisana mmogo le Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngeli thuba leeholide zokuphela konyaka, urhulumente uza kuqalisa ngamaphulo ahlukeneyo aza kufuna bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika nabo basindwendweleyo ukuba badlale eyabo indima ukuqinisekisa ukuba eli xesha leeholide zokuphela konyaka lonwatyelwa kwiimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezingenazingozi.

src: (SAPS) le go bega tiragalo efe kgotsa efe ya bosenyi mo malapeng le mo ditšhabeng tsa WEBTOKEN go kgoneng gore go amogelwe thologelo ya baeti ba ba kgabaganyang melelwane, mafapha otlhe a puso kwa meeding ya go tsena mo nageng go simolola ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2015 go fitlha ka la bo 14 Ferikgong 2016 go tla atolosiwa diura tsa one tsa tirelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuye wonke umntu ukuba asebenzisane nabeNkonzo zesiPolisa zoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kwaye baxele kwabasemagunyeni zonke izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho kumakhaya ethu neendawo esihlala kuzo.

src: One a tla akaretsa Lefapha la Boitekanelo, Lefapha la Temothuo, SAPS, Lefapha la Merero ya Selega le Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa (SARS).
tgt: La masebe aquka elezeMpilo, elezoLimo, elezamaPolisa, eleMicimbi yezeKhaya kunye neeNkonzo zeRhafu zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e kopane go buisana ka maemo a ikonomi le merero e e amang tekanyetsokabo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihlangene ngeenjongo zokuxoxa ngobume bezoqoqosho nemiba enxulumene nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: Kabinete e ne ya amogela dintlha tse dintsi tse di amang ikonomi ya naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele imiba eliqela enempembelelo kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Maemo go ralala lefatshe a koafetse mo dikgweding tse di fetileng.
tgt: Kwezi nyanga zakutsha nje imeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi iye isiba mbi.

src: Kgolo e e bokoa ya lefatshe lotlhe e supa tiragatso e e bokoa le dikotsi tse di kwa godimo mo dinageng tse di botlhokwa tse di tlhabologang, go akaretsa China.
tgt: Uhlumo loqoqosho olucothayo ehlabathini jikelele, ingakumbi, lubonakalisa ukuqhuba kakubi kunye nemingcipheko ephezulu kumazwe abalulekileyo asakhulayo aliqela, aquka neChina.

src: Poelomannong e e amogelegang e e solofelwang kwa USA e ka baka tlhatlogo ya dieelo tsa morokotso go ralala lefatshe.
tgt: Ukuphucuka kohlumo loqoqosho kwelizwe laseMelika (i-USA) obekulangazelelwa ngamazwe onke ehlabathi kulindeleke ukuba kungakhokelela ekunyukeni kwenzala kwimali-mboleko kwihlabathini jikelele.

src: Methamo e e ka fa tlase ga kgatelelo ya kgwebisano le maemo a a sa iketlang mo mebarakeng ya lefatshe ya matlole di gatelela tlhokego ya gore ditšhaba di tlhome tsepamo le go gata ka tlhoafalo mo dipakeng tse di latelang.
tgt: Umthamo ophantsi kurhwebo nombhodamo kurhwebo lwhlabathi kubethelelela ukubaluleka kokuba amazwe ehlabathi kufuneka aqine kwaye achule ukunyathela kwezi nyanga zimbalwa zizayo.

src: Kabinete e ne gape ya amogela gore go na le dipoelo dingwe tse di siameng ka ntlha ya tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli e e sa tlhotlhiwang.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphele ukuba iyeyakhona iinzuzo kwixabiso eliphantsi le-oli ekrwada.

src: Jaaka moromelantle wa diphatlho o mogolo, Aforikaborwa e tlhobaediwa ke bokoa bo bo tswelelang ba ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho.
tgt: Njengelizwe elithumela ikakhulu izimbiwa kumazwe angaphandle, uMzantsi Afrika uxhalabile kukuhla okuqhubekayo kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa.

src: Puso e tswelela go agelela mo maemong a ikonomi ya naga a mefutafuta, le dipoelo tsa thomelontle di tswelela go ikaega go le gontsi ka dimetale le dire tse di tlhotlhilweng go se kae.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhuba ekwakheni kwiziseko zoqoqosho ezahlukahlukeneyo zeli lizwe, kwaye ingeniso evela ekuthunyelweni kwemveliso kumazwe angaphandle kuyaqhuba ukuxhomekeka ikakhulu kwisinyithi kunye neempahla zorhwebo ezingalungiselelwanga ngokugqibeleleyo.

src: Go wa ga ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho go ka se dirologe ka bonako.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa akukhangeleki ngathi kungatshintsha ngokukhawuleza.

src: Se se tla nna le ditlamorago tse di tla tswelelang mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa le tsa dinaga tse dingwe tse dintsi tse e leng balekane ba rona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba neziphumo ezibi kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika nakuninzi lamazwe esirhweba nawo kwilizwekazi le-Afrika..Ukwehla kwexabiso leRandi kule minyaka imbalwa idlulileyo kunika ithemba elingcono kuhlumo lwemveliso ethunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle kwaye, kudityaniswe nexabiso le-oli eliphantsi ehlabathini jikelele, kuye kwanceda kwanika isiqabu kuxinzelelo kwimali ekhoyo karhulumente.

src: Kwelotlase ya Ranta mo dingwageng di le mmalwa tse di fetileng e tlamela ka ditšhono tse di botoka tsa kgolo ya thomelontle mme, mmogo le tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli, e thusitse go fokotsa kgatelelo mo akhaontong ya matlole ya naga.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, uhlumo olubuthathaka kumahlakani ezorhwebo aphambili oMzantsi Afrika luye lwathetha ukuhla kwezinga ezifunwa ngalo iimveliso zoMzantsi Afrika kumazwe angaphesheya.

src: Le fa go le jalo, kgolo e e bokoa mo balekaneng ba Aforika Borwa ba kgwebisano e kaya topo e e fokotsegileng ya ditlhagiswa tsa Aforika Borwa kwa dinageng tse dingwe.
tgt: Imeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi jikelele ithathwa njengomngeni ingakumbi kumazwe asakhulayo, nanamaxabiso aphantsi ezimbiwa nokuqiniswa kwemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali e-USA okubeka uxinizelelo ekungeneni nasekuphumeni kwemali namazinga ohlumo alindelekileyo.

src: Maemo a lefatshe a tsewa a gwetlha mo mebarakeng e e alogang, ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa tlase tsa diphatlho le go gagamadiwa ga pholisi ya ditšhelete kwa USA e leng se se beileng kgatelelo mo kelelong ya madi le ditsholofelo tsa kgolo.
tgt: Oku kukhokelele ekubeni kungabikho zinzo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi.

src: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, e leng lengwe la madi a mebaraka e e alogang le go gwebisanwang thata ka lona, e utlwisitswe botlhoko, segolo mo dibekeng tse di sa tswang go WEBTOKEN maemong a a bokete a a lefatshe, a mo go ona diikonomi tsotlhe di lebaganeng le dikgwetlho tse dikgolo, Kabinete e gateletse tlhokego ya gore puso e tsereganye ka botlhale le ka go tsaya tshwetso go busetsa segalo sa kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: IRandi yaseMzantsi Afrika, neseyiphakathi kwezinye zeemali ekurhwetywa ngayo kakhulu yamazwe asakhulayo, ibethwe ngokukodwa zimeko zoqoqosho kwezi veki zisanda kudlula.

src: Puso e tla golagana le balekane ba loago, segolo kgwebo le mekgatlo ya badiri, go bopa tumalano mo dikgatong tse di kopanetsweng tse di tlhokegang go tsepamisa ikonomi, go bopa tshepo, go tsholetsa maemo a peeletso le poelo mo Aforika Borwa go ya ntlheng ya kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.
tgt: Kule meko imaxongo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi, apho onke amazwe ajongene nemingeni enzima iKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukubaluleka kokuba urhulumente angenelele ngobuchule nangokupheleleyo ukubuyisela isantya uqoqosho obeluhluma ngayo.

src: Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ka 11 Tlhakole e tla tsaya tsia tiro e. Kabinete e tiisitse mekgwa e e maatla ya go busetsa tsela e e isegang ya matlole go lebilwe koafalo e e nnileng teng mo ikonoming ya lefatshe le ditlamorago tsa yona mo gae.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) siwalungiselele la manyathelo okungenelela.

src: Tona ya Matlotlo, Pravin Gordhan, o tla ribolola ditsela tse fa a ala tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba ka 24 Tlhakole Tlamelo ka matlole go Thuto e KgolwaneKabinete e amogetse diphetolo mo dikabong tsa tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba tse di tla fetisang matlole go thusa diyunibesithi ntle le go fetisa ditekanyetso tse di begilweng tsa tirisong ya matlole.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kuthethana namahlakani akhe, ingakumbi abezoshishino nemibutho yezabasebenzi, ukuze kufikelelwe kwizivumelwano ngamanyathelo ekuza kubanjiswana ngawo ukomeleza uqoqosho, ukwakha ukuthembeka, ukunyusa izinga lotyalo-mali nokubuyisela uMzantsi Afrika kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho oluquka wonke umntu.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, Blade Nzimande, go sa le gale ba supile gore dikabo tse di tla dirisediwa gore dituelo di se tlhatlosiwe jaaka go dumelanwe mo ngwageng wa ga jaana wa dithuto, go phimola sekoloto sa baithuti sa Sekema sa Thuso ya Matlole sa Baithuti sa Bosetšhaba le go thibela kokotsego ya sekoloto se mo pakagareng.
tgt: INtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) eza kuba ngomhla we-11 kweyoMdumba iza kuwuthathela ingqalelo lo msebenzi.

src: Mekgwa e ya tsereganyo ke tsibogo ya ditherisano di le mmalwa tse di simolotseng ka Diphalane 2015 e bile di santse di tswelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumeze amanyathelo aluqilima ukubuyisela umzila wezezimali ozinzileyo, iyithathele ingqalelo inkangeleko ebuthathaka yoqoqosho lwehlabathi jikelele kunye nemiphumela yayo apha ekhaya.

src: Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso le setlhopha sa gagwe sa bolaodi o tshwere dikopano di le mmalwa le boeteledipele ba SASCO, Makgotla a Dikemedi tsa Baithuti otlhe, Foramo ya Diyunibesithi tsa Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ba Aforika Borwa, boCEO ba diSETA, Mokgatlo wa Tlhabololo ya Thuto e Kgolwane le komiti ya Palamente e e nang le maikarabelo a thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: Inkxaso-mali yezeMfundo ePhakamileyoIKhabhinethi iziphumezile izilungisokuhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lesizwe apho kuza kuxulwa imali ukuze ixhase iidyunivesithi kungakhange kophulwe izicwangciso zenkcitho ezasibhengezo esasenziwe somda wenkcitho.

src: Moporesitente o kopane gape le boeteledipele ba baithuti e bile o ba begetse ka go tlhongwa ga Khomišene e e tla lebang dintlha tse di tlhagisitsweng ka ga Thuto e Kgolwane.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho uBlade Nzimande kutsha nje bachaze ukuba ezi mali ziza kuvala isikroba esivelileyo ngenxa yokunganyuswa kwemali yokufunda ekuvunyelwene ngako kulo nyaka, ukucima amatyala asele ekhulile atyalwa ngabafundi beSkimu soNcedo lwezeZimali saBafundi seSizwe (i-NSFAS) nokuthintela ukukhula kwamatyala lawo kwisigaba WEBTOKEN manyathelo okua aziziphumo zothotho lweentlanganiso ezaqala kweyeDwarha yowama-2015 nezisaqhubekayo sithetha nje.

src: Mo maemong a ga jaana, dibilione tsa diranta tse 2.33 di abetswe go samagana le tlhaelo mo go tlameleng diyunibesithi ka matlole ka ntlha ya tumalano ya koketso ya dituelo ka 0% ka Mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17, puso e abile sešwa dibilione tsa diranta di le 2.543 tsa matlole a Puso go abelwa NSFAS go tlamela ka dikadimo tsa go thusa baithuti ba ba supilweng ke NSFAS ba le 71 753 mme ba ne ba tlametswe ka seripa fela kgotsa ba sa tlamelwa gotlhelele ka matlole mo dingwageng di le tharo tse di fetileng tsa dithuto.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMfundo noQeqesho neqela lakhe labalawuli ubambe iintlanganiso ezininzi neenkokheli ze--SASCO, onke amaBhunga abaMeli babaFundi (ii-SRC), uMbutho weeDyunivesithi zaseMzantsi Afrika, iManyano yabaFundi baseMzantsi Afrika , amaGosa aziNtloko zeziGqeba zoLawulo (ii-CEO) we-SETA, uMbutho weNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye nekomiti yasePalamente ejongene nezemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Se se kaya gore baithuti ba ba tshwanelwang ba, ba ka se ganediwe go tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona ka ntlha ya fa ba na le dikoloto tse di saletseng morago tsa diyunibesithi.
tgt: UMongameli naye ukwadibene kunye neenkokheli zabafundi waza wavakalisa ngokumiselwa kweKhomishini eza kuqwalasela imiba ephakanyiswe kwicandelo lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go baithuti, badiri, batlhatlheledi le batsamaisi ba diyunibesithi go dirisana mmogo le puso go fitlhelela maikaelelo a. Dikgato tse di kgoreletsang dithuto kgotsa di tlholang maemo a a sa iketlang kgotsa go solofela dilo tse di ka se fitlhelelegeng, ga di na thuso epe.
tgt: Ezi ndibano zisaqhuba kuba njengorhulumente sikholelwa ekubeni siyafuna ukusebenzela ekufumaneni isisombululo esiza kusabela kuzo zonke ezi ngxaki.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go lemoga gore go na le maemo a a gwetlhang mo pakeng e e tlang.
tgt: Izinyanzeliso zabafundi ziyahambelana neenjongo zenkqubo karhulumente ngokumalunga nezemfundo.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e e tlhagisitsweng ka Labone, 11 Tlhakole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho engoBume beSizwe kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ayenze ngoLwesine umhla we-11 kweyoMdumba.

src: Puo e tlhomile mosupatsela wa togamaano wa tiragatso ya Lenaanetiro la Puso.
tgt: Le ntetho ibonise indlela mayelana nokusebenza kwenkqubo karhulumente yokungena endimeni.

src: Moporesitente o ikuetse mo pusong, mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le mo kgwebong go dira mmogo go bona ditharabaololo tsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e nnelang leruri.
tgt: UMongameli umemelele urhulumente, abasebenzi namashishini ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana ukuze bafumane izisombululo eziza kunceda ekukhuliseni uqoqosho ngokuzingileyo.

src: Kabinete e tshegetsa dikgato tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo tse di itsesitsweng ke Moporesitente tse di tla tlhalosiwang ke Tona ya Ditšhelete ka la bo 24 Tlhakole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amanyathelo okuthoba inkcitho, manyathelo lawo aza kwaziswa nguMphathiswa wezeMali ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba.

src: Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016/17 e tla tlhagisa kabelo ya ditlamelo go ya kwa manaaneng a a farologaneng a puso go ya jaaka Moporesitente a gateletse.
tgt: INtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-malii lowama-2016/17 iza kuphinda ibonise indlela yokwabiwa kwamancedo ngokweenkqubo ngeenkqubo zikarhulumente, ngokokugxinisisa kukaMongameli.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Indaba ya Meepo e e atlegileng e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 11 Tlhakole.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgqungquthela yezeMigodi ebibanjelwe ngempumelelo eKapa ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-11 kweyoMdumba.

src: Baemedi ba ba eteletseng pele go tswa kwa lephateng la meepo le dipuso tse di farologaneng tsa Aforika ba arogane megopolo ya bona malebana le ka moo lephata le ka tsamaisang dipeeletso ka teng mmogo le go dirisa ditšhono tse di leng teng mo Aforika.
tgt: Abameli abaphambili becandelo lezemigodi noorhululumente abaninzi base-Afrika babelana ngeembono zabo malunga nendlela eli candelo elingaluqhuba ngayo utyalo-mali lixhamle nakumathuba akhoyo e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e lebogetse maitlamo a a dirilweng ke puso ya Japane a go oketsa dipeeletso tsa yona mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqhwabele izandla ukuzinikela korhulumente waseJapan ekunyuseni utyalo-mali lwayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse maitlamo a yona a lephata la meepo le le tsepameng e bile le dira ka katlego.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwayo kwicandelo lezemigodi elizinzileyo neliphumelelayo.

src: Tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Indaseteri ya Meepo e e nnelang Leruri e tshegetsa indaseteri ya meepo mo seemong sa ga jaana se se boima.
tgt: IsiCwangciso-sikhokelo sesiVumelwano seCandelo lezeMigodi eliZinzileyo sixhasa icandelo lezemigodi kule meko inzima igqubayo.

src: Puso e tswelela go tlamela ka netefaletso ya taolo mme e tla netefatsa gore go konosediwa Molaotlhomo wa Tlhabololo ya Dimenerale le Ditlamelo tsa Peteroliamo, o o fa pele ga Palamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko inika ingcaciso kunye nesiqinisekiso ngemithetho elawula ezemigodi kwaye iza kuqinisekisa ukuqukunjelwa koMthetho osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweziMbiwa nePetroliyam osePalamente kungoku nje.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya makgaolakgang ya Itekolesego, e e samaganang le dikgwetlho tse di kgoreletsang go dira sentle ga Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego, wa 2004 (Molao wa bo 7 wa 2004).Pholisi e setse e fetile mo tsamaisong ya patlomaikutlo a setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMgaqo-nkqubo wokugqibela weSizwe wokuNgcakaza ojongene nemingeni ethintela ukusebenza kakuhle koMthetho weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza, wowama-2004 (uMthetho uNombolo 7 wowama-2007).

src: Pholisi e tshitshinya dipaakanyo mo letlhomesong la taolo ya dipopegotheo tsa diboto tsa itekolesego mme e maatlafatsa didirisiwa tsa taolo go fokotsa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya itekolesego.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza nezilungiso kwimithetho elawula iibhodi zokungcakaza, kwaye iqinisa imiqathango yolawulo ukuze kuhle ukusetyenziswa kakubi kokungcakaza.

src: E ama dikhasino, dibingo, metšhini e dituelo tsa yona di lekanyeditsweng mmogo le go betšha dipitsi.
tgt: Usebenza kwiikhasino, kwi-bingo, koomatshini bokungcakaza abangahlawuli kakhulu nasekubhejeni emidyharhweni yamahashe.

src: Pholisi e tla emisetsa Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Itekolesego ka Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego o o tla ikarabelang ka tlhamalalo kwa Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kutshintsha iBhodi yeSizwe yezokuNgcakaza, ijike ibe nguMlawuli weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza oza kuba phantsi kweSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Pegelo ya Tshekatsheko ya Dingwagapotlana tsa go Golegwa Bosenyi kwa Palamenteng, e leng se se tlhokegang go ya ka Molao wa Bosiamisi wa Bana, wa 2008 (Molao wa bo 75 wa 2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iNgxelo engokuPhononongwa kweYona miNyaka iVumelekileyo ukuba uBani angaBekwa iTyala loLwaphulo-mthetho ingeniswe ePalamente ngokommiselo woMthetho wezoBulungisa baBantwana, wowama-2008 (uMthetho uNombolo 75 wowama-2008).

src: Pegelo e atlenegisa gore naga e amogela maitlamo a boditšhabatšhaba le a kgaolo malebana le dingwagapotlana tsa go golegelwa bosenyi tsa bana ba ba iphitlhelang ba na le kgotlhang le molao.
tgt: Le ngxelo ikhuthaza ukuba ilizwe eli lamkele izinyanzeliso zamazwe ngamazwe nezeengingqi malunga neyona minyaka mincinci ivumelekileyo yabantwana abanokuthi baphule ngayo umthetho.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tsenngwa mo kaseteng ga Dikgaolo tsa Tlhabololo ya Maatla a a Ntšhwafadiwang (REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba lombuso kweZiza zokuPhuhliswa kwaMandla aHlaziyekayo (i-REDZ).

src: Seno se tla rulaganya thulaganyo ya taolo, sa supa mafelo a go ka maatlafadiwang dithekenoloji tsa motlakase wa phefo le wa letsatsidi ka bonwang le moo go ka atolosiwang tlamelo ya mafaratlhatlha a a boteng gona.
tgt: Ezi ziza ziza kucwangcisa iinkqubo zokumisela imithetho, zichonge iindawo apho ubuxhakaxhaka bobuchwepheshe bomoya nelanga be-photovoltaic bungakhuthazwa khona nalapho bungalawulwa khona.

src: Di-REDZ tseno di tla netefatsa kgabaganyo ya go ya kwa ikonoming e e tlhagisang khabone e e kwa tlase, di akofise tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha, le go tshwaela mo letlhomesong le le rulaganeng e bile le bonelwa pele la taolo le le fokotsang tsamaiso e e amanang le ditshenyegelo tsa go obamela.
tgt: Ezi REDZ ziza kuqinisekisa ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olusebenzisa ikharbon ephantsi, zikhawulezise uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, kwaye zibe negalelo kwimithetho evakalayo necacileyo eza kuphugula ubucukubhede obuhambelana nexabiso lokuthobela.. IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zowama-2014 zeNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yeziKhombisi zeNzululwazi, ubuChwephweshe nobuChule bokuYila yeBhunga leSizwe leeNgcebiso ngezokuYila.

src: Kabinete e boleletswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Aforika Borwa ya 2014 ya Disupi tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Boitlhamedi mo Lekgotleng la Bosetšhaba la Bokgakolodi jwa Boitlhamedi.
tgt: Le yingxelo yezinto ezenzekayo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yeSizwe yezokuYila (i-NSI).

src: Pegelo eno e tlamela ka mokgwa wa tiragatso wa Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitlhamedi (NSI).
tgt: Ihlola ukwenza umsebenzi negalelo le-NSI kwizinto eziphambili ezingundoqo kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).

src: E sekaseka tiragatso le tshwaelo ya NSI mo ditlapeleng tsa botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng mo Leanong la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NPD).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukusetyenziswa kwamagosa karhulumente adla umhlalaphantsi nalowo asaqeshiweyo njengabahlohli kwisiKolo sikaZwelonke sikaRhulumente (i-NSG).I-NSG yaqala ukusebenza ngowama-2013, sithatha indawo yeZiko lokuQeqesha ubuNkokeli noLawulo (i-PALAMA), kwaye sigunyaziswe ukuba sikhuthaze ukuphuhla okuphucukileyo kwezinto ezingundoqo nemithetho-siseko elawula ulawulo lwamagosa karhulumente kwaye sibe semgangathweni, sibe nefuthe ekuphuhliseni izakhono zabasebenzi kumaziko.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tiriso ya badiredisetšhaba ba ba rotseng tiro le ba ba dirang jaaka batlhatlheledi kwa Sekolokatisong sa Bosetšhaba sa Puso (NSG).NSG e tlhomilwe ka 2013, e tsena mo legatong la Setheo sa Tsamaiso le Boeteledipele jwa Botsamais jwa Thuto mo Pusong (PALAMA), mme thomo ya yona ke go tsweletsa phitlhelelo e e tswelelang ya boleng le dintlhatheo tse di laolang tsamaiso ya puso le go tokafatsa boleng, katoloso le ditlamorago tsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni jwa badiri mo ditheong.
tgt: Eli linge liza kukhe livavanywe kuqala nokusebenza kweNKqubo esisiNyanzelo yoQhelaniso yabasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Maiteko ano a tla lekelediwa ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga Lenaane le le Pateletsang la Kitsisotiro la badiredisetšhaba.
tgt: Le nkqubo yenza abasebenzi bakarhulumente babe lulutho kwinkonzo karhulumente.

src: Mokgwa ono o kgontsha badiredisetšhaba go oketsa boleng mo tirelong setšhaba.
tgt: Baza kwabelana ngamava abo, ubungcali, izakhono kunye nolwazi ukuze bacebise kwaye bancede abasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Ba tla dirisa maitemogelo a bona, bokgoni le kitso go tataisa le go rotloetsa badiredisetšhaba.
tgt: Eli linge liza kuphinda liphucule kakuhle nangendlela eyonga inkcitho izinga leenkonzo esizinika uluntu.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa ya Legato la Bofelo la bo 3 le le malebana le go Tsenngwa tirisong ga Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo (OECD) (Tumelano e e kgatlhanong le Pipamolomo).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yesiGaba sesi-3 sokuGqibela engokuPhunyezwa koMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso loQoqosho (i-OECD) (iSivumelwano esiChasana nokuNyoba.

src: Pegelo e tshwanetse go neelwa Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Pipamolomo sa OECD.
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kungeniswa kwiQela eliSebenza ngokuNyoba.

src: Pegelo e tlhalosa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke naga ka ditsereganyo tsa yona tsa go fedisa pipamolomo ka go e supa, go batlisisa mmogo le go e sekisetsa.
tgt: Ingxelo le icacisa nenkqubela karhulumente ekungeneleleni kwakhe athintele ukunyotywa ngabamanye amazwe, ngokukubona, ukukuphanda nokubutshutshisa.

src: Gape pegelo e sedimosa maiteko a a tserweng go lemosa ka bosenyi jono.
tgt: Ingxelo ikwagqamisa nelinge lokuvula abantu amehlo ngolu lwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae (DHA) le aroganngwe gape ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Pabalesego.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) lihlelwe ngokutsha libe phantsi kweNtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, uThintelo lolwaPhulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae ke go tshola le go babalela rejisetara ya boammaaruri ya boitshupo le seemo sa botlhe ba ba mo nageng ya rona, e leng sa botlhokwa se se kgontshang ditiro tse dingwe tsotlhe tsa mmuso.
tgt: I-DHA igunyaziswe ukuba ligcine irejista eluqilima, echanekileyo yokuba ngoobani, isithini imeko yabo, bonke abangaphakathi kwemida yeli lizwe, nto leyo encedisa kakhulu kweminye imisebenzi karhulumente.

src: Gape le romilwe go tsamaisa tsamaiso ya bofudugedi, e e amang ka tlhamalalo pabalesego ya bosetšhaba, tirisano ya loago mmogo le phitlhelelo ya diphitlhelelo tsa WEBTOKEN malobeng DHA e ne e arogantswe jaaka ditirelo tsa tshegetso ya tsamaiso ka kakaretso ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bolaodi le Tsamaiso.
tgt: Isebe likwagunyaziswe ukuba liphathe inkqubo yemfuduko, enefuthe ngqo kukhuseleko lwesizwe, ukunamathelana koluntu nokuphumeleliswa kweenjongo zophuhliso.

src: Molaotlhomo.1 Kabinete e amogetswe go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso, Tsweletso, Tlhabololo le Tsamaiso ya Kitso ya Tshimologo kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Kwilixa elingaphambili, eli Sebe lalihlelwe njengelixhasa ngeenkonzo zolawulo linqumbene nezokuPhatha kunye nezoLawulo.

src: Molaotlhomo ono ke wa go sireletsa, go tsweletsa le go tsamaisa dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo.
tgt: Imithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo wokuKhusela, ukuKhuthaza, ukuPhuhlisa nokuLawula uLwazi lweMveli.

src: O dira tlamelo ya go tlhomiwa le ditiro tsa kantoro ya Bosetšhaba ya dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo, tsamaiso ya ditshwanelo tsa batshodi ba kitso ya tshimologo, go tlhamiwa le ditiro tsa phanele ya Bogakolodi ya dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo.
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo injongo yawo kukukhusela, ukukhuthaza ukuphuhliswa nokulawulwa kweenkqubo zoLwazi lweMveli.

src: Gape o letlelela phitlhelesego le seemo sa phitlhelesego ya kitso ya merafe ya tshimologo le ya selegae, go tlhamiwa ga thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya go rekotiwa ga dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo, go kwadisiwa le go tlhomamisiwa ga badiragatsi ba tshimologo, kgokaganyo ya boitlhamedi jo bo ikaegileng ka kitso ya tshimologo.
tgt: Ubonelela ngokusekwa nangemisebenzi yeofisi yeeNkqubo zeSizwe zoLwazi lweMveli, ulawulo lamalungelo abo banolwazi lwemveli, ukusekwa nemisebenzi yabantu aBacebisi malunga neenkqubo zolwazi lwemveli.

src: Molaotlhomo o tla tshegetsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Dithoto tsa Tlhaloganyo, wa 2-13 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o Baakantsweng wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 2015 gore go tshwaelwe mo go ona.
tgt: Ukwavumela ukufikelela kunye nemiqathango yokufikelela kulwazi ngabahlali bomthonyama nabendawo, ukusekwa kwenkqubo yesizwe yokurekhoda iinkqubo zolwazi lwemveli, ukubhalisa, ukugunyazisa nokunikwa kweencwadi ezifaneleyo iincutshe zemveli, ukulungiselela nokulungelelanisa ulwazi lwemveli olungqiyame ngezinto ezintsha.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937).
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo uza kufezekisa iSilungiso seMithetho yoLwazi olungoloMqambi walo kuphela we- 2013 (uMthetho wama-28 we- 2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kweSilungiso soMthetho osaYilwayo wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zeMihlaba zowe-2015 ukuze uluntu luphefumle ngaso.

src: Molaotlhomo o ikaeletse go baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937) gore go fudugiwe go tswa kwa kantorong ya dikano ya dipampiri go ya kwa go ya mokgwa wa eleketoroniki.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zoMhlaba we-1937 (uMthetho wama- 47 we-1937) ukuze iofisi yezi ncwadi ibe yala maxesha asebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.

src: O samagana le merero ya tshireletsego ka go tlamela ka kwadiso ya diphetiso jaaka badirisi ba ba mo molaong ba thulaganyo ya kwadiso ya dikano ya eleketoroniki.2 Kabinete e amogetse go itsesewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boitekanelo jwa Dimela, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Loo nto ijonga imiba yokhuseleko ngokubonelela ngokubhaliswa kwabo bancutsheza ngokususa umhlaba komnye umntu uye komnye njengabagunyaziswe ukusebenzisa le nkqubo yokubhaliswa kwemihlaba ngobuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.2 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo weMpilo yeZityalo yowe-2015.

src: Molaotlhomo o lepalepanya melao ya Aforika Borwa le maitlamo a a maleba le dipeelo go gokaganya kgwebisano ya boditšhabatšhaba e e babalesegileng e bile e sa gobelele go netefatsa kgwebisano ya naga ya selegae le ya boditšhabatšhaba ya dimela le ditlhagiswa tsa dimela.
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo ulungelelanisa umthetho woMzantsi Afrika nezinyanzeliso kunye nemigangatho efaneleyo ukulungiselela urhwebo olukhuselekileyo nolungakhethi cala lamazwe ngamazwe ukuqinisa urhwebo lwasekhaya nolwamazwe ngamazwe lwezityalo neziveliso zezityalo.

src: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe, Aforika Borwa o tla kgona go thibela go tlisiwa ga ditshenekegi le malwetsi a dinaga di sele a a tswaletsweng tse di ka anamisang ditshenekegi le malwetsi a a kotsi mo dimeleng tsa naga.3 Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Molao, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Wakuba uphunyeziwe lo mthetho osayilwayo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kukwazi ukuthintela ukungena kwezitshabalalisi zasemazweni ezivalelweyo ngenxa yezifo ezibulalayo kwanezifo ezinokusasaza izitshabalalisi ezinobungozi nezifo zezityalo elizweni.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1944 (Molao wa bo 32 was 1944) le Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tse di Kwa Godimo, wa 2013 (Molao wa bo 10 wa 2013).Paakanyo e lebeletse go fokotsa mathata a bakoloti ba ba iphitlhelang ba sotlakakiwa ke thulaganyo ya go koleka dikoloto kwa dikgotlatshekelong tsa bomagiseterata le go amogela porojeke ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo ya go tlosa tshedimosetso e e maswe ya sekoloto ya badirisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osiSilungiso osaYilwayo weeNkundla zamaTyala we-2015.Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1944 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1944) noMthetho osiSilungiso weeNkundla eziPhakamileyo we-2013 (uMthetho we-10 we-2013).Ezi zilungiso zijonge ukwenza lula imeko yabakwelitayo abazifumana bengamaxhoba okuphathwa kakubi yinkqubo yokuqokelelwa kwamatyala kwiinkundla zemantyi.

src: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go baakanya dikarolo tsa Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1994 (Molao wa bo 32 wa 1994) (MCA), go samagana le tshotlakako e e mo Taelong e e Baakantsweng ya Tuelo (EAO).Molaotlhomo o ikaelela go samagana le go fedisa dikatlholo tse di rebolwang e se ka fa molaong, gantsi di dirwa ke ditlelereke tsa kgotlatshekelo kwa ntle ga bookamedi jwa bosiamisi, mme gantsi ka ntlha ya go tlhoka maitemogelo, gongwe go dirisana le ba ba kolotwang, babueledi gongwe ba ba kolekang sekoloto.
tgt: Zikwajonge nokulungiselela iprojekthi yeSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino yokuguzula iinkcukacha ezimbi zesikweliti somthengi.

src: Molaotlhomo o tla netefatsa gore bakoloti ba newa katlholo e e obamelang taelo ya tuelo gongwe Taelo ya Go Tsewa ga Tuelo e e obamelang melao ya tuelo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ufuna ukulungisa amacandelo athile oMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1994 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1994) ukuze ujongane nokuphathwa kakubi kwiziHlomelo zeMiyalelo yokuNyanzelisa ukuHlawulwa (i-EAO).

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforikaborweng otlhe go dirisa tšhono eo le go tlotla temokerasi e e bonweng ka bothata ka go ya go dirisa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa go kwadisa le go tlhopha mo ditlhophong tse di tlang.2 Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran go tloga ka la bo 28 go fitlha la bo 29 Tlhakole 2016.Leeto le tla maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa rona tse di tswelelang pele tsa sepolotiki le ikonomi le Iran le go susumetsa dikamano tsa Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Mogarafatshe.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ujonge kwanokuphelisa izigwebo eziwiswa ngokungekuko, isikakhulu ngoomabhalane abangenaliso lamthetho, kumaxa amaninzi ngenxa yokungabi namava okanye ngokwenza igumgedle nabakwelitwayo, amagqwetha abo okanye abaqokeleli bezikweliti.

src: Jaaka Molaodimogolo wa Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF), Moporesitente Zuma o tla bo a tsamaisa kwa karolong ya botlhano ya meletlo ya Letsatsi la Matsholo a a Tlhometseng kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapabotlhaba, ka la bo 21 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uza kuqinisekisa ukuba abakwelitwayo bagwetyelwa ngendela ehambelana nomyalelo wokuhlawula ngezavenge okanye i-Emoluments Attachment Order ekwimida esemthethweni yokuhlawula ngezavenge.

src: Moletlo ono wa ngwaga le ngwaga o supa tshegetso le ditebogo go banna le basadi ba SANDF.3 Moporesitente Zuma o tla bua kwa pulong ya Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Dikgosi/Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Baeteledipele ba Setso kwa Palamenteng, Motsekapa ka la bo 26 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 Impelaveki yokuqala yokubhaliswa kwabavoti bebhaliselwa uNyulo lowe-2016 loRhulumente waseKhaya iza kuba ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: Botsalano magareng ga puso le baeteledipele ba setso bo botlhokwa jaaka mmogo ba direla go tokafatsa matshelo a batho.4 Ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 20 Thakole 2016, Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Ditona kwa Dipontshong tsa Moporesitente tsa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa kwa Grace Bible Church kwa Pimville, Soweto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abahlali boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baluxhamle kwaye baluzimase olu lawulo lwentando yesininzi olufumaneke nzima ngokuthi baphume balisebenzise ilungelo labo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi babhalise kwaye bavote kolu nyulo luzayo.2 UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwaseburhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran ukususela ngomhla wama- 28 ukuya kowama-29 kweyoMdumba ngowe- 2016.Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa ukunxibelelana okusoloko kuqhubeka kwezopolitiko noqoqosho ne-Iran kwaye luvuselele nobudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe aseZantsi kunye naseNtla kwe-Ikhweyitha.

src: Dipontsho tseno di tshegediwa ke mafapha a Merero ya Selegae, Badiri, Tlhabololo ya Loago le Phemelo.
tgt: NjengeNkumanda ePhezulu yoMbutho weSizwe wezoKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika (i-SAND), uMongameli Zuma uza kuphatha umcimbi woSuku lwecandelo loMkhosi lesihlanu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo bašweng ba lefelo leo go tsenela dipontsho, tse di tla tlamelang ka tshedimosetso ya gore ba ka tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona jang, ba itshimololela dikgwebo jang gongwe go ungwelwa mo maitekong a puso a tshegetso.5 Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Seminara ya Kgaolo ya Aforika ka ga Tshireletso ya Batho go ya ka Boitlhophelo jwa Bona jwa Bong, Boitshupo le Itlhagiso ya Bong, ke Khomišene ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ya Aforika Borwa, go tloga ka la bo 3 go fitlha la bo 5 Mopitlwe 2016.Seminara e tla gokaganya puisano gore go tlhaloganngwe botoka modi le go tlhagelela ga dikgwetlho tseno gore go bonwe ditharabololo tse di dirang mmogo le boitlhophelo jo bo gona mo Mebusong go samagana le dikgatako tseno.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo owenziwa unyaka nonyaka ubonisa inkxaso nombulelo kumadoda namabhinqa oMkhosi weSizwe woKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika.3 UMongameli Zuma uza kuthetha xa kuvulwa iNdlu yeSizwe yeeNkokheli zeMveli ePalamente eKapa ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016.

src: Kabinete e eleletsa barutwana botlhe ba ba kwalang ditlhatlhobo tsa Tlaleletso tsa Setifikeiti se Segolwane/Materiki masego.
tgt: Ubudlelwane phakathi korhulumente neenkokheli zemveli bubaluleke kakhulu kuba zisebenzela ukuphucula ubomi babantu.4 NgoMgqibelo umhla wama-20 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016, uSekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokhela igqiza laBaphathiswa ukuya kuMboniso kaMongameli woPhuhliso loLutsha eGrace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.

src: Barutwana ba rotloediwa go fitlhelela Lenaane le le sa tswang go tlhomiwa la tshegetso la tšhono ya bobedi ya materiki le le fitlhelwang kwa diporofenseng tsotlhe mme le thusa barutwana ka dithuto tsa bona ka ditlamelo tse di farologaneng.
tgt: Lo mboniso uxhaswa ngamasebe emiCimbi yaseKhaya, ezabaSebenzi, oPhuhliso loLuntu noKhuselo.

src: Maitlhomo a Lenaane la Materiki la Tšhono ya Bobedi ke go tlamela bašwa ba ba sa kgonang go fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa Setifikeiti sa Bosetšhaba se Segolwane (NSC), tšhono ya bobedi go amogela materiki mme ka go rialo ba tokafatse boleng jwa matshelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abantu abatsha baloo ndawo ukuba baye kulo mboniso oza kubonelela ngolwazi lokuqhubela phambili ezifundweni,ukuqala amashishini abo okanye ukuncedwa ngamalinge karhulumente enkxaso.

src: Ditlhatlhobo tsa tlaleletso ke karolo ya Lenaane la lefapha la Tshegetso la Tšhono ya Bobedi ya Materiki mme le naya barutwana ba ba iseng ba fitlhelele ditlhokegopotlana tsa go fetisiwa le go bona setifikeiti, ba ba tlhokang dirutwa tse pedi go fitlhelela NSC, tšhono ya go dira jalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubanjwa kweNdibano ye-Afrika engokuKhuselwa kwaBantu ngokweNdlela abaziBona, Abazichaza nabaZazi ngayo iSini sabi yiKhomishoni yoMzantsi Afrika yamaLungelo oLuntu ukususela ngomhla we-3 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: E ikuela mo baameging botlhe ba ba nang le kgatlhego mo Thutong e Kgolwane go tshwaela mo tirong ya khomišene gore go bongwe tharabololo ya leruri ya dikgwetlho tse di lebaganeng le Thuto e Kgolwane.
tgt: Le semina iza kulungiselela uthethathethwano ukuze kubekho kuqondwe ngakumbi oyena nobangela ongundoqo wale mingeni nokuzibonakalisa kwayo ukuze kufumaneke izisombululo ezibonakalayo nezinto ezikhoyo okunokukhethwa kuzo nguRhulumente ukujongana nolu lwaphulo.6 IKhabhinethi inqwenelela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala iimviwo zabo zokuxabangela iBanga le-12.

src: Tona ya Ditlamelo tsa Dimenerale Mosebenzi Zwane, Tona kwa Lefapheng le le mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente Susan Shabangu le Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Loago Bathabile Dlamini - ba ba neng ba tlhomilwe ke Moporesitente Zuma go tlamela tshegetso go puso ya porofene, beng ba moepo mmogo le malapa a a amegileng go latela matlhotlhapelo a kwa Moepong wa Gauta wa Lily kwa Barberton - ba tlhaloseditse Kabinete dintlha tsa ga jaana.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuxhamla iNkqubo esandula ukusungulwa enika abafundi umnyinyiva wesibini wokubhala iimviwo zebanga le-12.

src: Kabinete e ikamantse le Moporesitente ka go ikuela mo setšhabeng go baya badiri ba moepo ba ba sa ntseng ba gaeletswe ka fa tlase ga lefatshe mmogo le bamalapa a bona mo dithapelong.
tgt: Ikho kuwo onke amaphondo kwaye inceda abafundi ezifundweni zabo ngezixhobo.

src: Kabinete e sa ntse e tshwentswe ke komelelo e e sa ntseng e amile dikarolo dingwe tsa naga.
tgt: Injongo yeli Thuba lesiBini lokuBhala iBanga le-12 kukunika abantu abatsha abangaliphumelelanga ibanga le-12 umnyinyiva wesibini wokupasa, ngaloo ndlela baphucule izinga lobomi babo.

src: E tlhagisitse ditebogo go maAforika Borwa otlhe, a a tshegetsang maiteko a namolo ya komelelo.
tgt: Iimviwo zokuxabangela ziyinxalenye yeNkquba yokuNika iThuba lesiBini lokuBhala iiMviwo zeBanga le-12 yesebe kwaye inceda abo bangaphumelelanga nabangafumananga ziqinisekiso, kodwa befuna ubuncinane izifundo ezibini ukuze babe bapasile.

src: Kabinete e leboga botlhe ba ba tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa go bega go dutla go tshegetsa Letsholo la Ntwa ya go Dutla le le eteletsweng pele ke Tona ya Metsi le Bophepa Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela isibhengezo sikaMongameli samagama amalungu eKhomishoni yoPhando ngeMfundo ePhakamileyo.

src: Kabinete e itumelela mowa wa Botho/Ubuntu o o bontshitsweng ke maiteko a a eteletsweng pele ke Operation Hydrate a a dirileng pharologano mo baaging ba ba neng ba le mo tlalelong.
tgt: Imemelela bonke abanomdla nabachaphazelekayo kwiMfundo ePhakamileyo ukuba babe negalelo emsebenzini wekhomoshoni ukuze kufunyanwe isisombululo esiza kuhlala sihleli semingeni ejongene nayo iMfundo ePhakamileyo.1 Uluvo lweKhabhinethi malunga nemiba esematheniUMphathiswa weSebe lemiThombo yeziMbiwa uMosebenzi Zwane, ovela kwiSebe likaMongameli uSusan Shabangu noMphathiswa weSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu uBathabile Dlamini—abakhethwa nguMongameli Zuma ukubonelela ngenkxaso urhulumente wephondo, abasebenzi-mgodini neentsapho ezichaphazelekayo emva kwentlekele kuMgodi iLiily Gold Mine eBarberton – bachazele iKhabhinethi ngokutsha okwenzekayo.

src: Kabinete e ganetsane le go lebelela ditlamorago ka botlalo tsa go simolola go dirisiwa ga Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Kgethiso, 2014.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazibandakanya noMongameli ekumemeleleni isizwe ukuba sicinge ngabasebenzi-mgodini abathathu abasabambeke phantsi komhlaba kwaye sibathandazele.

src: Go ya ka Molao, go fetolelwa ga ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo go nna tse di duelwang ka paka e e rileng go tla simolola ka la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ixhalabile yimbalela esachaphazela iindawo ezithile zelizwe.

src: Seno se kaya gore go tloga ka letlha leo, ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo le ditshiamelo tsa letlole la phenšene di tla tsewa ka go lekalekana ka gore e tla re fa ditokololo tsa letlole la tlamelo di rola tiro di letlelelwe go tsaya nngwetharong ya ditshiamelo tsa tsona tsa letlole la tlamelo e le tuelo ya madi a a seatleng mme peditharong e e setseng ya ditshiamelo tsa bona ba tla e dirisa go reka tlamelo e e duelang madi ka paka e e rileng gongwe annuity.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvuyo lwayo kwabo basabele ikhwelo lokuxela ukuvuza kwamanzi ngolo hlobo bexhasa iPhulo loMphathiswa waManzi noCoceko uNomvula Mokonyanene.

src: Ditlamelo tseo ke tse di dirang mo ditokololong tsa matlole a phenšene ga jaana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyela umoya wobuntu obubonakaliswe liphulo elikhokhelwa yiOperation Hydrate nelenze umahluko kubahlali ababandezelekileyo.2 IKhabhinethi ixoxile yaqwalesela iziphumo ngokupheleleyo zokuqalisa koMthetho osisiLungiso seMithetho yeRhafu we-2014.

src: Diphetogo tsa molao di ama baamogedi ba ba kwa godimo mmogo le batho botlhe ba e leng ditokololo tsa matlole a tlamelo.
tgt: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukuhlawulwa kwemali esisigxina kwingxowamali egciniweyo kuza kuqalisa ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla ngo-2016.

src: Ditheo di le mmalwa le batho ba tlhagisitse matshwenyego ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga diphetogo tse dintšhwa mme ba dirile ditlhagiso kwa pusong malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong.
tgt: Loo nto ithetha ukuthi ukususela ngaloo mhla amancedo aloo ngxowa aza kufana nawomhlala-phantsi lo uqhelekileyo kuba amalungu aloo ngxowamali xa athatha umhlalaphantsi aza kuvunyelwa ukuba athathe isambukru esiziinkozo esisinye esithathwini kumancedo.

src: Go bonala gore le fa go nnile le thulaganyo e e tseneletseng ya patlomaikutlo e e dirilweng pele ga molao o ka fetisiwa, matshwenyego ao a sa ntse a le gona le gore go tshwanetse ga samaganwa le matshwenyego ao pele ka bonako go netefatsa gore fa molao o simolola go dira, diphetogo tsa ditshiamelo tsa letlole la tlamelo di tla diragadiwa sentle kwa ntle ga kgoreletsego.
tgt: Imali esalayo kuza kufuneka amalungu ayisebenzise athenge imali enikwa umntu ngomnyaka ebomini bakhe bonke.

src: Ka ntlha ya seo, Kabinete e sweditse go tlhagisa paakanyo ya molao ya Molao wa Paakanyo ya Melao ya Kgethiso e le ntlha e e akofileng go busetsa morago letlha la tshimologo go tloga go la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2016 go ya go la bo 1 Mopitlwe 2018 go letla gore go nne le patlomaikutlo ya baamegi ba botlhokwa gape.
tgt: Ezi nguqu emthethweni zichaphazela abo bamkela kakhulu nabanye abangamalungu engxowamali esisigxina.

src: Patlomaikutlo eno e ka baka gore go nne le paakanyo e nngwe ya melao.
tgt: Imibutho eminizi nabantu bavakalise inkxalabo ngokusebanza kwalo mthetho mtsha kwaye bathethe norhulumente ngawo.

src: Bishopo Modise o eteletse pele phuthego ya ditokololo tse di fetang dimilione di le tharo go ralala borwa jwa Aforika, go latela go tlhokafala ga ga rraagwe le mosimolodi wa kereke, Moitshepi Comforter Frederick Modise ka 1996.
tgt: Ngeso sizathu, iKhabhinethi igqibe kwelokuba yandlale ngokungxamiseke kakhulu isilungiso kuMthetho osiSilungiso seMithetho yeeRhafu ungaqalisi ukusebenza loo mthetho ngomhla wokuqa kweyoKwindla kowe-2016, koko uqale ukusebenza ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla kowe-2018 ukwenzela ukuba kuphinde kuthethathethwane nabachaphazelekayo.

src: Gape kabinete e romela matshediso malebana le go tlhokafala ga Mokwaledi-Kakaretso wa maloba wa Ditšhabakopano (UN) Kgosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano.1 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano ngokubhubha koHloniphekileyo uBhishophu Glayton Modise weInternational Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: O tsene mo kantorong ka 1992 ka nako ya fa tshusumetso ya UN e ne e gola go latela seabe sa botlhokwa kwa ntweng ya Kgokgometso, mme a dira paka e le nngwe ya dingwaga tse tlhano.
tgt: UBhishophu Modise ukhokhele ibandla elinamalungu angaphezu kweemiliyoni ezintathu kumazantsi eAfrika, emva kokubhubha kukayise nongumseki waloo cawe oHloniphekileyo uComforter Frederick Modise ngowe-19.2 IKhabhinethi ikwavakalisa uvelwano lwayo olunzulu ngokubhubha kutsha nje kwayesakuba nguNobhala-jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, iNkosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: O tlhokafaletse kwa sepetlele sa Cairo ka Labobedi a na le dingwaga tse O tla gakologelwa ka tshwaelo ya gagwe mo kagisong le temokerasi.
tgt: Ungene kweso sikhundla ngowe-1992 xa ifuthe lo mbutho lo likhula emva kwemfazwe yeGulf, wasebenza iminyaka emihlanu.

src: Kabinete e akgola Rre Kevin Govender wa Kantoro ya Motsekapa ya Bolepanaledi go lebeletswe Tlhabololo mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Bolepanaledi yo a tla abelwang mmogo Metale o o Tlotlegang wa Edinburgh wa 2016 ka ntlha ya go tlhoma Kantoro ya Bolepanaledi go lebeletswe Tlhabololo kwa Motsekapa.
tgt: Ubhubhe kwisibhedlele saseCairo eneminyaka engama- Uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe kuxolo nolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Govender ke moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go amogela sekgele seno se se tlotlegang sa diphitlhelelo tsa saense le thekenoloji e e tshwaelang mo go tlhaloganyeng le itekanelong ya batho.
tgt: Imiyalezo yokuvuyisana.1 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMnu.

src: Kabinete e akgola motantshi wa dingwaga di le 16 wa ballet, Leroy Mokgatle yo a gapileng sekgele sa Audience Favourite mmogo le sekolašipi kwa Kgaisanong ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Ballet ya Pris de Lausanne kwa Switzerland.
tgt: Kevin Govender we-Cape Town-based Office of Astronomy for Development and the International Astronomical Union oza kuwonga ngembasa enodumo iEdinburgh Medal yowe-2016 ngokuseka iOffice of Astronomy for Development eKapa.

src: Ke moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go gapa sekolašipi mo dingwageng di le 28 le wa bobedi mo hisetoring ya naga.
tgt: UGovender ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika ukufumana le mbasa yodumo ngempumelelo kwezenzululwazi netheknoloji, nto leyo ebenegalelo ekuqondeni uluntu nempilo yalo.

src: Kabinete e ikamanya le Moporesitente Zuma go akgola bafenyi ba Dikgele tsa bo 2 tsa Ngwaga le ngwaga tsa Ubuntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi halala kuLeroy Mokgatle ongumdanisi weballet nominyaka ili-16 owine imbasa iAudience Favourite nemali yokufunda kukhuphiswano i-International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.

src: Dikgele tseno di akgola baeteledipele ba indaseteri ba Aforika Borwa mmogo le batho ba ba tlhagelelang ka ntlha ya ditshwaelo tsa bona go tsweletsa dikgatlhego tsa rona tsa bosetšhaba mmogo le dintlhatheo tsa maitsholo a rona go ralala lefatshe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibandakanya noMongameli Zuma ngokuvuyisana nabo baphumelele i-2nd Annual Ubuntu Awards.

src: Kabinete e akgola flautist Wouter Kellerman, setlhopha sa cappella Ladysmith Black Mambazo le moopedi wa mmino wa sedumedi Neville D ka ntlha ya go supiwa mo dikgeleng tsa Grammy tsa 2016.
tgt: Ezi zimbasa eziwonga iinkokheli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika nabantu ababalaseleyo ngenxa yegalelo labo ekukhuthazeni izinto zethu zesizwe nezo zobomi ezingundoqo ehlabathini liphela.

src: Batsweretshi bano ba a rotloetsa e bile ba fofisetsa folaga ya Aforika Borwa kwa godimo tota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nombethi-mbande uWouter Kellerman, cappella group Ladysmith Black Mambazo nomculi wegospile uNeville D ngokuba ngabakhethiweyo kwiGrammy yowe-2016.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaaneo a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016 e e dirilweng ke Tona ya Ditšhelete Pravin Gordhan ka la bo 24 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali yowama-2016 ethe yenziwa nguMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yama-2016.

src: Tekanyetsokabo eno e bontsha go tsetsepela ga rona, maitlamo a rona mmogo le mosola wa rona fa re ntse re samagane le paka eno e e maswe go gaisa ya ikonomi mo ya mo malobeng.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lubonakalisa ukomelela, ukuzinikela nokuba nobuchule njengoko sichankcatha kwelona xesha lakhe lanzima kwezoqoqosho ezimbalini.

src: Tekanyetsokabo e tsibogela se naga e se tlhokang mme e dira gore go nne le boikanyego mo ikonoming ka go baya naga mo tseleng e e ikanyegang, ya leruri le e e ka diregang mme e akaretsa ya kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali luhlangabezana noko eli lizwe likudingayo kwaye lukwadala intembeko kwezoqoqosho ngokubeka eli lizwe kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho ethembakeleyo, ezinzileyo nedibene ngokuphilisayo.

src: Gape kabinete e amogela dikgato tsa botlhokwa tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo mme e itlama go dira mmogo le maphata otlhe go tshwaela mo maitekong a a tlhakanetsweng a bosetšhaba a go diragatsa kgato eno e e tlhomilweng ke tekanyetsokabo.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo abalulekileyo okugcina iindleko ziphantsi kwemo elawulekayo kwaye ikwazibophelela ekusebenzisaneni nawo onke amacandelo ekwenzeni igalelo kwilinge elidibeneyo lesizwe ukuphumeza umlima-ndlela omiselwe luhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Setlhopha sa Bobegakgang sa Moporesitente (PPC) ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa kweQela looNondaba likaMongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.

src: PPC e tla akaretsa batseleganyi ba dikgang tsa sepolotiki, bakwaladikgang ba sepolotiki, babegakgang ba dipolotiki mmogo le babegakgang ba ikonomi ba ba tlhomamisitsweng go bega dikgang tsa Kantoro ya Moporesitente ka dinako tsotlhe.
tgt: I-PPC izakuquka abahleli bezopolitiko, iintatheli zezopolitiko, oonondaba bezopolitiko neentatheli zezoqoqosho eziqinisekisiweyo ukuba zizo ezinegunya lokukhupha ingxelo nge-Ofisi kaMongameli ngokupheleleyo zihlale zisenza njalo rhoqo.

src: Maitlhomo a PPC ke go tlamela bobegakgang ka phitlhelesego e e tokafaditsweng ya tshedimosetso.
tgt: Injongo ye-PPC kukubonelela amajelo eendaba ngokufikelela okuphuculiweyo kulwazi.

src: Gape e tla tokafatsa go fitlhelesega ga Moporesitente le Kantoro ya Moporesitente mo bobegakgannyeng go netefatsa gore babegakgang ba amogela tshedimosetso ya lemorago le dithulaganyo go tokafatsa go tlhaloganya le go bega ga bona.
tgt: Iza kuphucula ukufikelela kwamajelo eendaba kuMongameli ne-Ofisi kaMongameli, khona ukuze iqinisekise ukuba iintatheli nazo zifumana ulwazi neenkqubo ezizeleyo ukuze kuphucuke indlela ababhala kunye nabazikhupha ngayo iindaba.

src: Ditokololo tsa setlhopha sa bobegakgang di tla amogela dipego go tswa go Motlatsamoporesitente le Tona nngwe le nngwe e Moporesitente a e laletsang go arogana manaane a botlhokwa a bosetšhaba.
tgt: Amalungu eliqelaloonondaba aza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiitlanganiso noSekela-Mongameli okanye nawuphi na uMphathiswa omenyiweyo nguMongameli ukuba babelane ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwisizwe.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse ditebogo ka ntlha ya karolo eo Aforika Borwa e nnileng le yona malebana le go busetsa kagiso kwa Burundi, go lepalepana le maitlamo a rona a dipholisi tsa dinaga di sele go netefatsa gore go nna le kontinente e e renang kagiso e bile e tsepame.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilincomile igalelo elenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ekubuyiseleni uxolo eBurundi, ngokuhambelana nesibophelelo somgaqo-nkqubo wethu wezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.

src: Gape e amogetse dipoelo tsa Puisano e e akaretsang ya ka fa gare ga Burundi e e neng e tshwerwe ka nako ya leeto la kemedi ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU), e e neng e eteletswe pele ke Moporesitente Zuma.
tgt: Kwakhona izamkele iziphumo zoThethathethwano oluquka bonke abemi baseBurundi obelubanjwe ngethuba igqiza eliphezulu leeNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente leMbumba yase-Afrika (i-AU), ebelikhokelwa nguMongameli uZuma, belityelele eBujumbura eBurundi.

src: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ga Moporesitente Zuma ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa Ditšhabakopano (UN) Ban Ki-moon, go tlhakanela bodulasetilo jwa Khomišene ya Maemo a a kwa Godimo ya Boitekanelo, Ditiro le Kgolo ya Ikonomi le Moporesitente François Hollande wa Rephaboliki ya France.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kukaMongameli uZuma nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) uBan Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngusihlalo wesibini kwiKhomishini ePhezulu yeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlumo lwezoQoqosho ebambisene noMongameli u-François Hollande weRhiphabliki yaseFrance.

src: Ga se la ntlha Moporesitente Zuma a thapiwa ke setheo sa lefatshe go dira tiro mo seraleng sa lefatshe.
tgt: Asikuko okokuqala ukuba uMongameli uZuma achongwe ngumbutho wehlabathi ukuba enze umsebenzi kwimibutho yehlabathi.

src: Khomišene e tla susumetsa go tlhamiwa ga ditšhono tsa ditiro tse dintšhwa mo lephateng la boitekanelo go ralala dinaga tsotlhe, bogolo segolo tse di sa tlhabologang mo go kalo.
tgt: Le khomishini iza kuvuselela ukudalwa kwamathuba amatsha emisebenzi kwicandelo lezempilo kuwo onke amazwe jikelele, ingakumbi kulawo aphuhliswe kancinci.

src: Gape seno se maatlafatsa go diragadiwa ga Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri, e leng se se tla thusang go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di maphata mararo a botlhokatiro, lehuma le go tlhoka tekatekano.
tgt: Oku komeleza nokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo yowama-2030, eza kunceda kakhulu ukuhlangabezana nemingeni entlantlu-ntathu yentswela-ngqesho, indlala nokungalingani.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Tshekatsheko ya Bosetšhaba ya Baagi ya 2016 kwa Mamelodi, Pretoria ke Tona mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente Jeff Radebe le Radipalopalokakaretso Pali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koPhando lweSizwe loLuntu lowama-2016 eMamelodi ePitoli nguMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli uJeff Radebe noSonkcukhacha-manani Jikelele uPali Lehohla.

src: Tshekatsheko ya monongwaga e dirwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "MoAforika Borwa yo ke mo itseng, legae le ke le tlhaloganyang" mme go totilwe magae a feta 1,5 milione - e leng palo e kgolo go gaisa fa e bapisiwa le e e neng e totilwe mo dingwageng di le tlhano tse di fetileng mo go neng go dirilwe tshekatsheko ya magae a le 300 000 fela.
tgt: Uhlolo lwalo nyaka lwenziwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika endiwaziyo, ikhaya endiliqondayo” kwaye lujongiswe kwimizi engaphezu kwe-1,5 sezigidi – lilolona lukhulu ukuza kutsho ngoku xa luthelekiswa nolo lwalwenziwe kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo elafikelela nje kwimizi engaphezulu kwama-300 000.

src: Tshekatsheko e tla dirwa ka Moranang mme dipholo di tla itsesewe kwa bokhutlong jwa Seetebosigo 2016.
tgt: Olu hlolo luza kwenziwe kwinyaga kaTshazimpuzi zize iziphumo zifumaneke ekupheleni kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e nopotse ke go tshwenngwa ke pegelo e e tlhagisitsweng ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Boitekanelo (WHO) le Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo mo Patlisisong ya Mmaraka wa Boitekanelo e e eteletsweng pele ke Moatlhodi Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ngenkxalabo ingxelo enikzelwe nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi kunye noMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kuPhando lweCandelo llezeMpilo olukhokelwa yiJaji uSandile Ngcobo.

src: Pegelo e supa gore Aforika Borwa e tlamela ka ditirelo tsa kalafi tse di tlhotlhwagodimo go gaisa fa e bapisiwa le dinaga tse dingwe.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngezona nkonzo zezonyango zibiza kakhulu xa uthelekiswa namanye amazwe.

src: Kabinete e tla emela go konosediwa ga patlisiso pele ga go dira kgoeletso ka morero ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuqukunjelwe olu phando phambi kokuba iphefumle ngalo mba.

src: Ditshwetso tsa botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Togamaanotlhomo ya go Samagana le Kgotlhelego ya Mowa mo Baaging ba Lotseno lo lo kwa tlase ba ba nnang mo go kitlaneng gona mo Aforika Borwa gore go dirwe ditshwaelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwakweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa iNgxaki yoNgcoliseko loMoya kwiiNdawo eziXineneyo Ezihlala Abantu abaMkela iMivuzo ePhantsi eMzantsi Afrika ukwenzela uluntu ukuba luhlomle.

src: Maikaelelo a togamaano ke go tlamela ka tsela e e tsepameng go samagana le seelo se se kwa godimo sa kgotlhelego mo baaging bangwe ba ba bonang lotseno lo lo kwa tlase mme ba nna mo go kitlaneng gona.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxile ekuboneleleni ngendlela egxile ekuzinikeleni ukusebenza ngezinga eliphezulu longcoliseko kolunye loluntu oluhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo nolwamkela imivuzo ephantsi.

src: E tlamela ka tsela e e gokaganeng ya go tsenngwa tirisong ga maiteko a go fokotsa go fisa dituki mo magaeng.
tgt: Sibonelela ngendlela elungeleleneyo ekuphumezeni amalinge okunciphisa ukuvutha kwezibaso emakhayeni.

src: Tsereganyo eno e ikaelela go netefatsa gore dikarolo tseno di obamela Seemo sa Bosetšhaba sa Boleng jwa Mowa wa Tikologo.
tgt: Olu ngenelelo lelokuqinisekisa ukuba le mimandla iyathobelana neMimiselo yoMgangatho weziRhangqo yeSizwe.

src: Togamaano eno e e tsepameng e tla tshegetsa togamaano e e leng teng ya bosetšhaba ya go samagana le kgotlhelego ya mowa mo nageng.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxilileyo siza kuxhasa isicwangciso-qhinga sesizwe esikhoyo ukuhlangabezana nongcoliseko lomoya kweli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Khonferense ya bo 21 ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya AIDS (AIDS 2016) ke puso le Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa AIDS kwa International Convention Centre (ICC) kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Phukwi 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba urhulumente abe lelinye lamahlakani aza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe kaGawulayo yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) ndawonye noNombutho eHlabathi kaGawulayo kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe ngezizwe (i-ICC) eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.

src: Go amogela khonferense go tla tokafatsa tsibogo ya naga ya rona ya HIV le TB fa go ntse go ama nngwe ya dikgwetlho tsa botlhokwa tota mo Aforika Borwa, mo kgaolong le mo lefatsheng.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kuqhubela phambili indlela ilizwe lethu elihlangabezana ngayo neeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngeli xesha kwangaxesha nye lisenza impembelelo komnye weyona mingeni iyeyona ibalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika, kummandla welizwekazi nakwihlabathi.
