src: Khonferense eno e tla naya babatlisisi go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara serala sa go arogana dikgatelopele tsa ga jaana tsa saense mo lephateng, go ithuta mo boitseanapeng jwa ba bangwe mmogo le go tlhama maano a go tsweletsa dikarolo tsotlhe tsa maiteko a re a tlhakanetseng a go alafa le go thibela HIMolaotlhomo.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kubonelela abaphandi abavela kwiinkalo zonke zehlabathi ngeqonga lokwabelana ngeenkqubo zobunzululwazi zala maxesha kweli candelo, ukufunda kubuchule bomnye nomnye nokuphuhlisa ubuchule bokuqhubela phambili onke amacala kumalinge wethu ahlangeneyo okunyanga nokuthintela i-HIUmthetho oYilwayo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa 2015 wa Dipalangwa tsa Bosetšhaba tsa mo Lefatsheng, o o baakanyang Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dipalangwa tsa mo Lefatsheng, 2009 (Molao wa bo 5 wa 2009).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe wama-2015 ePalamente, ohlomela uMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe, wama-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wama-2009).

src: Dipaakanyo tsa Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dipalangwa tsa mo Lefatsheng wa 2009 di tla tsweletsa thulaganyo ya go fetola le go aga sešwa thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya dipalangwa tsa mo lefatsheng.
tgt: Ezi zilungisoo zoMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni wama-2009 ziza kuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuguqula nokumisela ngokutsha inkqubo yezothutho zasemhlabeni yesizwe.

src: Seno se tla tshwaela mo tirelong ya dipalangwa tsa botlhe e e babalesegileng, e e fitlhelesegang mme e le bokgoni.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza igalelo kwinkonzo yezothutho kawonkewonke ekhuselekileyo, efikelelekayo, enobuchule nesebenzayo.

src: Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya ditlhabololo tse dintšhwa mo lephateng la dipalangwa tsa botlhe.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubonelela ngophuhliso olutsha kwicandelo lezothutho kawonkewonke.

src: Molaotlhomo o tlamela ka kaedi ya, magareng ga tse dingwe, dipalangwa tse di senang dienjene, ditirelo tsa dipalangwa tse di bidiwang ka tiriso ya diselefounu gongwe dikhomphiutara mmogo le go tshwaya dipalangwa tsa botlhe.
tgt: Ubonelela ngesikhokelo ekukho phakathi kwaso, izithuthi ezingezo moto iinkonzo zezothutho ezibizwa ngezixhobo zobuchwephetshe nokuphawulwa kwezithuthi zikawonkewonke ngokutsha ngokusebenza ngendlela ephucukileyo.

src: Gape o sedimosa ntlha ya tsamaiso malebana le dithata tse di roletsweng mmogo le melawana malebana le go rebolwa ga dilaesense tsa go dira tsa dipalangwa tsa botlhe.
tgt: Ukwabonelela ngokucacisa ngengcaciso kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa kwamagunya nemimiselo ngokumayela nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zokuqhuba izithuthi zikawonkewonke.

src: Gape molaotlhomo ono o tla kgontsha go anamisiwa ga Mafaratlhatlha a a Lotaneng a Dipalangwa tsa Botlhe mme ke karolo ya Leano la Bosetšhaba la Mafaratlhatlha le Porojeke ya Togamaano e e Lotaneng ya 7 e e totileng go dirisa tlhabololo e e gokaganeng ya mafaratlhatlha a a lotaneng a dipalangwa go dira gore ditoropokgolo e nne madutelo a kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kubonelela ngokuqaliswa koThungelwano lwezoThutho lukaWonkewonke oluDibeneyo kwaye luyinxalenye yeProjekthi ye-7 yesiCwangciso seziSeko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe, sigxile ekusebenziseni uphuhliso olulungeleleyo ezidolophini nothungelwano lwezothutho oludibeneyo ukumisela izixeko njengonobangela wohlumo.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Bofederale ya Nigeria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Leeto la Semmuso le tla tokafatsa dikamano tsa ga jaana tsa sebedi le go tsweletsa gape kgwebisano ya mo kgaolong.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni luza kuqinisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwalamazwe mabini nokuqhubela phambili urhwebo oluphakathi kwemimandla yala mazwe.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ka Mopitlwe 2016 e tla ketekwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Aforika Borwa e kopane kgatlhanong le tlhaolele ya bosemorafe."
tgt: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ukulwa nobuhlanga.” ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko limisele inkqubo ebude buyinyanga equka iintlanganiso ezimalunga nokusebenzisana ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esingenabuhlanga, esingacaluli ngokwesini, esilinganayo nesilawulwa ngentando yesininzi.

src: Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso le rulagantse leano la kgwedi le le akaretsang metseletsele ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go dira mmogo go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka bosemorafe, bong, se se nang le tekatekano le sa temokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlomle kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza seSizwe sokulwa ubuHlanga, uCalucalulo ngokobuHlanga, iNtiyo yabaSuka kuMazwe angaPhandle kunye neminye imiKhuba yokungaNyamezelani (sowama-2016-2021) phambi komhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e laletsa maAforika Borwa go tshwaela mo Leanotirong la Bosetšhaba la go lwantsha Bosemorafe, Tlhaolo go ya ka Bosemorafe, Letlhoo la Batswakwantle mmogo le Go tlhoka itshokelano go go Amanang le tseo (2016-2021) pele ga la bo 30 Seetebosigo 2016.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sibonelela ngesiseko somgaqo-nkqubo kawonkewonke wokulwa nocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga okuza kunceda ukunika impembelelo kwisibophelelo sethu samalungelo oluntu ezizwe-ngezizwe.

src: Puisano ya Russia-Aforika e e Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi kwa ICC kwa Durban go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 9 Mopitlwe 2016 e tlamela ka serala sa go tokafatsa Leanolegolo la Bosetšhaba la Diritibatsi (2013-2017)Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tse di seng mo molaong go lepalepana le Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mme puisano e ka fa tlase ga bookamedi jwa AU go latelelwa maitlamo go ya ka Ditumelano tse di maleba tsa UN tsa Bosenyi jo bo Rulagantsweng go ralala Dinaga, Leano la Tiragatso la AU la Taolo ya Diritibatsi (2013-2017) le ditshwetso tsa BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa).Khonferense ke kopano e e latelang Puisano ya Russia-Aforika e e Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi, e maikaelelo a yona e leng go tlhagisa seemo se se gokaganeng malebana le gore baeteledipele ba lefatshe ba ikaelela go samagana jang le bothata jwa boditšhabatšhaba jwa diritibatsi.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa neziYobisi kwi-ICC yaseDurban ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 lubonelela ngeqonga lokuqinisa isiCwangciso esiyiNtloko seziYobisi seSizwe (sowama-2013-2017).Umlo wokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uyahambelana neSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwaye le ngqungquthela iphantsi kwemiqondiso emihle ye-AU ukusebenzela isibophelelo ngokwemimiselo efanelekileyo ye-UN yeziVumelwano zoLwaphulo-mthetho oluHleliweyo Phakathi kwaMazwe amaBini neziYobisi, isiCwangciso soMsebenzi se-AU (2013-2017 nezindululo zamazwe e-BRICS (i-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika).

src: Puso - ka tirisanommogo le Bokwaledi jwa Kgweranoditšhaba, Yunibesithi ya Aforika Borwa (UNISA) mmogo le Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa - e amogela Khonferense ya bo 2 ya Kgweranoditšhaba e e ka ga Tiro ya Bašwa kwa khamphaseng ya Unisa kwa Pretoria go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 10 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilandela iNgqungqthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa iziYobisi, eligxile ekubonakaliseni imo edibeneyo yokuba iinkokheli zehlabathi zizimisele kangakanani ukuqubisana neengxaki yeziyobisi phakathi kwezizwe ngezizwe.

src: Khonferense e tshwarwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Go akaretsa Bašwa mo Kagong ya Setšhaba: Seabe sa Modiri wa Mošwa" mme e tla sekaseka gape seabe sa badiri ba tiro ya bašwa mmogo le barutegi ba ba akaretsang bašwa mo tlhabololong ya dinaga tsa bona.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siza kuthiwe thaca kwiNdibano eNkulu eKhethekileyo ye-UN kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa molaetsa wa ga Moporesitente Zuma wa botlhokwa jwa go tlotla ditheo le ditsamaiso tse di tlhamilweng go ya ka Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996 le molao.
tgt: Urhulumente – ngokusebenzisana ne-ofisi kaNobhala wamaZwe aye ngamaThanga, iDyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-UNISA) ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe – uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yesibini2 yamaZwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga ngoMsebenzi woLutsha kwikhampasi yase-UNISA ePitoli ukususela ngomhla- we-8 ukuya kowe-10 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o samagane le morero wa Mokhomišinara wa Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le Tona ya Ditšhelete ka tsela e e siameng a dirisa ditsela tse di siameng tsa molao.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka phantsi komxholo othi: “Bandakanya uLutsha eKwakheni iSizwe: iNdima yabaSebenzi abaluLutsha” nokuphinda kuhlolwe indima yamagcisa alulutsha olusebenzayo nabahlohli bamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ekubandakanyeni ulutsha kuphuhliso lwamazwe walo.

src: Moporesitente o baakanya dikgato tsa go samagana le dintlha tseno ka maikarabelo le ka tsela e e siameng gore botlhe ba bone molemo.
tgt: Uluvo lwekhabhinethi kwimiba engundoqo ngokusingqongileyo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe a a nang le dikgatlhego go diga makgwafo le go itshwara mme ba neele sebaka sa gore morero ono o rarabololwe ka go dirisiwa ga ditsela tse di siameng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma ngokudingeka kokuhlonitshwa kwamaziko neenkqubo ezidalwe ngokwemimiselo yomgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika yowe-1996 nomthetho.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go ikwadisetsa Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uyasebenza ngemeko yoMkhomishinala weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leeNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika noMphathiswa wezeMali ngokulandela iindlela ezifanelekileyo esebenzisa izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zezomthetho.

src: Ditlhopho tsa pusoselegae di farologane le ditlhopho tsa bosetšhaba mme di tlhoka gore o ikwadise mo otong e o nnang mo go yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba azole azibambe, aze anikeze ithuba lokuba lo mba usonjululwe ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo.

src: Go botlhokwa gore o nne le Lekwaloitshupo (ID) - go tla amogelwa ID e e tala e e nang le bar-code mmogo le karata ya Boitshupo - le go tlhola seemo sa gago sa ikwadiso, nomoro ya oto kwa diteišeneng tse di farologaneng tsa ditlhopho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalisele uNyulo looRhulumente baseKhaya lowama-2016 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Dikantoro tsotlhe tsa Merero ya Selegae di tla bo di butswe go tloga ka 08:00 go fitlha ka 17:00 ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016, mme seo ke go lepalepana le diura tsa tiro tsa Khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC) mo matsatsing a mabedi ao.
tgt: Unyulo loorhumente basekhaya, alufani nolwesizwe kuba koloorhulumente basekhaya kufanele ubhalise kwiwadi ohlala kuyo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo batlhophing botlhe ba bašwa mmogo le ba ba tla bong ba tlhopha la ntlha go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba ube neNcwadi yeSazisi (i-ID) – ziza kwamkeleka zombini i-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi kunye neKhadi-Sazisi – nokukhangela isimo sokuba ubhalisile na, iinombolo yewadi kunye nokuba simi phi isikhululo sakho sokuvota.

src: Ka go tlhopha o tsaya kgato ya go dira gore lentswe la gago le utlwale mo ditshwetsong tse di go amang le tse di amang baagi ba gaeno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza lonke ulutsha kunye nabo baza kuqala ukuvota ukuba babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Kabinete e nyefola ditshupetso tse di tletseng tirisodikgoka tsa baithuti, tse di kgoreleditseng dithuto kwa diyunibesithi tse dingweng mme di lebisitse kwa tshenyong ya dithoto.
tgt: Ngokuvota kwakho uthathe inyathelo elibhekisele ekubeni ilizwi lakho livakale ekuthathweni kwezigqibo ezikuchaphazelayo nendawo ohlala kuyo.

src: Ditshupetso tseno di lomeletsa baithuti ba ba nang le tshiamelo tšhono ya go tsweletsa dithuto mme gape di ama tshwanelo ya bone ya go iponela thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela lwabafundi, noluthe lwaphazamisa izifundo kwezinye iidyunivesithi laze lakhokelela ekutshatyalalisweni kwezakhiwo nempahla.

src: Puso e buletse dipuisano le baamegi botlhe ba thuto e kgolwane go buisana le go ganetsana.
tgt: Aba baqhankqalazi bathintela abafundi abanelungelo ilungelo lokuqhuba ngezifundo zabo kwaye oko kunempembelelo engekho ntle kwilungelo labo lokufumana imfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Seno se buseditse maemo sekeng le tsweletso ya kgolagano ya loago kwa diyunibesithing tse di batlang go bona ditharabololo tsa dikgwetlho tsa pakagare le pakatelele tse di amanang le go fetolwa ga lephata jaaka go tlhalositswe mo ditshwetsong tsa Samiti ya 2015 ya Diphetogo mo Thutong e Kgolwane.
tgt: Urhulumente uvulele bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwezemfundo ephakamileyo iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukwenzela iingxoxo nothethathethwano.

src: Kabinete e tshegetsa maiteko a ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao go netefatsa gore go busediwa setso sa go ithuta, le gore go sirelediwa dithoto le ditshwanelo tsa batho.
tgt: Oko kukhokelele ekubuyeleni kwisiqhelo nokukhuthazwa kwentalo-ntle kwiidyunivesithi zethu ezifuna ukufumana isisombululo kwimingeni yexesha eliphakathi ukuya kweyelide edibene nokudalwa kwenguqu kwelicandelo njengoko ichazwe kwizindululo zeMbizo yeNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo yowama-2015.

src: Go tshwanetse ga busediwa maemo sekeng kwa diyunibesithing tsa rona gore manaane a thuto a tswelele pele fa go ntse go samaganwe le dikgwetlho tsa pakagare le pakatelele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge awenziwe zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba isithethe sokufunda sibuyiselwe, kunye nokukhuselwa kwempahla nesakhiwo namalungelo womntu ngamnye.

src: Kabinete e akgotse baithuti ba ba emeng mmogo kgatlhanong le bosemorafe le letlhoo la basweu, e leng sekai sa gore re ka dira mmogo go agelela mo tswelelopeleng le diphitlhelelong tse di dirilweng mo lephateng la thuto e kgolwane go baakanyetsa ngwaga ono wa dithuto.
tgt: Ukulawula komthetho kubaluleke kakhulu kwaye kufanele kuhlonitshwe ngamaxesha onke.

src: Re tshwanetse go sireletsa tswelelopele eo le go letla gore go busediwe le go somarela taolo kwa diyunibesithing tsotlhe tsa rona.
tgt: Ukubuyela esiqhelweni nenzolo kwiidyunivesithi kuyafuneka ukuze iinkqubo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuqhubeka ngeli xesha imingeni yexesha eliphakathi nelide kusazanywana nayo.

src: Gape kabinete e ikuela mo baameging botlhe go dira mmogo gore diyunibesithi tsa rona e nne baeteledipele ba puisano e e akaretsang le diphetogo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma abafundi abathe bema kunye bemanyene ukulwa ubuhlanga kunye nokulwa abo bazidla ngokuba nobuhlanga ngokugqithisileyo bechasa abamhlophe, oku kube ngumzekelo wokuba singasebenzisana sisonke ukwakha kwinkqubela neenzuzo ezenzwe kwicandelo lezemfundo ephakamileyo ukulungiselela lo nyaka wemfundo sikuwo.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisa matshwenyego a yona ka tatlhegelo ya ditiro e e tshitshintsweng mmogo le phokotso ya ditiro mo dikgatong tsa kgolagano eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo ukuba basebenzisane ukuze iidyunivesithi zethu zibe ziinkokheli zomsebenzi oquka konke nenguqu.

src: Ka ntlha ya botlhokatiro jo bo kwa godimo, Kabinete e ikuela mo ditlamong go netefatsa gore ga go nne le ditiro tse di latlhegang mme go tsholwa seemo sa ditiro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukucetywa kokudibanisa iinkampani ezintathu ezenza iibhotile ukwenzela iNkampani ye-Coca Cola eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e akgola Moambasadara wa Aforika Borwa wa Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Kgwebisano (WTO), Rre Xavier Carim, yo o tlhophilweng modulasetilo wa Setheo sa Tharabololo ya Dikgotlhang sa Lekgotlakakaretso la WTLekgotlakakaretso ke setheo se se tsayang ditshwetso tse di kwa godimo sa WTO magareng ga Dikhonferense tsa Ditona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba lo mba uza kuxoxwa kwiNkundla yoKhuphiswano.

src: Go thapiwa ga Moambasadara Carim go lemosa seabe sa botlhokwa sa Aforika Borwa mo WTO mme gape ke sesupo sa maitshwaro a ga Moambasadara Carim.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa ukuxhalaba kwayo ngokulahleka kwemisebenzi okucetywayo nokuncitshiswa komsebenzi kwiintengiselwano zokudityaniswa kwazo.

src: Kabinete e lemogile kitsiso ya Barclays PLC ya maikaelelo a yona go fokotsa 62.3% ya botsholadišere jwa yona mo Barclays Africa Group Limited (BAGL) mo dingwageng tse di latelang di le pedi go ya go di le tharo.
tgt: Ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lentswela-ngqesho, iKhabhinethi ibongoza ezi nkampani ukuba ziqiniseke ukuba akukho kulahleka kwemisebenzi kwaye kuze kugcinwe izinga eliphakathi lengqesho.

src: Barclays PLC, bogolosegolo Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo, o buisane le Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba le Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa mme re amogela maitlamo a setlamo a go diragatsa togamaano e ntšhwa ka tsela e e tla fokotsang ditlamorago mo ikonoming e BAGL e dirang mo go yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika kuMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi (i-WTO), uMnu Xavier Carim, othe wonyulwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo weBhodi yokuLamla iMbambano yeBhunga Jikelele le-WTIBhunga Jikelele yeyona bhodi iphezulu ye-WTO yokuthatha izigqibo phakathi kweNgqungquthela yobuPhathiswa.

src: Bankakgolo ya Aforika Borwa e tla dira le Barclays PLC le BAGL go netefatsa gore go fokodiwa matshosetsi otlhe a a ka nnang teng mo tiragatsong eo le gore go tsewa dikgato tse di maleba go samagana le motsamao wa ditšhelete o o tla bakwang ke tiragatso eo.
tgt: Ukuchongwa kukaNozakuzaku uCarim uyinxalenye yobungqina bokubaluleka kwendima edlalwa nguMzantsi Afrika kwi-WTO kwaye iyinxalenye yobungqina beempawu zikaNozakuzaku uCarim.

src: Kabinete e akgola botlhe ba ba fitlheletseng makgaolakgang mmogo le bafenyi ba Dikgele tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Barutabana tse di neng di tshwerwe ka la bo 27 Tlhakole 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isibhengezo seBarclays PLC sokuba nenjongo zokunciphisa ubunini-zabelo bayo zingama-62.3%i kwi-Barclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kule minyaka mibini ukuya kwemithathu ezayo.

src: Barutabana bano ba ba ititeileng sehuba ba tsweletsa naga ya rona pele ka go netefatsa gore diphaposiborutelo di tlhagisa barutwana ba ba rotloetsegileng ba ba tla tshwaelang mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: I-Baclays PLC, ngokukodwa iGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO), lithetha kunye nabo bobabini uNdyebo weSizwe kunye ngeBhanka enguVimba kothethathethwano olungafihlekelanga, kwaye siyakkwamkela ukuzinikela kwale nkampani ukuba iphumeze isicwangciso-qhinga sayo esitsha ngendlela eza kunciphisa impembelelo kuqoqosho apho iBAGL isebenza khona.

src: Kabinete e akgola Market Theatre kwa Johannesburg ka go keteka ngwaga wa bo 40 e ntse e le teng.
tgt: IBhanka enguVimba iza kusebenza neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuba nayiphi na imingcipheko ekwintengiselwano iyathityazwa kuze kuthathwe amanyathelo afanelekileyo ukulawula ukungena nokuphuma kwemali kule ntengiselwano.

src: Ka paka ya tlhaolele teatere e nnile sekao sa Kgaratlho ka go anela dikgang tsa boammaaruri tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi bonke abo bafikelele kumagqibela kankqoyi nabo bathe baphumelela iMbasa yokuFundisa yeSizwe.

src: Kabinete e akgola morutabana wa mmino, Rre Chad Hendricks, go tswa kwa Retreat kwa Cape Flats ka ntlha ya go fenya Kgaisano ya maemo ya Batshwaratakata ya Len van Zyl kwa Motsekapa.
tgt: Umsitho wazo ububanjwe ngomhla wama-27 kweyoMdumba yowama-2016.

src: Dimpho tsa gagwe di akaretsa sekolašipi sa dikgwedi di le tharo kwa Amerika koo Rre Hendricks a tla ithutang kwa Philadelphia Orchestra mme a katisiwa ke Moporofesara Victor Yampolsky kwa Chicago.
tgt: Aba titshala bakhutheleyo baliqhubela phambili ilizwe lethu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba amagumbi wabo okufundela avelisa abafundi abakhuthazekileyo abazokwenza igalelo ekuphuhliseni uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e akgola motlhagisi wa difilimi, Rre Anant Singh, ka ntlha ya go abelwa maemo a boraro ka filimi ya Shepherds and Butchers kwa Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film kwa Moletlong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Difilimi wa Berlin.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neMarket Theatre eRhawutini ngokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-40 ikho.

src: Seno ke phitlhelelo e kgolo ka ntlha ya fa filimi e ne e gaisana le difilimi di le 51 go tswa kwa dinageng di le Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.
tgt: Ngexesha lucalucalulo iMarket Theatre yaba luphawu lomzabalazo ngokubalisa ibali loMzantsi Afrika eliyinyaniso.

src: Katoloso ya konteraka ya ga Rre Lionel October jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) mo Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri, sebaka sa dingwaga di le tlhano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nootitshala womculo, uMnu Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat kwi-Cape Flats ngokuphumelela uKhuphiswano lwabaCulisi oludumileyo i-Len van Zyl eKapa.

src: Go thapiwa ga Ngaka Mantlhake J Maboya jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso (DDG): Pholisi ya Kharikhulamo le Tekolo mo Lefapheng la Thuto ya Motheo.
tgt: Ibhaso lakhe liquka imali yokufunda yeenyanga ezintathu e-United States apho aza kufunda khona kwiPhiladelphia Orchestra aze aqeqeshwe ngodumileyo uNjingalwazi uVictor Yampolsky eChicago.

src: Go thapiwa ga Mme Shamilla Chettiar jaaka DDG: Ditirelo tsa Pholisi le Kitso kwa Lefapheng la Bojanala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomvelisi wemidlalo-bhanyabhanya, uMnu Anant Singh, ngokufumana iwonga elikwindawo yesithathu ngomdlalo-bhanyabhanya i-uShepherds and Butchers kumsitho wokuWongwa ngabaBukeli wasePanorama woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya obuNtsomi kuMbiyozo woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya weSizwe-ngezizwe waseBerlin.

src: Go thapiwa ga Rre Mbulelo Tshangana jaaka DG mo Lefapheng la Manno a Batho.
tgt: Le yeyona mpumelelo inkulu njengoko lo mdlalo bhanyabhanya ubukhuphisana nemidlalo bhanyabhanya ingama-51 ebonisiweyo enobude bayo evela kumazwe angama-.

src: Go thapiwa gape ga Rre Kutoane Obed Kutoane jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo wa Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e sekasekile Dipegelo tsa Dipoelo tsa Dikgatelopele tsa Kotara ya Boraro tsa paka ya Diphalane go fitlha Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlole iiNgxelo zeNkqubela yeziPhumo zeKota yesiThathu ukususela kweyeDwarha kuye kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.

src: Dipegelo di bontsha kgatelopele e e utlwalang malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a puso a a amang ka tlhamalalo tokafatso ya matshelo a maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Ezi ngxelo zibonakalisa inkqubela ethe vetshe ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezinefuthe elingqalileyo ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Dipegelo tsa Dipoelo tsa Dikgatelopele di naya bosupi jwa gore puso e dirile kgatelopele go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo tse di neng di tlhagisitswe mo Letlhomesong la Togamaano ya Pakagare la 2014-2019.
tgt: Ezi Ngxelo zibubungqina bokuba urhulumente kukho inkqubela ayenzileyo ekuphumeleliseni izinto emakufikelelwe kuzo ngokwesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esibubuChule sesiGaba esiPhakathi sowama-2014-2019.

src: Gape di re atametsa le go fitlhelela Ponelopele ya 2030 jaaka e tlhagisitswe mo Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP), le maitlhomo a lona e leng go samagana le lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano.
tgt: Zikwasisondeza ekufezekeni koMbono wama-2030, njengoko uthiwe thaca sisiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe, nonjongo wawo ikukuhlasela indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani.

src: Kabinete e lemogile tswelelopele e e amogelesegang e e dirilweng go fitlhelela diphitlhelelo le ditlhagiso tsa botlhokwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenziweyo ukuphumelelisa izinto ezingundoqo emakufikelelwe kuzo kwakunye neziqhamo.

src: Kabinete e lemogile gore le fa go nnile le tswelelopele e e bonalang malebana le bontsi jwa disupi, go sa ntse go na le dikarolo tse di tlhokang tsereganyo e e gokaganeng ya puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba noxa kukho inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenzekileyo malunga nenkoliso yezinto ezalatha oko, kusekho imiba efuna ukungenelela kukarhulumente ngokulungeleleneyo.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse Ditebogo tsa yona go maAforika Borwa a a tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa Khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC) jwa gore batho ba ikwadise, ba tlhole seemo sa bone sa ikwadiso mmogo le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhopi ka mafelo a beke a la bo 5 le la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo wayo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abalisabeleyo ikhwelo elenziwe yiKhomishini yoNyulo eZimeleyo (i-IEC) lokuba abantu babhalise, bajonge imeko yabo malunga nobhaliso kwaye bahlaziye iinkcukacha zabo ezikumqulu wabavoti.

src: Beke ya bofelo ya ikwadiso e tla nna ka la bo 9 le la bo 10 Moranang 2016 fa diteišene tsa ditlhopho di tla bo di butswe gape go tloga ka ura ya bo 8:00 mo mosong go fitlha ka ura ya bo 17:00 mo maetsiboeng.
tgt: Loo nto yenzeke ngempelaveki yomhla we-5 nowe- 6 kweyoKwindla ngowama- 2016.

src: Seno e tla bo e le tšhono ya bofelo ya gore batlhophi ba ikwadise le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona tsa ikwadiso kwa diteišene tsa ditlhopho.
tgt: Abantu ababalelwa kwizigidi ezithathu baya kwiindawo ekubhaliselwa uvoto kuzo kulo lonke eli, kwaye abangama- 544 552 kwabo ibingabhalisa okokuqala (i-78.6%) kwaye beneminya yobudala engaphantsi kwengama-30.

src: Le fa go le jalo, go ikwadisa go tswelela pele kwa dikantorong tsa selegae tsa IEC ka dinako tsa tiro go tloga Mosupologo go fitlha ka Labotlhano, go fitlha lenane la batlhophi la Ditlhopho tsa Makgotlatoropo tsa 2016 le tswalelwa ka letsatsi le go tla bong go itsesiwe letlha la ditlhopho ka lona.
tgt: Loo nto ibonisa ukuzimisela kwabemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi.

src: Kabinete e kgalema ka bogale tirisodikgoka e e neng e aparetse mafelo a beke ya ikwadiso fa gautshwane kwa mafelong mangwe mme e boeletsa gore ga gona motho ope yo o tshwanetseng go thibela moAforika Borwa ope go diragatsa tshwanelo ya gagwe ya tmolaotheo ya go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balixhamle ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngokuthi babhalise, kwaye icela abo ababhalisa kwixesha elidluleyo ukuba baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zobhaliso njengoko kubekho izinto ezininzi ezikhokhelele ekutshintsheni komqulu wabavoti.

src: Kabinete e ikuela gape mo go botlhe ba ba rweleng maikarabelo go tila dikgato tseo tsa bosenyi le gore ba ba amegang ba bege ditiragalo tseo kwa ditheong tsa tiragatso ya molao.
tgt: Eli iza kuba lithuba lokugqibela lokuba abavoti babhalise kwaye bahlaziye inkcukacha zabo zobhaliso kwiindawo zabo zokuvota.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo ditheong tsotlhe tsa tiragatso ya molao go tsaya dikgato tse di bogale kgatlhanong le batlolamolao.
tgt: Phofu, ubhaliso yinto esoloko iqhubeka kuzo zonke ii-ofisi ze-IEC ngamaxesha omsebenzi ukususela ngoMvulo kude kube ngoLwesihlanu, de umqulu wabavoti woNyulo looMasipala wama-2016 uvalwe mhla unyulo lwaziswayo ngokusemthethweni.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla etela Port Elizabeth ka la bo 8 Moranang 2016 go tlhatlhoba kgatelopele e e dirilweng tebang le go tlhabolola mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa tsa mo lewatleng jaaka karolo ya maiteko a naga a Ikonomi ya Lewatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka udushe kwiingingqi ezithile noluthe lagxobhagxobha impelaveki yobhaliso esandul’ukubakho.

src: Ikonomi ya Lewatle ke nngwe ya maphata a le mararo a Operation Phakisa mme e atametsa naga gaufi le go bula bokgoni jwa mawatle a Aforika Borwa, a a nang le bokgoni jwa go nna le seabe sa bokana ka R177 bilione mo ikonoming ya naga le go tlhama ditiro tse dintšhwa di feta milione.
tgt: Iyaphinda iyayithetha into yokuba akukho mntu omele ukuthintela nawuphi na ummi woMzantsi Afrika ukuba alixhamle ilungelo lakhe elibhalwe lacaca kuMgaqo-siseko lokubhalisela uvoto.

src: Nngwe ya dintlhakgolo tsa diphitlhelelo tsa leeto e nnile go godisiwa ga Khomišene ya Dinagapedi go ya kwa seemong sa Tlhogo ya Mmuso, e leng se se bayang tlhabololo ya ikonomi magareng ga dinaga tse pedi go nna setlapele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamemelela bonke abenza loo nto ukuba bahlukane nezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezinjengezo.

src: Kabinete e letetse kgolo ya palo ya dipeeletso tsa Nigeria mo Aforika Borwa e leng se se tla tsweletsang kgwebisano ya maphatamabedi magareng ga dinaga tse pedi tse.
tgt: Uza kuhlola inkqubela eyenziweyo ekuphuhliseni iziseko zothutho zaselwandle njengenxalenye yelinge lesizwe mayelana noQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Dipoelo tsa puisano eno magareng ga diikonomi tse pedi tse dikgolo go gaisa mo kontinenteng di tla gokaganya diikonomi tsa kgaolo, mme ka go rialo di oketse mmaraka o o tlhakanetsweng le go godisa maiteko a a leng teng a kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le ditiro mo Aforika.
tgt: Olu qoqosho lolunye lwamacandelo amathathu e-Operation Phakisa kwaye lusondeza ilizwe eli ekuboniseni amandla eelwandlekazi zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Seno se supa gore Aforika Borwa e sa ntse e le boyo jo bo gaisanang jwa dipeeletso le fa ikonomi ya lefatshe e ntse e le mo mathateng, mme se tla lebisa kwa ditšhonong tsa ditiro mmogo le tlhabololo ya bokgoni jwa maAforika Borwa otlhe.
tgt: Loo nto inganegalelo lemali engafikelela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-177 kwimveliso yasekhaya iyonke, nto leyo enokudala imisebenzi emitsha engaphaya kwesigidi.

src: Kabinete e tsibogetse gore Aforika Borwa e tla nna le seabe mo Kopanong ya bo 60 ya Khomišene ya Seemo sa Basadi ya Ditšhabakopano (UN) (CSW60) e e diragalang kwa New York, Amerika go tloga ka la bo 14 go fitlha ka la bo 24 Mopitlwe 2016 ka fa tlase ga moono wa: “Maatlafatso ya basadi le kgolagano ya yona le tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri.” Kopano e diragala mo ngwageng wa botlhokwa wa Aforika Borwa ka ntlha ya fa o na le diphitlhelelo tse tharo tsa botlhokwa, e leng, Segopotso sa bo 20 sa Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996, Segopotso sa bo 40 sa Dikhuduego tsa kwa Soweto le Segopotso sa bo 60 sa mogwanto wa basadi wa 1956.Aforika Borwa e tlhagisitse pegelo kwa UN CSW60 mme seno se re naya tšhono ya go lekanyetsa kgatelopele e re e dirileng fa e sale re bona temokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkela utyelelo olube yimpumelelo lwaseBurhulumenteni lukaMongameli Zuma kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela kumhla we-8 ukuya kowe- 9 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Go botlhokwa go lemoga gore fa e sale ka puso ya temokerasi, Aforika Borwa, gareng ga tse dingwe, e nnile le seabe kwa Khonferenseng ya bo 4 ya Lefatshe ya Basadi ka 1995, mme ya saena Sekwalwa sa Beijing sa Maikano le Dirala tsa go tsaya Dikgato gone mo ngwageng oo.
tgt: Olo tyelelo lwaqinisa amakhonco akhoyo kula mazwe mabini kwezopolitiko, ezoqoqosho nezasentlalweni.

src: Go lepalepana le tshwetso ya E/RES/2013/18 ya Lekgotla la UN la Ikonomi le Loago, Aforika Borwa e itlamile go tswelela go diragatsa Sekwalwa sa Beijing sa Maikano le Dirala tsa go tsaya Dikgato, e leng leano la maatlafatso le tsweletso ya basadi.
tgt: Elinye leziganeko ezibalulekileyo zolo tyelelo yaba kukunyuselwa kwesiVumelwano seNtsebenziswano saMazwe amaBini iye kwinqanaba leNtloko yoMbuso, nto leyo ebeka phambili ukuphuhliswa koqoqosho kula mazwe mabini.

src: Go dirwa dipaakanyo mo Molaong wa Dipopegotheo tsa Makgotlatoropo,1998 (Molao wa bo 117 wa 1998) wa Pusoselegae o o fetisitsweng pele ga ditlhopho tsa ntlha tsa temokerasi tsa pusoselegae tse di diragetseng ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole 2000.Dipaakanyo di tla tokafatsa tsamaiso ya ditlhopho tsa pusoselegae mme gareng ga diphetogo tse dingwe, o batla go:a) baakanya seemo sa makgotlatoropo a Karolo ya Ab) tlosa go kaiwa ga dikarolo tsa tsamaiso ya dikgaoloc) tlhamalatsa letlha la go simolola tiro ga molekgotlad) letla Moporesitente go tlhoma le go itsise letlha la ditlhopho tsa makgotlatoropoe) letla gore go nne le katoloso ya kitsiso ya dipholo tsa ditlhophof) gore motsamaisi wa lekgotlatoropo a itsese IEC ka diphatlhatiro tse di mo otongg) swetsa gore Mokhuduthamaga a itsise le go tlhoma letlha la ditlhopho tsa tlaleletsoh) tlhamalatsa ditlhokego tsa maloko a setlhophatshwetso tsa kopano ya lekgotlai) tlhamalatsa mabaka a go tlhopha ga molekgotla yo e leng modulasetilo ka nako ya kopano ya lekgotlaj) oketsa pharologano ya palo ya batlhophi mo otong nngwe le nngwe ka nako ya kopano ya lekgotla lek) oketsa pharologano ya palo ya batlhophi mo otong nngwe le nngwe ka nako ya go aroganngwa ga melelwane go tlhalosa kabo ya ditilo tse di fetang tekano mo makgotlatoropong a selegae.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvuleleka koqoqosho lwaseNigeria kwiinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika kumacandelo anjengobunjineli, eleziseko ezingundo zonxibelelwano, elezokwakha, elobuchule bokuhamba ngeenqwelo-moya, amajelo eendaba, ukubuka nokutenda iindwendwe, imiba yebhanki, ulonwabo, imihlaba nezindlu, intengiso kunye neenkonzo zokuphonononga nokuzingela i-oli negesi.

src: Khomišene e totile tlhokego ya baporofešenale ba boitekanelo mo dinageng tsa lotseno lo lo magareng le lo lo kwa tlase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijonge ukunyuka kwenani lotyalo-mali lweNigeria eMzantsi Afrika, nto leyo eza kukhuthaza urhwebo phakathi kwezi zizwe zimbini.

src: Go solofetswe gore maiteko ano a UN a oketse go nna teng ga boitekanelo lefatshe ka bophara le go tsweletsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang, e e nang le seabe mo tiragatsong ya Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang Leruri.
tgt: Iziphumo zoku kusebenzisana kwala mazwe mabini analona qoqosho lungamandla kweli lizwekazi ziza kudibanisa uqoqosho lwengingqi, ngaloo ndlela zinyuse izinga labathengi nabasebenzisi-zinkonzo abafanayo namalinge akhoyo okukhulisa uqoqosho nengqesho e-Afrika.

src: Moporesident Zuma o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Nagabogosing ya Saudi Arabia go tloga ka la bo 27 go fitlha ka la bo 28 Mopitlwe 2016, le le tla maatlafatsang botsalano jo bo leng teng magareng ga dinaga tse pedi.
tgt: Oku kubonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika yindawo ekunokukhutshiswana ngayo ngotyalo-mali, noxa imeko yezoqoqosho ehlabathini imaxongo.

src: Moporesitente o tla tsenela Samiti ya bo 4 ya Tshireletsego ya Nyutlilea kwa Washington, Amerika go tloga ka la bo 31 Mopitlwe go fitlha ka la bo 1 Moranang 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni yama-60 yeKomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ngeMeko yabaseTyhini (i-CSW60) eNew York, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-24 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuxhotyiswa ngezakhono kwabasetyhini kunye nendlela okunxibelelana ngayo nophuhliso oluzinzileyo”.

src: Samiti e tla bua ka matshosetsi a a golang a borukhutli jwa nyutlilea le go sedimosa dikgato tse di ka tsewang ke baagi ba boditšhabatšhaba go fokotsa tiriso ya yuraniamo e e humileng thata, go sireletsa dimateriale tse di mo matshosetsing, go tsibogela go utswiwa ga nyutlilea le go thibela, batlisisa le go kgoreletsa maiteko a borukhutli jwa nyutlilea.
tgt: Le seshoni ibanjwa ngonyaka obalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika kuba kukho iziganeko ezithathu ezibalulekleyo ezenzekayo ezizezi: iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-20 yokusekwa koMgaqo-siseko weRiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika ngowe-1996, iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-40 sezidube-dube ezazikhokelwa luLutsha eSoweto ngowe-1976 kunye neSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-60 somngcelele wamanina wangowe-1956.UMzantsi Afrika wenze ingxelo kwiUN CSW60 kwaye oku kusinika ithuba lokuthelekisa inkqubela esiyenzileyo oko kuthe kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele meletlo ya Letsatsi la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho kwa Setediamo sa Moses Mabhida kwa KwaZulu-Natal ka Mosupologo, 21 Mopitlwe ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Aforika Borwa e kopane kgatlhanong le bosemorafe."
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuyiqaphela into yokuba oko kwathi kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi, phakathi kwezinye izinto, uMzantsi Afika wathabatha inxaxheba kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yesi-4 yabaseTyhini ngowe-1995,waza watyikitya isiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza kwangalo nyaka mnye.

src: Jaaka go itsisitswe ka Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ya 2016, Letsatsi la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho la monongwaga le tla tlhoma motheo wa lenaane la pakatelele la go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka morafe.
tgt: Uhambisana nesindululo E/RES/2013/18 seBhunga le-UN lezoQoqosho nezeNtlalo, uMzantsi Afrika uzinikezele ekuqhubeni ukusebenza kwesiVumelwano saseBeijing kunye neQonga lokuSebenza, nto leyo engumkhombandlela wokugunyaziswa kwabasetyhini kwanenkqubela yabo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go kopana kgatlhanong le, le go nyatsa bosemorafe - e ka nna kwa magaeng a rona, mo baaging, mo dikopanong tsa loago, kwa ditirong gongwe mo mafaratlhatlheng a ditlhaeletsano tsa loago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-sihlomelo osaYilwayo wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla wonyaka wama- 2016.

src: Bakhuduthamaga ba tla buisana le maAforika Borwa go ralala naga ka nako ya Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Imbizo magareng ga la bo 4 le la bo 10 Moranang 2016, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: Mmogo re tsweletsa pele Aforika Borwa: Godisa Aforika Borwa."
tgt: Izilungiso ziyenziwa kuMthetho wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla, wonyaka we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 117 wowe-1998), owaqalisa ukusebenza phambi konyulo lokuqala lorhulumente wemimandla kulawulo lwentando yesininzi olwalungomhla wesi-5 kweyoMnga ngowama-2000.Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula ulawulo lonyulo lukarhulumente wemimandla, kwaye phakathi kweenguqulelo ezikhoyo, ziza kwenza oku:a) ukulungisa imigaqo yoomasipala abakwiCandelo Ab) ukususa yonke into ebhekisa kwimimandla yolawulo lwezithilic) ukucacisa umhla wokuqalisa kokusebenza kocebad) ukumisela ukuba uMongameli abeke umhla wonyulo loomasipalae) ukuvumela ukuba lolulwe ixesha lokubhengeza iziphumo zonyulof) ukufuna ukuba umphathi kamasipala azise i-IEC ngezithuba ezikhoyo kwiiwadig) ukumisela ukuba iLungu leBhunga eliLawulayo limisele umhla wonyulo lwelungu olwenziwa phakathi kwexesha lolawulo lweBhungah) ukucacisa isininzi esifunekayo ukuze ibekho intlanganiso yebhungai) ukucacisa iimeko zokuvota koceba ochophele intlanganiso yebhungaj) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti kwiwadi nganye ngelixa lentlanganiso yebhungak) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti xa kucandwa ukuze kucaciswe ukunikwa koomasipala basekhaya izihlalo ezingaphaya.

src: Beke eo e tsamaelana le Beke ya Palamente ya Dikgaolotlhopho le meletlo ya Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe se se tlhaga mo ditiragalong tseno le go buisana le baeteledipele ba sepolotiki.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma – njengobambisane isihlalo noMongameli waseFrance uFrançois Hollande, kwiKomishini ePhezulu kwezeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlulo loQoqosho – uza kuya ekuphehlelelweni ngokusesikweni kwale Komishini eLyon, eFrance ngoLwesithathu umhla wama-23 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.

src: Beke ya Imbizo e tla tlhagisa go tsenngwa tirisong ga Leano la Dintlharobongwe le maikaelelo a lona e leng go susumetsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhama ditiro tse di tlhokegang thata.
tgt: Ikhomishini le igxile kwisidingo seengcali zezempilo kumazwe anemivuzo ephakathi nephantsi.

src: E tla bontsha gape dikatlego tsa pusoselegae, go akarediwa diphitlhelelo tse di fitlheletsweng ka ntlha ya leano la tsosoloso ya pusoselegae - dikgato tsa Re boela kwa Tshimologong.
tgt: Eli linge le-UN kulindeleke ukuba linyuse ukhuseleko ngokwasempilweni elizweni liphela kwaye likhuthaze ukukhula koqoqosho okubandakanyayo, nto leyo enegalelo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo lowama-2030.

src: Gape beke eo e tla tsamaelana le mafelo a beke a ikwadiso ya bofelo pele ga Ditlhopho tsa Makgotlatoropo tsa 2016, e naya gape baeteledipele tšhono ya go susumetsa le go rotloetsa maAforika Borwa ka thuto ya ditlhopho go ikwadisa le go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona tsa go tlhopha.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwasebuRhulumenteni eSaudi Arabia ukususela ngomhla wama-27 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, tyelelo olo oluza kuqinisa ubudlelwane obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla bula Samiti ya bo 2 ya Lekgotla la Tlhabololo ya Badiri e e tla diragalang kwa Gallagher Convention Centre kwa Midrand ka la bo 29 le la bo 30 Mopitlwe 2016, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Tirisanommogo go lebeletswe bokgoni - Boikuelo jwa go tsaya Dikgato".
tgt: UMongameli uza kuya kwiNgqungquthela yesi- 4 engoKhuseleko lweNyukliya eWashington, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ukuya kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.

src: Samiti e kgobokanya baamegi go tswa kwa lephateng la thuto e kgolwane go thusa mo tlhabololong ya lona le go tlhama tirisanommogo e e tla bopang ditheo tsa thuto e e kgolwane tse di maatla e bile di siametse indaseteri.
tgt: Ingqungquthela le iza kuxoxa ngomngcipheko okhulayo onokukhokelela kubunqolobi obunokuqhutywa kusetyenziswa izixhobo zenyukliya, kwaye iza kugqamisa amanyathelo anokuthathwa ngamazwe ngamazwe ukuthoba ukusetyenziswa kweyuraniyam enamandla amakhulu, ukugcinwa kwexhobo ezinobungozi, ukuchasa ukuthutyeleziswa kwenyukliya, ukuthintela, ukubona nokuphazamisa amalinge azama ukusebenzisa izixhobo zenyukliya kwizenzo zobunqolobi.

src: Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Metsi ya 2016 e tla ketekiwa go tloga ka la bo 14 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Mopitlwe ka moono wa: "Metsi a batho, metsi ka batho".
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokhela imibhiyozo yoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu kwiBala iMoses Mabhida kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngoMvulo, umhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ekulweni ubuhlanga”.

src: Beke e tla tlhagisa metsi jaaka tshwanelo ya botho ka go godisa temogo ya mathata a batho ba ba sa kgoneng go fitlhelela metsi a a phepa, a a nwegang.
tgt: Njengoko kwakwazisiwe kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowe-2016, olu Suku kulo nyaka luza kubeka isiseko senkqubo yexesha elide yokwakha isizwe esingacalulani ngobuhlanga.

src: Tse di kgonneng go fedisa gotlhelele kwa mafelong a baipei ke KwaZulu-Natal, Bokone Bophirima, Mpumalanga le Gauteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe banye ekulweni nasekuchaseni ubuhlanga – nokokuba busemakhayeni ethu, ekuhlaleni, kwimibutho yasekuhlaleni, emisebenzini okanye kunxibelelwano ngeselela.

src: Kabinete e amogela tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke lenaane la Ntwa kgatlhanong le go dutla ga dipeipi tsa metsi ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Lerothodi lengwe le lengwe le botlhokwa".
tgt: Le Veki yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo iza kugqamisa ukusebenza kwesiCwangciso esinaManqaku aliThoba enjongo yaso ikukomeleza ukukhula koqoqosho nokudala amathuba emisebenzi afuneka kangangoko.

src: Lenaane le ikaelela go ngoka, katisa le go phasalatsa bašwa ba le 15 000 ba ba nang le dithuto tse dinnye tsa Mophato wa 12 gongwe N3 jaaka dipolamara, diathisene gongwe baemedi ba metsi.
tgt: Le veki yeeMbizo iza kuphinda itshile ngempumelelo yorhulumente wemimandla, kubandakanywa nempumelelo eze ngecebo lokuvuselela urhulumente wasekhaya- inkqubo yokuBuyela kuNdalashe.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go badiraditshupetso go itshwara le go tlhagisa dingongorego tsa bona ka tsela e e obamelang molao le Molaotheo.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kudibanisa bonke abachaphazelekayo kwicandelo lemfundo ephakamileyo liphela ukuze incede ekuliphuhliseni nasekudibaneni ngentsebenzisano edala amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo alungele ukusebenza.

src: Go thuba le go senya dithoto ga e tlhole e le tshwanelo ya go dira ditshupetso mme ke tiro ya disenyi tse di senang taolo.
tgt: IVeki yeSizwe yezaManzi yowama-2016 iza kubakho ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-22 kweyoKwindla phantsi komxholo othi, “Amanzi abantu, amanzi ongiwa ngabantu”.

src: Ditheo tsa tiragatso ya molao di tla diragatsa molao ka go tshwara le go pega molato ba ba senyang dithoto kwa diyunibesithi, ditheong tse dingwe tsa thuto e kgolwane, le mo baaging ka nako ya ditshupetso.
tgt: Le veki iza kutshila ngamanzi njengelungelo lomntu ngokuvusa abantu malunga nengxaki yabantu abangafikeleliyo emanzini acwengileyo aselwayo.

src: Tona ya Ditšhelete o begetse Kabinete ka letsholo la fa gautshwane le a le tsereng go ya Amerika le Borithane le baamegi ba ba farologaneng, go akarediwa baeteledipele ba kgwebo.
tgt: ISebe laManzi noGutyulo likwiphulo lokutshabalalisa inkqubo yamabhakethe elindle kwaye kungoku nje sele iphelise ukusetyenziswa kwamabhakethe kwiindawo ezingama--78.8% ezinezindlu ezihlala abantu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e itlamile go netefatsa gore naga e dira mmogo go netefatsa gore maemo a rona ga a fokodiwe.
tgt: Amaphondo asixhenxe aqhube kakuhle kakhulu ngokuphelisa iindawo ezingumyinge ongama-90% ezisasebenzisa amabhakethe.

src: Ona a akaretsa dikgato tse di tshwaraganetsweng go akofisa kgolo e e akaretsang botlhe, dikgato tsa go akofisa tsolotanyo ya ditšhelete, go akofisa go tsenngwa tirisong ga Lenaane la Dipeeletso tsa Mafaratlhatlha la R870 bilione mmogo le tswelelopele e e dirilweng go rarabolola mathata a motlakase, go akarediwa motlakase o o ntšhwafadiwang.
tgt: Kwinani ebekujongwe kulo elingama-26 120 eMntla Koloni, eMpuma Koloni, eMntla Ntshona naseFreyistata, ukuza kuthi ga ngoku iindawo ezingama-11 650 ebezikade zisebenzisa amabhakethe ngoku azisawasebenzisi.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe go buisanela manaane le ditsereganyo tse di tserweng go sireletsa ikonomi ya rona.
tgt: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika mabaqhube bachuleze ukusebenzisa amanzi kwaye basebenzise amalinge okugcina amanzi.

src: Go botlhokwa gore maphata otlhe a netefatse gore ikonomi ya naga e kgona go emelana le dikgwetlho.
tgt: URhulumente selebonelele ngemali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi ukuhlangabezana nale ngxaki yembalela.

src: Mo ntlheng eno, Kabinete e laetse gape Komiti ya Ditona ya Dipeeletso go akofisa ditshwetso tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa tse di amanang le ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela inkqubela eyenziwe yinkqubo yeDabi lokuLwa ukuVuza kwaManzi yeminyaka emihlanu phantsi komxholo othi: “Ithontsi ngalinye libalulekile).

src: Kabinete e boeletsa gore go emelana le dikgwetlho ga ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa go agilwe mo dintlhatheong tse di tsepameng tsa ikonomi mmogo le dipholisi tse di dirisegang.
tgt: Injongo yayo le nkqubo kukufumana, ukuqeqesha nokusebenzisa abantu abatsha abali-15 000 abanesiqinisekiso semfundo ubuncinane seBanga le-12 okanye u-N3 ukuba babe ngabatywini, amagcisa nee-arhente zamanzi.

src: Kabinete e lemogile kgetse ya kgotlatshekelo e e tlhatlhetsweng ke Mokgatlho wa Meepo ya gore Tumelano ya Meepo e se e e mo molaotheong mme e tseewe jaaka e e seng mosola.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo ekuhlaleni.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa gore dintlhatheo tsa Tumelano ya Meepo di ikaeletse go fetola indaseteri ya meepo le go samagana le go tlhoka tekatekano ga maloba go go tlhotlheleditsweng ke tlhaolele gore indaseteri e lepalepane le diphetogo tsa go fetolwa ka kakaretso ga seemo sa Aforika Borwa sa loago, polotiki mmogo le ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabacela abaqhankqalazi ukuba bazibambe kakhulu, kwaye izikhalazo zabo zilawulwe ngumthetho nanguMgaqo-siseko.

src: Kgodiso ya baagi ke ntlha e nngwe ya botlhokwa go netefatsa gore tlhabololo ya meepo ga e kgaphele thoko baagi ba ba maleba.
tgt: Ukonakalisa okuyinkohlakalo nokonakalisa impahla yinto yokutsiba ilitye likaphungela malunga nelungelo lokuqhankqalaza kwaye loo nto ngumsebenzi wabaphuli-mthetho abalahlekileyo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo badirising botlhe ba tsela, bogolo segolo ba ba tla bong ba le mo maetong ka paka ya malatsi a boikhutso, go diragatsa seabe sa bona ka go rwala maikarabelo a pabalesego ya bona le ya badirisi ba bangwe ba tsela.
tgt: Ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho aziza kuwugcina umthetho ngokubamba nokubeka ityala abo batshabalalisa impahla kwiidyunivesithi, kwanamanye amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, ekuhlaleni nangexesha loqhankqalazo.. UMphathiswa wezeZimali wazise iKhabhinethi ngotyelelo asandula ukuba nalo eMelika naseNgilani apho athe wadibana nabachaphazelekayo, kuquka iinkokheli kwezoshishino.

src: Go fedisa matlhotlhapelo a mo tseleng e sa ntse e le setlapele sa bosetšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izinikele ekuqinisekiseni okokuba izinga lethu kwezoqoqosho alithotywa..Olo tyelelo lunika urhulumente ithuba lokwabelana ngamalinge athile aliqela asetyenzisiweyo ukuhlangabezana nemingeni.

src: Bakgweetsi ba tshwanetse go nna ba butse matlho, ba obamele melawana ya tsela, ba seke ba nwa mme ba kgweetsa, ba obamele tekanyetso ya lebelo mmogo le go netefatsa gore dijanaga tsa bona di siametse tsela.
tgt: Loo malinge aquka intsebenziswano ukuze ukukhula okubandakanyayo kukhawuleze, ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuqinisa imicimbi yemali kaRhulumente nokukhawulezisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoTyalo-mali kwiziSeko ezinguNdoqo exabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-R870 kwakunye nenkqubela eyenziweyo ekusombululeni imiqathango yezamandla, kuquka ukusebenzisa amandla ahlaziyekayo.

src: Kabinete e akgola bafenyi botlhe ba Dikgele tsa bo 3 tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Botswerere tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga tsa Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS), tse di akgolang botswerere jwa ditokololo tsa SAPS, maresefe mmogo le ditokololo tsa diforamo tsa baagi tsa sepodisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela onke amacandelo ukuba athethe ngazo zonke iinkqubo ezakhayo nangokungenelela okwenziweyo ukukhusela uqoqosho lwethu.

src: Kabinete e akgola bakwadimmogo Mandla Dube le Leon Otto ba Pambili Media ka baesekopo ya bona ya Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba onke amacandelo aqinisekise ukuba uqoqosho lwelizwe lomelele.

src: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go bogela baesekopo eno ya sepolotiki e e kgatlhisang e e ka ga go fetoga ga mosimanyana wa dingwaga di le 19 wa kwa Mamelodi, kwa botlhaba jwa Pretoria, go nna mogaka wa Kgaratlho.
tgt: Ngokuphathelele kulo mba, iKhabhinethi ikwayalele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa yezoTyalo-mali ukuba ikhawulezise zonke izigqibo ezingundoqo ezayamana noqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse gore puso, ka Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri le la Botsweretshi le Setso, e tla tswelela go tshegetsa kgolo ya indaseteri ya botsweretshi ka go keteka le go anela dikgang tsa Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayiphinda into yokuba ukomelela koqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kusekelwe phezu kwezinto eziqinileyo nezingundoqo zoqoqosho kwaneenkqubo ezisebenzayo.

src: Kabinete e akgola molweladitshwanelo tsa bosiamisi jwa loago Moruti Michael Lapsey ka go amogela Sekgele sa Kagiso ya Setšhaba sa boditšhabatšhaba sa 2016 mo karolong ya 'Kagiso ya Lefatshe le Poelano - Modirakagiso yo o Itsegeng Boditšhabatšhaba'.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isimangalo seQumrhu leMigodi sokuba uXwebhu lwezeMigodi kuthiwe alihambisani namgaqo-siseko kwaye alikho mthethweni.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amogela diphitlhelelo tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka nako ya ketelo ya setsha kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth kwa Kapa Botlhaba, go sekaseka kgatelopele e e leng teng malebana le go tsenngwa tirisong ga Operation Phakisa: e leng maiteko a Ikonomi ya Mawatle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izinto ezibe yimpumelelo ezithe zakhankanywa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngexesha lokutyelela iziko eliseBhayi eMpuma Koloni, ukuza kuhlola inkqubela esele yenziwe ekuphunyezweni kwephulo elibizwa i-Operation Phakisa: uQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Puso e golotse dipeeletso tse di ka nnang bokana ka R17 bilione mo Ikonoming ya Mawatle.
tgt: Urhulumente uvule utyalo-mali olufikelela kwimali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-17 kuQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.

src: Fa e sale e tlhomiwa, go tlhamilwe ditiro di feta 4 500 mo maphateng a a farologaneng.
tgt: Ukususela ekusungulweni kwayo, kudalwe imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-4 500 kumacandelo aliqela.

src: Mekoro e e gogang e le mebedi mo go e e robongwe e e agiwang ke Southern African Shipyards ba e agela Bothati Jwa Bosetšhaba jwa Maemelakepe jwa Transnet (TNPA) kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Durban di lebile kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Oodokolwana ababini kwabalithoba abakhiwa kuMzi weeNqanawa waseMazantsi e-Afrika, i-Southern African Shipyard, nesakhelwa uGunyaziwe waMazibuko eSizwe akwa-Transnet (i-TNPA) kwiZibuko laseDurban baza kuthunyelwa kwiZibuko laseBhayi.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tlhomile mokoro wa ntlha o o gogang kwa Port Elizabeth, o o teilweng leina la Mvezo, o teelelwa lefelo le Moporesitente Nelson Mandela a belegetsweng kwa go lona.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma umisele ngokusesikweni udokolwana wokuqala eBhayi, obizwa uMvezo, nothiywe ngendawo awazalelwa kuyo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.

src: TNPA e abile madi a feta R7 bilione go tokafatsa maemelakepe a rona.
tgt: I-TNPA ibekele bucala imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezisixhenxe yokuphucula amazibuko eli.

src: Moporesitente o ne a lebelela mafelo a dikepe di emelang mo go ona a a ntšhwafaditsweng mo Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth a a tla kgonang go amogela dikepe tse dingwe di le 12 fa a bapisiwa le a ga jaana a a amogelang di le pedi.
tgt: UMongameli ukubona oku kuhlaziywa nokwakhiwa ngokutsha kwesangwana neebhulorho zokungena ekumisa kuzo iinqanawa kwiZibuko laseBhayi neziza kukwazi ukungenisa iinqanawa ezongezelelweyo ezili-12 xa kuthelekiswa nezo zimbini zikhoyo ngoku.

src: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe ba ba tshwaraganeng le puso mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2015/16 go tsholetsa kokoanyo ya rona ya lotseno go ya go R1 trilione la ntlha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abathe basebenzisana norhulumente kunyaka-mali wama-2015/16 ukwenza ukuba uqokelelo lwethu lwerhafu lufikelele okokuqala kwitriliyoni yeerandi.

src: Seno ke sesupo se se tlhamaletseng se se ka ga maatla a ikonomi ya rona e e tsweletseng pele le fa go le thata WEBTOKEN fela ka tuelo ya lekgetho ya maAforika Borwa a a obamelang melao mmogo le kokoanya e e matlhagatlhaga ya letseno ka Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa (SARS) moo puso e kgonang go tlamela ka botlalo ditirelo tse di tlhokegang tse di nang le seabe mo tokafatsong ya matshelo a maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo ngumzekelo ocacileyo wamandla oqoqosho lweli oluphumelela naphantsi kweemeko ezinzima.

src: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya ga Moporesitente Zuma ya gore la bo 3 Phatwe 2016 ke letlha la Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016.
tgt: Kungenxa yerhafu ehlawulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abathe bangenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngethuba kunye nomsebenzi omhle wokuqokelela irhafu weZiko leeNkonzo zezeRhafu zaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) okwenza ukuba urhulumente akwazi ukunikezela ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu nezidlala indima ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Puso e kgotsofaditswe ke gore mafelo a beke a mabedi a ikwadiso a la bo 5-6 Mopitlwe le la bo 9-10 Moranang a ne a na le palo e e kwa godimo ya ba ba ka tlhophang ba ba neng ba etetse diteišene tsa ditlhopho, bogolo segolo ba ba tla bong ba tlhopha la ntlha mmogo le bašwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba umhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016 njengomhla woNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e leboga botlhe ba ba tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa go ikwadisa le go tlhola dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhopi.
tgt: Urhulumente uxolile kukuba iimpela-veki ezimbini ezingumhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla nomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpuzi zokubhalisela unyulo kubonakale inani elikhulu labo baselungelweni lokuvota, ingakumbi abo baza kuvota okokuqala kunye nolutsha.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe ba ba iseng ba ikwadise gongwe go tlhola dintlha tsa bona go etela dikantoro tsa Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho kwa makgotlatoropong a bona le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhophi (ba tlamele ka diaterese) le go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha ka ditlhopho tsa la bo 3 Phatwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abo bathe basabela kwikhwelo lokuya kubhalisa nokuya kukhangela iinkcukhacha zabo kuluhlu lwabavoti.

src: Gape batlhophi ba ka romela dinomoroitshupo tsa bona ka SMS mo go 3281.0 gongwe go letsetsa tikwatikwe ya kgolagano kwa 0800 11 8000 go tlhomamisa seemo sa bona.
tgt: Kungenxa yokusebenza ngokubambisana okubangela ukuba ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi luye lusomelela ngakumbi.

src: Ikwadiso e netefatsa gore leina la gago le teng mo lenaneng la batlhophi gore o kgone go tlhopha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi abangekabhalisi okanye abangekazikhangeli iinkcukhacha zabo ukuba batyelele ii-ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo koomasipala babo baze balungise iinkcukhacha zabo kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti (banikezele ngeedilesi) baze babhalisele unyulo lomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya temokerasi e e lwetsweng ka thata ya go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa Dipusoselegae tsa 2016 ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2016.
tgt: Abavoti basenokuthumela iinombolo zabo zeZazisi nge-SMS ku-3281.0 okanye baqhagamshelane neziko loqhagamshelwano ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa ukuba buthini ubume babo.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa semmuso ga Porojeke ya Tekeletso ya eChannel ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae (DHA) ke Moporesitente Zuma.
tgt: Ubhaliso luqinisekisa ukuba igama lakho likhona kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti ukuze ukwazi ukuvota.

src: Thulaganyo eno e ntšhwa ya boitlhamedi e letla baagi go dira dikopo tsa dikarata tsa boitshupo mo inthaneteng go tila mela e meleele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa ngokusesikweni kweProjekthi yokuLinga i-eChannel yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Tirisanommogo eno le dibanka tse dikgolo di le nne - Dibanka tsa ABSA, FNB, Nedbank le Standard - go tsenyatirisog serala sa go dira dikopo ka inthanete tsa dikarata tsa boitshupo le makwalo a mosepele go kgontsha badirisi go etela dikioseke tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae go isa fela dikgatiso tsa menwana le ditshwantsho morago ga go dira peelano le tuelo mo inthaneteng.
tgt: Le nkqubo yala maxesha intsha ivumela ukuba abemi bafake izicelo zabo zamakhadi-sazisi, i-Smart ID, kwi-intanethi ukuze baphephe imigca emide.

src: eChannel ke karolo ya togamaano ya tlhabololo ka kakaretso ya lefapha go tlosa ditirelo kwa mokgweng wa pampiri go ya go wa dijitale, e leng tsamaiso e e tla akaretsang go phepafatsa rejisetara ya baagi.
tgt: Le yintsebenziswano kunye neebhanki zeli ezine ezinkulu – i-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kunye ne-Standard Bank ukuvelisa iqonga lokufaka isicelo samakhadi-sazisi nepaspothi ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi kuza kuvumela abemi beli ukuba batyelele i-ofisana ze-DHA ukuya kunyathelisa iminwe nemifanekiso yabo emva kokwenza idinga baze bahlawula nge-intanethi.

src: Kabinete e amogela katlego ya Beke ya Imbizo e e neng e tshwerwe fa gautshwane ka moono wa 'Mmogo re tswetsa pele Aforika Borwa', e mo go yona batlhankedi ba puso ba neng ba kopana le baagi go ralala naga.
tgt: I-eChannel iyinxalenye yesicwangciso-qhinga sokwenza eli sebe lihambelane nala maxesha xa lilonke ukutshintsha iinkonzo zisuke kwezokusetyenziswa kwamaphepha kusetyenziswa ubuchwepheshe bale mihla , inkqubo eza kuquka ukulungiswa kweziphene kuluhlu oluqulethe iinkcukacha zoluntu.

src: Kabinete e akgola maAforika Borwa a a nnileng le seabe mo manaaneng a feta 36 go ralala naga, a a netefaditseng gore puso e tsibogela ditlhokego tsa baagi tse di supilweng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iimpumelelo yokubanjwa kutsha nje kweVeki eGxile kwiiMbizo phantsi komxholo othi ‘Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili’, apho sibone khona amagosa karhulumente etyelela iindawo ezininzi zoluntu kweli jikelele.

src: Beke ya Imbizo e maatlafaditse baagi ka tshedimosetso e e ka ga manaane a puso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abo bemi boMzantsi Afrika bathe bathatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezingaphezulu kwama-36 kweli jikelele, nezithe zaqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyahlangabezana nezo mfuno zoluntu zichongiweyo.

src: Lefapha la Manno a Batho le ne le amogetse khonferese e e atlegileng tota ya Ditšhabakopano (UN) e e dirang ka mafelo a baipei, e gatelela seelo se se kwa godimo sa phudugelo mo metsesetoropong mmogo le go gola ga mafelo a baipei.
tgt: Le Veki iGxile kwiMbizo iye yaxhobisa uluntu ngolwazi lweenkqubo zikarhulumente.

src: Ga jaana batho ba le bilione mo lefatsheng ba nna mo mafelong a baipei.
tgt: ISebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe ingqungquthela yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ebeyimpumelelo enkulu ebigxile kwimiba yeendawo ezingamatyotyombe, futhi igxininisa nakwisantya esiphezulu sokufudukela kwabantu ezidolophini nokukhula ngokukhawuleza kwemimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: Fa e sale ka 1994, Aforika Borwa e agile matlo a le dimilione e le karolo ya go netefatsa gore go nna le botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.
tgt: Ngoku ngabantu abayibhiliyoni ehlabathini jikelele abahlala kwimimandla yamatyotyombe.

src: MelaotlhomoKabinete e amogetse Melaotlhomo e e latelang:.
tgt: IMithetho eYilwayoIKhabhinethi iphumeze le Mithetho iYilwayo ilandelayo:.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso ya Dikago tsa Botlhokwa wa 2016 o o tla phasaladiwang mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: UMthetho oYilwayo ongokuKhuselwa kweZiseko ezinguNdoqo eziBaluleke kaKhulu wama-2016 oza kushicilelwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.

src: Molaotlhomo o phimola Molao wa Dintlha tsa Botlhokwa tsa Bosetšhaba, wa 1980 (Molao wa bo 102 wa 1980), mme o ikaelela go lepalepanya thulaganyo ya go supa le go goeletsa dikago tsa botlhokwa ka tsela e e seng bofitlha mme e le maikarabelo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho waMaziko weSizwe anguNdoqo, we-1980 (uMthetho onguNombolo 102 we-1980, kwaye ugxile ekulungelelaniseni inkqubo yokuchonga nokubhengeza iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngendlela eselubala necacisekayo.

src: Gape o tla netefatsa gore dikago tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa tsa tshireletsego ya setšhaba mo nageng di a supiwa mme di sirelediwa ka tsela e e maleba.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ziyachongwa zize zikhuselwe ngokufanelekileyo ukwenzela ukhuseleko lwesizwe.

src: Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya gore go tlhomiwe letlhomeso la setheo go tlhokomela le go tsamaisa tshireletso ya dikago tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwabonelela ngokumiselwa kwenkqubo-sikhokelo yeziko ukwenzela ukuhlolwa nokwenziwa kokhuseleko lweziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu.

src: Gape o tlhalosa tiro ya bothati jo bo tla gakololang Tona ya Sepodisi ka kgoeletso ya dikago tsa botlhokwa.
tgt: Ukwacacisa imisebenzi kweziko eliza kucebisa uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa ekubhengezweni kweziseko ezingundoqo.

src: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Mekgatlho ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng wa 2016 o o tla phasaladiwang gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba wowama-2016 uza kupapashwa ukwenzela ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukuhlomla kuwo.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o baakanya Molao wa ga jaanong wa Mekgatlho ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng, wa 1996 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 1996).Molaotlhomo o tla maatlafatsa thulaganyo ya bolaodi jwa temokerasi jwa Mekgatlho e e leng teng ga jaana ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng gongwe ditheo tsa Dikgwama tse di okameng mafatshe a a tlhakanetsweng ke baagi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uyilwayo uhlomela uMthetho okhoyo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba, we-1996 (uMthetho uNombolo 28 we-1996).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo womeleza inkqubo yolawulo olulolwentando yesininzi yeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba abaLuluntu okanye amaqumrhu eTrasti akhoyo athi ongamele umhlaba onabanikazi abaluluntu.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o o baakantsweng o dira tlamelo ya gore go tlhomiwe Mokwadisi mo Lefapheng la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le Ntšhwafatso ya Naga, mme o tlhalosa tiro ya kantoro eno.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlonyelweyo uvumela ukuba kumiselwe i-ofisi yoMgcini-ncwadi kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba, kwaye uyayicacisa imisebenzi yale ofisi.

src: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe jaaka molao, o tla maatlafatsa taolo ya ditheo tsa bolaodi le go tokafatsa tshegetso ya Mmuso mo go tsona.
tgt: Xa sele upasisiwe lo Mthetho uYilwayo waba ngumthetho, uza komeleza imimiselo yamaziko olawulo uze uqinise inkxaso kaRhulumente kuwo.

src: O tla kgontsha baagi go bona, go tshola le go tsamaisa dithoto ka ditheo tsa tsamaiso tse di bokgoni tse di tshegediwang ke puso.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukufumana, lubambe luze lulawule imihlaba ngokusebenzisa amaqumrhu olawulo asebenzayo nasekwe ngokomthetho naxhaswayo ngurhulumente.

src: Go itsisewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Tsereganyo wa 2016 kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Ukuthiwa thaca koMthetho oYilwayo ongoLamlo weHlabathi wowama-2016 ePalamente.

src: Thulaganyo ya tsereganyo ya boditšhabatšhaba ke sediriswa sa botlhokwa sa go gweba go ralala melelwane ya naga.
tgt: Inkqubo yolamlo lwehlabathi sisixhobo esibalulekileyo sokwenza ushishino ngaphaya kwemida yeli lizwe.

src: E tla tokafatsa phitlhelesego ya ditirelo tsa bosiamisi mo ditlamong tse di gwebang kwa ntle ga naga le ditlamo tsa kwa ntle tse di mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Uza kwenza ukuba kube lula kwiinkampani ezenza ushishino kumazwe angaphandle kweli nezamazwe angaphandle ezishishina eMzantsi Afrika ukuba zifikelele kwiinkonzo zezobulungisa.

src: Molaotlhomo o phimola Molao wa Temogo le Tiragatso ya Dikabo tsa Tsereganyo ya Dinaga di sele, wa 1977 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1977) mme gape o baakanya Molao wa ga jaana wa Tshireletso ya Kgwebo, wa 1978 (Molao wa bo 99 wa 1978).
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho wokwaMkelwa nokuSetyenziswa kokuNikezelwa koLamlo lwaMazwe angaPhandle, we-1977 (uMthetho uNombolo 40 we-1977) kwakunye nokuhlonyelwa koMthetho woKhuselo loShishino, we-1978 (uMthetho uNombolo 99 we-1978).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhambelana noMthetho woMfuziselo ongoLamlo kuRhwebo lweHlabathi, owamkelwa yiKhomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) kuMthetho woRhwebo lweHlabathi.

src: Molaotlhomo o o tshitshinngwang o lepalepana le Sekao sa Molao wa Tsereganyo ya Kgwebo ya Boditšhabatšhaba, se se amogetsweng ke Khomišene ya UN ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya Boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwedrafti yoMthetho-siHlomelo weSiseko soPhando-nzulu seSizwe wowama-2016 kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Setheo sa bosetšhaba sa Dipatlisiso wa 2016 mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore batho ba tshwaele mo go ona.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho weSiseko soPhando-nzulu weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 23 we-1998).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuphucula isakhono soMzantsi Afrika sokukwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano kuphuhliso lwezophando-nzulu nokuvelisa okutsha ngolawullo olusebenzayo, olwaneleyo noluququzelelweyo lokubandakanywa koluntu kwezenzululwazi, nobonelelo lweziseko ezingundoqo zophando-nzulu eziphuculilweyo nofikeleleko.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Dipatlisiso, wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 23 wa 1998).Molaotlhomo o tla tokafatsa bokgoni jwa Aforika Borwa jwa go gaisana mo tlhabololong ya dipatlisiso le boitlhamedi ka tsamaiso ya kgolagano le setšhaba ka tsela e e bokgoni, e e lekaneng mme e gokagane ya saense, mmogo le tlamelo le phitlhelesego e e tokafetseng ya ditlamelo tsa dipatlisiso.
tgt: Kwakhona uza kuphucula indlela uphuhliso loPhando-nzulu olusabela nolusebenza ngokuvakalayo kwalo nokubonelela ukuveliswa kokutsha, ukuphucula umgangatho wobomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuhambelana okungcono nemiba ephambili nengundoqo karhulumente.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: Kabinete e amogetse lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela la Sepodisi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso ngezobuPolisa.

src: Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela le phasaladitswe la ntlha gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go lona ka Mopitlwe 2015.
tgt: Idrafti yeli Phepha leNgcaciso lapapashwa okokuqala kwinyanga yoKwindla yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Lekwalo le dira tlamelo ya tirelo ya sepodisi e e ikamanyang le boagi jo bo tlhaga mme e tsibogela tikologo ya ga jaana ya sepodisi.
tgt: Eli phepha libonelele ngenkonzo yezobupolisa ebacingela kakhulu abemi abasebenzayo ize ilandele neemeko ezikhoyo zezobupolisa.

src: Gape le dira tlamelo ya Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa le sepodisi sa metro se se maikarabelo e bile se le porofešenale.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngeNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika neyamapolisa kamasipala ekwaziyo ukuphendula icacise futhi nesebenza ngobuchule nondiliseko.

src: Gape Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela le ikuela gore go tlhamiwe Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Sepodisi e, gareng ga tse dingwe, e tla rwalang maikarabelo a go tlhoma ditlhokego tsa go ngoka badiri, go tlhopha le go thapa bangokiwa ba bantšhwa mo tirelong ya sepodisi.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso likwafuna ukuba kumiselwe iBhodi yezobuPolisa yeSizwe eza kuthi, phakathi kweminye yemisebenzi yayo, ijongane nokumiselwa kwemimiselo nemigaqo yokukhupha izithuba zemisebenzi, ukukhethwa nokuqeshwa kwamalungu amatsha kwiinkonzo zezobupolisa.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela la Tshireletsego le Pabalesego.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso elingoKhuseleko noKhuselo.

src: Lekwalotlhomo la Mabudusatsela le le setseng le ntsheditswe go batla maikutlo a batho ka Tlhakole 2015, le totile mokgwa o o lotaneng wa tlhabololo wa pabalesego e e sa feleleng fela mo sepodising.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso, nebelikhutshwe kwinyanga yoMdumba yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba kufakwane imilomo noluntu malunga nalo, ligxile kwindlela edibeneyo neyophuhliso kukhuseleko ngaphaya kobupolisa.

src: Le ikaelela go kaela mo dikgatong tse di tla thusang baagi ka thibelo mo mererong ya tshireletsego.
tgt: Linika isikhokelo kumanyathelo okhuseleko loluntu oluthintelayo.

src: Lekwalotlhomo la Mabudusatsela le supa mafapha otlhe a a maleba mmogo le mekgatlho ya baagi e e tshwaelang mo pabalesegong ya baagi.
tgt: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso lichonge onke amasebe afanelekileyo nemibutho yasekuhlaleni yoLuntu enegalelo kukhuseleko loluntu.

src: Kabinete e rebotse Pholisitlhomo ya Tiragatso ya Setso ya Thupiso mo Aforika Borwa mme e rebotse gore Lefapha la Merero ya setso le simolole go kwala molao wa bosetšhaba wa thupiso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele idrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo woKwenziwa kweSiko loLwaluko eMzantsi Afrika yaza yakwamkela ukuba iSebe leMicimbi yeMveli maliqalise ukuyila umthetho wesizwe ongolwaluko.

src: Pholisi e setse e fetile mo thulaganyong ya patlomaikutlo a baamegi ba ba maleba.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele udlule kwinkqubo ebanzi yofakwano-mlomo loluntu kunye nabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo.

src: Pholisi e tlamela ka kaedi e e netefatsang tshireletso ya meetlo ya setso ya thupiso ya basimane ya ngwaga le ngwaga kwa ntle ga go ba baya mo kotsing.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngesikhokelo esiqinisekisa ngokhuseleko lwesiko lemveli lolwaluko lwamakhwenkwe lwaminyaka le kungakhange kubekwe emngciphekweni ukhuseleko lwawo.

src: Seno ke karolo ya dikgato tse puso e di tsayang go maatlafatsa meetlo e e maleba e bile e amogelesega.
tgt: Le yinxalenye yamanyathelo athathwa ngurhulumente ukuqinisa ukwenziwa kweli siko ngendlela efanelekileyo neyamkelekileyo.

src: E busetsa seelo se se amogelesegang sa maikarabelo go botlhe ba ba tsamaisang dikolo tsa thupiso le batsadi ba ba romelang bana kwa dikolong tseno.
tgt: Ubuyisela izinga elamkelekileyo lokuphendula nokucacisa kwabo baphethe amabhoma nabazali abathumela abantwana babo kulo mabhoma.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dikatlegeniso tse di dirilweng ke Komiti ya Dipatlisiso malebana le kgonagalo ya go gweba ka manaka a ditshukudu jaaka boitlhophelo jwa go ka somarela ditshukudu tsa naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamkele izindululo ezenziwe yiKomiti yoPhando lokuba kunokwenzeka na ukuba kwenziwe kurhwetywe ngeempondo zemikhombe njengenye yeendlela zokusindisa imikhombe yeli lizwe ingabi semngciphekweni wokutshabalala.

src: Dikatlenegiso di tshegeditswe ke Komiti ya Setegeniki ya Bogakolodi ya Mafapha le Komiti ya Ditona e e thapetsweng go batlisisa kgonagalo ya go dira gore go nne le kgwebisano ya semolao ya boditšhabatšhaba ya manaka a tshukudu.
tgt: Ezi zindululo ziye zaxhaswa yiKomiti yabaCebisi bezobuChwephetshe yamaSebe aHlukeneyo kunye neKomiti yabaPhathiswa echongelwe ukuba yenze uphando lokuba kungenzeka na lwenziwe olusemthethweni ushishino lwehlabathi lorhwebo lweempondo zemikhombe.

src: Dikatlenegiso di tshegetsa mokgwa wa tsamaiso ya togamaano ya Aforika Borwa wa go rarabolola mathata a bogodu jwa ditshukudu mmogo le kgwebisano e e seng mo molaong ka ditshukudu.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zomeleze indlela yolawulo lobuchule edibeneyo uMzantsi Afrika oyiqwalasele ngayo lo mba ukusombulula ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni nokurhweba ngemikhombe okungekhomthethweni.

src: Komiti e atlenegisa gore mokgwa wa ga jaana wa go tshola seelo sa naga o tswelediwe go na le gore go gwebisanwe ka manaka a ditshukudu.
tgt: Ikomiti icebisa ukuba le ndlela yangoku yokugcina izinga lomhlambi okhoyo ugcinwe unjalo kunokuba kushishinwe ngeempondo zemikhombe.

src: Togamaano ya naga e akaretsa tshireletso maatlafatso ya baagi tsamaiso ya diphologolo ditlamelo tsa molao tse di diragadiwang le go dirisiwa sentle le tsamaiso ya tlhokego.
tgt: Indlela yobuchule eliyisebenzisayo eli lizwe iquka ukhuselo ukuxhotyiswa koluntu ulawulo lwezenzulu-lwazi ngezilwanyana imithetho esabela ngqo kulo mngeni nesetyenziswa futhi inyanzeliswe ngokubonakalayo nolawulo lwezinga lokufunwa kweemveliso zemikhombe.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dithadiso tse di latelang tsa madi a segopotso tsa 2016:a) Motseletsele wa ledi la National Geographic Coin - Maiteko a Dikatse tse Dikgolo: 'Lengau'b) Motseletsele wa korone ya selefera le ledi la tiki 'boitlhamedi jwa Aforika Borwa - ‘Dolosse’.Dithadiso tsa madi, mmogo le dikgoeletso tsa tsona, di tla gatisiwa mo Kaseteng ya Puso, mme di tla tlhagisiwa le go rekisiwa ka ditsela tsa setlwaedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuyilwa kweenkozo zemali zesikhumbuzo sowama-2016:a) UThotho lweeNkozo zeMali ze-National Geographic – Iphulo leeKati eziNkulu: ‘INgwenkala’.b) Uthotho lweeNkozo zeMali zesiThsaba sePonti neTiki sesilivere ‘izinto eziqanjwe eMzantsi Afrika’ – ‘i-Dolosse’Uyilo lweenkozo zemali, kunye nezibhengezo zazo, ziza kupapshwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso, ize emva koko ziveliswe ize zithengiswe ngokweendlela zesiqhelo.

src: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.

src: Magareng ga la bo 18 le la bo 22 Moranang 2016, Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya maeto a tiro kwa mebusong e e leng ditokololo tsa Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Ditso tsa Borwa jwa Aforika (SACU) e e akaretsang wa Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho le wa Swaziland.
tgt: Phakathi komhla we-18 nowama-22 kuTshazimpuzi uMongameli uZuma uza kuthatha utyelelo lwaseburhulumenteni kumazwe angamalungu oMbutho waseMazantsi e-Afrika waMazwe angaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) noluza kuquka iNamibia, iBotswana, iLesotho neSwaziland.

src: Maeto a tla tokafatsa seabe sa botlhokwa se SACU e nang naso go tsweletsa kgolagano ya kgaolo le tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya ditokololo tsotlhe tsa yona.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa indima ebalulekileyo edlalwa yi-SACU ekukhuthazeni ukudityaniswa kommandla nophuhliso lwezoqoqosho lwamazwe angamalungu wayo.

src: Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran ka la bo 23 le la bo 24 Moranang 2016 go maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa sepolotiki le tsa ikonomi magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-23 nowama-24 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 uMongameli uza kuthatha uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya kwi-Islamic Republic of Iran ukomeleza unxibelelwano lwezopolitiko nolwezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Moporesitente o tla etelela pele meletlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Letsatsi la Kgololesego ka la bo 27 Moranang 2016 kwa Limpopo, kwa Lebaleng la Metshameko la Giyani ka moono wa: "Mmogo re aga baagi ba ba botoka - Pusoselegae e ama mongwe le mongwe".Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe le maphata otlhe go bontsha boikanyego jwa bona ka go nna le seabe mo ditiragalong tse di farologaneng tsa segopotso sa Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.
tgt: UMongameli uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku lweSizwe lweNkululeko ngomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 eLimpopo, kumaBala eMidlalo aseGiyani phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke sakha uluntu olungcono – ooRhulumente beeNgingqi yingxaki yomntu wonke”.IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika namacandelo ukuba babonakalise ukuba ngabathandi-besizwe ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimisitho emininzi yokubhiyozela iNyanga yeNkululeko.

src: Mo dibekeng tse di tlang, Palamente e tla tshwara Ditekanyetsokabo tsa mafapha.
tgt: Kwezi veki zizayo, iPalamente izakuba iqhuba iiNgxoxo-mpikiswano zeVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwamasebe karhulumente.

src: Bakhuduthamaga ba ba farologaneng ba mafapha ba tla ala maano a bona a tiro a ngwaga wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17.
tgt: Amalungu eKhabhinethi amasebe awohlukahlukeneyo aza kucacisa izicwangciso zawo zokusebenza zonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17.

src: Baagi ba tla itsisewe ka manaane a tlamelo ya ditirelo a puso.
tgt: Amalungu oluntu aza kwaziswa malunga neenkqubo zonikezelo-nkonzo zikarhulumente.

src: Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsibogo le kopo ya boitshwarelo ya ga Moporesitente Zuma malebana le katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo malebana le go obamela dikgato tsa paakanyo tse di tlhagelelang mo pegelong ya Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela impendulo elandelwe kukucelwa koxolo nguMongameli uZuma kwisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko ngokumalunga nokuthotyelwa kwamanyathelo okulungisa acaciswe kwingxelo yoMkhuseli woLuntu.

src: Kabinete e buisa katlholo go bona gore a go na le dikgato dingwe gape tse di tshwanetseng go tsewa go maatlafatsa seabe sa Tirelo ya Setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isasiphonononga esi sigwebo ukuze iqonde ukuba akhona na amanye amanyathelo ekufuneka athathwe ukuqinisa indima kaRhulumente.

src: Katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo e tlhomamisa temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa ya molaotheo.
tgt: Isigwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko someleza sikwaqinisekisa ngolawulo lwentando yesininzi lwaseMzantsi Afrika olusekelwe kumgaqo-siseko.

src: Kabinete e lemogile dikgato tse di tserweng ke dibanka di le nne tse di ntshitseng kitsiso ya go tswala akhaonto ya banka ya setlamo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwaqaphele amanyathelo eebhanki ezine ezithe zakhupha izaziso zokuvala ii-akhawunti zenkampani.

src: Le fa Kabinete e amogela melawana le dipeelo tsa dibanka, dikgato tseo di ka tshosa babeeletsi ba isago ba ba ka batlang go dira kgwebo mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ngeli xesha iKhabhinethi iyiqonda imiselo nemiqathango yeebhanki, la manyathelo asenokugxotha abo bebesenokuba ngabatyali-mali kwixesha elizayo abasenokufuna ukwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e tlhomamisitse gore Ditona tsa Ditšhelete, Bodiri le Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale di tshwanetse go bula dipuisano tse di agang le dibanka go bona tharabololo ya leruri ya morero ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali, owezabaSebenzi noweMithombo yeziMbiwa ukuba baqale iingxoxo zokubonisana nokucweya kunye nezi bhanki ukufumana isisombululo esiyakuhlala simile ngalo mba.
