src: Kabinete e akgotse Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, yo o amogetseng sekgele sa boditšhabatšhaba sa USAID-TB ka ntlha ya boeteledipele jwa gagwe mo ntweng ya lefatshe kgatlhanong le bolwetsi jwa lehuba (TB) gammogo le go etelela pele maiteko a Aforika Borwa le a kgaoloa go tlhatlhoba, go alafa le go thibela TB tshwaetso ya TB/HIV mmogo le TB e e dipelang melemo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, nothe wafumana imbasa yehlabathi i-USAID-TB ngenxa yendlela akhokele ngayo iphulo lehlabathi jikelele lokulwa isifo sephepha (i-TB) kwakunye nokuba nguvulindlela kumaphulo oMzantsi Afrika nawommandla ekuhlolweni, unyango nokuthintelwa kwe-TB usuleleko lwe-TB nayiNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) kunye ne-TB enganyangekiyo.

src: Kabinete e amogela go supiwa ga Aforika Borwa jaaka moamogedi wa 2016 wa Sekgele sa Tirelo e e Kgethegileng ya Sedipolomate (Distinguisned Diplomatic Service Award) ke Lekgotla la Merero ya Lefatshe kwa Washington DJaaka naga ya ntlha ya Aforika go amogela sekgele seno, se lemoga maitlamo a naga a thuto ya lefatshe, merero ya boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le tlhaeletsano ya lefatshe go tsweletsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphakanyiswa kwegama loMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliza kuwongwa ngeMbasa yeeNkonzo Zozakuzo ezikuDidi oluPhezulu liBhunga leMicimbi yeHlabathi eWashington DNjengelizwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukufumana le mbasa, ingqina ukuzinikela okungathethekiyo kweli lizwe kwezemfundo yehlabathi jikelele, kwimicimbi yehlabathi nonxibelelwano nehlabathi ukuqhubela phambili iimfuno zethu zesizwe.

src: Kabinete e akgola Tona ya Dikamano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba le Tirisanommogo, Mme Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe mo dipuisanong tsa Aforika Borwa tsa boditšhabatšhaba, tse di tsamaisiwang ke ponelopele ya "kontinente ya Aforika e e kopaneng mme e na le kagiso, temokerasi, e sa tlhaole go ya ka bosemorafe, e sa tlhaole go ya ka bong mme e humile, le e e tshwaelang mo lefatsheng le le nang le tshiamo le tekatekano.".
tgt: IKhabhinethi imothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa woBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano, uNksz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe kunxibelelwano loMzantsi Afrika namazwe ngamazwe, noluqhutywa ngumbono “welizwekazi le-Afrika elimanyeneyo nelinoxolo, elilawulwa ngentando yesininzi, olungenabuhlanga, olungenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo, nelithi lenze igalelo kwihlabathi elilungileyo nekulinganwayo kulo.”.

src: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ke Moporesitente Zuma ga Moatefokate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi jaaka Tlhogo ya Yuniti ya Dipatlisiso tse di Kgethegileng, mme e rata go mo eletsa masego mo maikarabelong a gagwe a mantšhwa a go lwantsha bobodu le tsamaiso e e sokameng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kuka-Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengentloko yeCandelo loPhando oluKhethekileyo (i-SIU) nguMongameli uZuma, kwaye imnqwenela okuhle kodwa kulo msebenzi wakhe umtsha wokulwa urhwaphilizo nolawulo olugwenxa.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa dipelo kwa lelapeng la ga Makwetu le Pan Africanist Congress ka go tlhokafala ga Rre Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaMakwetu kunye nombutho i-Pan Africanist Congress ngokusweleka kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: Rre Makwetu o tla gakologelwa ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe e e boitshegang le go intsha setlhabelo mo mokgatlhong o o neng o lwela kgololesego mmogo le go tlhamiwa ga Aforika Borwa e ntšhwa ya temokerasi.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi nokuzenza idini kumzabalazo wenkululeko nokusekwa koMzantsi Afrika omtsha wolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Moporesitente o goeleditse gore phitlho ya mogaka ono wa kgaratlho ya kgololesego e nne Phitlho e e Kgethegileng ya Semmuso ya Porofense.
tgt: UMongameli ubhengeze iinkonzo yoMngcwabo oseSikweni oKhethekileyo wePhondo kweli qhawe lomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa dipelo kwa lelapeng la ga Naidoo ka go tlhokafala ga Rre Kumarana Naidoo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaNaidoo ngokusweleka kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: Rre Naidoo e ne e le Mokaedikakaretso wa Namaotshwere wa Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ebenguMlawuli-Jikelele oliBambela weSebe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho.

src: O kile a dira jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri.
tgt: Ngaphambili ebesebenza njengeGosa lezeZimali eliyiNtloko leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Rre Naidoo o tshwaetse go utlwala mo tsamaisong ya ditšhelete mo Tirelong ya Setšhaba.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi kulawulo lwezezimali kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.

src: Kabinete e tlhagisitse malebo ka tshwaelo e e dirilweng ke Rre William Smith, yo o dirileng jaaka Mokwaledi wa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ombulelo kwigalelo elenziwe nguMnu William Smith, obesenza kwiQonga looNobhala leKhabhinethi.

src: Rre Smith o rotse tiro ka bogodi kwa bokhutlong jwa Mopitlwe morago ga go direla Tirelo Setšhaba dingwaga di le Kabinete e mo eletsa molemo mo pakeng ya gagwe ya phenšene.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlala-phantsi ekupheleni kweyoKwindla emva kokuphangelela iNkonzo kaRhulumente iminyaka engama-27.

src: Kabinete e lotlegetswe ka ga Pegelo ya Khomišene ya Dipatlisiso malebana le Magatwe a Tsietso, Bobodu, Tsamaiso e e sa siamang mo Thulaganyong ya Theko ya tsa Phemelo (Khomišene ya Theko ya Dibetsa) e e golotsweng ke Moporesitente mosong ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imnqwenelela okuhle kodwa kumhlala-phantsi wakhe.

src: Pegelo e fitlhetse go sena bosupi jwa molato, pipamolomo, tsietso gongwe bobodu mo thulaganyong ya theko ya dibetsa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe malunga neNgxelo yeKhomishini yoPhando malunga neziTyholo zobuQhetseba, uRhwaphilizo, iMposiso okanye iziPhene kwiSivumelwano seNtengo yeziXhobo zoMkhosi zobuChule (iKhomishini yeNtengo yeziXhobo) ethe yakhutshwa nguMongameli kusasa nje.

src: Re tlhatswitswe maina jaaka re sa bolo go bua mo dingwageng tse dintsintsi gore ga gona phoso epe le gore theko e dirilwe ka WEBTOKEN solofela gore diphitlhelelo di tla tswalela morero ono o o sa bolong go WEBTOKEN golagana le Moporesitente Zuma go leboga Moatlhodi Willie Seriti le Moatlhodi Thekiso Musi, dipaki tsotlhe, go akarediwa le Moporesitente wa maloba Thabo Mbeki, batsamaisi ba bosupi, ditlhopha tsa molao, badiri le botlhe ba ba tshwaetseng go atlegisa tiro ya Khomišene.
tgt: Le Ngxelo ayifumanisanga bungqina bubonakalisa bugwenxa, kunyoba, buqhetseba okanye rhwaphilizo kwinkqubo yokuthengwa kwezixhobo.

src: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.
tgt: NjengoRhulumente siyazamkela iziphumo zeKhomishini.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Manaane a a Botlhokwa a Puso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amogela Leeto la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran, le le akofisang botsalano jwa ikonomi le kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi, ka go saeniwa ga ditumelano le maitlamo a le mmalwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran, nolwandisa ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho norhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe omabini, ngokutyikitywa kwezivumelwano nezibhambathiso eziliqela.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Moporesitente Hasan Rouhani ba maatlafaditse tirisanommogo mo maphateng a kgwebisano, thuto le tlhabololo ya bokgoni saense le thekenoloji maatla, go akarediwa go phuruphudiwa ga gase ya petorokhemikale mmogo le bokgoni jwa go e fetola temothuo meepo mmogo le go fetolwa ga diminerale tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha le dipalangwa ditšhelete, dibanka le inšorense mmogo le bojanala.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMongameli uHasan Rouhani bayiqinisile intsebenziswano kumacandelo ezorhwebo, ezemfundo nophuhliso lwezakhono inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe ezamandla kuquka nokuhlolwa kwe-oli kunye namandla okucolwa kwayo ezolimo imigodi nezokuxhamlisa kwezemigodi uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nezothutho ezezimali, ezebhanki neze-inshorensi nokhenketho.

src: Mme tsotlhe tse di tshwaela mo go diragadiweng ga Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP).Mo go tsa boditšhabatšhaba, baeteledipele ka bobedi ba dumelane ka go maatlafatsa boikuelo jwa tlhabololo ya Ditšhabakopano (UN), bogolo segolo Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN, mo dikgatlhegong tsa dinaga tse di tlhabologang.
tgt: Xa zizonke zenza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).Kwimiba yezehlabathi, ezi nkokheli zimbini zivumelene ukuba makuqiniswe isimemo sokuhlaziywa nokuziza iinguqu kuMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ingakumbi iBhunga loKhuselo le-UN, ukuze lincede nezizwe ezinoqoqosho elisakhulayo.

src: Dipoelo tseno di maatlafaditse Leeto la Tiro la Moporesitente kwa United Arab Emirates (UAE) koo mebuso ka bobedi e neng ya ntšhwafatsa maitlamo a yona malebana le tsolotanyo le kgodiso ya botsalano jwa sebedi, bogolo segolo mo maphateng a kgwebisano, dipeeletso le ikonomi go nna botsalano jwa togamaano jo bo akaretsang.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zomeleza uTyelelo lukaMongameli oluyiNxalenye yomsebenzi kwi-United Arab Emirates (i-AEU) apho omabini la mazwe ahlaziye khona isivumelwano sawo ekudibaniseni nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwane benkululeko, ingakumbi kwezorhwebo, kwimiba yotyalo-mali neyezoqoqosho kubudlelwane bobuchule obudibeneyo.

src: Seno se ageletse mo Leetong la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Ngwanaitsele 2011, fa go ne ga tlhamiwang Khomišene e e Tlhakanetsweng ya SA-UAE e e akofisitseng lebelo la kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi go tloga go R13 bilione ka 2011 go ya go R27 bilione ka 2015.Aforika Borwa le UAE ba dumelane go atolosa tirisanommogo go dirisa ditšhono tsa Ikonomi ya Mawatle, go tsweletsa go romelwa ntle ga ditlhagiswa tsa temothuo tsa Aforika Borwa, ditlhagiswa tse di dirilweng mme bogolo segolo theko le tirisanommogo mo go tsa phemelo.
tgt: Oku kwakhela phezu koTyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni lwenyanga yeNkanga yowama-2011 nolwakhokelela ekusekweni kweKhomishini eDibeneyo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Unite Arab Emirates olwathi lwakhawulezisa isantya esipheleleyo sorhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini ukususela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13 ngowama-2011 ukuya kwiibhiliyoni zeerandin ezingama-27 ngowama-2015.UMzantsi Afrika ne-United Arab Emirates ukwavumelene ngokwandisa intsebenziswano yokusebenzisa ithuba elivela kuQoqosho laseLwandle, ukuthumela kumazwe angaphandle, iimveliso zezolimo zaseMzantsi Afrika, iimveliso ezenziweyo kwaye ngokukodwa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuselo nobudlelwane.

src: Gape leeto le tsweleditse bokgoni jwa Aforika Borwa jwa go aga mafaratlhatlha go totilwe ditšhono tsa ditlamo tsa Aforika Borwa kwa EXPO 2020 kwa Dubai, gammogo le tirisanommogo mo mererong ya kagiso, tshireletso mmogo le tsepamo.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lukwakhuthaza ukuxhotyiswa kolwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo olugxile ekunikeni iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika amathuba kwi-EXPO 2020 eDubai, kwakunye nentsebenziswano kwicandelo lezoxolo, ukhuseleko nozinzo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse dikgato tse di tsepameng tse di beilweng ke Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso Fikile Mbalula go aga sešwa sebopego se se kgaoganeng e bile se tlhaola thata sa metshameko le boitapoloso ka Tumelano ya Diphetogo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo angqongqo athe amiselwa nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula ngokusebenzisa uXwebhu lweNguqu ukwakha ngokutsha imbonakalo yezemidlalo nolonwabo eqhekekileyo nenocalucalulo olunzulu.

src: Seno se tla akofisa diphetogo tse di lebisang kwa tsamaisong e e kopaneng ya metshameko e e ikaegileng ka dintlhatheo tsa temokerasi, tekatenako, go direla dilo mo pepeneneng, kemedi ya baagi ba ba farologaneng, phitlhelesego, mmogo le seabe se se oketsegileng go lepalepana le dikeletso tsa NDKabinete e amogela ditekanyetsokabo tse di tlhagisiwang ke mafapha a a farologaneng ka dipegelo tse di tseneletseng tse di tlhagisang tswelelopele e e dirilweng malebana le go tokafatsa matshelo a maAforika Borwa.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa inguqu ebhekisele kwinkqubo yezemidlalo emanyeneyo exhaswa yimigomo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi, umakulingwane, ukwenza elubala, ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke ubani uthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela nokwanda kokuthathwa kwenxaxheba ngokweenjongo ze-NDIKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngamasebe ngamasebe nengxelo ezingena nzulu ekucaciseni inkqubela eseyenziwe ukuphucula ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Seno se bontsha tiragatso ya Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Pakagare (MTSF) le le re atametsang mo go fitlheleleng Ponelopele 2030 ya NDP.
tgt: Oku kubonakalisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiPhakathi nesisisondeza ekufezekisweni koMbono wama-2030 wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go latedisisa ditekanyetsokabo mo bobegakgannyeng jo bo farologaneng gore ba tlhaloganye Leanotiro la Puso botoka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamamele futhi bazibukele ezi ngxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuwo onke amajelo eendaba ukuze bayiqonde ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente.

src: Kabinete e ikuela gore go nne le maitlamo a a tswelelang go netefatsa gore go nna le diphetogo tse di mosola mo tirong go lebeletswe diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 16 ya Khomišene ya Tekatekano mo Tirong ya bathapi botlhe ba ba neng ba supilwe, e e tlhomilweng ka moono wa "Diphetogo di mosola mo kgwebong".
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuzibophelela okuqhubekayo ukwenza inguqu enentsingiselo emisebenzini ngenxa yeziphumo ezivela kwiNgxelo yoNyaka yeKhomishini ye-16 kaMakulingwane eMisebenzini kubo bonke abaqeshi abachongiweyo neyathi yamiselwa phantsi komxholo othi “Iinguqu zibalulekile”.

src: Pegelo e thusa puso go tlhaloganya seemo sa tekatekano mo tirong mo nageng mmogo le tswelelopele malebana le diphetogo mo tirong mo ngwageng wa 2015.
tgt: Le Ngxelo iyamnceda urhulumente ukuba abuqonde ubume bomakulingwane emisebenzini kweli lizwe nenkqubela yakhe ekwenziweni kwenguqu emisebenzini kunyaka wama-2015.

src: Kabinete e akgola Lefapha la Manno a Batho malebana le go abiwa ga Dintlo di le milione mmogo le ditšhono tsa dintlo fa e sa le temokerasi e le gona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezigidi eziyi-4,3 zezindlu namathuba ezezindlu ukususela mhla kwafika ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Ditšhono tseno di akaretsa dintlo di le 2 806 235 tse di etleediwang ka botlalo (dintlo tsa BNG), dintlo tsa loago/tse di hiriwang di le 121 784, di le 6 329 tsa Lenaane la Ketleetso ya Motho ka nosi le le Golaganeng le Ditšhelete le ditsha tse di nang le ditirelo di le 986 608.Phitlhelelo eno ya hisetori e tlametse batho ba feta dimilione di le 20 ka dintlo mme go keteka phitlhelelo eno, lefapha le tlhomile letsholo la bosetšhaba go bontsha katlego ya naga.
tgt: La mathuba aquka izindlu zenkxaso epheleleyo ezingama-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zezentlalo/zokurenta ezingama-121 784, izindlu zeNkqubo yeNkxaso-mali yoMntu ngaMnye ezingama-121 784 kunye neziza ezifumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezingama-986 608.Le mpumelelo iyimbali ibonelele ngezindlu abantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kwaye ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo isebe limisele iphulo lesizwe lokubonakalisa le mpumelelo yesizwe.

src: Go tlhomiwa bosetšhaba go dirilwe kwa COSMO City, e leng nngwe ya diporojeke tsa ditlapele mo nageng e gape e ketekang dingwaga di le lesome e ntse e le teng.
tgt: Oku kumiselwa kwesizwe kwenzeke e-COSMO City, neyenye yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezidibeneyo kwilizwe jikelele nekwabhiyozela iminyaka elishumi yabakho.

src: Kabinete e lebogetse maAforika Borwa otlhe ka ntlha ya ditshwaelo tsa ona, boineelo le go dira ka natla go netefatsa gore maAforika Borwa a a tlhokang a busediwa seriti ka manno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngegalelo labo, lokuzinikela nokusebenza kwabo ngamandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba isidima sabemi baseMzantsi Afrika abahlelelekileyo siyabuyiselwa ngezokuhlaliswa koluntu.

src: Kabinete e akgola Mokwaledikakaretso wa Ditšhabakopano ka go bitsa Moletlo wa Maemo a a kwa Godimo wa go Saena Tumelano ya Paris, e e amogetsweng ke Ditokolo di le 176 ka Sedimonthole 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo ngokuqhuba uMsitho wokuTyikitya okwiNqanaba eliPhezulu wesiVumelwano saseParis, nesithe samkelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu ali-176 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Go saeniwa ga Tumelano ya Paris go tshwaile kgato ya ntlha ya go diragadiwa ga yona go go tla kaelang maiteko a boditšhabatšhaba a go lekanyetsa tlhagiso ya digase tsa greenhouse mmogo le go fitlhelela dikgwetlho tsotlhe tsa phetogo ya tlelaemete.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano saseParis kuphawula inyathelo lokuqala ekuphunyezweni kwaso nokuzakukhokela amalinge ehlabathi ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa kweegesi ezingcolisa umoya nokukwazi ukulwa imingeni ehambelana nako ebangelwa kukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: Kabinete e letetse go konosediwa ga dithulaganyo tsa selegae tsa go amogelwa ke botlhe, go kgontsha gore go diragadiwe Tumelano ya Paris ka nako gore ka 2020 e bo e diragadiwa ka botlalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulinde ngomdla ukuqukunjelwa kweenkqubo zokugunyaziswa zalapha ekhaya, ngawo onke, ukuvumela ukungena kwangexesha ukwenzela ukufezekiswa ngokupheleleyo kwesiVumelwano saseParis ngowama-2020.

src: Gape Kabinete e lemoga gore Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo le dirisana mmogo le Lefapha la Bojanala go diragatsa dilaboratori tsa tlamelo tse di bidiwang "Biodiversity Lab: Go godisa tshwaelo ya ikonomi ya ditlamelo tsa bayoloji tsa Aforika Borwa" go tloga ka la bo 10 Moranang go fitlha ka la bo 13 Motsheganong 2016.Maikaelelo ke go lemoga bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa ditshedi le dimela tse di farologaneng jo bo tlhalositseng mo Togamaanotlhomo ya Ikonomi ya Bosetšhaba ya Ditshedi le Dimela tse di farologaneng e e amogetsweng ke Kabinete ka Phukwi 2015 gore batho ba nne le seabe mo go yona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphela ukuba iSebe lezeNdalo lizibandakanye neSebe lezoKhenketho ekuqaliseni iilebhu zokubonelela ezinesihloko esithi “iLebhu yeNzululwazi ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo: Ikhulisa igalelo loqoqosho lwemithombo yobunzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo yaseMzantsi Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-10 kuTshazimpuzi ukuya kowe-13 kwekaCanzibe yowama-2016.Injongo kukuphumeza amandla oqoqosho lobutyebi bezenzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo zaseMzantsi Afrika achazwe kuyilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lweNzululwazi ngeziLwanyana neziTyalo seSizwe esiphunyezwe yiKhabhinethi kweyeKhala yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuthatha inxaxheba koluntu.

src: Ditshwetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Leanotiro la Pholisi ya Diindaseteri (IPAP) la 2016/17 - 2018/19, e leng pilara ya botlhokwa ya Leano la Moporesitente la Dintlha di le Robongwe mme le tshwaela mo go diragadiweng ga NDP.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuSebenza kwezoShishino (i-IPAP) sowama-2016/17 – 2018/19, nesiyintsika engundoqo yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba sikaMongameli kwaye senza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Seno ke poeletso ya borobedi ya maano a madirelo a puso a a latelanang a a agelelang mo diphitlhelelong, dipholising mmogo le mo manaane a dipoeletso tse dingwe tse di fetileng.
tgt: Oku kukuphindaphindwa kwaminyaka le kwesibhozo kwesicwangciso sikarhulumente semizi-mveliso esiyimpumelelo nesakhelwa kwiimpumelelo, amaqonga emigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zokuphindaphindwa kwangaphambili.

src: Maitlhomo a IPAP 2016/17 ke go fitlhelela ditlamorago tse di kwa godimo tsa pholisi ya madirelo mo maemong a a boima a ikonomi.
tgt: I-IPAP yowama-2016/17 iinjongo zayo kukwenza impembelelo enkulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezoshishino phantsi kweemeko ezinzima zezoqoqosho.

src: Seno se akaretsa ditlamorago tse di tswelelang pele tsa kwelotlase ya ikonomi lefatshe ka bophara go akarediwa le mathata a tshipi mmogo le kwelotlase ya diminerale gammogo le komelelo e e tseneletseng mmogo le dikgoreletsi tse dingwe tsa selegae.
tgt: Ekukho phakathi kwazo impembelelo eqhubekayo yokudodobala kwezoqoqosho kwihlabathi jikelele kuquka iimeko emaxongo kurhwebo lwezesinyithi kunye nezimbiwa kwakunye nembalela enkulu neminye imiqobo ebalulekileyo yalapha ekhaya.

src: Diphitlhelelo tsa ngwaga o o fetileng di akaretsa go bolokiwa ga ditiro di ka fopholediwa go 67 000 le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro tse di nang le seriti di ka nna 7 000 mo lephateng la Diaparo le Matlalo le Ditlhako.
tgt: Imisebenzi eyimpumelelo yonyaka ophelileyo iquka ukusindiswa kwemisebenzi emalunga nama-67 000 nokudalwa kwemisebenzi emitsha endilisekileyo ethelekelelwa kuma-7 000 kwicandelo leMpahla nelezeziKhumba neZihlangu.

src: Lephatapotlana la phetolo ya ditlhagiswa tsa temothuo ke lengwe la maphata a madirelo a selegae a magolo ka go thapa, mme le tlametse ka ditiro tse di fopholediwang go 216 090 ka 2015 fa go bapisiwa le 208 822 ka 2014.
tgt: Icandelwana elisebenza phantsi kokucolwa nokulungiswa kweemveliso zezolimo lelinye lamacandelo okuvelisa amakhulu apha ekhaya ngokwengqesho, abonelela ngemisebenzi ethelekelelwa kuma-216 090 ngowama-2015 xa kuthelekiswa nama-208 822 ngowama-2014.

src: Go ngokilwe dipeeletso tsa boleng jo bo fetang R600 milione ka 2015/16 mme seo ya nna motheo wa go maatlafatsa tlhabololo ya dikgwebo go totilwe baagi ba metsemagae.
tgt: Lutyalo-mali olungaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-600 zeerandi athe atsalwe ngowama-2015/16, elusisiseko sokomeleza uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci olugxile kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Letlhomeso la Makgaolakgang la Tlhabololo e e Kopaneng ya Metsesetoropo le Leano la Tiragatso la 2016/19.
tgt: Khabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yokuGqibela yoPhuhliso lweeDolophu oluDibeneyo nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza sowama-2016/19.

src: Ditlamorago tsa kakaretso tsa Letlhomeso la Tlhabololo e e Kopaneng ya Metsesetoropo ke phetogo ya go abiwa ga dibaka.
tgt: Iziphumo ezipheleleyo zeNkqubo –sikhokelo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu oludibeneyo yinguqu ngokwabala omhlaba.

src: Seno ke tumelano e ntšhwa ya ditoropokgolo le ditoropo tsa Aforika Borwa, e e tla lebisang kgolo ya metsesetoropo kwa sekaong sa kgolo ya leruri ya ditoropokgolo le metsesetoropo e e kitlaneng, e gokagane, e babalesegile, e dirisa ditlamelo sentle mme e le mafelo a a siameng a bonno le a tiro.
tgt: Oku kuza notshintsho olutsha kwizixeko needolophu zaseMzantsi Afrika, nokuza kuqhubela uhlumo lwasezidolophini kwindlela eluqilima yohlumo oluzinzileyo, iqhagamshelanise ize iququzelele izixeko needolophu, neziyindawo ekhuselekileyo, ezinemithombo esebenzayo futhi neziyindawo elungileyo ukuba umntu angasebenza ahlale kuzo.

src: Seno se tsibogela kaelo ya NDP ya go tlhama pholisi ya tlhabololo ya metsesetoropo e e tla netefatsang thulaganyo e e siameng, dipeeletso tsa mafaratlhatlha le botsamaisi go tshegetsa kgolo le go bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa ditoropokgolo le ditoropo tsa rona.
tgt: Oku kusabela kumyalelo wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso wokuqulunqa umgaqo-nkqubo wophuhliso lwedolophu oza kuqinisekisa ngokucwangcisa okufanelekileyo, utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo nolawulo lokuxhasa uhlumo nokuvulela amandla ezoqoqosho lwezixeko needolophu.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Pholisitlhomo ya Tirelo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro - Go agela Aforika Borwa Thulaganyo e e bokgoni le e e Gokaganeng ya Tirelo ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro, mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore batho ba tshwaele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo – uKwakhela uMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo esebenzayo neDibeneyo yeeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Fa Pholisitlhomo e diragadiwa, e tla dira tlamelo ya mokgwa o o gokaganeng wa ditirelo tsa tlhabololo ya tiro tsa boleng go baagi botlhe.
tgt: Le drafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo xa sele iphunyeziwe iza kubonelela ngendlela edibeneyo yeenkonzo zophuhliso lwamakhondo asemgangathweni kubo bonke abemi.

src: Seno se tla ba kgontsha go dira boitlhophelo jwa tiro ka kitso go kgona go fitlhelela go thapiwa, go tshwaela mo loagong mmogo le go aga ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Oku kuza kubenza bakwazi ukuthatha izigqibo zokukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo ukuze bakwazi ukufumana imisebenzi, benze igalelo kuluntu nasekwakheni uqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Tirelo ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro e na le seabe sa botlhokwa go thusa gore mebaraka ya ditiro e dire mme ditsamaiso tsa thuto di fitlhelele diphitlhelelo tsa tsona.
tgt: IiNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo zidlala indima engundoqo ekuncedeni umsebenzi wokubonelela ngemisebenzi nenkqubo yezemfundo ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo ezijongise kuzo.

src: Seno se tshwaela mo go fitlheleleng dikatlenegiso tsa NDP tsa go tsweletsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go thapa, go lepalepanya badiri le ditiro le go oketsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni mmogo le palo ya dialogane tsa diyunibesithi.
tgt: Oku kwenza igalelo ekuphumezeni izindululo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso sokukhuthaza uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nemisebenzi, ukuthelekisa abasebenzi abaphangelayo nemisebenzi nokwandiswa kophuhliso lwezakhono kunye noninzi lwabo banezidanga zasedyunivesiti.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka tiragatso ya Thulaganyo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tshekatsheko mme e amogetse Pegelo ya Ngwaga le ngwaga ya 2014/15 le Leano la botlhano la Bosetšhaba la Tshekatsheko la 2016/17 go fitlha 2018/19 jaaka karolo ya letsholo la go tokafatsa tlamelo ya ditirelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngokuphunyezwa kweNkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe yaza yamkela iNgxelo yonyaka wama-2014/15 kunye nesiCwangciso soVavanyo seSizwe sesihlanu seminyaka yowama-2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018/19, njengenxalenye yendlela yokuphucula unikezela lweenkonzo.

src: Thulaganyo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tshekatsheko e tswa mo Letlhomesong la Bosetšhaba la Pholisi ya Tshekatsheko le le netefatsang gore bosupi jo bo ikanyegang e bile bo sa gobelele jo bo tswang mo ditshekatshekong, bo akarediwa mo dithulaganyong tsa maano, tekanyetsokabo, tlhabololo ya ditheo, tshekatsheko ya dipholisi, gammogo le jaaka lenaane le le tswelelang pele le tsamaiso ya diporojeke gore go tokafadiwe tiragatso.
tgt: INkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe ivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woVavanyo weSizwe oqinisekisa ukuba ubungqina bovavanyo obuthembakeleyo nobungakhethe-cala buyafakwa kwiinkqubo zokucwangcisa, ukwenza uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ukuphuculwa kweziko, uhlaziyo lomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nolawulo lwenkqubo oluqhubekayo nolawulo lweprojekthi ukuze kuphuculwe indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo.

src: Go konoseditswe gongwe go tsweletswe ka ditshekatsheko di le 47, tse di akaretsang ditshenyegelo tsa puso tsa R75 bilione.
tgt: Luvavanyo olungama-47 eselugqityiwe okanye olusaqhutywayo, lubandakanya imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-75 zeerandi enkcitho karhulumente.

src: Go amogetswe dipegelo tsa tshekatsheko di le 15 mme go fitlha ga jaana, di le 12 di tlhagisitswe fa pele ga Kabinete.
tgt: Zingxelo zovavanyo ezili-15 esezamkelwe ize ibe zezi-12 ezithiwe theca phambi kweKhabhinethi ukuza kutsho ngoku.

src: Go diragadiwa maano a tokafatso a le 14 mme tswelelopele ya ona e bontsha diphetogo tse di bonalang.
tgt: Izicwangciso zokuphucula ezili-14 ziyaphunyezwa kwaye inkqubela kuzo ibonakalisa iinguqu ezinkulu, ukuvula umsantsa wempembelelo.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa tshekatsheko mme ya amogela dikatlenegiso e lebile go oketsa ditlamorago go tswa kwa tiragatsong ya Lephata la Loago la Lenaanekatoloso la Ditiro tsa Setšhaba (EPWP-SS).Lenaane leno le na le seabe sa botlhoka sa tshireletso ya loago mo bagolong ba ba itekanetseng mme ba sa dire, ka go ba gogela mo tirong e e tlhagisang mme ba amogela tlhatswadiatla ya kgwedi le kgwedi ya palogare ya R1 Bontsi jwa manaane a lephata la loago bo tlamela baagi ba ba mo matshosetsing le ba ba humanegileng ka ditirelo tse di kgethegileng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zovavanyo nezindululo ezamkelweyo ngenjongo yokwandisa impembelelo yokuphunyezwa kweCandelo lezeNtlalo leNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP-SS).

src: EPWP-SS e godile ka bonako magareng ga legato la ntlha le legato la bobedi, go tloga go manaane a le 5 go ya go a le 22 a a bakileng gore lephata le fitlhelele ditšhono tsa tiro di le 175 769 mo legatong la ntlha le ditšhono tsa tiro di le 866 246 mo legatong la bobedi, e leng go feta 750 000 e e neng e beilwe.
tgt: Le Nkqubo idlala indima ebalulekileyo kukhuseleko lwezentlalo lwabantu abadala abakwaziyo ukusebenza abangaphangeliyo, ngokubatsalela kumsebenzi onenkqubela baze bafumene ukuvuzwa kwenyanga okungumyinge we-R 1 517.

src: Dikatlenegiso di totile go tokafatsa tiragatso go fokotsa tlhaelo ya go tsaya ditshwetso, tiragatso (tuelo ya tlhatswadiatla) mmogo le tlamelo ka katiso, gammogo le kgokaganyo.
tgt: Uninzi lweenkqubo zecandelo lezentlalo zibonelela ngeenkonzo ezikhethekileyo kuluntu oluhlelelekileyo noluhluphekayo.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo mme ya tlhomamisa dikatlenegiso tsa sethalo le tiragatso ya tshekatsheko ya Kabelo ya Tlhabololo ya Manno a Metsesetoropo mmogo le Leano la teng la Tokafatso.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngokuphindaphindeneyo phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibini, ukususela kwiinkqubo ezintlanu ukuya kwezi ngama-22 nezikhokelele ekubeni eli candelo lifikelele kumathuba emisebenzi engama-175 769 kwisigaba sokuqala namathuba emisebenzi engama-866 246 kwisigaba sesibini, ngaphezulu kakhulu kuma-750 000 ebesizimisele kuwo.

src: Diphitlhelelo di tshegetsa go tswelela ka Kabelo ya Tlhabololo ya Manno a Metsesetoropo jaaka kabelo ya tshegetso ya manno a batho a leruri le a a nang le tekatekano a a tswelang mosola magae a a humanegileng le a letseno le le sa reng sepe.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zigxile ekuphuculeni ukuphunyezwa ukuze kunciphe ukungathathwa kakuhle kwezigqibo, ukuphunyezwa (iintlawulo nokuvuzwa) nokubonelelwa koqeqesho, kwakunye nokuququzelela.

src: Seno se botlhokwa mo go fitlheleleng diphitlhelelo tsa MTSF go tlamela ka ditšhono di le 1 495 milione tsa dintlo mo tikologong ya boleng ka 2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo yaza yazivuma izindululo zokuyilwa nokuphunyezwa kovavanyo lweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini neSicwangciso sokuPhuculwa kwaso.

src: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ya Tiragatso le Tshekatsheko ya Ditlamorago tsa Ditlamelo tsa Thekenoloji le Badiri tsa Manaane a Indaseteri, tsibogo ya botsamaisi mmogo le leano la tokafatso le le tlhagisitsweng ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zixhasa ukugcinwa kweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini njegesibonelelo soxabangelo nesiyinkxaso-mali yombono obanzi wezokuhlaliswa koluntu ozinzileyo nolinganayo ukwenzela ukuba kuxhamle abahluphekileyo namakhaya amkela imivuzo ephakathi.

src: Lenaane leno le itsisitswe ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri ka 1992 go maatlafatsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni mo saenseng, boenjiniri le thekenoloji.
tgt: Oku kuyanceda ekufikeleleni kummiselo ovela lwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiphakathi ukubonelela ngamathuba ezindlu azizigidi ezi-1 495 kwimeko yezokusingqongileyo yokuhlala okusemgangathweni ngowama-2019.

src: Le tshwaela mo go tlhameng ditiro ka go tlhagisa kelelo ya babatlisisi ba ba nang le bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo le batsamaisi ba thekenoloji mo indasetering le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa kgaisano jwa dikgwebo tse di nang le seabe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo engokuphunyezwa nokuVavanywa kweMpembelelo yezobuChwepheshe nemiCimbi yezaBasebenzi yeNkqubo yezoShishino, indlela abalawuli abayihlangabeza ngayo le ngxelo nesiCwangciso sokuphucula esifakwe liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Lenaane ke karolo ya boammaaruri, ya botlhokwa le e e bokgoni ya tshegetso ya boitlhamedi e e tlamelang ka boleng jo bo bonalang jwa madi go lebeletswe tlhabololo ya thekenoloji mmogo le tlhabololo ya badiri le bokgoni jo bo maleba jwa indaseteri.
tgt: Le Nkqubo yaveliswa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngowe-1992 ukomeleza uphuhliso lwezakhono kwezenzulu-lwazi, ezobunjineli nobuchwepheshe.

src: Gape le gaisana sentle le Manaane mangwe a boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Yenza igalelo ekudalweni kwemisebenzi ngokuvelisa igquba labaphandi-nzulu abanezakhono ezikudidi oluphezulu nabalawuli bezobuchwepheshe boshishino nangokuphucula ukukhuphisana kwemibutho yamashishini athatha inxaxheba.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Setlhophatiro sa Ditona se se neng se batlisisa magatwe a 'diphatlhatiro tsa borutabana tse di rekisiwang' a a amang mekgatlho ya barutabana le batlhankedi ba Mafapha a Diporofense a Thuto.
tgt: Le Nkqubo iyasebenza, ibalulekile kwaye iluphawu olusebenzayo kwinkxaso yokuvelisa izinto ezintsha ebonelela ngexabiso elivakalayo ngemali ngokophuhliso lwezobuchwepheshe nophuhliso lwemicimbi yezabasebenzi nezakhono ezihambelana noshishino.

src: Kabinete e tlhomamisitse dikatlenegiso tsa go samagana le diphitlhelelo ka tsela e e WEBTOKEN Pegelong ya sona ya makgaolakgang, Setlhophatiro sa Ditona se sekasekile seabe sa baamegi botlhe mo tsamaisong ya go tlhopha le go ngoka WEBTOKEN lemogile gape mathata a a bonalang mo tsamaisong ya ga jaana ya go thapa mo diphatlhatirong mo lephateng la thuto ya motheo se tlamela ka dikatlenegiso tsa go thusa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lephata la thuto ya motheo ka kakaretso go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di supilweng.
tgt: Kwakhona ikwathelekiseka kakuhle kunye nezinye iinkqubo zehlabathi.

src: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dikgwa wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 84 wa 1998).Tiragatso ya dipaakanyo e tla tokafatsa tsamaiso ya leruri ya dikgwa mme gape e rotloetse seabe sa ditlhopha tse di mo matshosetsing, tse di ikaegileng ka jalo ya dikgwa go itshedisa, mo Lekgotleng la Bogakolodi la Bosetšhaba la Dikgwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zeNgxelo yeQela loMphathiswa eliphanda ngezityholo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezithuba zootitshala’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, imibutho yootitshala namagosa wamaSebe ezeMfundo kuMaphondo athile.

src: Baeteledipele ba sedumedi le baeteledipele ba mekgatlho ya baagi ba tla tshwaragana le puso go rapelela go golagana go ya pele ga temokerasi, kopano ya setšhaba, kopano ya loago gammogo le Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 tse di atlegileng e bile di rena kagiso.
tgt: Ikwaphawule iingxaki ezibalulekileyo kwinkqubo yangoku yokuqesha kwisithuba esikhoyo kwicandelo lezemfundo esisiseko yaza yabonelela ngezindululo zokunceda iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko necandelo lezemfundo esisiseko ngokubanzi ukuba lingayisombulula njani le mingeni ichaziweyo.

src: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go nna le seabe mo lenaaneng la maphata mantsi le le akaretsang ditiragalo tse di farologaneng tse di akaretsang botsweretshipono, teatere, mmino, ditlhatlhelelo le dipuisano gammogo le segopotso sa bo10 sa Letlole la Aforika la Ngwaoboswa ya Lefatshe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho siHlomelo wezamaHlathi weSizwe ePalamente.

src: Kgwedi ya Aforika ke serala sa gore re golagane gape le go itlama gape ka Kopano ya maAforika le Tsosoloso ya Aforika go kopanya batho ba kontinente.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho wezamaHlathi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuphunyezwa kwezi zihlomelo kuza kuphucula ulawulo lwezamahlathi oluzinzileyo kukhuthaze nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabahlelelekileyo, abaxhomekeke kwezamahlathi ukuze baphila, bathathe inxaxheba kwiBhunga leeNgcebiso lezamaHlathi leSizwe.

src: Ka la bo 20 Motsheganong 2016, puso e tla etelela pele keteko ya bosetšhaba ya ngwagakgolo wa Yunibesithi ya Fort Hare kwa khamphaseng ya Alice kwa Kapabotlhaba.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa esihlalweni nokufungiswa kukaMongameli uYoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe wama-2016.

src: Go baakanyetsa keteko e kgolo, Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tlhamile Komiti ya Ditona (IMC) go rulaganya le go gokaganya keteko eno ya hisetori ya ngwagakgolo.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luphumayo luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza ubudlelwane bala mazwe mabini, uMzantsi Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Setheo seno sa thuto sa hisetori se dirile jaaka mosupatsela ka nako ya kgaratlho ya rona ya kgololesego mme gape se itsege jaaka "motswedi wa boeteledipele jwa Aforika" jaaka e le setheo se se tlhagisitseng balwelakgololesego ba tshwana le bagaka ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo le Govan Mbeki.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela uSuku loMthandazo leSizwe eliza kubanjelwa kumaBala ase-ABSA eDurban ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi wama-2016.

src: Ke yona fela yunibesithi ya Borwa jwa Aforika e e tlhagisitseng ditlhogo tsa mebuso di le tlhano: Nelson Mandela wa Aforika Borwa, Yusuf Yule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho le Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.
tgt: Iinkokheli zakwaLizwi kunye neenkokheli zemibutho yoluntu ziza kuzibandakanya norhulumente ekuthandazeleni ukuqhubeka komanyano lwentando yesininzi, umanyano lwesizwe, intlalo- ntle kwakunye noNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 oluza kuba noxolo futhi lube yimpumelelo.

src: Jaaka karolo ya meletlo ya ngwagakgolo wa Yunibesithi ya Fort Hare, Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe ba ba ithutileng koo mmogo le baagi go amogana tseo ba di gakologelwang ka Fort Hare mo letsholong la Anela Kgang ya Gago ba dirisa #MyFortHare.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngezicwangciso zeSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko zokusingatha iNyanga ye-Afrika kuCanzibe yowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono” njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yelizwekazi yokusekwa koMbutho weManyano ye-Afrika (i-OAU), ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) kunye nemisebenzi eyenzileyo.

src: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa kwa Foramong ya Lefatshe ya Ikonomi (WEF) ya bo26 ya Aforika kwa Rwanda magareng ga la bo 11 le la bo 13 Motsheganong 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kumphehlelela iNyanga ye-Afrika ngoSuku loMthandazo leSizwe ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi yowama-2016.Ngowama-2016 iNyanga ye-Afrika iza kugxila kumalinge wophuhliso lwabantu basetyhini nolutsha, ngeli xesha siza kube sibhiyozela unyaka wama-60 woMngcelele wooMama nonyaka wama-40 woVukelo loLutsha eSoweto.

src: Foramo e amogelwa ka moono wa: "Go golaganya Ditlamelo tsa Aforika ka Diphetogo tsa Dijitale".Puso ka Leano la yona la Dintlha tse Robongwe e tsweletsa diphetogo tsa dijitale mo nageng.
tgt: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule nkqubo iqulathe iindidi ngeendidi zemisitho nemibhiyozo equka eyobugcisa obubonwayo, izifundo ngedrama, umculo, izifundo neentetho eziqhelekileyo kwakunye ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 yeNgxowa-mali yamaFa eHlabathi ase-Afrika.

src: E atolosa legato la ntlha la maiteko a broadband e e tla golaganyang ditheo di feta 5 000 tsa puso mo makgotlatoropong a dikgaolo a le robedi mo pakeng ya dingwaga tse tharo.
tgt: Le Nyanga ye-Afrika isebenza njengeqonga lokuqhagamshelanisa ngokutsha nokuzibophelela kwethu ngokutsha kuko konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika neBuyambo yase-Afrika ngokudibanisa abantu belizwekazi basondelelane.

src: Go rebotswe matlole a bokana ka R740 milione go tshegetsa katoloso eno.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wama-2016 urhulumente uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe wokugqiba kweDyunivesithi iFort Hare iminyaka elikhulu yabakho kwiziko layo eliseDikeni eMpuma Koloni.

src: INDABA 2016 kwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre kwa Durban go tloga la bo 7 go fitlha la bo 9 Motsheganong 2016, ke serala sa Kopano ya maAforika se se tla tsweletsang ditlhagiswa tsa bojanala mo bareking ba boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umsitho omkhulu wokubhiyoza, uMongameli uJacob Zuma umisele iKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) ukuba yenze izicwangciso ize iququzelele lo mbhiyozo wenkulungwane uyimbali.

src: Go godisa ditlamorago tsa Bojanala mo Ikonoming ya Mawatle ke ntlha ya botlhokwa mo Leanong la Dintlha tse Robongwe, mme seno se ikaegile ka bokgoni jo bo iseng bo dirisiwe jwa mawatle a rona, a a ka tshwaelang mo kgolong ya ikonomi.
tgt: Eli ziko lemfundo liyimbali belisebenza njengenqaba yethemba ngexesha lomzabalazo wethu wenkululeko kwaye laziwa “njengeziko lokupheka iinkokeli ze-Afrika” libe liyidyunivesithi ekwakufundwa kuyo ziinkokheli ezazikumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo ezifana neengqanga oo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukhwe, Oliver Tambo noGovan Mbeki.

src: Mo segopotsong sa Letsatsi la Badiri ka la bo 1 Motsheganong 2016, Kabinete e boeletsa maitlamo a naga go sireletsa ditshwanelo tsa badiri ka melao ya rona e e nang le tswelelopele.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yenkulungwane iDyunivesithi iFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu ababefunda kule dyunivesithi noluntu jikelele ukuba babalisane ngeenkumbulo zabo ngedyunivesithi iFort Hare nephulo likaBalisa iBali Lakho ngokusebenzisa i- #MyFortHare.

src: Fa e sa le ka 1994, puso e ntse e tsweletsa ditshwanelo tsa badiri ka melao e tshwana le Molao wa Dikamano tsa Bodiri, Molao wa Dipeelo tsa Motheo tsa go Thapa, Molao wa Tekatekano ya go Thapa mmogo le wa Boitekanelo le Pabalesego mo Tirong.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwingqungquthela yama-26 yeQonga lezoQoqosho leHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika e-Rwanda phakathi komhla we-11 nowe-13 kuCanzibe yowama-2016.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo barutwaneng ba Mophato wa 12 go simolola go laisolola diforomo tsa go dira kopo gongwe go dira dikopo mo inthaneteng kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane jaaka karolo ya Letsholo la Dira kopa jaanong/ Kheta Career Guidance.
tgt: Eli qonga lisingathwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqhagamshelanisa iMithombo ye-Afrika ngeNguqu yezebuChwepheshe”.Urhulumente uqhubela phambili inguqu kwezobuchwepheshe yeli lizwe ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba.

src: Letsholo leno la ngwaga le ngwaga la Lefapha la Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, le tla tswelela bosetšhaba go fitlha ka Lwetse 2016 mme le thusa barutwana go dira boitlhophelo ka kitso fa ba dira dikopo tsa kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane.
tgt: Uza kusungula isigaba sokuqala sephulo lakhe lamaza osasazo aza kufaka uqhagamshelwano kumaziko karhulumente angaphezulu kwama-5 000 kwizithili zoomasipala ezisibhozo kwixesha leminyaka emithathu.

src: Barutwana ba rotloediwa go ikgolaganya le Tikwatikwe ya Ditirelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Ditiro (Career Development Services Centre) ka SMS gongwe “please call me” mo 072 204 5056 gongwe 086 999 0123, emeile EMAILTOKEN, mo Facebook kwa WEBTOKEN gongwe mo Twitter kwa WEBTOKEN Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.
tgt: INDABA YOWAMA-2016 ebanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kuCanzibe yowama-2016, liqonga lokuzingca ngako konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika eliza kukhuthaza iimveliso zokhenketho kubathengi behlabathi.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa baamegi botlhe ba ba maleba go tshwaela mo lekwalotlhomong le le sekasekilweng la Tumelano ya Maatlafatso ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho e e Atolositsweng ya Indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Meepo le Diminerale 2016 le le phasaladitsweng mo Kaseteng ya Puso.
tgt: Ukhenketho, njengenye yeentsika ezintandathu zohlumo lwezoqoqosho kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, lenze igalelo eliyimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-357 kwiSambuku seMveliso yeSizwe (i-GDP) ngowama-2014 laza laxhasa i-9% kwingqesho epheleleyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lekwalotlhomo le le sekasekilweng la Tumelano ya Meepo gape le gokaganya dipholisi le melao ya puso ya diphetogo go tokafatsa tsela ya go dira kgwebo, go tlhalosa dintlha tsa taolo, diponelopele mmogo le tsepamo.
tgt: IBhunga lezoHambo eHlabathini noKhenketho lithelekelela ukuba ukhenketho lenze igalelo elizibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-560 kwi-GDP yethu ngowama-2015 kwaye luza kuxhasa imisebenzi engaphezulu kwezigidi ezibini.

src: Gape le lepalepane le ditlamelo tsa Molao wa Maatlafatso ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho e e Atolositsweng, 2003 (Molao wa bo53 wa 2003) le Melawana ya Tiragatso e e Siameng (Code of Good Practice (Melawana ya DTI).
tgt: Ukukhulisa impembelelo yezoKhenketho kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle yintsika ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, ngokubangelwa ngamandla akhoyo kumalwandle wethu, nanokuba negalelo kuhlumo loqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore go amogelwa ga go tsewa go go tshitshintsweng ga SAB Miller ke AB InBev go sa ntse go sekwasekwa ke bothati jwa dikgaisano.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwaselwandle nokhenketho lubonelela ngamathuba angumangaliso ohlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e amogela tsamaiso e e dumelanweng ke Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi le AB InBev le bothati jwa dikgaisano mo dintlheng tse di farologaneng tsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 urhulumente uwaqhubele phambili amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho efana noMthetho woBudlelwane bezaBasebenzi, uMthetho weeMeko zoMsebenzi ezisiSiseko, uMthetho womakuLingwane eMsebenzini nezeMpilo noKhuseleko eMsebenzini.

src: Maitlamo a setlamo a tla dira jaaka kaedi ya ditlamo tse dingwe tse di mo seemong sa go kopana le go tsaya tse dingwe mo mererong ya dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqalise ukuprinta iifomu zokufaka izicelo okanye bafake izicelo kwi-intanethi kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo njengenxalenye yephulo lika-Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.

src: Seno se akaretsa maitlamo a setlamo se dumelaneng ka ona go dirisa R1 bilione mo dingwageng tse di tlang di le tlhano go tsweletsa bolemirui jo bo potlana le tlhabololo ya batlamedi ba selegae, dikgwebo tse dintšhwa, dithekenoloji tse di somarelang maatla le metsi mmogo le tlhabololo ya bašwa.
tgt: Eli phulo liqhutywa rhoqo ngonyaka liSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, liza kuqhutya esizweni jikelele kude kube yinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2016 kwaye linceda abafundi ekukhetheni ngokufanelekileyo xa befaka izicelo kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Maitlamo a ditiro, go akarediwa maitlamo a go tila go fokotsa badiri ka ntlha ya go kopana ga ditlamo le go tshola badiri mo seemong sa ga jana mo setlamong mo dingwageng tse tlhano tse di latelang, ke karolo ya tumelano magareng ga setlamo le puso go tshegetsa go tlhabololwa ga indaseteri, dikgwebopotlana mmogo le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane neZiko leNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwaMakhondo ngokuthumela i-SMS okanye u-“please call me” kua-072 204 5056 okanye 086 999 0123, i-imeyili: EMAILTOKEN, kwikhasi lika-Facebook kwa: WEBTOKEN okanye basebenzise i-Twitter kwa: WEBTOKEN Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Mo ntlheng e nngwe e e kwa thoko, Kabinete e lemoga go diragadiwa ga ditlamelo tsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgaisano tse di reng ke tlolomolao ya bosenyi gore bakaedi le botsamaisi ba dumelane go tsepamisa ditlhotlhwa, dithendara gongwe mebaraka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphazelekayo ukuba bahlomle kwidrafti ehlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwamaLungelo ngokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi (i-BBBEE) kuShishino lwezeMigodi neziMbiwa zaseMzantsi Afrika, lowama-2016 nolwapapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso.

src: Ditlamelo tseno ke karolo ya dikgato tsa go maatlafatsa ntwa kgatlhanong le digongwana tse di senyang ikonomi mme di bolaisa badirisi ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa WEBTOKEN ikuela mo dikgwebong tsa Aforika Borwa go gaisana go ikaegilwe ka ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa tlase, boitlhamedi, boleng jo bo tokafetseng jwa dithoto gongwe ditirelo tse di gaisang go badirisi go na le go dira seo ka go dumelana.
tgt: Le draftio ihlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ibandakanya imigaqo-nkqubo yenguqu karhulumente nemithetho ngakumbi.

src: Kabinete e lemogile ka moo lephata la dibanka le laolwang ka gona mo Aforika Borwa - le lefatshe ka bophara, le tlhokego ya gore Aforika Borwa a obamele seemo sa boditšhabatšhaba go tshwana le Basel III le melawana e e kgatlhanong le madi a a bonwang ka bonweenwee (Anti-money laundering regulations) ya Setheo sa Tiro sa Dikgato sa Ditšhelete (Financial Action Task Force (FATF)), tse di kileng tsa amogelwa ke Kabinete, mme di tshegediwa ke molao o o amogetsweng ke Puso.
tgt: Ikwahambelana namasolotya oMthetho wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi, wama-2003 (uMthetho onguNombo 53 wama-2003) kunye neKhowudi yokuSebenza kaKuhle (iiKhowudi zakwa-DTI).

src: Thulaganyo ya Twin Peaks e tla laola maitsholo a mebaraka mo lephateng la dibanka le ditšhelete.".
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukugunyaziswa kokuthengwa kweSAB Miller ngu-AB InBev kusaqwalaselwa ngamaqumrhu ezokhuphiswano.

src: Kabinete e amogela ditlamorago tsa Kopano ya Dikgakologo ya Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditšhelete le Ditlhopha tsa Dibanka tsa Lefatshe ya 2016 e e neng e tshwerwe ka moono wa "Dikgwetlho tsa Lefatshe, Ditharabololo tsa Lefatshe".
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela ekuvunyelwene ukuba mawuphathwe ngayo lo mba nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho ne-AB InBev umaqumrhu okhuphiswano kuluhlu lwemiba ehambelana neemfuno zoluntu.

src: Go tshitshintswe tsela e e dintlha tse tharo go tlhosetsa kgolo mo legatong la lefatshe, go rotloetsa dinaga go dirisa dipholisi go tsweletsa kgolo, go tewa diphetogo mo go tsa ditšhelete le dipopegotheo.
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe yile nkampani siza kusebenza njengesikhokelo, kwimiba ebalulekileyo kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkampani ezithenga okanye ezizimanya nezinye phantsi kweemeko ezikwafanayo.

src: Dinaga tse di nang le sebaka sa ditšhelete di rotloeditswe go dira go le gontsi go oketsa tlhokego fela, tiragatso ya diphetogo tsa dipopegotheo e nnile botlhokwa go botlhe.
tgt: Oku kuquka isibhambathiso ekuvunyelwene ngaso yile nkampani sokuchitha imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukukhuthaza amafama afuyela ukuziphilisa efuya ngomyinge omncinci nophuhliso lababoneleli-zinkonzo balapha ekhaya, amashishini amatsha asakhulayo, ezamandla nobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa kakuhle amanzi nophuhliso lolutsha.

src: Go bontsi, seno se akaretsa dipeeletso mo mafaratlhatlheng, boitlhamedi le go tokafatsa tikologo ya taolo, gareng ga tse dingwe.
tgt: Isibophelelo ngokwemisebenzi siquka ukuthintela ukudendwa ngenkani kwabasebenzi ngenxa yendibanisela yeenkampani nokugcina izinga lengqesho kule nkampani kule minyaka mihlanu ilandelayo, oko yinxalenye yesivumelwano sokuhlahla indlela phakathi kwale nkampani norhulumente ukuxhasa ukwanda kwemizi-mveliso, uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci nokudala imisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e gakolola botlhe ba ba nang le tshiamelo ya go nna batlhophi ba ba iseng ba ikwadise le go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona gore ba sa ntse ba ka dira jalo ka go etela Kantoro ya selegae ya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).
tgt: Komnye omba, iKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwamasolotya oMthetho-siHlomelo woKhuphiswano owenza ukuba kungabikho mthethweni ukuba abalawuli nabaphathi basebenzisane ukwenze iyelenqe lokunyusa amaxabiso, kwiziniki-maxabiso okanye kurhwebo.

src: Seno se a tlhokega go netefatsa gore leina la gago le teng mo lenaneng la batlhophi le le tla kgontshang batlhophi ba ba nang le tshiamelo go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya temokerasi ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2016.Kabinete e ikuela mo batlhophing botlhe ba ba nang le tshiamelo go netefatsa gore ba fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa go tlamela ka diaterese tsa bona kwa kantorong ya selegae ya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).
tgt: La masolotya ayinxalenye yamanyathelo okunyusa izinga lokulwa amaqela enza amayelenqe enzakalisa uqoqosho ngokuthi abize abathengi amaxabiso aphezulu.

src: Kabinete e akgola Transet, Bothati jwa Bosetšhaba jwa Botšhotšhisi, SABC le Mafapha a Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, Dikamano le Tirisano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba le Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo jaaka di supilwe ele "Bathapi ba ba Ngokelang go Gaisa" mo Aforika Borwa ke setlamo sa matshwaokgwebo a bathapi, UNIVERSUKabinete e akgola Tona ya Saense le Thekenoloji, Naledi Pandor, yo o amogetseng Order of Merit go tswa kwa Rephaboliking ya Bofederale ya Jeremane ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe mo tlhabololong ya saense mo lefatsheng.
tgt: Sicela onke amashishini aseMzantsi Afrika ukuba mawakhuphisane ngamaxabiso aphantsi, ngokuba nobuchule obuthe chatha, ukuphucuka komgangatho wezinto abonelela ngazo okanye ukunika abathengi inkonzo ekwizinga eliphezulu kunokwenza amayelenqe.

src: Sekgele se abetswe batho go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ka ntlha ya diphitlhelelo tsa bona mo maphateng a sepolotiki, loago le botlhale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba icandelo leebhanki lilawulwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu eMzantsi Afrika – nasehlabathini jikelele, kunye nemfuneko yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhambelane nemigangatho yehlabathi efana ne-Basel III nemithetho yeQela lezemiSebenzi yezeZimali (i-FATF) yokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, neyayamkelwe ngaphambili yiKhabhinethi, yaxhaswa yimithetho engundoqo eyayamkelwe ngurhulumente.

src: Kabinete e akgola Mokaedikakaretso wa Merero ya Tikologo, Nosipho Ngcaba ka ntlha ya go amogela Sekgele sa 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic go tswa kwa phasalatsong ya tsa tikologo, The Enviropaedia.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuGunyaziwe Ababini nayo iza kulawula indlela oluziphatha ngayo urhwebo kwicandelo leebhanki necandelo lezezimali ngokubanzi.”.

src: Kabinete e akgola motsweretshi Kemang Wa Lehulere ka go nna "Motsweretshi wa Ngwaga" wa 2017 ka ketleetso ya Deutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgxowa-mali yeMali yeHlabathi yowama-2016 neNdibano yaseNtlakohlaza yamaQela eeBhanki zeHlabathi eqhubeke phantsi komxholo othi “IMingeni yeHlabathi, iziSombululo zeHlabathi”.

src: Wa Lehulere, yo o lebelelang bomaleba jwa botsweretshi mo go Aforika Borwa wa morago ga Tlhaolele, o tla tlhagisa pontsho ya gagwe ya ntlha ya motho a le mongwe kwa Jeremane kwa Deutsche Bank KunstHalle kwa Berlin mo ngwageng o o tlang.
tgt: Kuphakanyiswe indlela embaxa yokuvuselelwa kohlumo kwinqanaba lehlabathi, kukhuthazwa amazwe ukuba asebenzise onke amandla okunyusa akwimigaqo-nkqubo yawo ukukhuthaza uhlumo, oko kuthetha olungokwemali, olungokwemali kaRhulumente nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo.

src: Sekgele seno se newa lefapha la puso, bothati, gongwe setheo se se dirileng maitlamo a a bonalang le tshwaelo mo go tsweletseng bojanala jo bo nang le maikarabelo.
tgt: Amazwe anesithuba ngokwemali nangokwemali kaRhulumente akhuthazwa ukuba enze ngakumbi ukuphucula imfuneko noxa kunjalo, ukuphunyezwa kokulungiswa kwezakhiwo kubaluleke kakhulu kunako konke okunye.

src: Kabinete e akgola rakolofo Branden Grace ka go gapa la ntlha PGA Tour kwa RBC Heritage kwa Hilton Head, Amerika.
tgt: Kuninzi oku kuquka utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo, ubuchule bokuvelisa izinto ezintsha nokuphucula ukusebenza kolawulo, phakathi kokunye.

src: Kabinete e utlwisitswe botlhoko ke loso la ga Bertie Lubner yo o nnileng le tshwaelo e e bonalang mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa jaaka moeteledipele wa kgwebo, moetleetsi le modulasetilo wa botshelo wa SA Jewish Board of Deputies.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke abo bangabavoti abaselungelweni abangekabhalisi baqinisekise nangeenkcukhacha zabo ukuba bangakwenza oko ngokutyelela ii-Ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC) ezikufutshane kubo.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa pelo kwa ditsaleng le balesika ba batswasetlhabelo ba le lesome (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle le Simphiwe Nhlapo) ba kotsi ya masetlapelo ya bese fa ba ne ba tswa kwa Raling ya Kgoeletso ya Manifesto a ANC kwa Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Oku kuyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ngokubakho kwegama lakho kuluhlu lwabavoti okuza kwenza ukuba abavoti abaselungelweni bakwazi ukusebenzisa ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngomhla we-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abavoti abaselungelweni ukuba baqinisekise ukuba banazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo zokunikezela ngeedilesi zabo kwi-ofisi yeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC).

src: Kabinete e rometse matshediso go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa ga Ngaka Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, Moitseanape wa ntlha wa montsho wa mo mererong ya kungwiso ya peo ya pelegi mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabakwa-Transnet, iGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso, iZiko lezoSasazo loMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) neSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, iSebe lezoBudlelwane baMazwe ngamazwe neNtsebenziswano, kunye neSebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko ngokuthi anikwe iwonga lokuba kudidi lokuba “Ngabona baQeshi banoMtsalane” eMzantsi Afrika yinkampani esebenza ngamagama abaqeshi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othe wafumana imbasa i-Order of Merit kwiFederation Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe kuphuhliso lwezenzululwazi ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Jaaka mosimolodi wa tliliniki ya kungwiso ya peo ya pelegi kwa Sepetlele sa Park Lane kwa Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani o thusitse maAforika Borwa a le mantsi go itshimololela malapa.
tgt: Eli wonga belinikezelwa kubantu behlabathi jikelele ngeempumelelo zabo kwinqanaba lezepolitiki, lezentlalo okanye kwelobungqondi.

src: Kabinete e rometse matshediso kwa go balelapa le ditsala tsa ga Dene Smuts, Tokololo ya Palamente ya maloba ya Democratic Alliance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMlawuli-Jikelele weSebe lezeNdalo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokufumana imbasa ebizwa i-Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award evela kwimagazini yezendalo, i-The Enviropeadia.

src: Kabinete e akgola tshwaelo ya gagwe e e matsetseleko mo go tlhamiweng ga temokerasi ya rona ya molaotheo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla igcisa uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba “Ligcisa loNyaka” lowama-2017 elixhaswa yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: Kabinete e ikamanya le Moporesitente Jacob Zuma mo go eleletseng Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela pholo ya ka bonako mme e ikuela gore go tlotlwe ba lelapa mo nakong eno.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ophonononga imisebenzi yobugcisa emva koCalucalulo eMzantsi Afrika, uza kwenza umboniso wakhe wokuqala eyedwa eGermanu kwiholo eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulo nyaka uzayo.

src: Winnie Mandela o tlotlwa thata ka ntlha ya seabe sa gagwe mo kgaratlhong ya rona ya kgololesego se se dirileng gore go fedisewe dipholisi tse di neng di gatelela batho mmogo le mo go tlisetseng Aforika Borwa temokerasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezoKhenketho ngokuphumelela ibhaso lokuba Yelona Nkonzo kaRhulumente inoMgaqo-nkqubo/Nkxaso eNgcono kwiMbasa yoKhenketho oluFanelekileyo e-Afrika lowama-2016.

src: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.
tgt: Eli wonga linikezelwa kwisebe lecandelo laseburhulumenteni, ugunyaziwe okanye iqumrhu elithe labonakalisa ukuzinikela okucacileyo negalelo lokuqhubela phambili ukhenketho.

src: Paul Steenkamp mo Lekgotleng la Bogakolodi la Bosetšhaba la Boitlhamedi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomdlali wegalufa uBranden Grace ngokuphumelela imbasa yakhe yokuqala,i-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage e-Hilton Head, e-U IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokushiywa kwethu nguBertie Lubner nothe wenza igalelo elincomekayo kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika njengenkokeli kwezoshishino, umthandi wabantu nowawongelwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo ubomi bakhe bonke we-SA Jewish Board of Deputies.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde jaaka Mokhuduthamaga wa Setheo sa Ditirelo tsa Botlhe le tsa Phitlhelelo ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kubahlobo nosapho lwamaxhoba alishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, uSesi Mtshali, uSana Sibeko, uMphikeleli Malindi, uGugulethu Sithole, uVusi Nkabinde, uDaphney Linda, uSicelo Kheswa, uSphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) engozi yebhasi emasikizi eyenzeke ngethuba ebebuya kwiNgqungquthela yoMqulu weziThembiso ye-ANC eBhayi.

src: Go thapiwa gape ga ga Moatefokate Rory Wayne Voller Jaaka Motlatsamokhomišinara wa khomišeneng ya Dithoto le Dithata tsa Ditlamo (CIPC).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano olunzulu kusapho nezihlobo zikaGqirha u-Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, nongowokuqala oNtsundu eMzantsi Afrika ukuba yingcali kwezokuchumisa.

src: Go atolosiwa ga konteraka ya ga Lungisa Fuzile jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) wa Lefapha la Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba .
tgt: Njengomseki wekliniki yokuchumisa kwiSibhedlele i-Park Lane eRhawutini, uNetshidzivhani uncede abemi baseMzantsi Afrika abaninzi ukuba baqalise iintsapho zabo.

src: Go atolosiwa ga konteraka ya ga Nosipho Ngcaba jaaka Mokaedikakaretso wa Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zikaDene Smuts, owayesakuba liLungu lePalamente lombutho iDemocratic Alliance.

src: N Mafu jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Botsamaisi jwa Maatlafatso le Baamegi mo Lefapheng la Bagale ba Ntwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilothulela umnqwazi igalelo lakhe elikhulu kuphuhliso lolawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi olumilisele kumgaqo-siseko.

src: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Manaane a Botlhokwa a Puso.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: Kabinete e lemogile pegelo ya Tona ya Ditšhelete e a e neileng Moporesitente malebana le tswelelopele mo Patlomaikutlong ya Puso mo lephateng la poraefete le bodiri malebana le ikonomi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo eyenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali kuMongameli, ngenkqubela yokufakana imilomo kukarhulumente naboshishino lecandelo labucala kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi ngoqoqosho.

src: Moporesitente o romile Tona go etelela pele dipuisano le balekane bano ba loago go tlhama togamaano le go tla ka dikgato tsa go godisa ikonomi le go somarela tekanyetso ya molato ya naga.
tgt: UMongameli ebegunyazise uMphathiswa ukuba akhokele ezi ndibano zokufakana imilomo nala mahlakani ezentlalo ukuba kuboniswane ngesicwangciso-qhinga kunye nokuveza amalinge okukhulisa uqoqosho nokugcina indawo ilizwe elibekwa kuyo ngokwezoqoqosho.

src: Kabinete e itumeletse gore tiro eno e lebitse kwa maitekong a a tsepameng a a tla tokafatsang selebo sa ikonomi ya naga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inovuyo lokuba lo msebenzi uphele ekuveliseni amanyathelo okuqala aluqilima aza kuphucula amathemba kumbono wezoqoqosho weli lizwe.

src: Moporesitente o itsisitse maiteko a le mmalwa a ditlapele ka Mosupologo, a a akaretsang: (1) letlole le le kopanetsweng ke lephata la poraefete le la setšhaba la Tshegetso ya Dikgwebopotlana, (2) go samagana le dikgoreletsi tsa go okediwa ga dipeeletso gore go akofisiwe kgolo e e akaretsang, (3) go beeletsa mmogo ga puso le lephata la poraefete mo mafaratlhatlheng go dirisiwa maitemogelo a Lenaane le le Ikemetseng la Tlhagiso ya Maatla le le atlegileng le (4) go maatlafatsa Dikgwebo tsa Puso go netefatsa gore di nnela le ditšhelete leruri le go maatlafatsa seabe sa tsona mo go tsamaiseng tlhabololo.
tgt: NgoMvulo uMongameli ubhengeze amaphulo aphambili aliqela, aquka: (1) ingxowa-mali edibeneyo yabezoshishino labucala norhulumente yeNkxaso yamaShishini amaNcinane, (2) ukuhlangabezana neengxaki eziphazamisa utyalo-mali olwandayo khona ukuze kukhawuleziswe uhlumo oluquka wonke umntu, (3) utyalo-mali oludibeneyo lukarhulumente nabezoshishino labucala kwiziseko ezingundoqo kusetyenziswa umzekelo weNkqubo yabaVelisi baMandla oMbane abaZimeleyo ebe yimpumelelo kunye (4) nokomeleza amaShishini kaRhulumente ukuqinisekisa uzinzo lwawo lwezezimali nokomeleza indima yawo ekuqhubemi uphuhliso.

src: Dikitsiso tseno ke sesupo sa se puso e ka se fitlhelelang fa balekane botlhe ba loago ba tla mmogo go direla go fitlhelela phitlhelelo e le nngwe.2 Kabinete e sa ntse e dumela gore tsolotanyo e e bogale ya matlotlo ya puso, kokoanyo ya hisetori ya R1 triilione ke Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa le ditsereganyo tse tlhano tse di itsisitsweng fa gautshwane tsa pakakhutshwane, tsotlhe fela di tshegetsa leano la Dintlha tse Robongwe gore go netefadiwe gore go fetolwa lewa mo mererong ya ikonomi.
tgt: Ezi zibhengezo zibubungqina bokuba yintoni enokwenziwa leli lizwe xa onke amahlakani ezentlalo edibene esebenzisana kwaye ejongise kwinjongo enye.2 IKhabhinethi ihleli iqinisekile ukuba uhlengahlengiso olumandla lwezoqoqosho, ukuqokelela kweNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) imali efikele kwitriliyoni yeerandi okokuqala ezimbalini kwakunye nokubhengezwa kwakutsha nje kwamanyathelo okungenelela amahlanu exesha elifutshane, zonke nje zongeza kwisicwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ngokwenzeka kwenguqu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Koketsego ya kokoanyo ya lekgetho ke SARS e tla kgontsha Puso go tlamela ka ditirelo tse di tla tokafatsang boleng jwa matshelo a baagi botlhe ba yona.3 Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya setheo sa tekanyetso sa, Ditirelo tsa Peeletso tsa Moody, e mo bekeng e e fetileng e tlhomamisitseng tekanyetso ya molato ya naga go nna dinoko tse pedi fa godingwaga ga tekanyetso e e kwa tlase ga e e lekanetseng dipeeletso.
tgt: Ukwanda kwerhafu eqokelelweyo ngabakwa-SARS kuza kongeza ukwenza ukuba uRhulumente anikezele iinkonzo eziza kuphucula umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: Ka go tlhomamisa tekanyetso, Moody e lemogile gore Aforika Borwa o mo tseleng ya diphetogo morago ga dingwaga tsa kgolo e e bokowa mme dikgato tse di bogale tsa tsolotanyo mo tekanyetsokabong ya 2016 di tla tsepamisa molato wa puso mo GDP mo ngwageng ono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe yi-arhente yokuhlela, iMoody’s Investor Services, ethe kwezi veki zimbini zidlulileyo yaphinda yaliqinisekisa inqanaba eli lizwe elibekwa kulo kwezoqoqosho engamanqanaba amabini ngaphezulu kwenqanaba elilelona liphantsi nelamnkelekileyo kubatyali-zimali.

src: Maphata otlhe a dumelane gore go tlhokega gore go maatlafadiwe maiteko a a tlhakanetsweng go tlhotlheletsa pusetso ya ikonomi.
tgt: Ekungqineni eli nqanaba, abakwaMoody’s baphawule okokuba uMzantsi Afrika uya uyiguqula imeko emva kweminyaka yohlumo olubuthathaka kwaye amanyathelo okuhlengahlengisa nokomeleza uqoqosho owama-2016 aza komeleza ityala likarhulumente kwiSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP) kulo nyaka.

src: Go beilwe ditsamaiso tse di tsepameng go fokotsa ditlamorago tse di sa siamang tsa kwelotlase ya ikonomi ya lefatshe mo ikonoming ya rona, le go baakanyetsa kgolo e e itekanetseng fa ikonomi e tokafala.
tgt: Onke amaqela ayangqinelana ukuba amalinge entsebenziswano adinga ukomelezwa ukunika amandla ekuphucukeni koqoqosho.

src: Ditekanyetsokabo gape di bontsha gore puso, badiri le kgwebo ba dira mmogo, go feta mo dinakong tsotlhe, go bona ditsela tsa go tsosolosa kgolo le go agela botlhe botshelo jo bo botoka.
tgt: Sikwaqaphela ukuba umsebenzi woMphathiswa wezeMali kunye namahlakani ezentlalo ukwaquka umsebenzi oluthotho wohlolo lwemali ilizwe elinayo oza kuchonga uhlaziyo olunokwenziwa nongenelelo lokugcina urhwebo olomeleleyo lwemali eyinkunzi yaseMzantsi Afrika nomlinganiselo wohlolo lwemali yotyalo-mali.4 UMongameli uyazibulela iiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngabaPhathiswa ngokwahlukeneyo nezithi zihlangabezane neemfuno zabo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Seno se akaretsa go diragadiwa ga Leano la Dintlha tse Robongwe, le le itsisitsweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Puo ya gagwe ya Seemo sa Setšhaba ya 2015 gammogo le Operation Phakisa, e e diretsweng go akofisa go diragadiwa ga ditharabololo mo mefameng ya botlhokwa ya tlhabololo.
tgt: Iingxelo zenkqubela nezicwangciso eziphuma kwezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zibonakalisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usisizwe esisebenzayo, apho urhulumente akhokelayo khona, ekwakheni ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Manaane ano a samagana le dintlha tsa botlhokwa go tswa mo Leanong la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo , go tshwana le go fokotsa lehuma le botlhokatiro.5 Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa gape gore go samaganwe le seemo sa botlhokatiro sa naga ka go diragadiwa ga Leano la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo (NDP) la naga ka tsereganyo ya ikonomi ya Leano la Dintlha tse Robongwe le maikaelelo a lona e leng go tlhosetsa kgolo le go susumetsa ditiro mo maphateng a botlhokwa a ikonomi ya rona.
tgt: Kumiselwe amanyathelo aluqilima ukunciphisa impembelelo embi yokudodobala koqoqosho ehlabathini jikelele kuqoqosho lweli lizwe, nokulungiselela uhlumo lwezoqoqoqsho oludlamkileyo xa uqoqosho seluguquke lwathembisa.

src: Tirisanommogo le lephata la poraefete e botlhokwa gore go nne le dipoelo tsa katlego.
tgt: Sikwasebenza ngamandla ukususa imiqobo yalapha ekhaya kwezohlumo.

src: Puso e dirisa maiteko otlhe a a gona go akarediwa le Leano la yona la Dikgato tsa Pholisi ya Indaseteri (IPAP) go tlhama maphata a mangwe a a monyelang badiri le ditirelo go samagana le botlhokatiro jo gape bo amiwang ke seemo se se boima sa ikonomi mo lefatsheng le mo gae.
tgt: Ezi voti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zikwabonakalisa ukuba urhulumente, imibutho yabasebenzi nabezoshishino basebenzisana, kakhulu kunangaphambili, ukufumanisa ngeendlela zokuvuselela uhlumo nokwakha ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Tona ya Kgwebisano le Indaseteri, Rob Davies o tlhomile poeletso ya borobedi ya ngwaga le ngwaga ya IPAP 2016/17 go ya go 2018-19 ka la bo 9 Motsheganong 2016 kwa bodirelong jo bo gakolosang tshipi e e leng ya bantsho 100% kwa Gauteng.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa ngamandla kwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, esathi sabhengezwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowama-2015 kwakunye nephulo i-Operation Phakisa, elamiselwa ukukhawulezisa ukufezekiswa kwezisombululo kwimimandla apho uphuhliso ludingeka ngamandla khona.

src: Puso e gatelela botlhokwa jwa go nna le tirisanommogo le ditlamo tsa madirelo a selegae a a boitlhamedi a seabe sa ona e seng fela mo tlhabololong ya mafarathatlha, dipalangwa le go rora dithoto, fela se ralala maphata a a farologaneng a a dirisang thekenoloji e e marara, a a siametseng thomelontle mme a dirisa badiri thata mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa yotlhe.
tgt: Ezi nkqubo zihlangabezana nemiba ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP), efana nokuncitshiswa kwendlala nentswela-ngqesho.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa kwakhona abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba iimeko yentswela-ngqesho kweli lizwe kuhlangatyezwana nayo ngokufezekiswa kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) seli lizwe, ngongenelelo lwezoqoqosho lwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba esenzelwe ukuvuselela uhlumo size sikhulise imisebenzi kumacandelo angundoqoqo kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Ditlamelo tse di gona mo setheong seno sa bašwa di tla tlamela bašwa ba ba tswang mo mafelong a a humanegileng ka ditšhono tsa go nna le seabe se se botoka le go tshwaela ka tsela e e siameng mo mafelong a bona mmogo le mo nageng.
tgt: Intsebenziswano yecandelo lezoshishino labucala ibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kufumaneke iziphumo ezihle.

src: Tikwatikwe ya Bokgoni e e nang le ditlamelo tsotlhe e e tsamaisiwang ke Kholetšhe ya Kapaborwa e tla tlamela ka katiso ya tsamaiso ya kgwebo, tiriso ya dikhomphiutara mmogo le tlhabololo ya bana ba bannye go bannileseabe ba le 200 ba Ditlhopha tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Tirelo ya Bašwa ba Metsemagae (NARYSEC) NARYSEC ke lenaane la pakatelele le le totileng fela bašwa ba metsemagae, le le ba ngokang mme le ba naya konteraka ya dingwaga tse pedi.
tgt: Urhulumente usebenzisa onke amaphulo akhoyo kuquka nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza koMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukudala iimveliso eziza kuthatha abasebenzi abongezelelekileyo namacandelo eenkonzo ukuhlangabezana nentswela-ngqesho ethe yaphinda yongezwa bubunzima beemeko zezoqoqosho zehlabathi jikelele nezalapha ekhaya.

src: Go ngokiwa le go kwadisiwa bašwa ba ba bogolo jo bo magareng ga dingwaga tse 18 le 25 mo bokgoning jo bo farologaneng jwa kitso ya tiori le ya go dira, gore ba kgone go tlhama ditiro tsa bona le ba bangwe mo mafelong a gaabo.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uRob Davies umisele owesibhozo umfuziselo wonyaka we-IPAP2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018-19 ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 kwinkampani yokunyibilikisa isinyithi negilasi enabanikazi abaNtsundu ngokupheleleyo eGauteng.

src: Setheo seno sa Bašwa ke porojeke ya Tekeletso le ya ntlha ya mofuta wa yona, mme e tla atolosediwa kw diporofenseng tse dingwe.7 Kabinete e amogela Kopano ya Kgaolo ya Aforika ya Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha (OGP) ya 2016 e e neng e tshwerwe fa gautshwane, e e neng e amogetswe ke Aforika Borwa ka moono wa "Puso e e seng Bofitlha go ya kwa Tlhabololong e e nnelang Leruri mo Aforika" go tloga ka la bo 5 go fitlha ka la bo 6 Motsheganong 2016.Kokoano eno e tla dikgwedi di le supa morago ga gore Aforika Borwa e nne Moeteledipele wa Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha.
tgt: Urhulumente ugxininisa ukubaluleka kokwakhiwa kwentsebenziswano emandla neenkampani zezoshishino zalapha ekhaya ezigqwesileyo nezisebenzisa ubuchule bale mihla ezingabandakanyeki nje kuphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, ezothutho nezolungiselelo kodwa zibandakanyeke kuthotho lwezinto zobuchwepheshe ezinzima, ezilungele ukuthunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle necandelo elifuna kakhulu abasebenzi loqoqosho laseMzantsi Afrika liphela.

src: Dintlhatheo tsa puso e e seng bofitlha di botlhokwa gore go fitlhelelwe diphitlhelelo tse di farolgoaneng tsa tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri, go golaganya go sa fitlhe sepe le taolo gore go tokafadiwe ba ba mo matshosetsing le ba ba humanegileng mo lefatsheng jaaka le ikadile.
tgt: Ngeli xesha uPhando olungabaSebenzi lweKota ebelwenziwe kwikota yokuqala yowama-2016 lubonakalise ukwanda kwintswela-ngqesho okufikelela kuma-26.7% ngokwekota nekota, ngowama-2016 izinga lemisebenzi linyuke ngama-204 000 ekuqesheni abantu xa lithelekiswa nekota yokuqala yowama-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukunikezelwa kweZiko loLutsha laseBhobhofolo eNtshona Koloni nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, elibonelela ulutsha ngoncedo lobuchule, apho lunokuzixhobisa.

src: Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha le Puso e e seng Bofitlha ke sekgontshi sa botlhokwa se se tla thusang baagi ba lefatshe go fitlhelela Lenaane la 2030 la Tlhabololo e e nnelang Leruri.
tgt: Eli Ziko lineendidi ngeendidi zoncedo lobuchule olubonelela ngophuhliso olugabalala lwabantu abatsha noluntu ngokubanzi.

src: Samiti eno ya Kgaolo e ne e le samiti e kgolo go gaisa ya Kgaolo ya Selekane sa Puso e e seng Bofitlha (OGP) e e kileng ya rulaganngwa ke OGP mme e na le dipoelo tse di bonalang go tswa mo kopanong nngwe le nngwe mo khonferenseng.
tgt: Olu ncedo lobuchule lukhoyo kweli ziko lolutsha luza kubonelela abantu abatsha abasuka kuluntu oluhluphekileyo ngamathuba okuthatha ngcono inxaxheba nokwenza igalelo elihle kuluntu lwalo nakwilizwe.

src: Go lepalepana le maitlamo a dipuso a selekane le taolo e e siameng, samiti e ngokile bannileseabe go tswa kwa Mekgatlhong e e farologaneng ya Baagi (CSO) go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara, e e tswang mo baaging go ralala maphata a a farologaneng e seng fela diCSO tse di tlwaelegileng tse di sa bolong go nna karolo ya selekane.8 Kabinete e lemoga go amogelwa ga kgolagano ya dipolante tse tharo tsa mabotlolo go dira polante e kgolo go gaisa ya kontinente, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.
tgt: IZiko lezaKhono elixhotyiswe ngokupheleleyo neliqhutywa yiKholeji yaseMzantsi Koloni iza kubonelela ngoqeqesho kulawulo lwezoshishino, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nophuhliso lwabantwana abazintsana ukuya kutsho kubathathi-nxaxheba abangama-200 beQela leNkonzo yoManyano lwamaShishini oLutsha lwaseMaphandleni leSizwe (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka.

src: Kabinete e amogela tumelano ya dipeelo tsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba tsa kgolagano magareng ga puso le maphata a kgolagano a Coca-Cola Beverages Africa tse di ka tshegetsang maiteko a rona a gore go nne le kgolo ya indaseteri mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: I-NARYSEC yinkqubo yexesha elide apho igxile, ikwagaya ulutsha lwasemaphandleni kuphela nenesivumelwano sexesha leminyaka emibini.

src: Tumelano e sireletsa seelo sa go thapiwa mo setlamong sebaka sa dingwaga tse tharo, e sireletsa badiri mo yuniting ya dipuisanong mo diphokotsong tsa badiri tse di amanang le kgolagano, e tshegetsa go dirisiwa ga ditlamo tsa selegae mo dithekong mme e dira maitlamo a go tlhabolola balemirui le batlamedi ba ditirelo ba ba sa bolong go tlhoka ditšhono mo setlamong.
tgt: Kugaywa ulutsha oluminyaka iphakathi kwe-18 nama-25 ubudala luze lubhaliselwe uqeqesho kwizakhono ezahlukahlukeneyo eziza kuluxhobisa ngokufanayo kulwazi ngeengcingane nangokuphathwayo ukudala imisebenzi okanye bona ngokwabo nabanye abantu badale imisebenzi kuluntu lwabo.

src: Go feta moo, go tlamilwe R400 milione go tlamela ka matlole a tlhabololo ya dikgwebo mo thulaganyong ya tlhagiso ya temothuo le R400 milione e nngwe ya peeletso e e okediwang go tlhabolola go phasaladiwa le bokgoni jwa mabentlele ka tlhabololo e e maleba ya bokgoni le katiso.
tgt: Eli Ziko loLutsha luyiprojekthi esaLingwayo kwaye iyeyokuqala elolu hlobo kwaye liza kudluliselwa kwamanye amaphondo.7 Khabhinethi iyayamkela iNtlanganiso yoMmandla we-Afrika yoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo yowama-2016 ebibanjwe phantsi komxholo othi “UbuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo boPhuhliso obuZinzileyo e-Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kuCanzibe wowama-2016.Le ndibano iza emva kweenyanga ezisixhenxe uMzantsi Afrika wathi waba nguSihlalo oKhokelayo woBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo.

src: Tumelano e bula sebaka sa ditsidifatsi tse e leng tsa gongwe tse di tlamelwang ke Coca-Cola kwa bagwebing ba bannye: go tla nna le sebaka sa setsidifatsi sa diperesente tse lesome go dirisiwa ke ditlhagiswa tsa batlhagisi ba bangwe ba bannye mo mabentleleng a a nang fela le ditsidifatsi tse di tlametsweng ke Coca-Cola.
tgt: Imigomo yoburhulumente obuvulelekileyo ibaluleke kakhulu ekuphumezeni uludwe olubanzi lweenjongo eziphambili zophuhliso oluzinzileyo, ukuqhagamshelanisa okuvulekileyo kulawulo loorhulumente ukwenzela ukuphuculwa kwabahlelelekileyo nabahluphekileyo ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Seno se bulela ba bantšhwa le batlhagisi ba bannye ba mabotlolo, mme se thusa go tila ditiragatso tsa kgwebo tse di lekanyetsang tse di dirang gore dikgwebo tse dipotlana le tse di magareng di seke tsa tsena mo mebarakeng.
tgt: UBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo nobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo bukwangundoqo ekuncedeni uluntu lwehlabathi ukuba lukwazi ukuphumeza i-Ajenda yowama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo.

src: Go tlaleletsa foo, peeletso ya setlamo ya pakatelele mo tlhabololong ya naga ya ikonomi le loago e tla tokafadiwa ka go tlhomiwa ga ntlokgolo ya setheo se se golaganeng mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yoMmandla ibe yeyona inkulu kwiingqungquthela zoMmandla zoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo (i-OGP) kwezakhe zaququzelelwa yi-OGP eneziphumo ezincomeka kakhulu kwisigaba ngasinye yade yayokuphela le ngqungquthela.

src: Tumelano e latela tumelano e e tshwanang le eo ya fa gautshwane magareng ga Annhauser Beush InBev e e amanang le go rekwa ga SAB Miller.
tgt: Ukugcina isibophelelo sikarhulumente kubudlelwane nolawulo lukarhulumente olungcono, le ngqungquthela ibe nomtsalane kubathathi-nxaxheba abavela kwiMibutho yoLuntu (i-CSO) evela ehlabathini jikelele emilisele kuluntu olukumacandelo awohlukahlukeneyo olungaphandle kwe-CSO yesiqhelo esoloko iyinxalenye yobu budlelwane.

src: Tota, mo go gateleleng ntlha ya go thapa, go dirisa dikgwebo tsa selegae mmogo le tlhabololo ya dikgwebopotlana, ditumelano tseno di supa botlhokwa jwa go lekalekanya dikgolagano tsa ditheo le dintlha tsa kgatlhego ya setšhaba mme gape di beela ditlamo tse di akanyang ka dikgolagano tse di tshwanang le tseo seemo.9 Kabinete e lemogile go tlhomiwa ga polante ya R350 milione ya bottle-to-bottle ya Mpact Polymers ka tirisanommogo le Coca-Cola.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukwamkelwa kwesivumelwano sokudibanisa amaziko amathathu kutha ebhotileni ukwenza elona ziko lokutha ebhotileni lakwaCoca- Cola Beverages Africa lakhe lasikhulu kweli lizwekazi.
