tgt: Kulo meko, iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo akhawulezileyo athe athathwa liCandelo lokuLwa ukuRhweba ngaBantu looKhetshe kunye neQela lokuSabela ngobuChule le-SAPS nelithe labambaumfundisi ozinze eDurban ngesimangalo sokurhweba ngabantu eBhayi.

src: Se se mmaya mo maemong a go gwetlha dijana tsa lefatshe kwa mekgatlong e mene ya mabole e megolo: Lekgotla la Mabole la Lefatshe, Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Mabole, Feterasi ya Boditšhaba ya Mabole le Mokgatlo wa Mabole wa Lefatshe (WBO).
tgt: Kungumsebenzi noxanduva labo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisane nabasemagunyeni ukukhusela abantu beli basetyhini nabantwana kubabulali kwaye siqinisekise ukuba siyayenza eyethu indima ukwenza iindawo ezihlala abantu beli zikhuselekile.

src: Kabinete mmogo le Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e romela matshediso go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa mokatisi le motlhatlheledi yo o manontlhotlho wa mabole, Nick Durandt, yo a neng a itsege ka bokgoni jwa gagwe jwa go tlhagisa bommampodi ba mabole le go ntsha basimanyana mo mebileng mme a ba fetole bommampodi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noZolani Tete ngokuphumelela intshinga yodidi lwebhantamu yoMbutho wezamaNqindi weHlabathi (i-WBO).

src: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 10 Motsheganong 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibidibene ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-10 kuCanzibe wama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Foramo ya Ikonomi ya Lefatshe (WEF) e e ka ga Aforika.
tgt: IQonga lezoQoqosho lweHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go tshwara kopano go go atlegileng ga WEF e e ka ga Aforika ya bo 27 eo mo go yona Moporesitente Jacob Zuma a neng a eteletse pele Setlhopha sa Barongwa sa Aforika Borwa, Ditlhogo tsa Dinaga le tsa Dipuso go tswa mo kontinenteng ya Aforika, baeteledipele ba lefatshe mo diintasetering le mo dikhomeseng mmogo le baeteledipele ba setšhaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kwentlanganiso yama-27 yeQonga leHlabathi lezoQoqosho (i-WEF) e-Afrika apho uMongameli uJacob Zuma ebekhokela iQhiza loMzantsi Afrika, iiNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente zelizwekazi lase-Afrika, iinkokeli zezorhwebo noshishino eziphuma mbombo zone zehlabathi kunye neenkokeli zemibutho yoluntu.

src: Khonferense eno e ne e tshwerwe ka moono o o reng: “Go fitlhelela kgolo e e akaretsang botlhe: boeteledipele bo bo tsibogelang e bile bo le maikarabelo”.
tgt: Le nkomfa ibibanjelwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuphumeza uHlumo oluXhanyulwa Nguye Wonke: Iinkokeli eziPhendulayo nezineNkathalo”.

src: Kopano eno ya bo 27 ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e tota e netefaletsa lefatshe gore e santse e le karolo ya mafelo a go ka beelediwang mo go ona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.
tgt: Le seshoni yama-27 ye-WEF e-Afrika iqinisekise ihlabathi ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uselelinye lamazwe anomtsalane kubatyali-zimali kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika.

src: Barulaganyi ba kopano eno ba netefaleditse gore baeteledipele ba feta ba le 1 000 ba tsenela kopano eno, e leng palo e ntsi go fetisisa fa a bapisiwa le ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e e fetileng.
tgt: Abaququzeleli bale ndibano baqinisekisile ukuba abathunywa abangaphezulu kwi-1 000 bebezimase lo msitho, inani elo ekungazange kufikelelwe kulo kwi-WEF e-Afrika ngaphambili.

src: Mowa o o tebileng wa tirisanommogo magareng ga puso le bagwebi mo kopanong ya WEF e e ka ga Aforika e ne e le o o itumedisang.
tgt: Umoya omhle wentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente nabezoshishino ngethuba le-WEF e-Afrika uncomeka kakhulu.

src: Dipuisano tse di tseneletseng tseno di neile Aforika Borwa tšhono ya go bontsha kgatelopele eo e e dirileng mo go kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang botlhe le go bontsha gore Aforika Borwa e buletse dikgwebo.
tgt: Ezi ngxoxo bezityebile kwaye zishushu zinike uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokubonisa inkqubela oyenzileyo ukufikelela kuhlumo loqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke nokubonisa ukuba amasango oMzantsi Afrika avuliwe ukuba abatyali-zimali beze kutyala imali.

src: Aforika Borwa e santse e semeletse mo go tsenyeng tirisong Leano la yona la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mo go fokotseng maemo a khumanego, tlhokotekatekano le botlhokatiro.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika usesekhondweni lokuzalisekisa isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) ukuze kuliwe intlupheko, ukungalinani nentswela-ngqesho.

src: Go thankgolowa ga diterene tse dintšhwa tsa Setheo sa Banamedi ba Diterene sa Aforika Borwa (PRASA) mmogo le ditirelo tsa diterene, ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka la bo 9 Motsheganong 2017 kwa seteišeneng sa kwa Pretoria.
tgt: Ezothutho.1 Ukuphehlelelwa koololiwe abatsha bakwa-PRASA (i-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yooLoliwe Abakhwelwa ngaBantu) kunye nenkonzo yololiwe, nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 eSitishini sasePitoli kuyinxalenye yephulo likarhulumente eliqhubekayo lokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho izithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezifikelelekayo nezithembakeleyo, ngolo hlobo kuphuculwe iziseko zeli lizwe ezingundoqo zezoqoqosho.

src: Diterene tse dintšhwa tsa motseseteropo (tseo di itsegeng ka gore ke diterene tsa batho) ke karolo ya diterene tse dintšhwa tse di tla thankgololwang ke puso mo dingwageng tse di tlang di le 10 go ya go di le 15 jaaka karolo ya Lenaane la Dintšhwafatso la PRASKe tshimologo ya tirisanommogo ya PRASA le Alstom ka tumelano e e saenilweng magareng ga Fora le Brazil.
tgt: Aba loliwe bakwa-Metrorail batsha bayinxalenye yoololiwe abatsha abaza kuthengwa ngurhulumente kule minyaka izayo ili-10 ukuya kweli-15 njengenxalenye yeNkqubo ka-PRASA yokuPhucula ooLoliwe.

src: Diterene tse dintle tse dintšhwa tsa motseseteropo (tseo di itsegeng ka gore ke diterene tsa batho) di abelana ka maemo a a farologaneng a boiketlo le ditirelo, mme adi tla fetola megopolo ya banamedi ka go tsaya maeto.
tgt: Eli phulo liza kudala amawaka emisebenzi esigxina nezithuba zemisebenzi, umzi-mveliso wokwenziwa koololiwe abatsha uyakhiwa eNigel e-Ekurhuleni.

src: Ke karolo ya puso ya go tlhabolola ikonomi ka go aga mafaratlhatlha a magologadi mme e bile di bonolo go ka dirisiwa le ke batho ba ba nang le bogole.
tgt: Oku kukuqala kokusebenza kwesiVumelwano esityikitywe nelizwe lase-France nelaseBrazil phakathi ko-PRASA no-Alstom.3 Aba loliwe batsha bale mihla bakwa-Metrorail (baBantu) abekho abafana nabo ngokuhamba kamnandi nangokubamba ixesha, futhi abakhweli bazo baza kukonwabela kakhulu ukuhamba ngazo.

src: Kabinete e dirile boikuelo mo maAforika Borweng go ikgantsha le go tlhokomela diterene tseno tse dintšhwa kgatlhanong le ditiragalo dipe tsa tshenyo ya thoto ya puso.
tgt: Eli phulo liyinxalenye yophuhliso lwezoqoqosho oluqhutywa ngurhulumente ngokusebenzisa iphulo elikhulu lophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kwaye aba loliwe balungiselelwe nokuba bakwazi ukukhwelisa abantu abakhubazekileyo.4 IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazingce ngalo msebenzi mngaka futhi babakhusele aba loliwe batsha ukuba bangonakaliswa.

src: Kabinete e amogela ditsereganyo tse di atlegileng tsa Moporesitente Zuma kwa Vuwani, Limpopo.
tgt: Izidube-dube zaSevuwani.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukungenelela kukaMongameli Zuma eVuwani eLimpopo.

src: Moporesitente o ne a kopana le Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana wa Vha-Venda, mmogo le bannaleseabe ba bangwe mo baaging gore go bonwe fa go ka se fitlhelelwe ditharabololo tseo ba ka di utlwanelang mo dingongoregong tseo di tlhagisitsweng.
tgt: UMongameli uye wadibana neThole leSilo, lisiSilo Ngokwalo, uKumkani uToni Mphephu Ramabulana weSizwe samaVenda, kwakunye namanye amahlakani amele uluntu ngelinge lokuzama ukuba kukhangelwe isisombululo esiza kwanelisa wonke umntu kwimiba ibiphakanyisiwe.2 Kule ntlanganiso siye samkelwa isiphakamiso soMntwan’egazi sokuba uMasipala wesiThili saseVhembe kufuneka ibe nguye obonelela abantu baseVuwani ngeenkonzo ngeli thuba ingxaki yomba wokucandwa kwemida isaxoxwayo.

src: Mo kopanong go utlwanetswe gore tshitshinyo ya Kgosi ya gore Masepala wa Kgaolo wa Vhembe o tshwanetse go tlamela ka ditirelo baagi ba Vuwani fa go santse go sekwasekwa ditharabololo tse di tla nnelang ruri tse di mabapi le dintlha tsa go kgaoganngwa ga mebasepala.
tgt: Esi siphakamiso sihambelana nemithetho elandelwayo xa kulawulwa oomasipala.3 Kuye kwagqitywa nokuba amasebe afanelekileyo kazwelonke nawamaphondo kufuneka anike inkxaso kulo masipala wesithili ukuze akwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi wongezelelweyo mtsha.

src: Tharabololo e e tshitshintsweng eno e tsamaelana le molao o o leng teng ga jaana o o laolang mebasepala.
tgt: Noxa kunjalo, le ntlanganiso iye yagxininisa ukuba esi sigqibo asithethi ukuba umasipala omtsha (i-LIM 345) uyapheliswa.

src: Go ne gape ga swetswa ka gore mafapha a a maleba a puso ya bosetšhaba le a puso ya porofense a tshwanetse go tshegetsa masepala ono wa kgaolo mo maikarabelong ano a o sa tswang go a rwala ga jaana.
tgt: Esi sigqibo siyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuzibophelela ekuzameni ukufumana isisombululo esiza kwanezisa wonke umntu.4 Le ntlanganiso uMongameli ebeyibambe nabo bonke abachaphazelekayo ekhokelele ekubeni izikolo namashishini abuyele kwimeko yesiqhelo.

src: Dipuisano tsa Moporesitente le bannaleseabe botlhe di dirile gore dikolo le dikgwebo di boele di dire jaaka gale.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawabulela amahlakani ngokunyanzelisa ukuba izivumelwano ebeziphakanyiswe yiKumkani zifezekiswe.

src: Kabinete e akgola bannaleseabe mo go gateleleng gore go tsenngwetirisong ditumelano tse di utlwanetsweng tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Kgosi.
tgt: UMongameli uzimisele ukuphinda abuyele kubantu baseVuwani aye kubonisana nabo.

src: Moporesitente o ikanne gore o tla boa go tla go buisana le baagi ba Vuwani mme letlha leo le santse le tla utlwanelwa le Kgosi Toni Mphephu Ramabulana mmogo le bannaleseabe botlhe ba lefelo leo.
tgt: Umhla aza kubuyela ngawo kuza kuboniswana ngawo noMhlekazi oBekekileyo uKumkani uToni Mphephu Ramabulana kunye nawo onke amahlakani achaphazelekayo akulaa mmandla.5 IKhabhinethi icela abazali noluntu ukuba bawaxhase amalinge esebe okungenelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba bonke abafundi babuyela esikolweni bafunde iincwadi zabo nokuzama ukuleqa umsebenzi abasemva kuwo bencediswa ngamanyathelo okungenelela aqhutywayo kuzo zonke izikolo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo batsading le mo baaging gore ba tshegetse ditsereganyo tsa lefapha go netefatsa gore bana ba boela sekolong mme ba ithuta le go gatela pele ka tseo ba saletseng morago ka tsona ka matsholo ao a diriwang kwa dikolong tsotlhe.
tgt: Uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela.1 IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba lwahlukane nobundlobongela, ukugrogrisa nokutyhuthula iivenkile xa bevakalisa izikhalazo zabo.

src: Ditiragalo tsa tirisodikgoka le dikgato tsa bogodu jwa dithoto le tsa go senya dithoto tsa bagwebi tseo di ntseng di tsweletse malobanyana fa kwa Coligny, Eldorado Park, le Ennerdale di nyefolwa ka bogale ke Kabinete.
tgt: Ubundlobongela nokutyhuthula iivenkile kunye nokutshabalalisa izakhiwo neempahla zamashishini okwenzeke kutsha nje eColigny, e-Eldorado Park nase-Ennerdale kugxekwa kabukhali yiKhabhinethi.2 IKhabhinethi icela bonke abantu ukuba bavaklise izikhalazo zabo ngendlela eyakhayo, akunyanzelekanga ukuba bade bonakalisa iimpahla zoluntu okanye banyhashe amalungelo abanye abantu.3 UMongameli wenza isimemezelo ngethuba leNtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) yowama-2015 sokuba iNtlanganiselo yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho kunye noKhuseleko (i-JCPS) izilwe kangangoko izaganeko zoqhankqalazo ezinobundlobongela nezonakalisa iimpahla zoluntu.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo baaging go tlhagisa matshwenyego a bona ka tsela eo e batlang ditharabololo go sena tlhokego ya gore go senngwe dithoto tsa puso kgotsa go gatakaka ditshwanelo tsa baagi ba babangwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela kwakhona ikhwelo eyalihlabayo lokuba umthetho nawo awuzikuhleka kwabo nabo baphula umthetho.4 IKhabhinethi icela onke amahlakani ukuba angqubanise iintloko ngeenjongo zokusombulula imiba ekungabonwa ngasonye ngayo e-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park naseColigny.

src: Mo nakong ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ya Tlhakole 2015, Moporesitente Zuma o ne a dira boikuelo jwa gore Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelobosenyi le Tshireletsego (JCPS) se samagane ka tshwanelo le ditshupetso tse di renang dikgoka e bile di na le tshenyo ya dithoto.
tgt: Umthetho-sihlomelo oyilwayo weziko lolwaphulo-mthetho kwezezimali (i-FICA)5.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutyikitywa koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weZiko loLwaphulo-mthetho kwezeziMali (i-FICA) nguMongameli Zuma ukuba ube ngumthetho.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa ntlha eno gore bao ba tshelang molao ba tla kopana le dinta di fuduga.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe alwa unaniselwano ngemali olungekho mthethweni, nawo uza kuzayamanisa namanyathelo ehlabathi okungenelela afuna ukulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali kunye nokuncediswa ngemali kwamaphulo obunqolobi.2 Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuba negalelo ekwenzeni inkqubo yezezimali eMzantsi afrika ukuba ihlonitshwe futhi yenze izinto elubala, futhi oko kuza kwenza ukuba kube nzima kwabo baphula umthetho bayinxalenye yabo bangahlawuli zirhafu, bathubelezisa imali futhi bananiselana ngemali ngokungekho mthethweni ngeenjongo zokufihla imali kusetyenziswa ubuxhaka-xhaka neenkqubo zezimali zoMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo bannaleseabeng botlhe gore ba buisanele dintlha tseo ba lebile gore ba di rarabolole ka bonako kwa Ennerdale, Eldorado Park le kwa Coligny.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ungomnye weminye imithetho esinayo njengelizwe lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho oluqhutywa zizifundiswa kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala.3 IKhabhinethi ixelelwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali ukuba iintlanganiso zokubonisana ziyaqhuba kwaye ziza kuqukunjelwa kungekudala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngenkqubo yokubhengezwa kwemithetho nemigaqo eza kuchaphazela uMthetho we-FICIzigqibo zekhabhinethi.1 UMphathiswa wezeMali unike iKhabhinethi amagqabantshintshi ngeentlanganiso zeNtwasahlobo zeNgxowa-mali yeHlabathi yeziMali (i-IMF) neBhanki yeHlabathi, namaPhulo okuTsala abaTyali-mali kunye neentlanganiso ze-WEFUye wanika neenkcukacha ngesiVumelwano se-G20 neziphakamiso ze-Afrika kunye neenkxalabo zabatyali-zimali kunye nee-arhente ezihlela amazwe ngokwesakhono sawo sokubhatala izikweliti.

src: Aforika Borwa, jaaka karolo ya lefatshe ka bophara eo e samaganeng le go lwantsha ditiragalo tse di seng mo molaong tsa matlole e tla samagana le ditsereganyo tsa boditšhabatšhaba tseo di lekang go lwantshana le dithulaganyo tse di sa lolamang tsa matlole le dithuso tsa madi a menolopuso.
tgt: Kubekho iingxoxo ezinzulu ngemeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi nolwengingqi nokuba kufuneka senze ntoni ukulungisa le ngxaki yokubekwa kwelona zinga lisezantsi ngokwesakhono sokukwazi ukuhlawula izikweliti.2 IKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukuba isazimisele nokuqhubeleka nemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali eyayicaciswe kwiNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lowama-2017, ukuqaliswa kwenguqu ukuze kuphuculwe ulawulo kumashishini karhulumente ukugcina umyinge wemali ebekelwe inkcitho nokuqinisekisa ukuba amatyala karhulumente awanyuki.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o tla nna gape le seabe mo go natlafatseng botlhokalehunela le mo seriting sa thulaganyo ya matlole ya Aforika Borwa le go ketefaletsa basenyi bao ba tlolang melao ya go duelang lekgetho, bao ba amegang mo dithulaganyong tse di sa lolamang tsa matlole le dithulaganyo tse di seng mo molaong tsa go tila go latela melao ya thulaganyo ya matlole ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Inkqubo karhulumente yokukhawulezisa ukuqaliswa kweenguqu kwiindlela uqoqosho olumi ngayo ukuze lukhule njengoko kutshiwo kwisiCwangciso esiManqaku aliThoba iseyiyo enokusetyenziswa ukusabela kweminye yemiba ephakanyiswe ngabatyali-mali.3 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo ebesanda ukukhutshwa yinkampani i-EY Consultancy emalunga noTyalo-mali lwangaPhandle oluza Ngqo e-Afrika.

src: Ke karolo ya didirisiwa tseo re nang le tsone mo nageng tsa go lwantsha bosenyi jwa matlole mo makaleng ka bobedi a poraefete le a puso.
tgt: Le ngxelo iwuchaza uMzantsi Afrika njengelinye lamazwe anoqoqosho olukhulu kwaye ubekwa kwindawo yesibini kuLuhlu lowama-2017 lwase-Afrika lokuba Nomtsalane.4 IKhabhinethi iye yaxelelwa nangohambo lwee-Arhente zokuHlela iSakhono sokuBhatala iziKweliti oluzayo oluza kweli ukuze zingqubanise iintloko nemibutho emininzi kunye nezikhulu zikarhulumente.

src: Kabinete e ne ya tsiboswa ke Tona ya Matlole gore dipuisano di tsweletse mme di tla konosediwa go ise go e kae gore kgato ya go phasalatsa melawana e tsee kgato e e tla amang FICDitshwetso tsa Kabinete.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyivumile iDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo sezoThutho emaPhandleni.

src: Tona ya Matlole o ne a tsopolela Kabinete ka kopano ya mo malobeng ya Setheo sa Matlole sa Boditšhabatšhaba (IMF)/kopano ya Dikgakologo ya Banka ya Lefatshe, Dipontsho tsa Dipeeletso mmogo le WEF e e ka ga Aforika.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sisabela kanye kwimiba ephambili koomasipala bezithili zasemaphandleni nakumaphondo anemimandla emininzi engamaphandle ngokusombulula umba wokungabikho kweziSeko ezinguNdoqo neeNkonzo ezifanelekileyo zezoThutho emaPhandleni into leyo ephazamisa uphuhliso lezoqoqosho.

src: O ne gape a tsopolela Kabinete ka ga Kopano ya G20 ka ditshitshinyo tsa Aforika tsa go rarabolola dingongorego tsa babeeletsi le Ditheo tsa Tshekatsheko Maemo a Ikonomi.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga kuza kuncedisa ekukhuliseni uqoqosho loomasipala nolwamaphondo ngokwenza izithuthi zikawonke-wonke zifikeleleke.

src: Go nnile le dipuisano tse di tseneletseng tse di mabapi le sebopego sa maemo a ikonomi ya mo tikologong le ya mo lefatsheng, maeo a a tikologo go tsopotswe tseo di tshwanetsweng ke go diriwa go busetsa morago tshwetso ya go folosiwa mo maemong a ikonomi.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba kube lula ebantwini ukusuka emaphandleni baye ezidolophini, ngeenjongo zokunceda imimandla yasemaphandleni ukuba ikwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho lwelizwe ngobubanzi.6 IKhabhinethi iwuvile uMgaqo-nkqubo oBanzi wezoThutho zaseManzini.

src: Kabinete e gateletse gore e santse e ikemiseditse go sala morago moano wa pholisi ya matlole o o tlhalositsweng mo Puong ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017 go tsenngwatirisong ga dipaakanyo tsa go tokafatsa puso mo Ditlamong tsa Puso (di-SOC) go se sutise maemo a a beilweng a go lekanyetsa tiriso ya madi mmogo le go netefatsa gore dikoloto tsa puso ga di tswe mo taolong.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonakalisa ukuzimisela kukarhulumente kuhlumo, uphuhliso kunye nokutshintsha icandelo lezothutho lwasemanzini loMzantsi Afrika, ukuze luxhase uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nolwezentlalo ngeli thuba lifaka igalelo kurhwebo lwehlabathi.

src: Lenaane la puso le le totileng go salamorago tshalelomorago e e ka ga go tsenya tirisong dipaakanyo tsa maemo a baeteledipele le ikaeletse go tlhotlhetsa kgolo ya ikonomi, jaaka e tlhalosiwa ka fa teng ga Leano la Dintlharobongwe, mme le santse le le matshwanedi go ka samagana le matshwenyego a mangwe a a tlhagisitsweng ke babeeletsi.
tgt: Oku kuhambelana nemiba ekhokeliswa phambili ngurhulumente ngokumayelana ne-Operation Phakisa ngokukhuliswa koQoqosho lwaseLwandle.

src: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo e e sa tswang go gololwa malobanyana ke ba feme ya EY Consultancy e e mabapi le Peeletso ya Dinaga tsa kwa Ntle e e Tobaneng le Aforika.
tgt: Futhi kukwahambelana neenjongo ezibanzi zokusebenzela ukukhulisa uqoqosho kunye nokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala imisebenzi, njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) kunye nesiCwangciso seSizwe seziSeko ezinguNdoqo.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga seziThuthi Ezingenzi Monakalo kwiNdalo ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuyo.

src: Pegelo eno e nopola Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo le lengwe le le nang le ikonomi e kgolo le gore e mo maemong a bobedi mo Tshupaneng ya Ngokelo ya Aforika ya 2017.
tgt: Icandelo lezothutho lidlala indima ebalulekileyo ekwenzeni ukuba urhwebo lwehlabathi luqhutywe ngeendlela engazikuthibaza uqoqosho, futhi yenze umonakalo kwezentlalo nakwindalo.

src: Kabinete gape e ne ya tlotlomadiwa ka maeto a a tla diragalang a go etelwa ke ditheo tsa ditshekatsheko tsa maemo a ikonomi a a leng ka ga go buisana le mekgatlho e le mmalwa mmogo le baeteledipele ba puso.
tgt: Icandelo lezothutho liyintsika yoqoqosho nentlalo eMzantsi Afrika kuba linceda abantu batsho bakwazi ukuya kwiindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo neempahla zithuthwe.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Sekwalwatlhomo sa Togamaano ya Tekolosešwa ya Dipalangwa tsa kwa Metseselegaeng.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, imisi ekhutshwa zizithuthi inegalelo elikhulu kwiigesi ezichaphazela iqondo lobushushu bomhlaba (i-GHG), zona izithuthi ezihamba ezindleleni zikhupha umsi omninzi.

src: Togamaano eno e tsibogela ditlapele tsa dimasepala tsa kgaolo ya metseselegae mmogo le diporofense, ka go samagana le tlamelo e e tlhaelang ya Mafaratlhatlha a Dipalangwa tsa Metseselegae e leng seo se thibelang tlhabololo ya ditiragalo tsa ikonomi ya loago.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siphakamisa amanyathelo okungenelela aza kunciphisa iigesi ezenza i-GHG ngokwemimiselo yophuhliso oluzinzileyo.8 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilungu loMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.

src: Go tsenngwatirisong ga togamaano eno go tla nna le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya tikologo le ya porofense ka go tokafatsa phitlhelelo ya dipalangwa tsa setšhaba.
tgt: Eli liphulo lokusebenzisana elikhokelwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika futhi ligxile ekuqambeni izisombululo ezifanelekileyo nokwabelana ngezixhobo zokusebenza ukuze kuliwe imingeni yezophuhliso eli lizwekazi elijamelene nayo.

src: Seno se tla oketsa kgolagano magareng ga mafelo a kwa metseselegae le a kwa metseseteropong, ka maitlhomo a go dira gore tikologo ya metseselegae e nne karolo ya ikonomi ya naga.
tgt: Eli liphulo likhokelisa phambiil iintlobo zokuxhakaxhaba bobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano kwi-Ajenda yezoPhuhliso yowama-2063 yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Pholisi e e Golaganeng ya Dipalangwa tsa kwa Mawatle.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kuzuza ngokwezoqoqosho kunye nangokwezopolitiko ngokuthatha inxaxheba kulo Mfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.

src: Yona e tlhalosa maitlhomo a puso mabapi le kgolo, tlhabololo le phetolothefosano ya lekala la Aforika Borwa la dipalangwa tsa kwa mawatle mo go tshegetseng tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya loago fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe e tsenya letsogo mo kgwebisanong ya boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Ngokulungelelanisa icandelo lezobuchwepheshe loMzantsi Afrika kunye nobunganga balo neenkqubo zophuhliso zoMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika, uMzantsi Afrika uz a kuncedisa kuhlumo lwamashishini eli lizwekazi.9 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa koMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weSebe leMfundo esisiSeko weNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV), iziFo ezoSulela ngokuLalana (ii-STI) kunye neSifo sePhepha (i-TB).Umgaqo-nkqubo wowe-1999 wawugxininisa kuzo zonke iindlela zokulumkela kunye neendlela zokuzikhusela ezisekelwe kunyango, ungawuseli so kakhulu umba wezinto zeendlela ubomi bethu esibuphila ngayo, iimeko zezentlalo kwakunye neendlela esiziphethe ngazo njengezinto ezibalulekileyo ezibangelala i-HIV.

src: Seno se tsamaisana le ditlapele tsa puso tseo di amanang le Operation Phakisa mo go godiseng Ikonomi ya Mawatle.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucebisa ukuba masiyitshintshe yonke indlela esiyibona ngayo i-HIV siyibone njengesifo ekufuneka silawulwe kusetyenziswa indlela esetyenziswa ukulawula iinkonzo zezempilo zoluntu, kunye nokukhokeliswa phambili kwengxaki ye-TB ezikolweni, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: Gape e tsamaisana le dipeelo tse di atolositsweng tseo maitlhomo a tsona e leng go rotloetsa kgolo ya ikonomi mmogo le go tshegetsa go tlhamiwa ga ditiro jaaka go tlhalositswe mo go NDP le mo go Leano la Mafaratlhatlha a Naga.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kusetyenziswa uquke abantu abaninzi uquke abafundi, ootitshala kunye namagosa kwizikolo zikarhulumente ngokunjalo nakwezizimeleyo.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go phasaladiwa ga Sekwalwatlhomo sa Togamaano ya Dipalangwa tse di sa Kgotlheleng Tikologo gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka ga sona.
tgt: Imithetho Eyilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalammente koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani yeziKhululo zeeNqwelo-moya wowama-2017, kunye noMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zezoLawulo lweeNqwelo-moya eMoyeni nobuChwepheshe bokuLawula iiNqwelo-moya eMoyeni.

src: Dipalangwa di na le seabe se segolo mo go kgontsheng gore go nne le kgwebisano mo lefatsheng ka bophara e e siametseng go ka somarela ikonomi, loago le tikologo.
tgt: Izilungiso kule Mithetho-sihlomelo zilungiselelwe ukunika umthetho osisigxina.

src: Dithulaganyo tsa dipalangwa ke karolo ya seikokotlelo sa ditiragalo tsa ikonomi ya loago ya Aforika Borwa ka go kgontsha gore batho le dithoto tse di rekisiwanng di kgone go kgabaganya melelwane.
tgt: Ezi zilungiso zinika nethuba lokuba kumiselwe iikomiti zokubhena, eziza kusetyenziselwa ukusombulula iimbambano.

src: Le fa go le jalo, semoko se se tswang mo dijanageng se na le seabe mo semokong sotlhe se se tlhodiwang ke naga (GHG), mo dipalangwa tsa mo tseleng e leng tsone tse di eteletseng pele ka semoko se sentsi.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kwenza intetho yokuvula i-Indaba yezoKhenketho yowama-2017 eza kube ibanjelwe kwiziko i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban phakathi komhla we-16 nowe-18 kuCanzibe wowama-2017.Le yingqungquthela yehlabathi eza kubonisa ngeemveliso zoMzantsi Afrika zecandelo lezokhenketho nelokuntenda.

src: Togamaano eno e senka go tlhagisa ditsela tse di ka fokotsa semoko sa GHG go ya ka melawanatheo ya tlhabololo ya leruri.
tgt: Le Indaba iza kukhuthaza futhi ixhase amaphulo aqhubayo okuzisa iinguqu kunye nophuhliso kwicandelo lezokhenketho loMzantsi Afrika ingakumbi ngokwendima edlalwa ngoosomashishini abasakhasayo kunye nabanikazi bamashishini amancinci.

src: Eno ke tirisanommogo e e etilweng pele ke Aforika mme e lebeletse go tlhagisa ditharabololo tse di matshwanedi le go abelana didirisiwa go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa tlhabololo tse di totileng kontinente.
tgt: Ngeli thuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kube usingathe le Indaba yezoKhenketho uza kuxhamla ngokuza kwenkitha yabathunywa abaza kutyelela eli lizwe lakuthi.2 UMphathiswa wezaMandla uNksz Mmamoloko Kubayi uza kukhokela iphulo leNyanga yaMandla kule nyanga phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukukhuthaza iintlobo zamandla ezahlukeneyo ezifikelelekayo nezizinzileyo ngeenjongo zokuxhasa ingunqu ezimandla zezentlalo nezoqoqosho’.Eli phulo liza kufundisa, lazise futhi linike namathuba okufakana imilomo noluntu malunga nemiba yokusebenzisa amandla ngobunono, ubukho bamandla aneleyo kunye nezinye iintlobo zamandla nokuba ibaluleke kangakanani indlela amakhaya, abezoshishini kunye nemizi-mvelisi eyisebenzisa ngayo umbane.3 IiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zowama-2017 eziza kubanjwa kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 ziza kunika amasebe ithuba lokuba axelelele ipalamente kunye noluntu ngobubanzi ngendlela aza kuyisebenzisa ngayo imali ayabelwe ngowama-2017.Amasebe aza kusebenzisa eli thuba acacisele uluntu ukuba iinkqubo zawo zalo nyaka-mali umiyo ziza kube ziqulathe ntoni na.

src: E baya Thekenoloji ya Ditlhaeletsano le Tshedimosetso (ICT) kwa setlhoeng sa Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la 2063 la dinaga tsa Aforika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luzifunde luzicokise ezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali njengoko ziza kube zinikezelwa epalamente ngokweenkqubo zepalamente.

src: Aforika Borwa e tla unngwelwa mo maemong ka bobedi a ikonomi le a sepolotiki ka go nna le seabe mo go Smart Africa Alliance.
tgt: ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo liza kusingatha iVeki yezoGutyulo phakathi komhla we-16 nowama-22 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: UGutyulo luSetyenziselwa iMpilo neSidima Sabantu”.

src: Ka go baya diintaseteri tsa Aforika Borwa mo maemong a a tla di unngwelang mmogo le kitso ya bokgoni mo lenaneong la tlhabololo la Smart Africa Alliance, Aforika Borwa e tla nna le seabe mo kgolong ya dikgwebo tsa legae mo kgaolong.
tgt: Urhulumente uzimisele ukubuyisela abemi boMzantsi Afrika isidima sabo ngokubabonelela ngeenkonzo zogutyulo.

src: Kabinete e letleletse gore go phasaladiwe Pholisi ya Naga ya Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo e e ka ga Lebolelamading (HIV), Malwetse a a Fetelanang ka Thobalano (di-STD) le Lehuba (TB).Pholisi ya ngwaga wa 1999 e tobane le tlhokomelo ya lefatshe lotlhe mmogo le dintlha tsa melemo ya tlhago ka ga thibelaketegelo, mme ga e lebelele thata sebopego, mekgwa le maitsholo a a bakang HIV.
tgt: Ngale veki kuza kugxininiswa kakhulu ekukhokeliseni phambili iNkqubo yokuPhelisa Amabhakethi.

src: Pholisi eno e tshitshinya gore go nne le phetogo ka fao HIV e tsewang ka teng ka fao go dirisiwang maokelo a setšhaba go samagana le HIV, mmogo le go akarediwa ga TB jaaka e nngwe ya dintlha tsa botlhokwa go samaganwa natso kwa dikolong, gareng ga mafelo a mangwe.
tgt: Ngethuba lale veki kuza kunikezelwa izindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo kubantu abakuMasipala weNgiqi waseNketoane, eFreyistatha kunye noMasipala weNgingqi iDavid Kruiper eMntla Koloni njengenxalenye yokukhawulezisa iinkonzo zogutyulo ukuze kupheliswe inkqubo yokusebenzisa amabhakethi njengezindlu zangasese.5 UMzantsi Afrika ubhiyozela iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono.

src: Seno se atologile go akaretsa le barutwana, barutabana mmogo le badiredipuso, kwa dikolong tsa puso le tseo e seng tsa puso.
tgt: ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko liza kukhokela imisitho emininzi eza kugxininisa kubumbano lwe-Afrika.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tsenngwatirisong ga Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditlamo tsa Difofane, 2017 mmogo le Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Taolosephethephethe le Taolo ya Mebila Difofane gore o isiwe kwa Palamenteng.
tgt: Le misitho iza kufikela kuvuthondaba ngomhla wama-25 kuCanzibe kowama-2017 apho uMongameli eza kusingatha umsitho osisidlo esisesikweni eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse.

src: Diphetogo tse di leng mo Melaotlhomong eno e mebedi di senka go tlamela ka Setheo sa Leruri sa Melawanataolo.
tgt: Abantu abamenyiweyo kwesi sidlo zinkokeli zemibutho yabantu abaphuma kumazwe angaphandle abahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika uMongameli ebekhe wadibana nabo ngowe-20.

src: Di senka gape le go tlamela ka ditsela tsa go tlhoma dikomiti tsa go tlhatlhela boikuelo, tseo di tla nnang le seabe mo go rarabololeng dikganetsano tse di ka runyang.
tgt: Ukutyalwa komkhosi wezokhuselo wesizwe womzantsi afrika (I-SANDF)9.1 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigqibo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma sokwandisa ixesha elibekelwe amajoni e-SANDF atyalwe eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC).Ukwenza oku kukuncedisa kumalinge okudala uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika ingakumbi kulo mmandla ngokuhambelana noxanduva lwethu njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe ehlabathi kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo weli wezangaphandle wokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala i-Afrika kunye nehlabathi elingcono.2 Ngamajoni e-SANDF angama-1 371 atyalwe e-DRC ukuya kuncedisa kwiPhulo lokuZisa uZinzo loMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla neelana ka puo ya pulo ya 2017 ya Tourism Indaba, e e tla tshwarelwang kwa Tikwatikweng ya Kopanelo ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Inkosi Albert Luthuli kwa Durban magareng ga la bo 16 le la bo 18 Motsheganong 2017.Eno ke Indaba ya boditšhabatšhaba e e tla bontshang ditlhagisiwa le ditirelo tsa Aforika Borwa mo lekaleng la bojanala le la botlhabakgobe.
tgt: Ixesha aza kulichitha e-DRC la majoni landisiwe lisuka kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2017 laya kutsho kumhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-20.3 Ukutyala kwethu amajoni kweli lizwekazi kulilinge lokuxhasa amaphulo alo mmandla naweli lizwekazi okuzama ukulwa izixholo-xholo, ukukhuthaza uxolo nokhuseleko, ukomeleza ubudlelwane phakathi kwemimandla yeli lizwekazi, ukunyusa izinga lokurhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika kunye nokulwela uphuhliso oluzinzileyo e-Afrika.

src: Tourism Indaba 2017 gape e tla rotloetsa le go tshegetsa phetolothefosano e e tsweletseng mmogo le go tlhama intaseteri ya bojanala ya Aforika Borwa, go lebeletswe thata karolo ya baitshimololedi ba dikgwebo mmogo le ya beng ba WEBTOKEN Aforika Borwa, bajanala ba feta dimilione di le 10 ba jetse naga nala ka 2016, e leng palo e e oketsegileng ka 13% fa e bapisiwa le ya 2015.
tgt: Iimbasa zesizwe.1 IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla bonke abathe bawongwa ngeeMbasa zeSizwe ngo-ngowama-2017.

src: Mo pakeng eno ya Tourism Indaba, Aforika Borwa e tla unngwelwa go tswa mo palong ya baeteledipele bao ba tla jelang naga nala.
tgt: Kulo nyaka ka-OR Tambo, basibonisile ukubaluleka kokusebenzela uMzantsi Afrika ongcono nesizwe esingcono.

src: Tona ya Eneji, Mme Mmamoloko Kubayi, mo kgweding eno o tla etelapele letsholo la Kgwedi ya Eneji ka moono yo o reng: “Go rotloetsa metswako ya eneji e e rekegang e bile e le e e somarelegang mo go tshegetseng phetolothefosano ya phetakapejana ya ikonomi ya loago”.
tgt: Sifunda kwimisebenzi yabo emihle, ukuzinikela kwabo, ukuthanda nokubonakalisa umdla ongazenzisiyo wokulwela uluntu nobuntu.

src: Letsholo leno le tla ruta, la lemosa le go buisana le baagi ka ga mosola wa eneji, tlhokomelo ya eneji, mefuta e mengwe gape ya eneji le ka fao e ka thusang malapa, dikgwebo le diintaseteri.
tgt: I-Order of Ikhamanga yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeSilivere (basixhenxe), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Baobab yeBronzi (babini), i-Order of Luthuli yeSilivere (bangama-29), i-Order of Luthuli yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of Mapungubwe yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo yeGolide (mnye).2 Ukukhutshwa kweNgxelo ye-17 yeKhomishini yoLungelelwaniso lwezeNgqesho nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi uNksz Mildred Oliphant kubonakalisa indlela esihamba kancinci ngayo isantya sokuzisa iinguqu kwimisebenzi emininzi apha eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Puo ya Lefapha ya Thebolo Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017 e naya lefapha tšhono ya go tsibosa Palamente mmogo le baagi ka ga tsela eo ba tla dirisang tekanyetsokabo e ba e neilweng yone mo ngwageng wa 2017.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonakalisa ukuba sisekude kakhulu ekufikeleleni kwisizwe apho abasebenzi bebonakalisa iintlanga ezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika ngokulinganayo.

src: Gape ba tla dirisa serala seno go itsise le baagi ka ga seo leano la bona le leng ka ga sona mo ngwageng ono wa matlole.
tgt: Abantu abaNtsundu, abantu basetyhini kunye nabantu abakhubazekileyo ngabona bantu bavinjwa amathuba kuwo onke amabakala oLungelelwaniso kwezeNgqesho.3 Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba abantu abamhlophe ngabo abakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezingama-68% zeli lizwe kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala, inani elo lilinani eliphindwe kathandathu labantu abamhlophe asele bekwinqanaba lokusebenza.

src: Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe le tla tshwara Beke ya Kgeleloleswe ka la bo 16 le la bo 22 Motsheganong ka moono yo o reng: “Kgeleloleswe tebang le Boitekanelo le Seriti”.
tgt: Abantu abantsundu bona bakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezili-14.4% kuphela.4 Njengoko umba wokuzisa iinguqu nowohlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke ingxamiseke kakhulu xa kungoku, la manani eenkcukacha zengqesho kwizikhundla eziphezulu awamkelekanga kwaphela.

src: Puso e ikaeletse go busetsa maAforika Borwa seriti sa bona ka go ba tlamela ka ditirelo tsa kgeleloleswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi sokuba baza kuthathelwa amanyathelo aqatha abo bophula umthetho.

src: Kabinete e kopane ka Laboraro, la bo 24 Motsheganong 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kuCanzibe kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke ditiragalo tse di tswelelang tsa tiriso e e botlhaswa le tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi mo setšhabeng sa rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile ziziganeko ezifuna ukuthatha unyawo zoxhatshazo kunye nobundlobongela obujoliswe kwabasetyhini kweli lizwe.

src: Ditiragalo tsa sešweng tse di amang tirisodikgoka ka bakapelo di bakile gore basadi ba digatlhamelamasisi e bile ba le sebete ba bue kgatlhanong le go gatakwa ga ditshwanelo tsa bona.
tgt: Iziganeko zakutsha nje ziquka ubundlobongela obenziwa zizinqanda-mathe ezithe zakhokelela ekubeni abantu basetyhini abaninzi babonakalise isibindi nokungoyiki ngokuthi bathethe phandle bekhalimela ukunyhashwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: Kabinete e amogela gore jaaka naga re tswelela go nna le setšhaba se se laolwang ke banna mme ka jalo e ikuela gore go dirwe go le gontsi go lwantsha tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le kgwebisano ka batho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuba njengelizwe siyaqhubeleka nokuba sisizwe esilawulwa ngogonyamelo labantu abangamadoda kangangokuba iyakubethelela ukuba kuninzi ekufuneka kwenziwe ukulwa umkhuba wokubulawa ngolunya kwabantu basetyhini kunye nokurhweba ngabantu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go makala otlhe a setšhaba go dirisana mmogo go fenya bothata jo, go ganetsa mofuta ofe fela wa tirisodikgoka kgatlhanong le basadi le bana le go dirisana le sepodisi le tsamaiso ya bosiamisi go dira gore badiri ba ditiro tse di maswe tse ba lebagane le molao.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo kweli lizwe ukuba abambisane kuliwe nalo mkhwa mbi kangaka, azikhabe zonke iintlobo zobundlobongela ezenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, nokuba asebenzisane namapolisa kunye necandelo leenkundla ukuze bonke abenzi bobubi badityaniswa nomthetho.

src: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o ikuetse gore tiriso e e botlhaswa kgatlhanong le basadi le bana e khutle.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma umemelele ukuba mawuphele lo mkhuba uqhubekekayo wokuxhatshazwa kwabantu basetyhini nabantwana.

src: Kabinete e laetse Setlhopha sa Tshireletso ya Loago, Tlhabololo ya Setšhaba le Baagi go tsenya tirisong lenaane la tiro le le tla thusang naga go thibela tiriso e e botlhaswa ya basadi le bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iNtlanganisela yoKhuseleko ekuHlaleni, uPhuhliso loLuntu naBantu ukuba imisele inkqubo yokusebenza eza kuba sisikhokelo esiza kunceda isizwe kwidabi lokulwa ukuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Kabinete e amogela dipoelo tsa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo le Boitekanelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa 2016 ka Lefapha la Mananepalo la Aforika Borwa (stats SA), tse di lekanyetsang kemo ya boitekanelo ya maAforika Borwa, le phitlhelelego le boleng jwa manaane a boitekanelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zoPhando loMzantsi Afrika lowama-2016 leNani laBantu nezeMpilo liziko lezeNkcukacha-mani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA), eliphonononga imeko yempilo yabemi boMzantsi Afrika, kunye nomgangatho kunye nenani labantu abaxhamlayo kwiinkqubo zezempilo.

src: Gareng ga tse dingwe, dipatlisiso tse di supa kwelotlase ya dintsho tsa masea ka 20% le kwelotlase ya 11% ya basadi le banna ba ba gogang motsoko.
tgt: Olu phando, phakathi kwezinye izinto, lunike ingxelo ezichaza ukuba inani labantwana abaswelekayo lihle ngama-20% nokuba elabantu basetyhini namadoda abatshaya icuba lona lihle nge-11%.Ezi ziphumo zibonakalisa ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo emiselwe ngulo mbuso uphantsi kukaMongameli Zuma iza neziphumo ezincumisayo.

src: Dipoelo tse di supa gore ditsereganyo tsa pholisi tse di neng tsa tsenngwa tirisong ke boeteledipele jwa ga Moporesitente Zuma di ungwa maungo a mantle.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, iKhabhinethi ixhalabile linani labemi beli ababelana ngesondo namaqabane amaninzi ahlukeneyo bengasebenzisi zikhuseli.

src: Le fa go le jalo, Kabinete e tlhobaediwa ke palo ya maAforika Borwa a a santseng a tswelela go robalana le balekane ba bantsi ntle le tshireletso.
tgt: Abantu basetyhini abangama-32% kunye nabangamadoda abangama-42% bathe zange baye kuhlolela iNtsholongwana kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nangoku sele kukho amaphulo amaninzi karhulumente okufundisa abantu malunga nokubaluleka kokuvavanyelwa i-HIV.

src: Basadi ba le 32% le banna ba le 42% ba supile fa ba ise ba ke ba dirwe diteko tsa HIV le fa tota puso e leka go dira matsholotsiboso a go dirwa diteko tsa HIV.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bayazi into yokuba impilo yabo kunye nobomi babo busezandleni zabo, nokuba mabasebenzise izikhuseli xa besabelana ngesondo futhi bazihlole i-HIV kunye nazo zonke ezinye izifo ezosulelayo nezingosuleliyo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go rwala maikarabelo a boitekanelo le matshelo a bona, go robalana ba dirisa tshireletso le go nna ba dirwa diteko tsa HIV le malwetse a mangwe a a tshelanwang le a a sa tshelanweng gangwe le gape.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abazali nabagcini-bantwana ukuba baqinisekise ukuba abantwana babo bazigonyelwe izifo zabantwana.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go batsadi le batlhokomedi go netefatsa gore bana ba soutisiwa kgatlhanong le malwetse a bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isazimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuba bayagonywa ukuze kuliwe izifo ezosulelayo eziyingozi.

src: Kabinete e tswelela ka maikemisetso a go netefatsa gore bana ba a soutisiwa go thibela malwetse a a tshelanwang e bile a le kotsi mo matshelong a bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abazali kunye nabagcini-bantwana ukuba amayeza akhutshwa liSebe lezeMpilo awanabungozi.

src: Kabinete e netefaletsa batsadi le batlhokomedi gore diritibatsi tse di rebolwang ke Lefapha la Boitekanelo di babalesegile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigaba sokuqala sokuhlaziywa kweMizi-mveliso yaseVulindlela Heights eMthatha eMpuma Koloni.

src: Kabinete e amogela kgato ya ntlha ya Madirelo a Vulindlela Heights a a tsosolositsweng kwa Mthatha kwa Kapa Botlhaba.
tgt: Oku kuyinxalenye yeNkqubo yesizwe yokuHlaziya imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso.

src: Se ke karolo ya Lenaane la Tsosoloso ya Diphaka tsa Madirelo.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ngowesibini eMpuma Koloni futhi lo mmandla wemizi-mveliso ngomnye wemithandathu evuselelwayo kweli lizwe.

src: Ke ya bobedi ya mofuta wa yona kwa Kapa Botlhaba e bile e le nngwe ya diphaka tse thataro tse di ntšhwafadiwang go ralala naga.
tgt: Urhulumente uhlaziya imimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze kudaleke imisebenzi futhi kubekho nohlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Puso e ntšhwafatsa diphaka tsa madirelo go etleetsa go tlholwa ga ditiro le go netefatsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.
tgt: Ukususwa kwemizi-mveliso norhwebo ezidolophini nako kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuzisa iinguqo zezoqoqosho.

src: Tshedimosetso ka ga go nna le seabe mo ditšhonong tse di leng teng kwa diphakeng tsa madirelo, go fitlhelela tshegetso ya puso le mananeo a thuso, le ditšhono tsa dipeeletso mo makaleng a a farologaneng e ka bonwa mo go WEBTOKEN kgotsa ka Tikwatikwe ya Thuso ya Badirisi ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo (the dti) mo go 0861 843 384.
tgt: Iinkcukacha malunga nokuba ubani angawasebenzisa njani amathuba akhoyo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso, ukufumana inkxaso karhulumente kunye neenkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente, kunye namathuba otyalo-malo kumacandelo ahlukeneyo ziyafumaneka kule webhusayithi: WEBTOKEN okanye ngokutsalela umnxeba kwiZiko lemiBuzo leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti) kule nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: Kabinete e swabisitswe ke tshwetso ya General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd ya go fedisa tlhagiso le thekiso ya dirori tsa Chevrolet mo nageng e. Se se na le ditlamorago tse di sa itumediseng mo go ba ba tla latlhegelwang ke ditiro le mo ikonoming ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivile futhi idanisiwe sisigqibo sika-General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuyeka ukwenza kunye nokuthengisa iimoto zakwa-Chevrolet kweli lizwe.

src: Puso e tswelela ka maikemisetso a yona a go tshegetsa lekala la dirori mo nageng e, le le leng botlhokwa mo ikonoming le go tlhola WEBTOKEN dti ba tswelela go dirisana le bannaleseabe botlhe go fokotsa ditlamorago tsa se.
tgt: Oku kuzindaba ezimbi ngenene kuqoqosho lweli kwakunye nabo baza kuphulukana nemisebenzi.

src: Go oketsa tlhagiso, go tlholwa ga ditiro le kgolo ya thomelontle, re sa tswa go thankgolola kgato ya borobongwe ya Leanotiro la Pholisi ya Madirelo (IPAP) go re supetsa tsela.
tgt: Urhulumente nangoku usazimisele ukuxhasa icandelo lezeemoto, elilicandelo elibaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli kunye nakumalinge okudala imisebenzi.

src: Kabinete e tlhaloganya gore Isuzu, e e ntseng e le mo semphatong le GMSA dingwaga di le dintsi mo Aforika Borwa, e tla dira ditiro tse di neng di dirwa ke GMSKabinete e lemogile go etegela ga maemo a komelelo kwa Kapa Bophirima le Kapa Botlhaba.
tgt: I-dti iyaqhubeleka nokusebenzisana nawo onke amahlakani ukuba enze iinzame zokuphungula umonkalo oza kwenziwa koku.

src: Setlhopha se se nang le batlhankedi go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Komiti ya Bosetšhaba ya Taolo ya Matlhotlhapelo ka tirisano le diporofense le pusoselegae, e ntse e semeletse go netefatsa gore ditharabololo tsa pakakhutshwane go ya go tsa pakagare di a itlhaganedisiwa go netefatsa tshireletso ya tlamelo ka metsi mo diporofenseng tseno mo pakateleleng.
tgt: Ukunyusa izinga lokuvelisa, ukudala imisebenzi nokunyusa umthamo wempahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle, siphehlelele isigaba sesithoba sesiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukuze sibe sisikhokelo sethu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go akaretsa mo magaeng, dikgwebo, lekala la meepo, maatla le temothuo go dirisana mmogo go dirisa metsi ka tshomarelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuba inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebikade isebenzisana no-GMSA iminyaka emininzi eMzantsi Afrika, yiyo ngoku eza kungena endaweni ka-GMSIKhabhinethi iwuqaphela umba wembalela ethathe unyawo eNtshona Koloni naseMpuma Koloni.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go rebolwa ga tokomane ya dipuisano ya Togamaano Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee, e e tla nnang mosupatsela mo Togamaanong ya Bosetšhaba Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba nalo luncedise kwiinkqubo eziqaliswe ngala maphondo zokunciphisa indlela amanzi ankinkishwa ngayo.

src: Kabinete e laletsa baagi go neela ditshwaelo tse di kwadilweng ka go dirisa webosaete ya Lefapha la Tiromaano,Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro: www.
tgt: Iqela elakhiwe ngamagosa aphuma kwiSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kunye neKomiti yeSizwe yoLawulo lweeNtlekele lisebenzisana namaphondo kunye noomasipala, lifakana imilomo ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukuba izisombululo ezikhawulezileyo nezexesha elide ziyakhawuleziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho amanzi aneleyo kula maphondo aza kusetyenziswa ixesha elide.

src: Ntwa kgatlhanong le bonweenwee ke nngwe ya dintlhakgolo mo pusong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koxwebhu ekuza kuxoxwa phezu kwalo lesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo, eliza kusetyenziswa njengesikhokelo sesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo.

src: Bonweenwee le maitsholo a a maswe mo makaleng a poraefete le a puso di na le ditlamorago tse di maswe mo tlhabololong ya naga ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luhlomle luvakalise izimvo zalo ngolu xwebhu ngokuthumela ezo zimvo kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya ethi: www.

src: Kabinete e lemoga gore ntlha ya go thapiwa gape ga ga Rre Brian Molefe jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) kwa Eskom e kwa kgotlatshekelo le kwa Palamenteng, ka jalo e tla ikobela ditiragalo tseo.
tgt: Urhwaphilizo nokungathenjwa kwabasemagunyeni kurhulumente nakwicandelo lamashishini kuneziphumo ezibi kuphuhliso lwelizwe.

src: Le fa go le jalo, Moporesitente o tlhomile Komiti ya Ditona (IMC) e e nang le Tona ya Dikgwebo tsa Puso, ya Maatla, ya Matlotlo le Bosiamisi le ya Ditirelo tsa Kgopololo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuxhalaba sisenzo sakutshanje sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi kwihlabathi, esichazwe njengesona senzo sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi esakhe sasikhulu ezimbalini.

src: IMC e kopilwe go kokoanya dintlha gore di kgone go kaela Kabinete gore e ka samagana jang le merero e mo isagong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balumke kangangoko xa besebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka beteknoloji xa benxibelelana okanye bethumela, bekhupha okanye befakelwa imali.

src: Moeteledipele ke Tona ya Bosiamisi le Ditirelo tsa Kgopololo, Michael Masutha.
tgt: Abantu bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinesakhono esihlaziywa rhoqo sokulwa nezinye iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinjongo yazo ikukuba nokutshabalalisa ulwazi olukwikhompyutha.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Tumelano e e Tlhabolotsweng ya Matlafatso e e Anameng ya Bantsho mo Ikonoming ya intaseteri ya Meepo le Diminerale ya Aforika Borwa ka 2017.Tona ya Meepo Mosebenzi Zwane o tla tlamela ka pegelo fa tumelano e e sena go phasaladiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakuqonda ukuba umba wokuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengeGosa eliPhezulu lesiGqeba (i-CEO) usezinkundleni zamatyala nasePalamente ke ngoko ayizikuphazamisana neenkqubo zala macandelo karhulumente.

src: Kabinete e mametleletse Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio ka Lefapha la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, uMongameli umisele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa (i-IMC) eyakhiwe nguMphathiswa wamaShishini kaRhulumente, owezaMandla, owezeMali kunye nowezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko.

src: Go abiwa ga marang ke Khonferense ya Lefatshe ya Radiocommunication go na le seabe sa botlhokwa mo kgolong ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Le IMC inikwe umsebenzi wokuqokelela iinkcukacha eziza kunceda iKhabhinethi ukuba ikwazi ukusombulula nokuphendula imiba efana nale kwixa elizayo.

src: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio ke motswedi o o tletseng wa kabo ya marang a ditirelo tse di farologaneng tsa tlhaeletsano ka radio.
tgt: Umququzeleli wale IMC nguMphathiswa wezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko uMichael Masutha.

src: Leano la Bosetšhaba la Marang a Radio le le tlhabolotsweng la 2017 le netefatsa gore Aforika Borwa o nyalana le Melawana ya Boditšhaba ya Radio e e amogetsweng kwa khonferenseng ya Kopano ya Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano ya Boditšhaba (ITU) ka 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa ngowama-2017 koMqulu oHlaziyiweyo wezoPhuhliso oluBanzi lwabaMnyama kwezoQoqosho wecandelo lezeMigodi neziMbiwa loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Togamaano ya Pabalesego ya Ditselana tsa Metsi.
tgt: UMphathiswa wemiThombo yeziMbiwa uza kunika amagqabantshintshi wakuba lo mqulu upapashiwe kwigazethi.

src: Togamaano e, ka Bothati ba Pabalesego ya Mawatle a Aforika Borwa, e tlhoma maemo le go tsweletsa mekgwatsamaiso ya go letla le go rebolela dikepe dilaesense tsa go dira mo metsing a e seng a kwa mawatleng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 esamkelwe liSebe leziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi.

src: Se se tla netefatsa pabalesego ya diketswana tse mo metsing a a seng kwa mawatleng mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Lo mthamo wamaza omoya eli lizwe liwabelwe kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yezoNxibelelwano ngaMaz’omoya uza kudlala indima enkulu kuhlumo loqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.

src: Togamaano e e ikaelela go tlhola letlhomeso la taolo e e momaganeng e bile e dira sentle, e e tla netefatsang gore Aforika Borwa o fitlhelela maemo a a gaisang a boditšhaba a ditiro tsa tsamaiso ya dithoto ka tsela.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 sisikhokelo esityebileyo esicacisa indlela amaza omoya abiwe ngayo esabelwa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisa amaza omoya kwezonxibelwano.

src: Dikatlenegiso mo letlhomesong le di tla netefatsa nonofo ya tiragatso, thotloetso ya pabalesego mo tseleng, fokotsa seabe mo tikologong, le go tlhola letlhomeso le le momaganeng la kgaisano e e laolwang ka boleng e mo go yona lekala la tsamaiso ya dithoto ka tsela e tla tswelelang go direla ditlhokego tsa maAforika Borwa tsa ikonomi.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 siza kuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uthobela iMithetho yeHlabathi yezaMaz’omoya eyamkelwa kwinkomfa yowama-2015 yoMfelandawonye weHlabathi weziSeko zoNxibelelwano.

src: Kabinete e amogetse ditebego tse dišwa tsa madi a segopotso le a a tla dirisiwang ka 2017 le 2018.Ka tirisano le Kabinete, motseletsele o mošwa o, o ne wa tlhongwa go supa setso, kgololesego le temokerasi ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Go keteka Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso-qhinga soKhuseleko kwiMijelokazi neMilambo Emikhulu.

src: Ngwagakgolo wa botsalo jwa mogaka wa Kgaratlho, Oliver Reginald Tambo o ne wa tlhophiwa jaaka setlhogo sa ntlha go supiwa.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga, ngokusebenzisa iQumrhu loMzantsi Afrika lezoKhuseleko eManzini, simisela imigangatho kwaye siphucula iinkqubo zokunika amaphepha-mvume kunye neelayisenisi kumaphenyane asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazo.

src: Go tlhagisiwa ga ledi la tshipi le lešwa la R50 (1oz, selefera e e tsabakelang), ledi la tshipi la R500 (1oz, gauta ya 24-carat) le ledi la tshipi la R50 (metale wa motheo) go keteka ngwaga wa bo100 wa letlha la matsalo la ga OR Tambo.
tgt: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba la maphenyana asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazi akhuselekile.

src: Ledi le le phasaladiwang la 2017: ledi la R5 le le supang Letshwao la Tlotlo la Ditsala tsa ga OR Tamboc.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uhlobo lwengqekembe olwenziwe yi-South African Mint Company lweengqekembe zowama-2017 nowama-2018 ezisisikhumbuzo neziza kusetyenziswa luluntu.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2017 wa Protea: Botshelo ba Mogaka – Nelson Mandelad.
tgt: Ngokusebenzisana neKhabhinethi, olu hlobo lutsha lweengqekembe lwenzelwe ukuphawula inkcubeko, inkululeko nolawulo lwentando yesininzi phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2017 R1: Digagabi tsa Aforika Borwa - Leboloboloe.
tgt: Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu sokuzalwa kweGqala loMzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo sakhethwa njengomba ekuza kusekelwa phezu kwawo xa kuzotywa ezi ngqekembe.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2018 Mokgatlo wa UN wa Thuto, Saense le Setso (UNESCO) Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa Motho le Tikologo: Serapa sa Waterberg sa Botshelof.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwengqekembe ye-R50 entsha (i-1oz, nesilivere ye-sterling), ingqekembe ye-R500 (i-1oz, negolide eneekharathi ezingama-24) kunye nengqekembe ye-R50 (eyenziwe ngesinyithi) zokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2018: Setšhaba sa Thutalefatshe ya Bosetšhaba ‘Maiteko a Dikatse tse Dikgolo’ - Taug.
tgt: Zenziwe iintlobo zengqekembe zezi ngqekembe zesikhumbuzo zilandelayo zowama-2017 nowama-2018:a. Iingqekembe zowama-2017: Umbhiyozo wemiNyaka eliKhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: Motseletsele wa madi a tshipi wa 2018: Sejana sa Lefatshe sa FIFA 2018 FIFA RussiaTDitiragalo tse di tlang.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2017 eziza kusetyenziswa: ingqekembe ye-R5 ebonisa imbasa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tshegetsa Beke ya Tshireletso ya Bana go tloga ka la bo 28 Motsheganong go fitlha ka la bo 4 Seetebosigo ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Tlaang rotlhe re sireletse bana go isa Aforika Borwa kwa pele”.
tgt: Iingqekembe ze-Protea zowama-2017: Ubomi beSithwalandwe – uNelson Mandelad.

src: Tshireletso ya bana ke tiro le maikarabelo a maAforika Borwa otlhe batsadi, batlhokomedi, motho ka nosi le setšhaba.
tgt: Iingqekembe ze-R1 zowama-2017: Izirhubuluzi zoMzantsi Afrika - Irhambae.

src: Mo ketekong ya ngwagakgolo wa ga OR Tambo, Aforika Borwa e tla bo e keteka Ngwaga wa Bašwa ka Seetebosigo 2017 ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Ngwaga wa ga OR Tambo: Go Tsweletsa Seabe sa Bašwa mo Ikonoming.”Mo kgweding e puso e tla nna le matsholo a a farologaneng a bašwa go akaretsa dipontsho, ditherisano mafelo a dikgwebo a bašwa go bontsha ditšhono tse bašwa ba ka nnnang natso le go ba rotloetsa go tsepama mo meonong ya thuto le boeteledipele ya ga OR Tambo.
tgt: Iingqekembe zowama-2018: i-National Geographic Society ‘iPhulo leziLwanyana eziziKati zaseNdle eziNkulu - Ingonyamag.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa bašwa botlhe go fitlhelela mananeo a a farologaneng a tshegetso le thuto a puso a a tlhagisang go tokafatsa ditšhono tsa bona le go tsweletsa seabe sa bona mo ikonoming.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bayixhase iVeki yokuKhuselwa kwaBantwana eza kuqala ngomhla wama-28 kuCanzibe iphele ngomhla wesi-4 kweyeSilimela phantsi komxholo othi: “Sonke masikhusele abantwana ukuze siqhubele uMzantsi Afrika phambili”.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go bathapi go nna le seabe mo lenaneong la e ya le mosetsayana tirong ka la bo 25 le la bo 26 Motsheganong.
tgt: Umba wokukhuselwa kwabantwana ngumsebenzi noxanduva lwabemi boMzantsi Afrika, abazali, abagcini-bantwana, abantu kunye noluntu.

src: Maitlhomo ke go supetsa basetsana ba Mephato ya 10 go fitlha go ya 12 mefuta e e farologaneng ya ditiro tse ba ka ithutelang tsone.
tgt: Njengesizwe sinoxanduva lokwenza konke esinakho ukwenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuba abantu abasemngciphekweni wokuba ngamaxhoba okuxhatshazwa kwesi sizwe abaxhatshazwa baphathwe kakubi.

src: Se e tla bo e le tsweletso ya ditiragalo le mananeo a a ntseng a le teng go keteka Kgwedi ya Aforika ka fa tlase ga setlhogo: “Ngwaga wa OR Tambo: Go Aga Aforika o o Botoka le Lefatshe le le Botoka”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuba bonke abantu kweli lizwe badale iimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezifanelekileyo zokunceda abantwana bakhule, bantingele ezinkwenkwezini.

src: Keteko ya ngwaga le ngwaga ya Letsatsi la Aforika le ka ga go tlhangwa ga Mokgatlo wa Tshwaraganelo ya Aforika (OAU) ka 1963.Jaaka re konosetsa Kgwedi ya Aforika, Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go dirisana le balekane ba bangwe ba Aforika ba ba nnang mo Aforika le mafelo a mangwe mo kontinenteng e go netefatsa tswelopele ya kgaolo ya rona le Aforika WEBTOKEN maikarabelo gape a botlhe ba ba nnang mo nageng ya rona, maAforika Borwa le baditšhaba go ikobela melao ya naga.
tgt: Kule mibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kubhiyozela iNyanga yoLutsha ngeyeSilimela yowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukuqhubela Phambili Indima Edlalwa Lulutsha kuQoqosho.”Ngale nyanga, urhulumente uza kubamba iindibano eziliqela, eziquka imiboniso engezolutsha, iindibano zokubonisana kunye neengqungquthela ezingendima yolutsha kwezoshishino ukuze kucaciswe ngamathuba akhoyo okunceda abantu abatsha, futhi nokubakhuthaza ukuba bafunde iimpawu zobunkokeli ezibonakalisa nezixabise imfundo, izakhono ezo u-OR Tambo naye awayesimelele ngazo.

src: Mmogo re tshwanetse go lwantsha kgwebo ka batho, go thopiwa le tiriso e e botlhaswa ya basadi le bana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu abatsha ukuba bazisebenzise iinkqubo zoncedo nezemfundo eziqulunqwe ngurhulumente ukulungisela bona ukuze kuphuculwe izakhono zabo ukuze amathuba abo okuthatha inxaxheba evakalayo kuqoqosho abe mahle.

src: Katlego ya tiro e mo diatleng tsa setlhopha sa jalelelo ke bopaki jwa maemo a a kwa godimo a nonofo le boitseanape a a leng teng mo lekaleng la puso la boitekanelo mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Injongo yeli phulo kukunika abantwana abangamantombazana abafunda kwiBanga le-10 nele-12 ithuba lokuba bazibonele ngokwabo iintlobo zamakhondo ezahlukeneyo.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Phaka ya iSimangaliso Wetland ka go amogela Sekgele sa Manontlhotlho mo Boruning kwa Dikabong tsa Botswerere mo Lekaleng la Puso tsa Setheo sa Diakhaontente sa Aforika Borwa (SAICA) go sale gale mo kgweding e. Kabo e ke ya go tlotla Phaka e ka go amogela boruni jo bo senang dilabe dingwaga di le tlhano ka tatelano.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma ngoLwesine, umhla wama-25 kuCanzibe wowama-2017, uza kubamba umsitho wokubhiyozela uSuku lwesizwe lwe-Afrika eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: iSimangaliso e ne ya goelediwa jaaka Lefelo la Ngwaoboswa la Lefatshe la ntlha mo Aforika Borwa ka Sedimonthole 1999.
tgt: Lo msitho uza kube uluvuthondaba lwemibhiyozo neenkqubo eziphawula iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono kunye neHlabathi eliNgcono”.

src: Kabinete e akgola lenaane la Go Dira ka Molelo ka go amogela sefikantswe go tswa go Puso ya Alberta kwa Canada jaaka segopotso sa thuso e e tlametsweng ke lenaane le mo go laoleng melelo ya naga mo Porofenseng ya bona ka 2016.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo woSuku lwe-Afrika ubanjwa rhoqo ngonyaka uphawula ukusungulwa koMbutho weMbumba ye-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Xa siqukumbela le Nyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babambisane namanye ama-Afrika ahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika nabo bakwamanye amazwe kweli lizwekwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba lo mmandla wethu kunye ne-Afrika iphela inekamva eliqaqambileyo nelizele amathamsanqa.

src: Go Dira ka Molelo ke Lenaane le le Atolositsweng la Ditiro tsa Setšhaba (EPWP) le maikaelelo a lona e leng go neela bašwa ba banna le basadi ditšhono tsa ditiro.
tgt: Kubalulekile nokuba bonke abo bahlala ngaphakathi kwemida yeli, oko kukuthi abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nabanye abantu bamazwe angaphadle abakweli, bayihloniphe futhi bayithobele imithetho yeli lizwe.

src: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka la bo, 7 Seetebosigo 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso yayo ngoLwesithathu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeSilimela kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Kabinete e boeleditse boikuelo jwa ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jwa gore maAforika Borwa a tshwaragane kgatlhanong le tirisodikgoka le go bogisiwa ga basadi le bana, le go ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tsaya dikgato ka ponyo ya leitlho tsa go fedisa setlwaedi seno mo metseng ya rona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela ikhwelo ebelihlatywe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika babambisane balwe ubundlobongela noxhatshazo olwenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, kwaye icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe amanyathelo akhawulezileyo okusiphula neengcambu lo mkhuba mbi kangaka kwisizwe sethu.

src: Seno se latela leeto la ga Moporesitente kwa Elsies River, kwa Motsekapa, mo go tshegetseng letsholo la Imbizo la Ntwa Kgatlhanong le Bosenyi.
tgt: Oku kulandela utyelelo obelwenziwe nguMongameli lusiya e-Elsies River eKapa ngeenjongo zokuxhasa iMbizo yokuLwa uLwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Leeto leno gape le nopotse go nna mo tlalelong ga basadi le bana mo metseng ya rona.
tgt: Le Mbizo iphinde yawucacisa ngokuphandle umba wokuba sesichengeni kwabasetyhini nabantwana kweli lizwe lethu.

src: Moporesitente o ne a swetsa ka gore o tla boela kwa lefelong leno go tlhotlhomisa dikgwetlho tse dintsi tsa bosenyi le dipolao, bogolosegolo mo baneng le gore boramolao ba tla tokafatsa jang ditirelo tseo ba di abelang baagi ba foo.
tgt: UMongameli waye wathembisa ukuba uza kuphinda eze kule ndawo aze kuqwalasela iingxaki zeziganeko ezininzi zolwaphulo-mthetho nokubulawa kwabantu, ingakumbi abantwana kunye nokuba ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho zingenza njani ukuze ziphucule indlela ezisebenza ngayo ukunceda uluntu.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga pegelo ya Dipatlisiso tsa Malapakakaretso tsa 2016, e leng seo se tsweletseng go bontsha kgatelopele e e leng teng mo go tsenyeng tirisong manaane a puso mabapi le go tokafatsa matshelo a maAforika Borwa, bogolosegolo a baagi bao mo malobeng ba neng ba sa neelwe ditšhono.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koPhando lowama-2015 ngaMakhaya Ngokubanzi, olubonisa inkqubela kumba wokufezekiswa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ukuze kuphuculwe ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika, ingakumbi abantu abaphuma kwmimandla eyayihlelelekile ngaphambili.

src: Dipalo di bontsha gore puso e dira go tlala seatla mo go tlameleng baagi ka dintlo, mo malapa a maAforika Borwa a nnang mo dintlong tsa ‘RDP’ kgotsa mo dintlong tseo puso e thusanang le moreki go di duelela ka dipalo tse di oketsegileng go tloga mo go 5% ka 2002 go fitlha mo go 13,5% ka 2016.Dipatlisiso tseno gape di bontsha gore manaane a thuso ya tlhokomelo ya setšhaba a oketsegile go tloga mo go 12,7% ka 2003 go fitlha mo go 29,7% ka 2016.Gape go na le koketsego e e nopotsweng mo go tlameleng ka metsi, motlakase le kgeleloleswe, e leng sengwe se se botlhokwa thata mo maitlhomong a pusong ya Aforika Borwa a go baakanya diphoso tsa puso ya tlhaolele ka go tlamela baagi botlhe ka ditlamelo tsa motheo.
tgt: Iinkcukacha-manani zibonakalisa ukuba liyanda inani labantu elakhelwe izindlu ngurhulumente, kangangokuba inani labantu beli abahlala kwizindlu ezisisibonelelo sikarhulumente linyuke lisuka kwi-5% ngowama-2002 laya kutsho kwi-13,5% ngowama-2016.Olu phando lubonakalisa nokuba iinkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente zinyuke zisuka kwi-12,7% ngowama-2003 laya kutsho kuma-29,7% ngowama-2016.Kwakhona nenani labantu abafakelwe amanzi, umbane kunye nezindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo linyuke kakhulu, into eluphawu olubalulekileyo olubonisa ukuzimisela kukaRhulumente woMzantsi Afrika ukulungisa umonakalo owashiywa ngumbuso wocalu-calulo ngokusa iinkonzo ezisisiseko kubo bonke abantu.

src: Kabinete, le fa go le jalo, e nopotse gore le fa ikwadiso kwa thutong e kgolwane e oketsega, le fa e le ka lebelo le le kwa tlase, ke bathobatsho ba le 3,3% ba ba mo magareng ga dingwaga di le 18 le 29 ba ba ithutelang pele fa go bapisiwa le 18,8% ya maIndia/maAsia mme 17,5% ke ya basweu mo bathong ba dingwaga tse di WEBTOKEN fela 3,5% ya makhalate ao a neng a ithutela pele mo ngwageng wa 2016.Dipatlisiso di bontshitse gape le phokotsego go tloga mo go 23,8% go fitlha mo go 11,8% ya malapa a a robalang ka tlala, e leng sesupo sa kgatelopele mo go samaganeng le baagi ba ba leng mo khumanegong e e tseneletseng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele nokuba nangona inani labantwana ababhalisela ukufunda kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo linyuka, noxa linyuka kancinci, ngabantu abantsundu abaneminyaka yobudala eli-18 ukuya kwengama-29 abayi-3,3% kuphela abafundayo xa kuthelekiswa ne-18,8% yamaNdiya nama-Asiya kunye ne-17,5% yabamhlophe nabo abayile ntanga.

src: Kabinete gape e tsibogetse Dipatlisiso tsa Badiri mo Kotareng tseo di dirilweng mo kotareng ya ntlha ya ngwaga tseo di bontshitseng fa ikonomi e kgonne go tlhola gape ditiro tse dingwe di le 144 000.
tgt: Abantwana bebala abebefunda ngowama-2016 bona bebeyi-3,5% kuphela.

src: Dipalo tseno di rotloeditswe ke koketsego ya batho ba le 433 000 bao ba senkang ditiro.
tgt: Olu phando luphinde labonakalisa ukuhla kwenani lamakhaya athwaxwa yindlala lisuka kuma-23,8% laya kutsho kwi-11,8%, into leyo ebonakalisa ukuba uyabonakala umsebenzi owenziwayo ukulwa indlala kwimimandla ethwaxwa kakhulu yindlala.

src: Kabinete e gatelela maikemisetso a yona a go tswelela go dirisana mmogo le lekala la poraefete le mekgatlho ya badiri mo maitlhomong a yona a go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa naga tse di mabapi le botlhokatiro.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iluqaphele uPhando lweKota leCandelo lezeMisebenzi lekota yokuqala yonyaka olubonisa ukuba uqoqosho lweli ludale imisebenzi engama-144 000.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go thankgololwa ya Intaseteri ya Diphaka ya Babelegi kwa Hammanskraal jaaka karolo ya puso ya go potlakisa tlhabololo ya ikonomi le go tlhola ditiro mo lefelong leo.
tgt: Umtyhi oze nenani lezi zithuba zemisebenzi uphinde waphelela emoyeni ngenxa yenani labantu abafuna imisebenzi elinyukileyo, langabantu abangama-433 000.IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyakubethelela ukuzibophelela kwayo kumba wokusebenzisa namashishini abucala kunye nabasebenzi kumalinge ayo okulwa ingxaki ehlupha ilizwe yokunqongophala kwemisebenzi.

src: Porojeke eno e e jeleng R42 milione ke karolo ya puso ya Lenaane la Tsosoloso ya Mafelo a Diintaseteri mme gape ke le lengwe la mafelo ao a le marataro ao a tsosoloswang mo nageng gore a kgone go tlhabolola ikonomi ya diintaseteri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvulwa kweBabelegi Industrial Park elungiswe ngokutsha eseHammanskraal njengenxaleye yezicwangciso zikarhulumente zokukhawulezisa uphuhliso loqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi kulo mmandla.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsa diintaseteri tsa fa gae mmogo le dikgwebo go ka fudusetsa dikgwebo tsa bone kwa mafelong ao a diintaseteri gore ba iponele ditshegetso tse di farologaneng tseo di leng teng go ka atolosetsa pele dikgwebo tsa bone.
tgt: Le projekthi ityabule imali ezizigidi ezingama-42 zeerandi iyinxalenye yeNkqubo kaRhulumente yokuVuselela imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso kwaye iyenye yeeprojekthi ezintandathu zemimandla yemizi-mveliso ehlaziyiweyo kwilizwe liphela ukuze incedise kuphuhliso olubanzi loqoqosho namashishini.

src: Kabinete e ne ya tsiboswa ke Tona ya Matlole, Rre Malusi Gigaba, ka tshedimosetso ya jaanong e e ka ga dipalo tsa Seelosotlhe sa Ditlhagisiwa tsa Naga mo Ngwageng (GDP) sa Aforika Borwa, seo se aparetsweng ke 0,7% mo kotareng ya ntlha ya 2017.Dipoelo tse di bokoa thata tseno tseo di neng di sa solofelwa di kwa tlase thata go gaisa tsa Tshekatsheko ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2017, tseo di neng disolofetse kgolo ya GDP mo ngwageng wa 2017 go gola ka 1,3%.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza imizi-mveliso namashishini eli ukuba acinge ngokuvula amanye amasebe namacandelo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze nawo axhamle kwezi zibonelelo zenkxaso zikwezi ndawo ukuze bakhulise nangakumbi amashishini wabo.

src: Seno, gareng ga tse dingwe, se tlhodilwe ke go se dire sentle ga tlhagisodikuno, kgwebisano, diintaseteri tsa dijo le tsa marobalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi nguMphathiswa wezeMali, uMnu Malusi Giba malunga namanani akutsha nje eMveliso yeLizwe yoNyaka (i-GDP) yoMzantsi Afrika, enciphe ngo-0,7% kwikota yokuqala yowama-2017.Esi siphumo se-GDP sibi kuneso besilindelwe singaphantsi kakhulu kuHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali oluHlaziyiweyo lowama-2017, ebeliqikelele ukuba i-GDP yowama-2017 iza kuhluma ngo-1.3%.

src: Le fa go le jalo, ikonomi e ne e sa tshegediwa ke kgolo mo intasetering ya meepong le ya mo mawatleng e leng e e tlhatlogileng ka 12.8%.
tgt: I-GDP yenziwe ngenxa yokungaqhubi kakuhle kwecandelo lezemizi-mveliso, elezorhwebo, elezokutyisa nelezokuhlalisa iindwendwe.

src: Temothuo, intaseteri ya dikgwa le boreatlhapi di itharabologetswe mo kotareng ya ntlha ya 2017 ka koketsego ya 22,2%.Go na le dikgato tseo naga e ka di tsayang go thusa go tshegetsa sebopego sa kgolo ya ikonomi ya yona.
tgt: Noko kunjalo, uqoqosho luxhaswe luhlumo kwicandelo lezemigodi nelekwari wona akhule nge-12,8%.

src: Tseno di akaretsa go tokafatsa kgolo mo lefatsheng, go somarela ditlhwatlhwa tsa dithoto, go nna le maemo a loapi a a siametseng naga, go nna le tlamelo ya motlakase e e tshepagalang le go nna le dikgogakgogano tsa badiri tse di senang tshenyo.
tgt: Icandelo lezolimo, elezamahlathi kunye nelezokuloba aqhube kakuhle kwikota yokuqala yowama-2017 kuba akhule nge-22.2%.Zikhona iimpawu ezibonakalisa ukuthembisa eli lizwe elinokuzisebenzisa ukunceda uhlumo loqoqosho lwalo.

src: Kabinete e ipiletsa mo dikgwebong, mekgatlhong ya badiri le mo setšhabeng ka botlalo go dirisana le puso mo go matlafatseng manaane a rona a kgolo ya ikonomi le mo go direng gore babeeletsi ba nne le tshepo e kgolo mo nageng ya rona gore re kgone go kgaotsa kwelotlase mme re kgone go godisa ikonomi, go fitlhelela kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang WEBTOKEN ntlheng eno, Tona ya Matlole e tla kopana le baeteledipele ba dikgwebo mo maitekong a go tlhama ditogamaano tse di tla samaganang le kwelotlase ya ikonomi le go ka fitlhelela kgolo ya ikonomi.
tgt: Ezi ziquka uhlumo oluncumisayo loqoqosho lwehlabathi, ukuphucuka kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa, iimeko zezulu ezintle, imeko yombane ezinzileyo kunye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaqeshi.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsiboso ka botlalo ya bobegakgang e e dirilweng ke Tona ya Matlole go tsibosa maAforika Borwa ka ga dikgato tseo puso e tla di tsayang go latela letlhomeso la ga jaana la tekanyetsokabo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela amashishini, imibutho yabasebenzi kunye noluntu ngobubanzi ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukuze kuqiniswe inkqubo yokuhlumisa uqoqosho nokunyusa izinga eli lizwe elithenjwe ngalo ngabatyali-mali ukuze sinqade ukuwa koqoqosho size ngolo hlobo sibuyisele uqoqosho lweli kwimeko yohlumo, ukuze kubekho uhlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Ditheo tsa Tshekatsheko Maemo a Ikonomi e leng sa Fitch le sa Standard & Poor’s ba netefaleditse gore Aforika Borwa e balelwa mo maemong a dikoloto tsa pakatelele tsa madi a dinaga tsa kwa ntle a ‘BB+’.Seno se tla morago ga gore Tona Gigaba a buisane le makala a poraefete go netefatsa gore tiro e e kopanetsweng ya puso, kgwebo, mekgatlho ya badiri le setšhaba e a tswelela, le gore maikano a a tserweng a a diragadiwa.
tgt: Ke ngoko uMphathiswa wezeMali uza kudibana neenkokeli zezoshishino bagwadle iqhinga lokulwa le ngxaki yokudodobala koqoqosho lutshintshe luhlume ngenxela eza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.

src: Kabinete e gateletse gore maAforika Borwa a tshwanetse go tswelela go dira ba tshwaragane, bogolosegolo fa fo na le mathata mme ba dire ka natla go netefatsa gore naga e boela mo maemong a yona a dipeeletso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali abambe intlanganiso nonoondaba aze axelele abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngamanyathelo okungenelela urhulumente aza kuwathatha kolu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lwalo nyaka-mali.

src: Kabinete e amogetse ditsereganyo tse di dirilweng kwa kopanong ya Komiti ya Botsamaisi e e Kopanetsweng tebang le Dimaraka tse di Tlwaelegileng tsa Borwa (MERCOSUR) le tsa Mokgatlho wa Lekgetho wa Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Aforika (SACU) mo malobeng o o tshwaretsweng mo nageng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphinda iyazibophelela ekubeni iyaluxhasa uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lweli lizwe.

src: Makoko a dumelane gore mmogo a tla sekaseka ditšhono tsa go tsholetsa Tumelano ya Dikgwebisano tse di Tlhokegang (PTA) ya MERCOSUR ka go akaretsa ditheo tsa yona tsa tsholetso ya dikgwebisano, mekgatlokitso ya dikhomese, makala a poraefete mmogo le Dintlo tsa Boambasatara mmogo le tsa barongwa ba batswantle.
tgt: I-arhente zokuhlela amazwe u-Fitch kunye no-Standard & Poor’s aziyitshintshanga indawo obekwa kuyo uMzantsi Afrika ngokwasakhono sokubhatala isikweliti setyala langaphandle, indawo leyo engu-‘BB+’.Oku kwenzeke ngenxa yeentlanganiso uMphathiswa Gigaba ebezibambile namashishini abucala ukuqinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi oqhutywa ngokubambisana phakathi kukarhulumente, amashishini, imibutho yabasebenzi kunye nemibutho yoluntu uyaqhubeka, kwaye nezithembiso ezenziweyo ziyazalisekiswa.

src: PTA ya MERCOSUR-SACU e tlamela baitseanape ba fa gae ka ditšhono tsa go tsenela dimaraka tsa go feta batho ba ba fetang ba le 280 milione.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakubethelela ukuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika kufuneka batsale ngamxhelo-mnye, ingakumbi ngala maxesha anzima futhi basebenze ngokuzimisela ukuqinisekisa ukuba eli lizwe libuyiselwa kwiindawo yalo ngokwesakhono sokukwazi ukubhatala izikweliti.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go bagwebi ba naga ba diromelwantle go tsaya tšhono eno ya PTA ka fa ditlhagisiwa tsa ka fa nageng ga jaana di kgona go tsena mo lenaneong la MERCOSUR ka lekgetho le le tlhokegang la ditlhagisiwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo zendibano yeKomiti yoLawulo eHlangeneyo phakathi koMbutho ongaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo wamaZwe elizwekazi leMelika eseMazantsi (i- (MERCOSUR) noMbutho wamaZantsi e-Afrika ongaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) ebibanjwe kwezi ntsuku zimbalwa zidlulileyo kweli.

src: Kabinete e swabisitswe ke tshwetso ya Amerika (USA) ya go ikgogela morago mo Tumelanong ya Paris.
tgt: Amazwe abekulo ndibano avumile ukuba kufuneka asebenzisane akhangele amathuba okukhuthaza isiVumelwano sokweNzelelelana kwezoRhwebo (i-PTA) se-MERCOSUR ne-SACU ngokubandakanya ii-arhente zezorhwebo, amaqumrhu ezoshishino, amashishini abucala kunye namaziko kunye nezindlu zozakuzo zamazwe angaphandle.

src: Tumelanong ya Paris, eo e tla simololang go dira ka botlalo ka 2020, e ikaegile ka seabe sa tsenyoletsogo seo dinaga ka bo tsona se itlhophetseng sone e le go fitlhelela dipeelo tsotlhe tseo dinaga ka bo jotlhe mo lefatsheng di di utlwanetseng.
tgt: Isivumelwano esiphakathi kwe-MERCOSUR ne-SACU siza kunika oosomashishini beli abarhweba ngokuthumela iimpahla ngaphandle ithuba lokuba bathengisele abantu abazizigidi ezingama-280 iimveliso zabo.

src: Aforika Borwa e ikueletse mo nageng ya Amerika go ipatla e ipatlisise ka tshwetso ya bone mme e swetse ka go boela mo thulaganyong eno ya dinagantsi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubo bonke oosomashishini abarhweba ngokuthumela iimpahla kumazwe angaphandle lokuba mabawasebenzise la mathuba eza ne-PTA njengoko iimveliso zeli zikwazi ngoku ukuthunyelwa kumazwe angamalungu e-MERCOSUR zibhatalelwe irhafu yorhwebo enesaphulelo.

src: Mmemorantamo wa Ditumelano (MoU) magareng ga Novartis, Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso ka tsa Boitekanelo la Aforika Borwa mmogo le Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji o rulaganyetsa tsela ya go tshegetsa bontsi jwa ditekelelopatlisiso tsa boitekanelo le go tlhoma bokgoni jwa dipatlisiso mo kontinenteng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukudana sisigqibo esithathwe yi-United States of America (i-USA) sokurhoxa kwisiVumelwano saseParis.

src: Tumelano eno tla kgontsha gore go nne le manaane a dipatlisiso a a kopanetsweng mo malwetseng a a nopotsweng a a fetelanang le a a sa fetelaneng, ya tokafatsa phitlhelelo ya maAforika Borwa ya melemo e e sa tswang go tlhamiwa mmogo le go godisa bokgoni jwa dipatlisiso mo nageng le mo kontinenteng.
tgt: IsiVumelwano saseParis, esiza kuqala ukusebenza ngokupheleleyo ngowama- 2020, sixhomekeke kwimali ehlawulwa ngamazwe angamalungu elungiselelwa ukufezekisa iinjongo zamazwe ehlabathi ekuvunyelwene ngazo.

src: Kabinete e dumela gore go santse go tlhokagala gore go nne le terisanommogo magareng ga ditheo tsa puso le tsa poraefete, e ga e na pelaelo gore tseno di ka kgona go samagana le dikgwetlho tse dintsi tse go tobanweng natso.
tgt: UMzantsi Africa ucela i-USA ukuba isicingisise esi sigqibo isithathileyo ibuyele kwakhona kwesi sivumelwano samazwe ngamazwe.

src: Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya 2017 go tswa kwa Mokgatlhong wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Kgothakgothe le Kopanokgothakgothe, o o tswelelang go balela Aforika Borwa mo maemong a a kwa godimo mo go tshwareleng mekete ya dikgwebo mo Dinageng tsa Aforika le mo Dinageng tsa Botlhabagare.
tgt: IsiVumelwano sokuQondana phakathi kukaNovartis, iBhunga loMzantsi Afrika loPhando ngezoNyango kunye neSebe lezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, siza kunceda ukwandisa umthamo nokuphucula umgangatho wamaphulo ophando ngezonyango futhi siqeqeshe abantu kwizakhono zezophando kweli lizwekazi.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswelela go nna e nngwe ya dinaga tse di itsegeng thata mo lefatsheng tsa bojanala mme e tswelela go balelwa kwa maemong a a kwa godimo mo Foramong ya Ikonomi ya Lefatshe mo Maetong a go eta leftshe ka bophara mmogo le mo go bapisiweng ga maemo a dikgaisanong tsa bojanala jaaka go phasaladitswe ka Moranang 2017.Kabinete e ka rata go bona tse dingwe tsa ditorotswana tsa Aforika Borwa di tsenela go ka nna baamogelabaeng ba dikopano tse dinnye moo ba ka kgonang go fitlhelela ditlhokwa tsa go nna baamogelabaeng.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano siza kunceda ukuba kuqhutywe amaphulo ophando ngokubambisana ngezifo ezithile ezosulelayo nezingosuleliyo, kuphuculwe indlela izigulane zoMzantsi Afrika eziwafumana ngayo amayeza aluncedo, nokwakha izakhono zezophando nophuhliso zeli lizwekazi.

src: Seno se tla kgontsha go tokafatsa go anama ga bojanala go feta ditikwatikwe tse dikgolo mmogo le go phasaladiwa ka go lekalekana merokotso e e tlisiwang ke go tshwarwa ga mekete eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikholelwa ukuba akhona namathuba okungena kwizivumelwano zentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente namashishini abucala, kwaye iqinisekile ukuba izivumelwano ezifana nezi zingaluncedo kakhulu ekusombululeni imingeni enzima emininzi esijamelene nayo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa go nna ba ntshitse matlho dinameng kgatlhanong le dikgang tseo e leng tsa maaka, bogolosegolo mo mafaratlhatlheng a ditlhaeletsano mabapi le basetsanyana le basadi ba ba latlhegileng, ba ba utswitsweng le ba ba thopilweng ka dikgoka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iNgxelo yowama-2017 yoMbutho weeNkomfa neeNggqungquthela zeHlabathi, ebeka uMzantsi Afrika kwiindawo ephezulu kumazwe okubamba imisitho yezoshishino e-Afrika nakuMbindi-Mpuma.
