src: Ditshitshinyo tsa pholisi eno le tsona, gare ga dilo tse dingwe tse dintsi, di samagana le merero ya go laola le go dirisana mmogo mo bojanaleng mo taolong ya pabalesego le phemelo mo phetolong ya botshwarateu mmogo le mo go rotloetseng tiriso ya didirisiwa tsa thekenoloji.
tgt: The continuation of essential food price monitoring is motivated by the need to ensure affordable and accessible essential food products for consumers.

src: Sekwalwa seno se ka fitlhelwa mo go: WEBTOKEPholisi ya Naga e e ka ga Metshameko ya mo Seraleng mmogo le Go Ja Leoto.1 Kabinete e neseditse pula Pholisi ya Naga e e ka ga Metshameko ya mo Seraleng mmogo le Go Ja Leoto.
tgt: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.

src: Maitlhomo a pholisi eno ke go tumola ka moodi tlhokotekatekano le go se tshwarwe ka go tshwana ga baagi e leng selo se se sa bolong go agelelwa mo ditheong tsa rona se se gatang ka mosito o le mongwe le wa tlhaolele le go tswalela mejako ya go iphedisa mo ditheong tsa metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le ya ditheo tsa go ja leoto.2 Maitlhomo a pholisi ke go tlhoma ponelopele le dipholisi tse di ka diragadiwang, go loga maano, go tla ka dikgato tse di tla latelwang go tsenya tirisong maano ano mmogo le go tlhagisa dinako tse ka tsona go tshwanetsweng go bo go garetswe go dira gore lephata la metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le go ja leoto le tswelele go nna teng le go nna le matlhagatlhaga mo diporofenseng tsotlhe di le robongwe tsa naga, mo badiragatsi ba metshameko ya mo seraleng mmogo le ba go ja leoto ba kgone go ipela mo go emeleng naga ya rona mo kontinenteng le mo lefatsheng ka bophara.
tgt: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.

src: Dipegelo tsa go Ela Tlhoko Maemo a Ditlhwatlhwa tsa Dijo tse di Botlhokwa.1 Khomišene e e Okameng Merero ya Dikgaisano tsa Dikgwebo e ntse e etse tlhoko maemo a ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo tse di botlhokwa go latela gore go nne le ditiragalo tsa go tlhatlosa ditlhwatlhwa ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa godimo e leng ditiragalo tse di simolotseng go iponagatsa fa go ne go nna le Ditiragalo tsa go Emisa Ditiro tsa ka ga Nageng ka Ntlha ya Masetlapelo ka Mopitlwe 20.2 Maitlhomo a go ela tlhoko ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo ke ka ntlha ya gore ka fa nageng bareki ba dijo ba tshwanetse go kgona go reka dijo tse di botlhokwa tse di rekegang e bile ga di a tshwanela go tlhaela.3 Khomišene e etse tlhoko maemo a a tlhatlogang ka lebelo le le bofefo mo ditlhwatlhwa di tlhatlogetseng ruri ka bonako mme gantsi tlhwatlhwa e di tlhatlogang ka yona e feta eo ba e dirisang fa ba reka dilo tseo ba di rekisang e bile ditlhwatlhwa tse ba rekileng ka tsona fa di fokotsega tseo ba rekisang ka tsona di fokotsega ka bonya.
tgt: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.

src: E nopotse gape le go tlalatlala ga dijo mo mebarakeng e e rekisang gore le seno ke se sengwe sa dilo tse di nang le seabe mo go seo se diragalang.4 Kabinete e nopotse dikgato tse di tshitshintsweng ke Khomišene mme di tsenyeletsa le dipatlisiso tse di dirilweng mo dimarakeng tseno go samagana le mamo a dimaraka tseno a e leng ona a a dirang gore ditlhwatlhwa di ye kwa godimo mme go se nne le batho ba le bantsi ba ba gaisanang le mabentlele ano a a tlhatlosang ditlhwatlhwa ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa godimo.5 Kabinete e dumetse gore Setlhopha sa Merero ya Ikonomi se tshwanetse go tsenya tirisong leano la go tseela ditlhwatlhwa tsa dijo dikgato, tsa go dira gore dijo di se tlhaele le gore go se nne le ope yo a palelwang ke go iponela dijo.
tgt: Ms Nosiphiwo Mzamo as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the State Diamond Trader.

src: Mme Nosiphiwo Mzamo o thapilwe go nna Mokaedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) wa Setlamo sa Tirelo ya Kgwebisano ya Puso ka Ditaemane.
tgt: Mr Loyiso Tyabashe as the CEO of the South African Nuclear Energy Corporation (reappointment).

src: Rre Loyiso Tyabashe o thapilwe go nna CEO wa Koporasi ya Motlakase wa Nyutlelia ya Aforika Borwa (o thapilwe sešwa).
tgt: Appointment of Non-Executive members to serve on the Ports Regulator Board for a period of three years.1 Mr Aubrey Ngcobo as the Chairperson.2 Ms Lauriette Lynne Sesoko.3 Adv.

src: Go thapiwa ga ditokololo tsa Maloko ao e Seng a Khuduthamaga mo Boto ya Taolo ya Maemelakepe sebaka sa dingwaga di le tharo:3.1 Rre Aubrey Ngcobo o thapilwe go nna Monnasetulo.2 Mme Lauriette Lynne Sesoko.3 Moatefokate Derrick Jeffrey Block.4 Mme Thembela Beryl Taboshe.5 Rre Abdul Qadir Chogle.6 Ngaka Percy Derrick Manzini.7 Mme Princess Mangoma.8 Mme Sizakele Makhanya.9 Mme Ntebaleng Rolland Setlako.10 Mme Marcia Xolisile Mkhari.11 Mme Leanda Marsha Mtshali – o thapilwe gape.
tgt: Derrick Jeffrey Block.4 Ms Thembela Beryl Taboshe.5 Mr Abdul Qadir Chogle.6 Dr Percy Derrick Manzini.7 Ms Princess Mangoma Ms Sizakele Makhanya.9 Ms Ntebaleng Rolland Setlako.10 Ms Marcia Xolisile Mkhari.11 Ms Leanda Marsha Mtshali – re-appointment.

src: Go thapiwa ga Bakaedi bao e Seng ba Khuduthamaga ba Boto ya Setheo sa Aforika Borwa sa Pabalesego ya kwa Mawatleng (SAMSA) sebaka sa dingwaga di le tharo.1 Rre Mahesh Fakir – Monnasetulo.2 Rre Tau Morwe – Motlatsamonnasetulo.3 Moatefokate Aurelia Nosipho Sobekwa.4 Ngaka Natalie Skeepers.5 Mme Nogolide Feziwe Nojozi.6 Rre Sihle NguseDitiragalo tse di Tlang.
tgt: Appointment of Non-Executive Directors of South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA) Board for a period of three years.1 Mr Mahesh Fakir – Chairperson.2 Mr Tau Morwe – Deputy Chairperson.3 Adv Aurelia Nosipho Sobekwa.4 Dr Natalie Skeepers Ms Nogolide Feziwe Nojozi.6 Mr Sihle NguseUpcoming events.

src: Kgwedi ya Ngwaoboswa.
tgt: Heritage Month.

src: Kgwedi ya ngwaoboswa e tla ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Re keteka pharologano ya ditso tsa rona ka fa nageng ya temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa”.
tgt: Heritage month will be celebrated under the theme: “Celebrating our cultural diversity in a democratic South Africa”.

src: Jaaka re tla bo re keteka lobebe lwa mefuta e e farologaneng ya ngwaoboswa ya rona, baagi ba rotloediwa go sola mosola Kgwedi ya Ngwaoboswa ka go dira gore setšhaba sa rona e nne seoposengwe.
tgt: Communities are urged to use Heritage Month in September to unite our nation, as we celebrate our nation’s rich heritage and diversity.

src: Kgwedi ya Ditirelo tsa Setšhaba (PSM).
tgt: Public Service Month (PSM).

src: Ba Ditirelo tsa Setšhaba ba tla keteka Kgwedi ya Ditirelo tsa Setšhaba go tloga ka la bo 1 go fitlha ka la bo 30 Lwetse 2023.
tgt: The Public Service will celebrate PSM between 1 and 30 September 2023.

src: Kgwedi eno e re gopotsa gore fa motho a direla setšhaba go raya goreng, mme e re naya tšhono ya go ipatla re ipatlisise gore badiredipuso ke eng se ba ka se dirang go nna mosola le go fetola matshelo a baagi mo setšhabeng.
tgt: The month serves as a reminder of what it is to serve, and offers us an opportunity to reflect on how public servants can impact and change the lives of communities.

src: Mokete wa monongwaga wa Beke ya Thusong Service Centre o tla tshwarwa go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 22 Lwetse 2023.
tgt: Thusong Service Centre Week This year’s Annual Thusong Service Centre Week will take place from 18 to 22 September 2023.

src: MaAforika Borwa a lalediwa go tla go ipatlela metseletsele ya ditirelo tse di farologaneng kwa mafelong a Thusong Service Centre a a leng gaufi nabo, jaaka mafelo ano e le mafelo a a tlisang gaufi le bona metseletsele ya ditirelo le tshedimosetso ya puso.
tgt: South Africans are invited to explore the array of services offered at their local Thusong Service Centre, which is a one-stop service point that brings government information and services closer to people.

src: Go bontsha tlotlo mo basading le banneng ba e leng bagale ba rona ba ba thutseng botala ka tlhogo ka ntlha ya ditiro tse ba neng ba di direla setšhaba, Mokete wa Letsatsi la Naga la go Keteka Mosola wa Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) o tla tshwarelwa kwa Union Buildings ka Latshipi wa la bo 3 Lwetse 2020.
tgt: National Police Commemoration Day In honour of our heroes and heroines who passed away in the line of duty, the South African Police Service’s National Commemoration Day will be held at the Union Buildings on Sunday, 3 September 2023.

src: Folaga ya naga e tla fokesediwa kwa tlase gona le ka gale go bontsha tlotlo ka letsatsi leno.
tgt: The National Flag will be flown at half-mast on the day of the event.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Messages.

src: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego:Mme Natasha Joubert, mmabontle yo a sa tswang go rweswa korone ya go nna Mmabontle wa Naga ya Aforika Borwa mo Ngwageng wa 2023, jaaka a simolola tiro ya gagwe ya go nna Mmabontle wa Naga ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: CongratulationsCabinet extends its congratulations and well-wishes to: Ms Natasha Joubert, the newly crowned Miss South Africa 2023, as she embarks on her reign as Miss South Africa.

src: Rre Brad Binder, yo a tswileng mo maemong a bobedi mo metshamekong ya mabelo a dijanaga a Austrian MotoGP.
tgt: Mr Brad Binder, who finished second at the Austrian MotoGThe Springboks for beating the All Blacks and wished them well in the forthcoming Rugby World CupIndia, for becoming the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon.

src: Kopanokakaretso ya Kokoano ya Dinagakopano (UNGA) Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke puo ya ga Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa kwa kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa New York, kwa Amerika go tloga ka la bo 18 go fitlha ka la bo 26 Lwetse 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele intetho kaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kwi-UNGA yama-78 nebibanjelwe e-New York, e-United States of America ukusuka ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-26 kweyoMsintsi ngowama-2023.

src: Puo ya ga Moporesitente e e neseditsweng pula ke botlhe e totobaditse maemo a naga ya Aforika Borwa mo go nneng le seabe mo go direng gore kontinente ya Aforika mmogo le dinaga ka kakaretso tse di leng kwa Borwa jwa Lefatshe dikgatlhegelo tsa tsona le go nneng le seabe ga tsona go sekegelwe mosako mo diforamong tsa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano (UN) mmogo le mo diforamong tse dingwe tsa dinaga tsa mafatshefatshe.
tgt: Intetho kaMongameli eyamkelwe ngokubanzi iphinde yaqinisekisa kwakhona isikhundla soMzantsi Afrika ekukhuthazeni umdla, kunye nasekuthatheni inxaxheba okulinganayo kwaye okunentsingiselo kwelizwekazi i-Afrika kunye namazwe akwi-Global South jikelele kwi-UN kunye nakwezinye iiforam zamazwe ngamazwe.

src: Puo eno gape e totobaditse le kemo ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le go bokeletsa kemonokeng mo:
tgt: Le ntetho ikwaphinde yaqinisekise ukuzinza koMzantsi Afrika ekuhlanganiseni inkxaso:a) ukuzinikela ngokutsha kumanyano lwamazwe ngamazwe, olusekwe kwimithetho ecacileyo kwaye exhaswa ngamaziko asebenzayo.

src: mererong e e ntšhwafaditsweng ya go ema nokeng bosetšhaba, mme seno se tla diriwa go ya ka melao e e tlhamaletseng e e engweng nokeng ke ditheo tse di mosola.
tgt: b) uhlaziyo lweBhunga lezoKhuseleko le-UN (i-UNSC), ukunika intsingiselo kumthetho-siseko wokulingana kwezizwe ezizimeleyo kunye nokwenza ukuba i-UNSC iphendule ngempumelelo kwizinto ezenzekayo ngoku kwiipolitiki zelizwe.

src: go rulaganyeng sešwa Lekgotla la Tshireletso la Dinagakopano (UNSC), go dira gore le nne le bokao jo bo sa tshwaneng le jwa mo nakong e e fetileng fa go tla mo go lekalekaneng ga maatla a dipuso tse di ipusang gore UNSC e kgone go tsibogela ka tshwanelo dikgwetlho tsa ga jaana tsa dipolotiki tsa dikgaolo.
tgt: c) izizwe ezityebileyo mazandise inkxaso mali ukuze kuphunyezwe i-Ajenda yama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo kunye nokufezekisa iinjongo zabo zokutshintsha kwemozulu ngendlela ebanzi kwaye edibeneyo, kubandakanywa nesidingo sokusebenza ngokukhawuleza kwengxowa-mali i-Loss and Damage Fund yamazwe asemngciphekweni wokuhlaselwa kakhulu yintlekele yemozulu, njengoko kwakuvunyelwene kwiSeshini yama-27 yeNkomfa yamaQela neyayibanjelwe e-Egypt ngeyeNkanga wama-2022.

src: go direng gore dinaga tse khumo ya tsona e tswang ka dinala e oketse matlole a go thusa go tsenya tirisong Mogopolo wa ngwaga wa 2030 wa Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo e e Nnelang Ruri gore go kgonwe go busetsa morago maemo a phetogo ya maemo a loapi ka mokgwa o o tshwaraganeng le o o utlwanetsweng, mmogo le botlhokwa jwa go tsenya tirisong Letlole la Ditatlhegelo le Ditshenyegelo go thusa dinaga tse di tlhokang tse di nang le ditshenyegelo tse dintsi tse di tlhodiwang ke phetogo ya maemo a loapi, go ya jaaka go dumelanwe mo kopanong ya bo 27 ya Khoferense ya Makoko e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Egepeto ka Ngwanaitseele 2022.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukuqinisekisile ukuzinikela koMzantsi Afrika ekuqhubekeni kujongana nokutshintsha kwemozulu kunye nokubeka eli lizwe njengenkokeli kumandla ahlaziyekayo, i-hydrogen eluhlaza kunye noshishino oluzinzileyo.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o totobaditse maikano a naga ya Aforika Borwa go tswelela go samagana le phetogo ya maemo a loapi le go dira gore naga e digoge kwa pele mo mererong ya motlakase wa go fetlhiwa ka ditsela tse dintšhwa, leokwane la gase le le sa kgotlheleng tikologo mmogo le mo go direng gore re nne le diintaseteri tse di sa phutlhameng.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathethe kwiNgqungquthela eQhubela Phambili ukuThintela, ukuLungela kunye nokuSabela kuBhubhani, kwisikhundla sakhe sobuNtshatsheli kuManyano lwama-Afrika ukuSabela kwiSifo seNtsholongwana i-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o atlhaatlhile gape le kgang ya go Atolosa Dikgato tsa go Thibela Maroborobo, ya Samiti ya go Ipaakanyetsa le go Samagana le ona, mo maemong a gagwe a Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU )jaaka a tseewa a Dirile Bontle mo go Samaganeng le Bolwetse jwa Mogare wa Leroborobo (COVID-19).
tgt: Inkqubo yamazwe amabini yoMzantsi Afrika esecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-7.

src: Letsholo la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Dikopano tsa Tirisanommogo Magareng ga Dinaga ka Bobedi tse di Tshwaretsweng ka fa Letlhakoreng kwa Kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA Ka fa Letlhakoreng kwa Kopanong ya bo 78 ya UNGA, Moporesitente Ramaphosa o ne a eteletse kwa pele Letsholo la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Dikopano tsa Tirisanommogo Magareng ga Dinaga ka Bobedi tseo maitlhomo a tsona e neng e le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo mo togong ya maano, dipolotiki, botipolomate le kgwebisano.
tgt: Ecaleni kwe-UNGA yama-78, uMongameli Ramaphosa ukhokele igqiza likarhulumente elibambe iintlanganiso ezininzi zamazwe amabini ezijolise ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane kubuchule, kwezopolitiko, kwezozakuzo kunye nakurhwebo.

src: Moporesitente o ne a tshwara kopano le Moporesitente ka ene wa naga ya Ukrain, Volodymyr Zelensky, mo ba tšhotlhileng kgang ya gore Letsholo la Barongwa ba Kontinente ya Aforika go Buisanela Kagiso le Dinaga tse di leng mo Ntweng le tsamaya kae mo go tleng ka ditharabololo mmogo le go buisanela le dintlha tse dingwe.
tgt: UMongameli udibene nogxa wakhe wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky ukuze baxoxe ngenkqubela phambili eyenziwayo kwiNyathelo lwase-Afrika loXolo - olukhokelwa ngamanyathelo okwakha ukuzithemba kunye nolunye uphuhliso.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o kopane gape le:2.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwadibene no:2.

src: Moporesitente Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wa naga ya Türkiye, mabapi le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Turkey, mmogo le go tsopolelana ka merero ya letsholo la go buisanela kagiso magareng ga naga ya Russia le ya Ukraine.
tgt: Mongameli Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wase-Türkiye, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Turkey, kunye nokwazisana ngamaphulo oxolo kungquzulwano oluphakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.

src: Moporesitente Bola Tinubu wa naga ya Federal Republic of Nigeria, mabapi le go gagamatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Nigeria.
tgt: Mongameli Bola Tinubu we-Federal Republic of Nigeria, malunga nokuqinisa ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-Nigeria.

src: o ne gape a tsopolelwa tshedimosetso e e ka ga seo se setseng se dirilwe mo letsholong la Mererong ya Ikonomi le le eteletsweng kwa pele ke Dinaga tsa Bophirima jwa Aforika, mo go rarabololeng matsapa a menolopuso e e dirilweng kwa nageng ya Niger mmogo le dikgato tsotlhe tse go samaganweng natso mo go busetseng molao we temokerasi kwa karolong ya Sahel.
tgt: Uye wafumana ezihlaziyiweyo malunga nenyathelo loQoqosho lwaMazwe aseNtshona Afrika elikhokelwa lubhukuqo-mbuso e-Niger kunye neenzame ngokubanzi zokubuyisela ulawulo lwentando yesininzi e-Sahel.

src: Moporesitente Emmerson Mnangagwa wa naga ya Rephaboliki ya Zimbabwe, mabapi le maiteko a Zimbabwe mo go direng gore maemo kwa nageng a boele sekeng go latela gore naga eno mo malobeng e tshware ditlhopho tse di neng di sena merusu.
tgt: Mongameli Emmerson Mnangagwa weRiphabhlikhi yaseZimbabwe, kumalinge karhulumente waseZimbabwe okuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa ngokutsha kwela lizwe emva kolonyulo olunemvisiswano lwakutsha nje.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa o ne gape a tsaya karolo le mo kopanong ya magareng ga naga ya Aforika Borwa le Amerika mabapi le Kgwebisano le Dipeeletso, mo go neng go le baeteledipele ba dikgwebo ba dinaga ka bobedi.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa ukwathathe inxaxheba kwiNgxoxo yoShishino ngezoRhwebo kunye noTyalo-mali lweMelika (i-US) noMzantsi Afrika, equka iinkokeli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika kunye nezaseMelika.

src: Jaaka ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa go na le dikgwebo di feta di le 6 000 tsa Amerika, go ne go le botlhokwa gore dipuisano tseno di tshwarwe gore tirisanommogo ya dinaga tseno e kgone go tswelela go gagamala.
tgt: Ngeenkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza eMzantsi Afrika, olu thethathethwano lwalubalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwane phakathi koMzantsi Afrika kunye ne-UNgeli xesha, kwenziwa isaziso esisesikweni sokuba iForam yama-20 ye-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum, (iForam ye-AGOA) iza kubanjelwa eRhawutini ukusuka ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowesi-4 kweyeNkanga wama-2023.

src: Mo pakeng eno go ne ga ntshiwa tsiboso e e tlhamaletseng ya gore Kopano ya Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA) ya bo 20 e e ka ga Amerika le Dinaga tsa Borwa e tla tshwarelwa kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023.
tgt: Le foram iza kuphinda ibe nomboniso othi ‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ oza kubonisa amakhonkco ewonke eemveliso zommandla kwilizwekazi.

src: Mo foramong eno go tla tlhagisiwa gape le 'Dipontsho tsa Dilo tse di Dirilweng ka fa Kontinenteng ya Aforika' mme tsona di tla bontsha ka fao kgaolo ya kontinente e nang le dilo tse di botlhokwa mo ikonoming.
tgt: UMongameli Ramaphosa uphinde wangqina isibhengezo sentsebenziswano phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk kunye ne-Aspen.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphos gape o ne a le teng ga go diriwa kitsiso ya gore setlamo sa Novo Nordisk le sa Aspen di tla dirisana mmogo.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano iza kubona ukuveliswa kweyeza leswekile (i-insulin) kwiziko le-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpuma Koloni.

src: Tirisanommogo eno e tla dira gore melemo ya go lwantshana le bolwetse jwa tshukiri e diriwe kwa femeng ya Aspen e e leng kwa Gqeberha, kwa porofesneng ya Kapa Botlhaba.
tgt: Le ntsebenziswano ijolise ekuboneleleni ngamathamo eyeza leswekile angaphezulu kwe-16 lezigidi ngowama-2024, neza kunyuswa ngowama-2026.

src: Tirisanommogo eno e tla dira gore go tlhagisiwe melemo ya go lwantshana le bolwetse jwa tshukiri e feta dimilione di le 16 mo ngwageng wa 2024, mme palo eno e tla tlhatlosiwa gape mo ngwageng wa 2026.
tgt: Oku kuya kuphucula kakhulu ufikelelo kunyango lweswekile, kungapheleli nje eMzantsi Afrika, kodwa nakwilizwekazi liphela.

src: Seno se tla oketsa tota palo ya melemo eno gore e kgone go lekana balwetse ba ba e tlhokang e seng fela ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme gape le go ralala le kontinente ka bophara.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukunikwa koMlawuli wezaMandla weSizwe woMzantsi Afrika izicelo zempepha-mvume zokurhweba kunye nokungenisa/ukuthumela ngaphandle kwiNkampani yeSizwe yoThumelo lwezaMandla yoMzantsi Afrika, kuvulwa indlela yokuthengwa kwamandla kuwo wonke ummandla.

src: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke dikgato tsa Setheo sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa sa Taolo ya Merero ya Motlakase tsa go neela Setlamo sa Naga ya Aforika Borwa sa go Reka Motlakase tetla ya go reka le go rekisa motlakase, mme seno se bulela setlamo seno dikgoro tsa go ka reka motlakase go tswa kwa dinageng tsotlhe tsa kgaolo.
tgt: Ukusebenza kwakhona kwesiKhululo soMbane saseKusile Yunithi yesi-4 kulungiso olucwangcisiweyo noluthe lwabuyisa iimegawathi ezingama-800 kuthungelwano lwethu lombane.

src: Go busediwa tirong ga Yuniti ya Bone ya Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile, e e neng e baakanngwa, go busetsa tirong motlakase o o kana ka dimekawate di le 800 mo diyuniting tsa tlamelo ya motlakase.
tgt: Esi siganeko singundoqo ekuphuculeni umthamo wokuvelisa uthungelwano lwesizwe kunye nasekukhawulelaneni namaxesha okucinywa kombane.

src: Kgato eno e botlhokwa thata mo go tokafatseng maemo a tlhagisong ya motlakase mo diyuniting tsa ka fa nageng tsa tlamelo ya motlakase mmogo le mo go samaganeng le ditiragalo tsa motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yachazelwa ngenkqubela yokubuyisela iYunithi yoku-1, yesi-2 kunye neyesi-3 kwiSikhululo soMbane iKusile phambi kwexesha elimiselweyo.

src: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gape le ka dikgato tse di setseng di dirilwe mo go busetseng tirong pele ga nako yuniti ya bo 1, 2 le ya bo 3 tsa Seteišene sa Motlakase sa Kusile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamkele izinga elizinzileyo lika-Eskom elenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, nto leyo eza kuphucula ukufaneleka kwetyala leli ziko lombane lize likwazi ukucwangcisa kwangaphambili ukuphumeza ulungiso olucetyiweyo lwezithuthi zalo zokuvelisa.

src: Go se Felelwe ke Metsi.
tgt: Ukufumaneka kwamanzi.

src: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka dikgato tse di tserweng go leka go rarabolola dikgwetlho tsa metsi tse di amang mafelo a le mantsinyana ka fa nageng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi malunga namalinge okujongana nemingeni yamanzi nechaphazela iindawo ezininzi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Tona ya Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, Rre Senzo Mchunu mmogo le Dimeyara tsa tse dingwe tsa diteropo tse dikgolo kwa Gauteng ba tla ema baagi ka lefoko go ba itsise gore ke eng se se diriwang go samagana le tlamelo ya metsi a a tshabetseng ruri mo porofenseng eno.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezaManzi noGutyulo, uMnu Senzo Mchunu kunye noosodolophu abalawulayo kwezinye zezixeko zaseRhawutini baza kubonelela ngohlaziyo longenelelo oluqhubekayo lokuzinzisa ukuhanjiswa kwamanzi kweli phondo.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe go gakologelwa gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya dinaga tse di senang metsi go le kalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inqwenela ukukhumbuza wonke umntu ukuba uMzantsi Afrika lilizwe elinqongophelelwe ngamanzi.

src: MaAforika Borwa mmogo le botlhe ba ba leng ka fa nageng ba tshwanetse go somarela metsi le go se a dirise botlhaswa.
tgt: Bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye naye wonke umntu okweli lizwe kufuneka onge kwaye asebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.

src: Merero ya Kgwebisano.
tgt: Imiba yezorhwebo.

src: Kopano ya Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga (BNC) mmogo le Setlhopha sa Ditona tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Lesotho.
tgt: IKomishoni yeZizwe eziManyeneyo eziMbini yoMzantsi Afrikane-Lesotho (i-BNC) kunye neNtlanganiso yeQela laBaphathiswa.1 INtlanganiso ye-BNC yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho kunye neQela laBaphathiswa ebibanjwe ukusuka ngomhla wama-25 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023 igxile kwintsebenziswano yezoqoqosho, kwimiba yokuwela imida, kunye nokuhamba ngokukhululekileyo kwabantu, iimpahla neenkonzo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.2 UMongameli Ramaphosa kunye neNkulumbuso u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane baza kujongana neSeshoni yokuQalwa kwe-BNC phakathi koMzantsi Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, umhla wama-28 kweyoMsintsi 2023.

src: Kopano ya Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga (BNC) mmogo le Setlhopha sa Ditona tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Lesotho e tshwerwe go tloga ka la bo 25 go fitlha ka la bo 28 Lwetse 2023 e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo go dirisaneng mmogo mo mererong ya ikonomi, ya go kgabaganya melelwane, mmogo le mo go letleleleng baagi le dithoto go kgabaganya melelwane ya dinaga ka bobedi ntle le tshitiso epe.
tgt: I-BNC iza kubandakanya ubudlelwane kwezozakuzo, kukhuselo nokhuseleko, amanzi, ezothutho, umbane kunye nakwezorhwebo.2 UPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.1IKhabhinethi ifumene ingxelo evela kwiKomishoni yoKhuphiswano malunga neziphumo kunye namanyathelo okulungisa malunga noPhando lweNtengiso kwiQonga elikwi-Intanethi.

src: Moporesitente Ramaphosa mmogo le Tonakgolo ya naga ya Lesotho e bong Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane e tla nna badulasetilo mo kopanong e e ka ga Dintlo tsa Barongwa ba Dinaga tsa Aforika Borwa le Lesotho ka Labone wa la bo 28 Lwetse 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuncomile umsebenzi wekhomishini ekujonganeni neenkxalabo kumaqonga edijithali, kubandakanywa urhwebo lwe-ecommerce, ii-arhente zokuhamba ezikwi-intanethi, ukuhanjiswa kokutya, iivenkile ze-app, ababoneleli abakhethiweyo kunye neenjini zokukhangela.2 IKhabhinethi iyalele abaPhathiswa bamasebe karhulumente achaphazelekayo ukuba aqhubele phambili athethathethane ngezindululo zokuphucula, baqwalasele iziphumo zomgaqo-nkqubo baze benze utshintsho oluyimfuneko kumgaqo-nkqubo, oluya kunceda abantu baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngokufanelekileyo kunye namashishini amancinci naphakathi kushishino olukhulayo olenziwa nge-intanethi.

src: Mo kopanong eno go tla tšhotlhiwa merero e e ka ga tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga, ditirelo tsa sesole le tsa pabalesego, metsi, dipalangwa, motlakase le kgwebisano.
tgt: Umkhuhlane weentaka IKhabhinethi iqaphele uqhambuko lwangoku loMkhuhlane obangela izifo (i-HPAI) H5 kunye ne-H7 kushishino lweenkukhu eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e rometswe pegelo go tswa kwa go Khomišene e e Okameng Merero ya Dikgaisano tsa Dikgwebo e e ka ga tseo e di ribolotseng mmogo le ditharabololo tsa tsona mo Dipatlisisong tse di ka ga go Tsenya Letsogo mo Diraleng tsa go Rekisa mo Inthaneteng.
tgt: INtshona Koloni kunye neKwaZulu-Natal ziye zafumana ukuqhambuka kwe-HPAI H5 ngelixa i-HPAI H7 iye yachazwa kumaphondo iRhawutini, i-Limpopo, iMpumalanga kunye naseMntla Ntshona.

src: Kabinete e rolela hutshe tiro e e dirilweng ke khomišene eno mo go samaganeng le matsapa a go paralela dikgwebo tsotlhe ga dikgwebo tse dingwe mo diraleng tseno, go akatsetsa le dirala tse di supetsang bareki koo ba ka rekang gone, dirala tse di rekisang ditlhagisiwa, dirala tsa inthanete tse di rekisang mareu ka go rulaganyetsa bao ba tsayang maeto dithulaganyo tsa dinamelwa tse ba tla di dirisang, dirala tse di tlisetsang bareki dijo ba le kwa ba leng gone, dirala tse di rekisang diepe, dirala tse di rekisang ditirelo tse di itlhophileng mmogo le dirala tsa go batla dilo mo inthaneteng.
tgt: Amanyathelo okulawula ukusasazeka koku kuqhambuka akhona kwaye amafama ayakhuthazwa ukuba athathele ingqalelo amanyathelo amiselweyo okhuseleko lwendalo.

src: Kabinete e laetse Ditona tse di maleba go sala morago ditshitshinyo tse di dirilweng gore maemo a tle a nolofale, go atlhaatlha seo pholisi e ka se dirang mmogo le go tsaya dikgato tse di maleba go baakanya pholisi gore e tle e kgontshe gore maAforika Borwa a a nang le dikgwebopotlana, tse dikgolwane le tse dikgolo a tle a nne le seabe se se utlwagalang mo dikgwebong tse di golang tsa inthanete.
tgt: Uqhambuko lubeka imingcipheko yokhuseleko lokutya kwaye amanyathelo orhwebo okungenisa elizweni ukuze kulawulwe ukufumaneka kwamaqanda kunye nenyama yenkukhu anokuphunyezwa.

src: Kabinete e tsibositswe ka Malwetse a a Tshelanang a Mokgotlhwane wa Dikgogo (HPAI) H5 le H7 a a aparetseng leruo la dikgogo ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: ISebe lezoLimo, uHlengahlengiso loMhlaba noPhuhliso lwasemaPhandleni, uGunyaziwe woLawulo lweeMveliso zezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika kunye noshishino baphonononga izicelo zokubhaliswa kwamayeza okugonya anokubakho, ezi namanyathelo okuthotyelwa kwezinto ezinxulumene nokhuseleko, ukusebenza kakuhle kunye nomgangatho zezona zinto zibalulekileyo ekubhalisweni kwezitofu zokugonya.

src: Porofense ya Kapa Bophirima mmogo le ya KwaZulu-Natal di wetswe ke bolwetse jwa HPAI H5 fa HPAI H7 yona e begilwe kwa diporofenseng tsa Gauteng, Limpopo, Mpumalanga le Bokone Bophirima.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo yakutsha yokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho, nethe yanikwa isizwe nguMphathiswa wamaPolisa, uNjengele Bheki Cele, kunye neCandelo leSizwe lokuSebenza okuDityanelweyo nobuNtlola.

src: Go setse go tsentswe dikgato tirisong go ka samagana le go thibela go anama ga malwetse ano mme barui ba rotloediwa gore ba obamele dikgato tsa go thibela malwetse ano.
tgt: Iphulo leendidi ngeendidi malunga nokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni kunye nofuduko eMntla Koloni kukhokelele ekubanjweni kwabantu abangama-867, uninzi lwabo lusuka e-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kunye nabemi abathile boMzantsi Afrika.

src: Bolwetse jono bo dira gore go nne le tlhaelo ya dijo le dikgwebo di retelelwa ke go rekisetsa dinaga tse dingwe mae a go thuthusa ditsuane, mae a go jewa le dinama tsa kgogo go tswa ka fa nageng.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise uluvo lwee-arhente zogcino-mthetho lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika abagcine abaphuli-mthetho ababandakanyeka kwizenzo zokombiwa kwemigodi ngokungekho mthethweni baya kujongana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Lefapha la Temothuo, Pusetsomafatshe le Tlhabololo ya Metsemagae, Setheo sa Taolo ya Melemo ya Boitekanelo ya Aforika Borwa mmogo le intaseteri eno ba samagane le dithulaganyo tsa go dira kopo ya go kwadisa meento e e ka dirisiwang mo bolwetseng jono, mme merero ya go obamela melao ya pabalesego, kalafo le boleng ke tsona dikarolo tse di botlhokwa mo go kwadiseng meento eno.
tgt: Iimeko zemozulu ezimbi kakhulu zelizwe zigxininisa ifuthe lokutshintsha kwemozulu kubomi bethu kunye nesidingo sokuthatha amanyathelo azinzileyo okuphelisa ikhabhoni kuqoqosho lwethu ngelixa sizama uphuhliso oluzinzileyo.

src: Go Tshwaraganela go Lwantshana le Bosenyi Kabinete e neseditse pula tshedimosetso ya go e baya mo dinakong e e ka ga dikgato tsa go lwantshana le bosenyi, e Tona ya Mapodisi, Bheki Cele, a neelaneng ka yona mo setšhabeng mmogo le Setlhopha sa Maphata a a Farologaneng a Naga a go Lwantshana le Bosenyi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaziswa ngomonakalo obangelwe zizaqhwithi ezimandla kunye nezikhukula ezise Mpuma Koloni, eNtshona Koloni kunye naseRhawutini, nto leyo ebonisa ukuba oku kunganwenwa nakwamanye amaphondo.3 IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuluntu ukuba luhlale luphaphile kwaye lujonge izilumkiso ezingakumbi zemozulu, nezinokuzisa umonakalo ongakumbi kwilizwe liphela.

src: Letsholo la go lwantshana le bosenyi le le tshwaraganetsweng ke ditheo tse di farologaneng tsa molao kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Bokone le le samaganeng le bogodu jwa dirašwa tsa meepo le kgonne go ka tshwara batho ba le 867, mme bontsi jwa bona bo tswa kwa nageng ya Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mozambique mmogo le ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhubeka nokuxhasa iinkonzo zongxamiseko kunye namaziko olawulo lweentlekele ukulungiselela imisebenzi yokuhlangula kunye nokubonelela ngenkxaso kuluntu.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa mafoko a ditheo tsa molao gore maAforika Borwa a a fitlhang ditlhokotsebe tse di amegang mo bogodung jwa dirašwa tsa meepo ba tla di gama ba sa di tlhapela.
tgt: I-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuthiywa ngokutsha kwe-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton ukuba ibe yi-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengenyathelo elibalulekileyo lokubhala ngokutsha imbali yoMzantsi Afrika ukuze ibonise igalelo labo babesilwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Maemo a a bogale a dipula ka fa nageng a bontsha gore re mo dinakong tsa phetogo ya maemo a loapi mmogo le gore go tlhokagala gore go tsewe dikgato tsa go fedisa kgotlhelo ya loapi mo ditirong tsa ikonomi ntle le go kgaotsa tlhabololo e e tsepameng.
tgt: Lo mnyhadala ubungqamene nomhla wokuzalwa kuka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMsintsi 2023.Izigqibo zeKhabhinethiISicwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kabinete e beewa mo dinakong ka dipula le merwalela e e gogotseng mafelo kwa porofenseng ya Kapa Botlhaba, Kapa Bophirima le Gauteng, mme go na le kgonagalo ya gore ditshenyegelo tseno di tla aparela le diporofense tse dingwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa kwesiCwangciso-qhinga esiHlaziyiweyo seNyama yeeNyamakazi eMzantsi Afrika, esijonge ukumisela ngokusesikweni kunye nokuguqula ishishini lenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go ntsha matlho dinameng fa go na le melaetsa e e ka ga dipula tse di bogale, tse di ka senyetsang pele ka fa nageng.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijolise ekuqiniseni icandelo lenyama yenyamakazi njengomboneleli wokufumaneka kokutya kunye necandelo lohlumo kuqoqosho elinokunceda ekudaleni imisebenzi.

src: Puso e tswelela go ema nokeng ditirelo tsa tshoganyetso mmogo le ditikwatikwe tsa taolo ya masetlapelo gore di kgone go thusa ba ba leng mo tlalelong mmogo le go tswa baagi thuso ka ditlamelwana tse ba di tlhokang.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika ubekwe kwindawo yokuqala kwilizwekazi i-Afrika ngenxa yemveliso yenyama yenyamakazi.

src: Winnie Mandela Avenue Kabinete e neseditse pula kgato ya go fetola leina la mmila wa William Nicol Drive kwa teropong ya Sandton go o neela leina la Winnie Mandela Avenue jaaka e tsaya seno e le kgato e kgolo mo hisetoring ya naga ya Aforika Borwa ka go dira gore bao ba nnileng le seabe se se botlhokwa mo kgaratlhelong ya kgololesego maina a bona a tlhagelele ka magetla.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sijonge ukuqinisekisa ukudalwa kwemisebenzi engama-202 666 ezinzileyo kushishino lwenyama yenyamakazi ngowama-2030.

src: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Leano le le Kwalolotsweng Sešwa la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Nama ya Diphologolo tsa Naga Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa gore go tsenngwe tirisong Leano le le Kwalolotsweng Sešwa la Naga ya Aforika Borwa la Nama ya Diphologolo tsa Naga, mme maitlhomo a lona ke go dira gore intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga e tsenngwe tirisong semmuso mmogo le go fetola intaseteri eno.
tgt: Isicwangciso-qhinga siya kupapashwa kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lamaHlathi, ezokuLoba nokusiNgqongileyo ku: www.

src: Aforika Borwa ke yona e e di gogang kwa pele ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika fa go tla mo nameng ya diphologolo tsa naga.
tgt: IsiCwangciso esiPhambili seCandelo lezoKhenketho.

src: Leano leno le ikaeletse go tlhola ditiro di ka nna 202 666 tse di tla nnelang ruri mo lephateng la intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga mo ngwageng wa 2030.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukulungelelaniswa kwesiCwangciso sokuBuyisela iCandelo lezoKhenketho kwisiCwangciso esiPhambili soKhenketho esitsha.

src: Leano leno le tla phasaladiwa mo webesaeteng ya Lefapheng la Merero ya Dikgwa, Botshwaro jwa Ditlhapi le ya Tikologo mo go: WEBTOKELeanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bapisa Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le Leanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala.
tgt: Inxalenye nebalulekileyo yesiCwangciso esiPhambili kukunciphisa iimpembelelo zobhubhani we-COVID-19 kwicandelo lezokhenketho.

src: Karolo e e botlhokwa ya leanokonokono leno ke go samagana le ditlamorago tsa leroborobo la COVID-19 mo lephateng la bojanala.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngemephu yendlela yokubuyisela ngokupheleleyo ukhenketho elizweni.

src: Le thusa gape le gore naga e itharabologelwe ka botlalo mo lephateng la bojanala.
tgt: Nangona iSicwangciso soBuyisela seCandelo lezoKhenketho saphuhliswa ukuququzelela ukuchacha ngcono kweli candelo, ukugcina imisebenzi kunye nokukhusela iindlela zokuphila, esi Sicwangciso siPhambili siya kuwuthatha lo msebenzi siwuse kwelinye inqanaba kwaye siququzelele amathuba amatsha kweli candelo.

src: Fela jaaka maitlhomo a Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le ne le logetswe go thusa go tsosolosa lekala leno, go somarela ditiro le ditsela tse batho ba iphedisang ka tsona, Leanokonokono leno le logetswe go tsweletsa pele tiro ya leano leno ka go dira gore go nne le ditšhono tse dintšhwa mo lekaleng leno.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siphakamisa izicwangciso-qhinga zongenelelo ezisixhenxe ukuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lezokhenketho libuyela kwiintsuku zalo zodumo, kwanokuba libe liziko lokudala imisebenzi kunye noshishino.

src: Leano leno le tshitshinya dikgato di le supa go thusa go busetsa lekala la bojanala mo maemong a le neng le le mo go ona mo motsing yoo botshelo bo neng bo itobetsa, mme le dira gore lekala leno le nne botlhokwa mo go tlholeng ditiro le mo go itshimololeleng dikgwebo.
tgt: Ishishini lezokhenketho linegalelo elibalulekileyo kuqoqosho kwaye lalixhase imisebenzi engama-725 000 phambi kobhubhani we-COVID-19.

src: Intaseteri ya bojanala e na le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo ikonoming, mme pele ga leroborobo la COVID-19 e ne e eme nokeng ditiro di le 725 000.
tgt: Imithetho eYilwayoUMthetho oYilwayo weQumrhu loSasazo laseMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) wama-2023.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Lekgotlakgaso la Aforika Borwa (SABC) wa Ngwaga wa 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho oYilwayo we-SABC wama-2023.

src: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng Molaotlhomo wa SABC wa 2023.
tgt: Wakuba upasisiwe ube ngumthetho, lo Mthetho uYilwayo uya kukhokelela ekurhoxisweni koMthetho woSasazo okhoyo ngoku, we-1999 (uMthetho wesi-4 we-1999).

src: Fa molaotlhomo ono o sena go fetisiwa go ka nna molao wa semmuso, o tla tsena mo legatong la molao wa ga jaana o o bidiwang Molao wa Kgaso wa ngwaga wa 1999 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1999).
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuqinisa ukusebenza kakuhle kosasazo loluntu.

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla dira gore ditiro tsa setheo sa kgaso di nne tse di manontlhotlho.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwaphakamisa iinguqu kwindlela yenkxaso-mali ye-SABC kunye nenkqubo yokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zikamabonakude.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o dira gape le ditshitshinyo mo mererong e e ka ga tlamelo ya SABC ka matlole mmogo le mo go ya dithulaganyo tsa dilaensense tsa thelebišene.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zaManzi ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Maitlhomomagolo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go gagamatsa dikgato tsa go nna le maikarabelo ga batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi mmogo le go dira gore mo lephateng leno go se nne mahunelo.
tgt: Iinjongo eziphambili zalo Mthetho uYilwayo kukuqinisa ukuphendula kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi kunye nokwazisa ukungafihlwa kwezinto.

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa mo Molaong wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi wa ngwaga wa 1997 (Molao wa bo 108 wa 1997) di tla dira bonnete jwa gore batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba abelane ka metsi a maemo a ona a leng boleng jo bo kwa godimo jaaka seno e tla nna karolo ya ditlhokwa tse di beewang mo tumelanong ya go ba neela dilaesense.
tgt: Izihlomelo kuMthetho weeNkonzo zaManzi, wowe-1997 (uMthetho we-108 wowe-1997) ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba ababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi bahambisa amanzi akumgangatho ophezulu njengenxalenye yemiqathango yabo yokufumana iimpepha-mvume.4Ezi zihlomelo ziza kujongana nobuthathaka obuthe bachongwa kwicandelo leenkonzo zamanzi.

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa tseno di tla thusa gape le go tswalela makoa a a nopotsweng mo lekaleng la ditirelo tsa metsi.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubeka imigangatho emincinane yokusebenza kwababoneleli ngeenkonzo zamanzi, nekufuneka inyanzeliswe ngabasemagunyeni beeNkonzo zaManzi.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o tlhoma maemo a batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba tshwanetsweng go itepatepanya nao, mme tiro ya go netefatsa gore go itepatepanngwa nao e rwele ke magetla a Setheo sa Ditirelo tsa Metsi.
tgt: UMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe.

src: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa koMthetho-siHlomelo oYilwayo waManzi weSizwe ukuze uluntu luhlomle.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o kwalola sešwa Molao wa Metsi a Naga wa ngwaga wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 36 wa 1998).
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho waManzi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-36 we-1998).

src: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla thusa go tokafatsa melawanataolo ya metsi mmogo le go dira bonnete jwa gore metsi a naga a tlhokomelwa ka tshwanelo, a sirelediwa mmogo le go somarelwa.
tgt: Ezi zihlomelo ziza kuphucula imimiselo kwaye ziza kuqinisekisa ukuba imithombo yamanzi yelizwe ilawulwa kakuhle, iyakhuselwa kwaye iyongiwa.

src: Molaotlhomo ono o dira ditshitshinyo tsa gore go fedisiwe go tlhoka tekatekano go go tlhodilweng ke ditiragalo tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tse di ka ga kabelo ya metsi, mme o tshitshinya gore go nne le dikgato tse di matlhagatlhaga tsa go rarabolola ka bonako dikgogakgogano tse di nnang teng magareng ga ditheo tse di dirisanang mmogo.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo wenza izindululo zokuphelisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili ngokunxulumene nokwabiwa kwamanzi, kwaye ubonelela ngeendlela ezisebenzayo nezikhawulezayo zokusombulula iingxabano zangaphakathi.

src: Go Thapiwa Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.
tgt: IzikhundlaZonke izithuba zengqesho zixhomekeke ekungqinisisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuseleko.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa Monongwaga Kgwedi ya go Keteka Dipalangwa e tla ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Re a Aga - Re aga mafaratlhatlha a a botoka thata gore Aforika Borwa e kgone go gola”.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yalo nyaka iza kukhunjulwa phantsi komxholo othi: “Siyakha - Sakha iziseko ezingundoqo ezingcono ukukhulisa uMzantsi Afrika”.

src: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa ya ngwaga wa 2023 e tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo dipeeletsong tse dikgolo mo lephateng la mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa, mmogo le mo go direng boikuelo jwa gore mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa a tlhokomelwe gore a se utswiwe le go phutlhamisiwa.
tgt: INyanga yezoThutho yowama-2023 iza kugxila kutyalo-mali olukhulu kwiziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho, kwaye ihlaba ikhwelo lokuba kukhuselwe iziseko ezingundoqo zezothutho kubusela kunye nasekonakalisweni.

src: Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla keteka mmogo le lefatshe ka bophara Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana ka Labone wa la bo 05 Diphalane 2023 ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Barutabana ba re ba tlhokang go tlisa thuto e re e batlang: dikgato tse di botlhokwa tsa lefatshe ka bophara tsa go dira gore barutabana ba se tlhaele”.Maitlhomo a letsatsi leno ke go lemosa setšhaba, go dira gore se tlhaloganye le go lemoga botlhokwa jo barutabana ba nang le bona mo thutong le mo go tliseng tlhabologo lefatshe ka bophara.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kujoyina ihlabathi liphela ekubhiyozeleni uSuku looTitshala lweHlabathi ngoLwesine, umhla wesi-5 kweyeDwarha 2023, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ootitshala esibadingayo kwimfundo esiyifunayo: Kunyanzelekile kwihlabathi jikelele ukunciphisa ukunqongophala kootitshala”.

src: Letsatsi leno le utlawnetswe mmogo ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso go keteka tiro e e botlhokwa e barutabana ba rona ba e dirang.
tgt: Olu suku lujolise ekukhuliseni ulwazi, ukuqonda kunye nokuxabisa igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elenziwa ngootitshala kwimfundo nakuphuhliso kwihlabathi jikelele.

src: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego kwa go: Rre Bheki Cele, Tona ya Mapodisi, yo a abetsweng Metale wa Tlotlo wa Great Wall go tswa kwa nageng ya China mabapi le go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo Tirelong ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) mo go dirisaneng le ditheong ka bontsi tsa molao tse di dirisanang le dinaga ka bobedi.
tgt: Olu suku lubhengezwe ngokubambisene noMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi kunye noMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye neNkcubeko ukubhiyozela umsebenzi obalulekileyo owenziwa ngootitshala bethu.

src: Mme Angie Motshekga, Tona ya Thuto ya Motheo, jaaka a tlhophilwe ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa UN Rre Antonio Guterres, gore a nne yo mongwe wa baeletsi ba gagwe ba bagolo mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng ba ba mo eletsang ka fao dinaga di ka fetolang ka gone dithulaganyo tsa tsona tsa thuto.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba:UNjengele Bheki Cele, uMphathiswa wamaPolisa, ofumene iMbasa ye-Great Wall Commemorative evela e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo leNkonzo yamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika kwintsebenziswano ebanzi yokuthotyelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Go tlhophiwa ga Tona Motshekga mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng go supa kitso e e tseneletseng e a nang le yona mo thutong e bile seno ke sesopu sa go bontsha tshepo mo dikgatong tsa thuto tse Aforika Borwa e di WEBTOKEN setlhopheng seno go na le baemedi go tswa kwa Mokgatlhong wa Lefatshe wa Badiri, Setlhopha sa Barutabana sa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso, Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Ditona di le tharo tsa Thuto.
tgt: UNks Angie Motshekga, uMphathiswa weMfundo esiSiseko, ekukhethweni kwakhe nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu Antonio Guterres, ukuba asebenze kwi-Global High-Level Panel ukumcebisa ngendlela amazwe angaziguqula ngayo iinkqubo zawo zemfundo.

src: Disetudio tsa kwa Motse Kapa tsa Metshameko ya Difilimi, batshameko ba ka fa nageng mmogo le bao ba diragatsang ditiro tse di masisi mo legatong la batshameki, jaaka ba dirile bontle mo Metshamekong ya ditshwatsho tsa Netflix, mo setshwantsho sa One Piece, se tlhatlogetseng kwa maemong a ntlha a a kwa godimo a setshwantsho se se bogelwang ga jaana ke batho ba bantsi mo diraleng tse di gasang ditshwantsho tse di bogelwang.
tgt: Ukukhethwa kukaMphathiswa u-Motshekga kwiphaneli yomgangatho ophezulu kubonisa inqanaba lobuchule bakhe kwinkalo yezemfundo kwaye kubonakalisa ukuthemba indlela eqhuba ngayo imfundo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Setlamo sa go titiela dinotagi sa Van Ryn's, jaaka kwa moletlong wa ngwaga wa 2023 wa dikgaisana tsa dinotagi o o neng o tshwaretswe kwa London, se abetswe terofi ya maemo a a kwa godimo ka ntlha ya bojalwa jwa bona jo bo bogale jwa porenti e e titieletsweng sebaka sa dingwaga di le 12 ka fa nkgong.
tgt: Le phaneli ibandakanya abameli abavela kuMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi, uMbutho waMazwe aManyaneyo ezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye nezeNkcubeko, i-Teacher Task Force, uManyano looTishala kwiHlabathi jikelele (i-Global Teachers Union) kunye nabaPhathiswa abathathu bezemfundo.

src: Merero ya ga Jaanong Bagale ba Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 Kabinete e akgotse setlhopha sa di-Springbok jaaka se fentse Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 mme phenyo eno e dirile gore Aforika Borwa e nne yona naga e le esi mo lefatsheng go ka fenya makgetlo a le mane Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi mme e bile gape setlhopha seno se fentse sejana seno ka tlhomagano makgetlo a le mabedi.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni IiNtshatsheli zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivuyisene neqela lama-Springboks kwimpumelelo yalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 eyenze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilizwe ekukuphela kwalo ukuphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo amaxesha amane (4) kunye nelesibini ukuyiphumelela amaxesha elandelelana.

src: Fa e sale go nna le rakabi mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa setlhopha seno sa di-Springbok ke sona sa ntlha se se emetsweng ke batshameki ba merafe e e farologaneng ya naga ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Kwimbali yebhola yombhoxo eMzantsi Afrika, eli qela le-Springboks lelona lineyantlukwano ngokwentlanga eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Gore setlhopha seno se rulaganngwe ka mokgwa o se leng ka ona ga se ka ntlha ya lesego, ke ka ntlha ya ditshweetso tse di totobetseng tse balaodi le bakatisi ba di tsereng ba butse matlho mo ba neng ba batla gore di-Springbok di emelwe ke setlhopha sa merafe e e farologaneng.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweqela elineyantlukwano enjalo ibingesosenzo sebhaqo, kodwa ibingumzamo wangabom wabaphathi kunye nabasebenzi abaqeqeshayo be-Springboks abaye bakhetha iqela eliquka zonke iintlanga.

src: Tshweetso e e nonofileng e e tserweng ke mokatisi wa mo malobeng Rassie Erasmus mmogo le setlhopha se se neng se mo eme nokeng e tswelela go iponagatsa mo go maAforika Borwa le mo lefatsheng ka bophara gore motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a nang le bokgoni, fa a ka neelwa tšhono le go enngwa nokeng, a ka kgona go ntsha ga tshwene – mme seno ke bontlha bongwe jo bo totobatsang boammaruri jwa gore Re le Ngatananngwe ga go se se ka re Tsenang fa Gare.
tgt: Eso sigqibo sokuthatha umngcipheko somqeqeshi welo xesha u-Rassie Erasmus kunye neqela lakhe sisaqhuba ukubonisa abantu baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokubanzi, ukuba wonke umntu onesakhono, xa enikwe ithuba nenkxaso, angagqwesa – oku kusisiqiniseko sokuba soMelele xa Sikunye.

src: Se se botlhokwa go gaisa ke ka fao batshameki ba di-Springbok ba neng ba kakatletse ka teng mo lebaleng fa ba ne ba tshameka e leng sesupo sa go nna moAforika Borwa tota, e leng sona se se dirang gore naga eno ya baganka e atlege le go finyelela le fa e tobane le dikgwetlho tsa dinta di fuduga.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukunyamezela kunye nokuzimisela kwe-Springboks kwibala lezemidlalo ngumfuziselo wokuba ngumNtu waseMzantsi Afrika wokwenene, oko okwenza ukuba esi sizwe sikhulu kangaka silwe noloyiso nangona sijongene neenzingo, ekugqibeleni siphume soyisile.

src: Ba bangwe ba batshameki ba ba dirileng bontle mo setlhopheng seno sa di-Springbok ba ne ba itshokela dikgwetlho mo matshelong a bona gore ba kgone go atlega.
tgt: Abathile kwabona badlali bagqwesileyo beli qela le-Springboks kuye kwafuneka endleleni yabo ebhekise empumelelweni boyise iinzingo zobomi babo.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa setlhopha sa di-Springbok sa go fenya gabedi ka tatelano Sejana sa Lefatshe jaaka a eteletse kwa pele setlhopha seno gore se kgone go fenya maemo a a iseng a tle a bonwe mme ka ntlha ya seno re tshwanetse go se kgaotse go keteka tiro e ntle eno.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuvuyisana kwayo noSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, ikapteni ebikhokele i-Springboks iqela eliphumelele iNdebe yeHlabathi kabini ngokulandelelana de labe lifikelela kwiwonga lokuba liqela eliphambili elake Laba liKhulu ngeXesha lalo i-Greatest of All Time (i-GOAT) mayiqhube ke imibhiyozo.

src: Kopano ya AGOA Kabinete e neseditse pula mafoko a puso ya Amerika mmogo le a palamente ya yona a go totobatsa gore ba ikemiseditse go oketsa nako ya go nna mo tirisong ga Molao wa Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA), mme seno se tla digela matswalo a bao ba batlang go ka beeletsa mo dinageng tse di nang le matshwanedi a go unngwelwa ke AGOKabinete e neseditse pula gape le go neelwa tetla ya go tshwara Kopano ya AGOA ya 2023 kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023 mme e tla tsenelwa ke bannaleseabe go tswa kwa dinageng di le 32 tsa Aforika mo maphateng a puso, kgwebo, mme lekgetlho la ntlha fa e sale go tla bo go na le mekgatlho ya baagi le mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le batlhankedi ba puso ya naga ya Amerika.
tgt: I-Forum ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi isamkele isiqinisekiso esisuka kulawulo lwase-United States kunye nenkongolo esimalunga nenjongo yokolula i-AGOA, nto leyo izisa isiqinisekiso kuluntu lotyalomali kumazwe afanelekileyo ukuxhamla kwi-AGOKanajalo iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kwe-forum ye-AGOA yama-2023 ebibanjelwe e-Johannesburg ngomhla we-2 ukuya mhla we-4 kweyeNkanga 2023 nebizinyaswe ngabathathi nxaxheba abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika angama-32 avela kurhulumente, uShishino, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nabezemisebenzi ebebehambele lo msitho okokuqala kuquka kunye nabameli bakarhulumente wase-United States.

src: Kabinete ga e a bolo go ema ka lefoko le le reng AGOA e naya Amerika tšhono ya go ka ema ka dintsetsenkwano go thusa ikonomi ya Aforika mme ka jalo go matshwanedi gore e okelediwe nako gore e nne mo tirisong sebaka se se utlwagalang, mme e atlaatlhiwe gore e kgone go nna le seabe se se utlwagalang mmogo le go ngokela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ikuqinisekisa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela i-United States of America ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bayo bezoqoqosho ne-Afrika yiloo nto ke kufuneka le AGOA yolulwe ukuze ibenethuba eloneleyo lokuthela iziqhamo, kwaye yenziwe luqilima ukuze ibe neempembelelo ezintle kananjalo ibenawo nomtsalane.

src: Kopano ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go garela ka katlego Kopano ya Ngwaga wa 2023 ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa, mme kopano eno e lopile dinaga tse e leng leloko go oketsa tirisanommogo ya tsona ka go rotloetsa go jelana nala ga batho ba dinaga tsa BRICS, go aga mebila gore go etelana le go golagana ga dinaga tse e leng leloko e nne selo se se botlhofo.
tgt: INtlanganiso yobaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqukunjelwa ngempumelelo kweNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS yama-2023 ebibanjelwe eKapa, apho amazwe angamalungu azibophelele kwintsebenziswano enzulu kunye nasekukhuthazeni ukhenketho phakathi kwi-BRICS, ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokuhamba nonxulumano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Seno se tla gagamatsa lephata la bojanala la naga ya Aforika Borwa jaaka le setse le ntse le itharabologelwa.
tgt: Oku kuza komeleza nangakumbi icandelo lezokhenketho laseMzantsi Afrika esele libonisa iimpawu zokuvuka ke noko.

src: Mo dikgweding di le robedi tsa ntlha tsa ngwaga wa 2023, re bone ka fa nageng go goroga bajanala ba le dimilione di le tlhano le halofo mme palo eno e lekana le koketsego ya bokana ka diphesente di le 63.4% go tloga mo go tsa yona paka eno mo ngwageng wa 2022.
tgt: Kwiinyanga ezisi-8 zokuqala zika-2023, ilizwe lamkele i-5.5 yezigidi zabantu abafikayo oko okubonakalise ukonyuka ngama-63.4% xa kuthelekiswa neli thuba linye lango-2022.

src: Go Ikwadisetsa go Tlhopha Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC) e tsibositse gore ka la bo 18 le la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2023 e tla bo e le matsatsi a bokhutlho jwa beke jwa ntlha a go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa ngwaga wa 2024.
tgt: UkuBhalisela ukuVota I-IEC yabhengeza umhla we-18 nowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023 njengempelaveki yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo bathong botlhe ba ba nang le matshwanedi a go tlhopha go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa ngwaga wa 2024 ka go leba kwa mafelong a ditlhopho a mo metseng ya bona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuba babhalisele ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024 kwizikhululo zokuvota ezikufutshane nabo.

src: Serala sa go ikwadisetsa ditlhopho ka inthanete ga se a bolo go bula ka Tlhakole 2023 mme baagi go ikuelwa mo go bona go sola mosola serala seno ka go ikwadisa mo go sona kgotsa ka go tsenya dintlha tsa bona mo dinakong.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota nge-intanethi kuvulwe ukususela ngeyoMdumba wama-2023 kwaye abemi bayabongozwa ukuba basebenzise esi sibonelelo ukubhalisa okanye ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabo.

src: MaAforika Borwa a a dirileng dikopo tsa makwaloitshupo go ikuelwa mo go bona go leba kwa dikantorong tsa Merero ya Selegae go di lata.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abafake izicelo zabo zee-ID bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazilande ngokuthi batyelele i-Ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.

src: Go santse go na le makwaloitshupo a feta a le 500 000 a a santseng a tlhoka beng ba ona go tla go a tsaya kwa dikantorong ya Merero ya Selegae go ralala le naga ka bophara.
tgt: Angaphezulu kwama-500 000 amakhadi ee-ID ekusafuneka ukuba ayolandwa kwii-ofisi zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya elizweni ngokubanzi.

src: Motlakase Tona mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente e e rweleng maikarabelo mo kantorong ya Tona ya Merero ya Motlakase o buile go tlala molomo ka maemo a motlakase ka fa nageng.
tgt: Umbane UMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli onoxanduva lokujonga imicimbi yezoMbane unike amagqabantshintshi abanzi ngemeko yombane elizweni.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Puso ya Porofense ya Gauteng jaaka e dirisana le setlamo sa Eskom gore ba busetse motlakase kwa mafelong a a kgaoletsweng motlakase a kwa Gauteng ka ntlha ya go utswiwa kgotsa go senyega ga diteransefomara tsa motlakase.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabele izandla iinzame zikaRhulumente wePhondo lase-Gauteng zokusebenza ne-Eskom ukubuyisela umbane kwimimandla yase-Gauteng ebithwaxwa kukucima kombane ngenxa yokwebiwa okanye umonakalo kwizixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane.

src: Maabane bosigo go letswe go tshumilwe diteransefomara tsa motlakase tse dintšhwa di le thataro kwa Kagiso, mo kgaolong ya West Rand morago ga gore baagi ba foo ba fetse dingwaga di le tharo ba se na motlakase.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, kuye kwalayitwa izixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane ezithandathu eKagiso, kummandla weNtshona Randi emva kokuba uluntu lwashiyeka lungenambane isithuba esingaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging bano go tlhokomela mafaratlhatlha ano a a botlhokwa gore a se utswiwe ke magodu, ba se a senye bona ka bo bona ka ntlha ya fa ba batla go itsenyetsa motlakase go se mo molaong.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema olu luntu ukuba luzikhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo ekwebiweni, ekonakalisweni kunye nomonakalo obangelwa luqhagamshelo olungekho mthethweni.

src: Dijo tse di nang le botlhole Kabinete e tshwenyegile thata ka dintsho tse di ganang go fela tsa bana ba ba nnye ba ba fetsang ke dijo tse di feletsweng ke nako le tse di kgotlhelegileng tse ba di rekang kwa mabentleleng a di-spaza le mo bathong ba ba rekisang mo mebileng.
tgt: UkuTyhefeka kokuTya IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindlela ekonyuke ngayo iziganeko zabantwana abatya ityhefu ngenxa yokutya ukutya okuphelelwe lixesha kunye nokutya okungcolisekileyo kwasespaza kunye nokwabathengisi basesitalatweni.

src: Kabinete e tiisitswe maatla ke dikgato tse ditheo tsa molao di di tsereng mo go direng gore go obamelwe melao e e buang ka tlhokomelo ya dijo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazwa ziinzame ezenziwa ngabanyanzelisi bomthetho zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko ekutyeni.

src: Kopano ya go Tlhatlhelela Dimeyara le Magosi ka Phudugelo ya Baditšhaba Kabinete e tsibositswe ka Kopano ya go Tlhatlhelela Dimeyara le Magosi ka Phudugelo ya Baditšhaba e e neng e tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae mo Lefapha la Thuso ya Dikgwebopotlana (DSBD), la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), le la Bonno jwa Batho ba nnileng le seabe mmogo le magosi le dimeyara tsa diteropokgolo le tsa dikgaolo ba atlhaatlhileng kgang ya gore ba ka fokotsa jang ditiragalo tsa batho ba ba tlang ka fa nageng go se mo molaong, mmogo le ona mabenkele a di-spaza.
tgt: INtlanganiso yeeNgxoxo nooSodolophu kunye neenkokeli zeMveli ngeMfuduko yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi malunga nentlanganiso yeengxoxo ngemfuduko yehlabathi eyayisingethwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngothatho nxaxheba lwe-DSBD, i-COGTA, iSebe leeNdawo zokuHlaliswa kwabaNtu kunye neenkokeli zemveli noosodolophu abavela koomasipala abambhaxa kunye nabezithili eyayijolise ekunqandeni iziphumo zemfuduko engekho mthethweni, kuquka noshishino lwezipaza.

src: Dintlha tse di botlhokwa tse di tswileng foo ke go tsenya tirisong matsholo a sekaseka mabenkele go bona gore a obamela melao ya dimasepala le ya magosi.
tgt: Iziphumo ezingundoqo ziquka ukwaziswa kwemithetho equka konke kamasipala ukuze ithathele ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene nokunyanzeliswa kokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yendawo inyanzeliswa ngoomasipala kunye nabasemagunyeni kulawulo lwemveli.

src: Go tla simololwa ka gangwe matsholo a go phuruphutsa dikgwebo, segolobogolo dikgwebo tsa di-spaza mme tiro eno e tla diriwa ke ba lefapha la merero ya ditiro, la boitekanelo, la thuso ya dikgwebopotlana mmogo le la merero ya selegae leo le tla bong le emetswe ke batlhankedi ba go phuruphutsa ditokomane tsa go tsena ka fa nageng, mme seno se tla dira bonnete jwa gore go ikobelwa melao ya naga e e leng teng.
tgt: Kuza kubakho uhlolo nophando olukhawulezileyo oluza kuqhutywa ngokuhlanganyelweyo lokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yamashishini, ingakumbi izipaza lisebe lezemisebenzi, elezempilo, elophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci kunye namaqela ahlola imfuduko eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ukunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho elindelekileyo kumashishini.

src: Go tla tsewa dikgato tsa go sekaseka mabentlele a di-spaza a a butsweng kwa metseselegaeng le kwa makeišeneng, mme go tla nna le ditsela tse di tsenngwang tirisong tsa go kwadisa dikgwebo tseno mo dikantorong tsa magosi kgotsa tsa dimasepala.
tgt: Ukuphicothwa kwezipaza ezilalini nasezilokishini, kunye neendlela zokuzibhalisa ezingasetyenziswa ziinkokeli zemveli kunye noomasipala nako kuza kwenziwa.

src: Go na gape le dikgato tsa go ema nokeng ditshwetso tsa gore magosi a nne le rekoto ya gore batho ba ba nnang foo ba tswa kwa dinageng tsa kwa ntle ke bo mang.
tgt: Kukwakho neenzame zokuxhasa oogunyaziwe bemveli ukuba bagcine uluhlu lwamagama abemi bangaphandle kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Go samaganwe le go kwalola sešwa molao wa go rebola dilaesense tsa dikgwebo gore o kgone go ema nokeng batho botlhe ba ba batlang go simolola dikgwebo tse di sa kwadisiwang.
tgt: Kulungiswa umthetho wokunikwa kwelayisenisi kumashishini ngelo kuxhasa bonke abo banqwenela ukurhweba kwicandelo lweshishini elingekho sikweni.

src: Letsholo le le Tshwaraganetsweng la go Lwantshana le Bosenyi Kabinete e akgotse Tirelo ya Mapodisi a Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka tsela eo e phuagantseng ditiragalo tsa digongwana tsa bogodu tsa go gweba ka diritibatse ka ntlha ya go utolola le go thopa diritibatsi tse di ka balelwang go R80 milione ka la bo 20 Diphalane 2023 kwa lefelong la go tlhokomela dithoto la Dube Trade Port kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Difofane tsa Boditšhabatšhaba jwa King Shaka.
tgt: UMlo woLwaphulomthetho oHlanganyelweyo IKhabhinethi iyincomile i-SAPS ngokufumana iqela elithubelezisa iziyobisi kumazwe angaphandle kulandela ukufunyanwa kwe-cocaine exabisa ama-R80 ezigidi ebanjwe ngowama-20 kweyeDwarha 2023 kumzi wokugcina impahla i-Dube Trade Port kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Matsatsi a le mabedi pele ga letsatsi leno go ne go letswe go tshwerwe diritibatsi tse dingwe gape tsa khokheini tse di ka balelwang go R70 milione mo lefelong la go tlhokomela dithoto la Durban Harbour.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini eziphambi koku, kubanjwe enye i-cocaine exabisa ama-R70 ezigidi kwiZibuko laseThekwini.

src: Kabinete e akgotse SAPS ka tiro e ba e dirileng mo go latlhiseng motlhala bosenyi jo bo tsamaisanang le magodu a dinaga tsa boditšhaba jaaka seno se wisetsa baagi ba rona le naga ya rona ka digegi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqhwabela izandla i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wayo ekuphazamiseni kunye nasekunqandeni ulwaphulomthetho oluququzelelweyo lwamazwe amaninzi olusisigrogriso esikhulu kwiindawo zethu esihlala kuzo nakwisizwe siphela.

src: Letsholo la Tshireletsego mo Pakeng ya Matsatsi a Dikeresemose le setse le re tswela mosola mo re boneng mapodisi a golega babelaelwa ba feta ba le 140, go tsenyeletsa le mmelaelwa yo a latofadiwang ka gore ke ene komang ka nna wa ditiragalo tsa bogodu jwa dirašwa, mmogo le go thopa ditlhobolo tse di seng mo molaong.
tgt: IPhulo le-Operation Safer Festive Season sele liveza iziphumo ngamapolisa abambe ngaphezulu kwe-140 yabarhanelwa, kuquka norhanelwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwemigodi okungekho mthethweni, kunye nokuthathwa kwemipu engenazilayisenisi.

src: Leeto la Moporesitente la go Lekola Maemo Kabinete e neseditse pula Leeto la Moporesitente la go Lekola Maemo kwa Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, mme mo leetong leno Moporesitente o ne a ikgata motlhala morago ga gore a tsee leeto la ntlha la Leano la Tiragatso ya Kabo ya Ditirelo le le Ikaegileng ka Ditikologo mo ngwageng wa 2022.
tgt: UTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ukujonga iziphumo zothetha-thethwano zendibano noluntu elalibanjwe ngo-2022 kwiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili.

src: Mo leetong la ngwaga wa 2022 kwa Emfuleni go nopotswe dikgwetlho tse di tsamaisanang le masepala jaaka o sa tlhokomele mafaratlhatlha.
tgt: Utyelelo luka-2022 Emfuleni lwachonga imiba yokungalungiswa kakuhle kweziseko zophuhliso ngumasipala.

src: Ka ntlha ya go thusiwa ke Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, jaanong go na le ponelopele ya gore go lebilwe kae mo go rarabololeng matsapa a metsi le kgeleloleswe a a dirileng gore Bodutelo jwa go Tlhatswa Metsi a a Leswe jwa Vaal bo phutlhame.
tgt: Ngongenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kube khona inkqubela ebonakalayo ekuthatheleni ingqalelo imingeni yeziseko zophuhliso zamanzi nezogutyulo ekhokelele ekuweni kwenkqubo ye-Vaal Waste Water.

src: Go setse go simolotswe ka tiro ya go baakanya tlamelo ya metsi, go dira gore bodutelo jwa go tlhatswa metsi a a letswe bo dire ka tshwanelo le go fedisa matsapa a kgelelolese gore re se nne le mantle a a gasaganeng mo mebileng le mo malapeng a batho.
tgt: Sowuqalile umsebenzi wokuphukcula unikezelo lwamanzi, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweziseko zophuhliso zamanzi amdaka kwaye oko kuphelisa ingxaki yemibhobho ehambisa amanzi amdaka ebesele egxagxaza ezitalatweni nakwiiyadi zabantu.

src: Seo go bonagetseng e kete go na le kgatelopele mo teng ke dipeipi tse dikgolo tsa metsi mmogo le diteišene tsa dipompo tsa metsi, go tsosoloswa le go tshelwa ga dikontiri, mmogo le matsholo a magolo a go tsenya mabone mo mebileng gore go nne le lesedi le gore go nne le pabalesego.
tgt: Inkqubela eqatshelweyo kolu tyelelo iquka uphuculo kwimibhobho yamanzi emininzi kunye nakwizikhululo zeempompo zamanzi, ukulungiswa ngaphezulu kunye nokutywinwa kweendlela, kunye nokufakwa ngobuninzi kwezibane zasesitalatweni ngelokuphucula ukukhanya nokhuseleko.

src: Leano la Tsamaiso ya Dithoto la Ditlamo tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwa le setse le boloditse letsholo la go batla maikutlo a Ditlamo tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa tsa Tsamaiso ya Dithoto, jaaka seno e le karolo ya dikgato tse di tsewang go rarabolola dikgwetlho tse di tobaneng le lephata la tsamaiso ya dithoto mmogo le go matlafatsa maiteko a go busetsa sekeng maemo a ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa sekeng.
tgt: ISicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika ISebe lezoThutho liqalise iindibano kwiSicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika, njengenxenye yamanyathelo okuthathela ingqalelo imingeni ejongene necandelo lokuthuthwa kwempahla kunye nokomelezwa kweenzame zokubuyiselwa koqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kago le Tlhokomelo ya Mafaratlhatlha Kabinete e neseditse pula kgatelopele e e diriwang mabapi le go agiwa le go tlhokomelwa ga mafaratlhatlha mo go setseng go konoseditswe diporojeke tsa go agiwa ga maborogo a le 36 kwa metseselegaeng ka letsholo la Mborogo a Metseselegae la Welisizwe, mmogo le matsholo a go samaganweng nao a diporojeke di le 20 tsa go aga dintlo, ditsela le mafaratlhatlha a metsi.
tgt: UPhuhliso nokuGcinwa kweziSeko zoPhuhliso IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela eyenziweyo ngophuhliso kunye nokugcinwa kweziseko zophuhliso ngokugqitywa kweebhulorho zasezilalini ezingama-36 phantsi kwenkqubo yeWelisizwe Rural Bridges, kunye nokwakhiwa okuqalayo kweeprojekthi ezingama-20 kwiindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iindlela, namanzi.

src: Go Bulwa Sešwa ga Mebila ya go Leba kwa Dinageng tsa Boditšhabatšhaba ka Difofane tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bulwa Sešwa ga Mebila ya SAA go Leba kwa Dinageng tsa Boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le go busediwa tirong gape ga difofane tsa yona tsa mebila ya ka fa kontinenteng go leba kwa São Paulo, Brazil, mme seno se tshwaile gape le go busediwa tirong ga ditirelo tsa maeto a matelele a go tloga kwa Motse Kapa go leba kwa Johannesburg.
tgt: UkuPhehlelelwa ngokuTsha kweendlela zehlabathi zeQumrhu leeNqwelomoya loMzantsi Afrika (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa ngokutsha kweendlela zehlabathi ze-SAA ngokubuyiswa ngokutsha kwehambo yayo yenqwelomoya ehamba phakathi kwamazwekazi eya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, ephawule kananjalo ukubuya kwenkonzo ehamba ihambo ende esuka eKapa nase-Johannesburg.

src: Go busediwa tirong ga maeto a go leba kwa dinageng tsa boditšhabatšhaba ga SAA go tla nna le seabe mo go godiseng kgolo mo maetong a boditšhabatšhaba a go leba ka fa nageng, mmogo le go godisa lephata la bojanala go latela gore le phuaganngwe ke leroborobo la COVID-19.
tgt: Ukubuyela kwe-SAA kwiindlela zehlabathi kuza kufaka isandla ngqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula kokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi ezihamba kweli lizwe, kunye nokukhula kwecandelo lezokhenketho emva kokuba ligqugqiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: Aforika Borwa e Thankgolola Terouno e Kgolo go Gaisa tsa Dinaga tse Dingwe tsa Aforika Kabinete e akgotse Sesole sa yona mmogo le setlamo sa go aga difofane sa Milkor jaaka ba atlegile mo go thankgololeng sefofane se se okomelang maemo se le kwa godimo (UAV) se se bediwang Milkor 380, mme seno se raya gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya dinaga tse di ntshang ga tshwene fa go tla mo go thekenolojing ya difofane tsa diterouno.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphehlelela eyona drone inkulu e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ivuyisene noMkhosi kunye nenkampani yobuchwepheshe bokubhabha emoyeni kweenqwelomoya i-Milkor ngokuphehlelela kwabo ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okusisithuthi esizihambelayo emoyeni (i-UAV), oku kubeka uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubayo ukwenza imitsi emide kubuchwepheshe beenqwelomoya ezizihambela emoyeni ii-drone.

src: Milkor 380 ke terouno e kgolo e e iseng e tle e agiwe ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika mme e tla dirisiwa ke sesole mo dintweng, mo go diseng melelwane, mo go tlhokomeleng tlhago mmogo le mo go lwantshaneng le polao ya diphologolo tsa naga.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 yeyona drone inkulu eyakhiwe e-Afrika kwaye iza kusetyenziswa licandelo lezokhuselo ngeenjongo zokulwa, ulawulo lomda, ulondolozo lwendalo kuquka nokulwa ukuzingela okungekho mthethweni.

src: Ditlhatlhobo tsa Bokhutlho jwa Ngwaga mmogo le tsa Mameteriki Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke ditlhatlhobo tse di simolotseng sentle tsa Ngwaga wa 2023 tsa go Kwala Lekwalo la Naga la Dithuto tse Dikgolwane, mme tsona di simolotse ka la bo 30 Diphalane 2023.
tgt: Iimviwo zeMatriki kunye nezokuphela konyaka ezikolweni IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqala kakuhle kweemviwo zeSatifiketi esiPhezulu seSizwe (iMatriki) zama-2023, eziqale ngowama-30 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Batsadi le bagodisi ba bana ba rotloediwa go tswelela go ema barutwana nokeng mo pakeng e e botlhokwa eno.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini babantwana bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeleke nokuxhasa abafundi ngeli xesha libaluleke kangaka.

src: Kabinete e eletsa gape masego le barutwana ba bangwe botlhe ba ba tla bong ba kwala ditlhatlhobo tsa bona tsa bokhutlho jwa ngwaga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithumela iminqweno emihle kubo bonke abafundi abaza kuchophela iimviwo zabo zokuphela konyaka.

src: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Seemo sa kwa Palestina Kabinete e swabile nko go feta molomo ke maitsholo a puso ya Iseraele a go gana go ikobela melao ya lefatshe jaaka e tswelela go bontsha lenyatso le le feletseng mo ditshweetsong tse di tserweng ke Dinagakopano tsa go fedisa ntwa e e runtseng koo.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi IMeko yase-Palestine Idanile iKhabhinethi kukwala kukarhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuthobela umthetho wehlabathi kunye nokuqhubeka kwayo ijongela phantsi izigqibo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo zigqibo ezo ezifuna kubekwe phantsi izikhali ngaphandle kokohlwaywa.

src: Ditirelo tsa go thusa baagi ba Palestina ba ba leng mo tlalelong di santse di tswaleletswe ke puso ya Iseraele, mme seno ga se jese diwelang mo baneng, basading le mo baaging ba ba senang molato.
tgt: Iindlela zokunika uncedo kubantu base-Palestine zisavaliwe kuza neziphumo ezimbi ebantwaneni, abasetyhini nabemi abangenatyala.

src: Polao ya Mapalestina e kete ke ditshenekegi ba bolawa ka difofane ke puso ya Iseraele e santse e tswelela mo dipalo tsa batho ba ba bolawang di tlhatlogang e bile di tsenyeletsang basadi le bana.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olubulala abantu ngobuninzi olwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine, luyaqhuba lubonakala ngamanani okusweleka kwabantu anyukayo aquka abasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Mo matsatsing a le mabedi fela a a fetileng lefatshe le ne le itshwere ditlhogo le lebeletse difofane di tlhasela metse ya kwa Gaza le kwa West Bank mo go phampholotsweng dikolo, maokelo, dijanaga tsa balwetse le mafaratlhatlha a baagi mmogo le ditsela e leng dilo tse di neng di tshwanetse go bo di sa kgomiwe e bile di babalesegile ka ntlha ya fa e le dilo tse di sa tshwanelang go tlhaselwa kwa kgaolong ya Borwa jwa Gaza.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini ezidlulileyo, ihlabathi liye lahlala lijongile nje kungekhonto linokuyenza, njengoko uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olonyukayo lwase-Gaza nase-West Bank lutshabalalise izikolo, izibonelelo zempilo, iinqwelo zezigulane neziseko zophuhliso zabantu kunye nezo ndlela kuthiwa zikhuselekile eziya kuMzantsi we-Gaza.

src: Ka ntlha ya tiragalo eno, Kabinete e tsere tshweetso ya go laela diambasatara tsotlhe tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa go phuthaphutha sengwe le sengwe sa puso eno kwa Tel Aviv go boela gae gore ba tle go itlhalosa sentle gore matsapa di a tsaya kae.
tgt: Ngenxa yoku, iKhabhinethi igqibe ekubeni ibuyise bonke oonozakuzaku baseMzantsi Afrika abase-Tel Aviv ukuze kudityanwe nabo.

src: Kabinete e nopotse gape le dipuo tse di swabisang nko tse di tswang mo molomong wa moabasatara wa naga ya Iseraele tse di ka ga naga ya Aforika Borwa, e bong Rre Eliav Belotsercovsky, yo a buang kgattlhanong le Aforika Borwa, le boeteledipele jwa Aforika Borwa fa a bua a le mo maemong a gagwe a puso le fa a bua a sa emela maemo a gagwe a puso yo a ganetsang gore se se diriwang ke puso ya Iseraele mo baaging ba Palestina ga se tshwane le seo Puso ya Jeremane e kileng ya se dira baagi ba Majuta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele kananjalo ngokukhathazeka izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezenziwa ngunozakuzaku wakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika, uMnu Eliav Belotsercovsky, ezibhekisele kubantu baseMzantsi Afrika, ubunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kuquka uluntu ekuhlaleni oluthetha phandle ngokubulawa ngobuninzi kwabantu okwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine.

src: Dipuopuo tsa ga Moabasatara Belotsercovsky ga di tsamaisane ka gope le tseo di tswang mo melomong ya diambasatara di le pedi tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tsa Iseraele tse di neng di emetse naga ya tsona ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa (mme bona ke Illan Baruch mmogo le Ngaka Alon Liel) mme bona ba ne ba totobetse ka le le reng seo puso ya bona e se dirang mo go Mapalestina ga se farologane ka gope le seo puso ya tlhaolele e neng e se dira.
tgt: Ezi zimvo zinyhatshayo zikaNozakuzaku Belotsercovsky ziyaphikiswa ziingxelo zabo babengoonozakuzaku bakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika ababini (u-Illan Baruch noGqr Alon Liel) abo babengangungqi ekuchazeni izenzo zikarhulumente wabo ezichasene nabantu base-Palestine njengezenzo zengcindezelo.

src: Dipuopuo tsa moambasatara yono tse di emang kgatlhanong le bao ba ntshang maikutlo a bona ka seo se sa itumediseng seo se diriwang ke baeteledipele ba naga eo se dira gore go se tlhole go nna le pelotelele ya go itshokela moambasatara Belotsercovsky.
tgt: Izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezibhekiswe kwabo bathethela phandle kunye nakwiinkokeli zelizwe zenza isikhundla sikanozakuzaku Belotsercovsky singakhuseleki okanye angafumani khuseleko.

src: Mme ka ntlha ya seno, Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano le Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba go begela moamasatara yono semmuso ka fao puso ya Aforika Borwa e swabisiwang ke dipuopuo tsa gagwe mme e dire jalo ka go latela dikgato tsa semmuso tsa setipolomate.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi iyalele iSebe lezobuDlelwane beHlabathi neNtsebenziswano ukuba livakalise ukungoneliseki kukarhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ngalo nozakuzaku oko kuzakwenziwa kulandelwa amajelo ozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Puo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetsokabo ya Kgweditharo (MTBPS) Kabinete e neseditse pula MTBPS ya ngwaga wa 2023, e e neng e baya mo pepeneneng maemo a ikonomi a re leng mo go ona mme e bontshitse le ka fao puso e kakatletseng ka gone mo mererong ya matlole a naga le fa go ntse go le boima mo go direng letseno.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwomali leXesha eliPhakathi IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo yoHlahlo Lwabiwomali yeXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTBPS) yama-2023, enike uvavanyo olucacileyo lwemo yezoqoqosho ekhoyo ngoku kwaye yabonisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwemali yethu yelizwe ngurhulumente nangona ephakathi kwemiqobo enzima.

src: Ditshwetso tse di tserweng mo go MTBPS di tla tokafatsa matlole a rona, tsa godisa ikonomi mmogo le go re thusa gore re diragatse ditsholofetso tsa rona mo go tlhokomeleng baagi ba ba tlhokang ditlogo ka fa nageng.
tgt: Izigqibo ezikwi-MTBPS ziphucula inkqubosikhokelo yethu yezemali zivuselela ukukhula koqoqosho ngexa ingqinelanisa izibophelelo zethu zasekuhlaleni ezixhasa abo basesichengeni elizweni lethu.

src: Leano la Itharabologelo le Kagosešwa ya Ikonomi le thusitse dikarolo di le dintsi mo ikonoming ya rona.
tgt: ISicwangciso soKwakha ngokuTsha eMva kweNtlekele sibe negalelo kwiimpawu zokuqala zokuphucuka kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Go Agiwa ga Diterene tse di Tsamayang ka Lebelo Kabinete e neseditse pula Leano la go Tsamaisa Tiro ya Go Agiwa ga Diterene tse di Tsamayang ka Lebelo mme Tona ya Matlole mmogo le ya Dipalangwa ba tla atlhaatlha kgang ya gore go tla tlhokagala matlole a le kanakang.
tgt: UPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubosikhokelo yoPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu kwaye iimpembelelo zemali ekuphunyezweni koku kuza kuxoxwa ngazo phakathi kwabaPhathiswa owezoThutho nowezeMali.

src: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go simolola ka diporo tsa go tloga kwa Johannesburg go leba kwa Durban gore go diriwe dipatlisiso tse di tseneletseng tsa gore go ka tlhokagala eng, mmogo le tsa go tloga kwa Johannesburg go leba kwa Polokwane le go fetela kwa Musina, mmogo le tsa Johannesburg go leba kwa Mbombela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubekwa phambili komzila osuka e-Johannesburg uya eThekwini ngophononongo olucazululiweyo loko kunokwenzeka, kwaye osuka e-Johannesburg nase-Polokwane uya eMusina, kunye nosuka e-Johannesburg uya eMbombela ziza kubekwa emarikeni.

src: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka go Bona Ditshwanelo tsa go Nna Moagi, Mofaladi le Tlhokomelo ya Batho ba ba Tshabetseng ka fa Nageng Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go phasalatsa Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka go Bona Ditshwanelo tsa go Nna Moagi, Mofaladi le Tlhokomelo ya Batho ba ba Tshabetseng ka fa Nageng gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka ga sona.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo eliQulunqwayo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu ukuze ulunike izimvo uluntu.
